dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i ming gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi spo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang nab 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las dzi'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad kur stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin la legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhud sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che 〈zho//spungs 'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhid / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam bto ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang /deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang /dgon sde dang /spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang /mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing /lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du masang tsho'i las kur gdeng 'jog tshad med dang /ma nor lam ston/ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang /snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang /zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang /slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang /nga tsho'i las skar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o//ser ga khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'chos ba phyogs ga khang na /spyi lo 79lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes7la/

bsdo/sgrig gab55 bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin tshol yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb nyanas 4bar pod rtags (kan 6) rtogana' ) sto rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar bod rtags 6༄ 6) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) stergyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)snye bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos wo drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa snyel pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags 6)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (she (chen ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (0ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags rton)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtong)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/ lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin sgrib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/thog ma'i zhu dag dang /bskyar zhus/yang zhus/zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing /tshig phrad dang /lhag bcas/rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/mtshams la 'tshams/mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/med la smad/byung la 'byung /rang rkya la rang skya/grwa la gra slong la slong /rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/rig gnas la rigs gnas/rigs pa la rig pa/gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang /nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang /shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thogazhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang /mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o//༄ser la khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'tshor bas phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ ratna'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bande zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku zhakhrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dang rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsisadang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhug ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sdo khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa g.yin don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ka khuganang pa'i dbe rnying 'tshor bas phyog ga khang nas/10

dkar chagabastan pa'i rtsa ba rab byung dang khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i cho ga mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa 'khrul spong rnam rgyal gser mdog ces bya ba/ (1)'dul ba'i rnam bshad spyir bstan pa/ (5)gangs can ljongs su 'dul ba'i bstan pa ji ltar dar tshul/ (15)ma byin len gyi rin thang gi tshad bshad pa/ (yo)so thar sdom pa'i ngo bo dang dbye ba bshad pa/ (71)so thar sdom pa'i khyad chos bshad pa/ (76)rtsa lhung sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yin min la dpyad pa/ (77)khyim pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i so thar sdom pa'i bslab bya/ (80)zhan la bar ma rab byung gi bslab bya bshad pa/ 583)rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs kyi khyad par bshad pa/ (99)byin rlabs bshad pa/ (147)bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen zas bzhi bshad pa/ (173)gso sbyong gi gzhi bshad pa/ (188)'dul ba'i dus tshigs bshad pa/ (224)dge tshul slong gi sdom pa 'bogs chog bya tshul/ (248)dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga sogs bshad pa/ (262)tshigs phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i cho ga bshad pa/ (275)1

sngon chog dang da chog gi khyad par bshad pa/ (277)zhan byung khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga bshad pa/ (315)nyin zhag gcig tu bsrung ba'i bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa sogs bshad pa/ (323)mjug gi cho ga bshad pa/ (355)so thar gyi tshul khrims la dga' ba'i dpyod ldan tshogs la phan byed nyung ngu rnam gsal sgron ma/ (364)bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga lag len snying po bsdus pa/ 5385)yan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga'i lag len gyi snying po bsdus pa bsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba/ (387)chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba/ (393) mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (393)klad kyi don/ (395)gnas dang po khams bstan pa/ (403)'dus byas ming gi rnam grangs sogs nga mond pa/ (406)chos gsum gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa/ (407)rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa/ 5410)ldan min 'du byed bshad pa/ (412)chos phung gi ngo bo sogs bshad pa/ (417)gnas gnyis pa dbang po bstan pa/ (428)dbang po dbye ba bshad pa/ 5434)

'dus byas chos kyi skye tshul bshad pa/ (440)ldan min 'du byed bcu bzhi bshad pa/ (47)de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa/ 4461)gnas gsum pa 'jig rten bshad pa/ (466)sems kyi gnas pa bdun sogs bshad pa/ (469)skye gnas bzhi bshad pa/ (472)rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin bshad pa/ 5478)nyon mongs pa gsum dpes mtshon tshul sgo nas don bsdu ba/ (485)phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa/ (489)'dzam bu gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa/ (494)dmyal ba'i gnas bshad pa/ (496)lha rnams kyi gnas bshad pa/ (505)'gro ba rnams kyi lus tshe'i tshad bshad pa/ (508)3 bshad pa/ 4512)snod bcud khyad chos bshad pa/ (518)gnas bzhi pa las bstan pa/ (521)rig byed ma yin pa bye brag tu bshad pa/ (529)bsam gto zag med kyi sdom pa bshad pa/ (532)gzhi gang la brten nas 'thob tshul bshad pa/ (537)las kyi rnam grangs du ma bstan pa/ (545)dge rtsa gcod byed kyi las bshad pa/ (549)3

las gang gis 'bras bu gang 'grub tshul bshad pa/ kyi (551)las kyi rnam grangs gzhan bshad pa/ (554)gnas lnga pa phra rgyas bstan pa/ (566)nga rgyal dbye ba sogs bshad pa/ (572)phra rgyas bye brag tu bshad pa/ (576)dus gsum rnam bzhag ldan tshul/ (579)phra rgyas kyi rnam grangs sogs bshad pa/ (581)spong byed kyi gnyen po bshad pa/ (587)spangs pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes bshad pa/ (588)gnas drug pa lam dang gang zag bstan pa/ (595)lam gyi dmigs pa bshad pa/ 5598)lhag mthong sgom tshul bshad pa/ 5602)nges 'byed cha mthun gyi khyad chos bshad pa/ (604)bden pa mngon par mngon par rtogs pa bcu drug sgom tshul bshad pa/ (606)sa gang gis chags pa dang bral ba bshad pa/ (613)dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag bshad pa/ (614)dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi dbye ba sogs bshad pa/ (618)lam gyi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa/ (621)gnas bdun pa ye shes bstan pa/ (626)'thob tshul bshad pa/ (631)khyad par gyi chos bshad pa/ (634)

thun mong gi yon tan bshad pa/ (637)so so'i skye bo dang thun mong gi yon to bshad pa/ (639)mngon shes lnga po so sor bshad pa/ (yo0)gnas brgyad pa snyoms 'jug bstan pa/ 5yo4)snyoms 'jug yon tan gtan la dbab pa/ (644)bsam gtan gyi yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa/ (647)bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug sogs kyi khyad chos bshad pa/ (649)zhan byung thod rgal gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa/ (651)rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba bstan pa/ (657)mdzad byang / (660)
byu

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)ra༅༅//bstan pa'i rtsa ba rab byung dang khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i cho ga mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa 'khrul spong rnam rgyal gser mdog ces bya ba bzhugs so//mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/ngo mtshar dag zhing gzhan gyis bzung mthar ches cher gdul dka'i 'gro la rjes chags snying stobs mchog gis byang chub chen por thugs bskyed de//2na〉skye 'phags phal gyi khong du chud min bya dka' rlabs chen spyod pa dwangs mtshor 'khor lo'i yan lag can bzhin dga' mgur 'jug mdzad pas//2brdzogs sangs rgyas dpang sa lhas byas tshe yid srubs gdong dmad zas gtsang sras khyod mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan slar yang bdag sogs 'gro kun la//ldan po ngos mthong skal bzang mchosan ston zhes dung ba'i skad gsang phyogs bcur 'bod par glang po'i sna zhags lta bu'i phyag de gtsug tu khyongs//3ba'i 'dzin lang long 'khrigs las dbyar rnga dal bur sgrog tshe mdong mtha' sgro gshog zlum por bsgyur nas gar byed na//tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro mang rna ba bdud rtsir spyod pa dngosapo'i gshis der mtshar 'dzin byis blo ltar phra mod//'on te bdud snying bsregs pa'i bud shing 'di kos kun la rjes brtse bden gtam bser bur bskur zhes 'khyogs 'phyang bar//sems can bsam pa 'i khyad par mtha' klas sna tshogs 'jug sgo dbye ba'i gsung gis bdag blo'i the tshom dra ba chod//nye ring med par lus can yongs kyi snying la nyer sim thugs rje'i dri bsung dngar po'i ngad//mi phyed dad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung la bum/ 6po wa wapa'i rlung gis drangs tshe srid zhi'i tsha gdung rab bcil sman gyi mchog /sngon med tsandan rkang 'thung gcig pu ji lta ji snyed mngon sum gzigs pa'i ye shes che/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yis skye rgu'i yid kyi lcags khams bsgyur nas rgyud lnga'i 'gro 'dren nus byin rlobs/ /sngon dang da lta'i cho ga'i sgo nas ngur smrig gos kyis kun gsal mdog /mtshams sprin gzhen nu'i mdangs su spel mdzad skye 'phags dge 'dun mu thi la'i/ /chad med 'phreng mdzes skye rgu'i bsod nams thod du bcings par dga' ba'i gar/ /blta bar lha rnams yang yang rgyu bas go la'i sgang gshongs byung ngam snyam/ /gsol bzhi'i cho gas spong bdun tshul khrims yid bzhin nor/ /nyes tshogs dri bkrus bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pas/ /mngon mtho nges legs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs sgra gcan 'dzin/ /zung sogs rim byon bka' drin phung po (4na skong gis gzhal/ /gangs ljongs mong rtul smag rum so thar nyis/ /phan bde'i 'od dkar snang khyab sdom brtson che/ shwanta rakṣi ta yi snyan grags rnga/ /tshangs ris yul sa'i bar du brdungs min nam/ /de lta na'ang phyogs 'di'i 'gro'i/ /las nag smin pa'i dug rlangs kyis/ /'dul gzhung srog rtsa chad nye ba/ /gso ba'i bdud rtsi mdo med byung / /tshul der rang gar spyod pa gzu lum gyis/ /rnam dag bstan la bgrang byar 'os mi 'os/ /mig mangs rde'u'i rtse 'jor gangs ljongasakyi/ /mang dag mgo 'khor tshe 'di'i nyi ring 'phul/ shwaka seng 'phrin las sems can khams la 'jug pa'i rgyun po che/ /mi 'chad shā ri'i bu'i mched da smi ra pa'i bsod snyoms pa/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sdom rgyun nyal 'gros mngon gyur nyon mongs zhugs/ /dbal bcil bag yod lhung lhung sgra snyan 'phagasabod kun khyab mtshar/ /rlangs spyod na bun ra ri dang bral brtan mkhas gnyis ldan gangs can las/ /nyes med phun tshogs sdom gsum gaṅgā bod yul bstan pa'i chu gter cher/ /'bebs mkhas rdor byang sa lo rjes 'brangs blo gsal skal ldan shing rta che'i/ /rnam par thar la gzur gnas mtha' dag dad dung ba skru gyen du langs/ /stod smad kha cher bcas pa'i 'dul khrims nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal du sgrums pa yi/ /lcid kyis gnas brtan rngul chu star brgyus yal bor phra zhib bslab bya'i gnad rnams —2

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanakun/ /gtan la phab ste dzā ti'i me tog bkra nas shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab kyi bar/ /mtshams sprin gos (4ba)kyis khyab mdzad blo bzang grags pa nyi ma'i gnyen de slar byon tam/ khreng rta'i srol 'dzin rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dar ma rin cen sogs/ /rnam dpyod rdzings kyis sde snod chu gter pha mtha' rab brgal ba'i/ /mkhas bcun ded dpon gser sbyangs thod bcings brtag thabs dpyad yangs pas/ /bzhed srol 'byul med nor bu'i tshong zong 'dren rnams phyag gi yul/ /'dul mngon dka' ba'i gnasakun yongs 'grol rgyud mang glu/ /yang yang rna bar rab 'brol legs bshad gtam snyan pos/ /yid dbang kun dgar spyod mdzad 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs/ /dkon cog chos 'phel bka' drin dran tshe lag pad zum/ /gzod ma nyid nas sgo gsum bag yod lcags kyus snar btab chu lha'i bus/ /'chal ba'i dug gi dri ma kun sbyangs tshul gnas yan lag brgyad ldan du/ /bsgyur pas phra rgyas nad brgya drung 'byin sbyor 'dzin 'a po gsal nyer mkhas pa/ /rin cen bsod nams mchog tu grub khyod gangs can ljongs 'dir nye bar 'khor/ /gang gi zhabs sen 'od dmar rdul tshogs gtsug lhung ba'i//mod la srid wor e raṇḍa yi snying po bzhin/ /nges par 'byung bas bstan la rab zhugs yongs rdzogs drin/ /byang chub mchog gi bar du gzhal dka' yid dbang 'byogs/ /rnam dag cho ga'i sa bon mesatshig pa'i/ /lang long snye ma'i phung pog khugs brnyan tsam/ /tshigs gsum nos kyang bsrung sdom rags pa yi/ /lhung ba'i khur de yang srid phyi mar lci/ /mkhas snyan grags 'dod ma yin par/ /rdon kun grub bstan bskal ba'i (5na thar/ /gnas smon las choge zhabrul spong gi /rnam rgyal gser gyi mdog can spel/ zhes mkhas dbang da khri'i gtsug lag gi rjes su 'brangs te nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gi sgo nasabarjod pa rnam par dag pa'i tshigs su bcad pa spobs pa'i mgrin pa mthon por bteg pa sngon du 'gro bas skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni/ 'o skol gyi rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras po don kun grub pa ni drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo las/ ston pa 'di sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas shes rab dang snying rje'i stobs kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po bsags pa yin kyang bar skabs su las kyi dbang —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logegis dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad cig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ rang gi sdug bsngal la dpags te grogasal tshad med pa'i snying rje skyes nas gshin rje'i skyes bu a wa glang mgo dang sdig pa sbrul mgo la/'di'i khur kyang bdag gis 'khur bar ci gnang zhes zhus pas/ de dag khros te sems can rang rang gi las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa la khyod kyis ci byar yod ces zer nas lcags kyi tho lum mgo la bsnun pas che'i dus byas lha'i nang du skyes te lo mang por bde ba nyams su myong bar byas/ snying rje 'phel ba'i bdag rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pas rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe shākya thub pa chen po la/ gdugs/ mchil lham zung / rdza'i bum pa byi dor byas pa gsum phul/mgron bu lnga me tog gi tshul du gtor nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra sogs kyis thugs bskyed/ tshogs ni mdzod (5ba〉pas/ rnam gzigs mar me rin cen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung / /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ zhes rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan can du rgyal po'i sras gzhen nu brtson 'grus spyod du zhakhrungs pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po sogs sangs rgyas slob mar bcas pa la bsnyen bkur nas smon lam btab pa nas rin cen gtsug tor can gyi bar bdun khri lnga stong la grangs med dang po'i tshogs bsags/ de rjes tshong dpon shes rab bzang por gyur pa'i tshe/ rgyal po mdzes par snang ba'i pho brang 'dzam bu'i gser du sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag byon pa nas mar me mdzad kyi bar bdun khri drug stong la grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs bsags/ ston pa 'di gzhen nu chos kyi sprin du gyur pa'i tshe rgyal po dgra thub kyi pho brang grong khyer padmo can du sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas rnam gzigs la thug gi bar bdun khri bdun stong la grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs bsags pa'i mthar sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog tu sangs rgyas/ des bram ze'i khye'u bla mar sprul nas sangs rgyas 'od srungs la bsnyen bkur zhing dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar por gyur nas chos bstan/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs su grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad cing / grangs med dang por sa dang po man/ /gnyis par ring du song ba —4

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)man/gsum par dag pa sa gsum zhes grags kyang theg dman gyi skabs su grangs medagasum ga tshogasalam 6na ) gyi gnas skabs su rdzogs par 'dod/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i nang tshan/lung gzhi las/byang chub sems dpa' lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes nas lo drug dka' ba spyod par 'gyur te/de nas bdud rtsi rtogs par mthong ngo //zhes dbus 'gyur lang rdo rje'i gdan gyi spor//zor ba'i gdan la skyil mo krung gcig gis chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal te/mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhir yul wa rā ṇa sir sangs rgyas stong gi khri yod par bzhi pa'i steng du bzhugs nas lnga sde la sogs mtha' yas pa'i gdul byar chos kyi 'bor lo bskor ba'i nang nas slob dpon chos kyi kṣe dpon gyis/ji ltar 'di ni shing rtsa gtso bo ste//rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis kyi gzhi//de bzhin dam chos tshogos rnams kun gyi yang /khyu dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/zhes dang /rgyal ba ston pa de yi dam chos dag/mdo dang chos ma rga yin gsungs 'dul ba ni//ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir//gnyisagyur phyag byas sangs rgyas da gcig bzhin//zhes ma cane pa dang mdo sde'i sde snod kyis bstan pa'i go chod kyang ston pa'i go mi chod/'dul ba'i sde snod kyis gnyis ka zhi go chod pa'i phyir legs par gsungs pa dam pa'i chos lung sdo bzhi bka' stsal ba'i brjod don 'dul ba'i rnam bshad spyir bstan pa/'dul ba'i rnam bshad spyir bstan pa/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen gyi 'dul ṭīka 'dul ba'i snying po rab tu gsal ba'i gzhi smad kyi rnam bshad las/dbye 6ba tha/bsdu ba/mtshan nyid/go rim/grangs nges/sgra don dang drug go/dang po ni/lung las/rab byung gso sbyong gzhi dang ni//dgag dbye dbyar dang ko lngags dang //sman dang gos dang sra brkyang dang //ko sha zhi dang las kyi gzhi//dmar ser can dang gang zag dang //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gespo dang gso sbyong bzhag pa dang / /gnas mal dang ni rtsod pa dang / /dge 'dun dbyen rnams bsdus pa yin/ zhes pa ltar bcu bdun no/ /bsdu na/ rab byung gi gzhi'i sum cha dang / las dang gnas mal gyi chos ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang / /phyir 'chos kyi gzhi bdun dang / /las kyi chos nyams na phyir 'chos pa dang / lhag ma rnams kyis thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba ste gsum du'ang 'du la/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i dang / bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi dang / thams cad 'grub pa'i dang / phyir bcos pa'i dang / thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i gzhi ste lngar bsdu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'jug ldog gnyis kyi nang nas dang po gtso bor gyur pa'i tshul khrims ni brjod bya'i dang / de ston byed ni rjod byed kyi gzhi'i mtshan nyid do/ /bzhi pa ni/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang / thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang / nyams na phyir 'chos pa rnams rab byung gi gzhi dang /bar skabs na shas che ba'i gzhi brgyad dang / /tha mar shas che ba'i bdun rnams kyis ston pas phal cher rgyu gos kyi go rim mo/ /gnyis pa la mi nyams par bsrung ba la/ gso sbyong dang por bstan pa ni spyir bsrung thabs lnga'i gang zag gzhan la brten pa dang / rang gi bsam pa'i (7na tshe stobs bskyed pa dang mi mthun phyogs ngo shes pas bsrung ba gsum/ rab byung bzhi dang rnam 'byed kyis bstan zin pas/ da ni bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i dang / bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba gnyis yin la/ de gnyis kyi nang nas dang po gtso bo yin cing / de la yang rang stobs kyis bslab pa sbyong ba gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i 'og tu gzhan stobs kyis spyong ba dbyar dang dgag dbyes byed la/ de yang lung las dgag dbye sngon la gsungs kyang bstan bcos las dbyar dgag dbye'i rgyu yin pa la dgongs nas dbyar dang por bshad do/ /rkyen gnyis pa la yang lung las sman dang por gsungs kyang de bder gnas rkyen gyi gtso bo yin pas 'dir 'og tu bstan la/ gos gzhi gsum la yang lung las ko lpags dang por bstan kyang /sra brkyang ni rgyu dgag dbye dang 'brel zhing gos 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas dang / de las gos dngos —6

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / 9)'byung bas dang / de'i dmigs bsal yin pas 'dir rim pa bzhin no/ /las kyi gzhi ni ma thob pa thob par byed pa sogs gsum ga la dgos pas kun gyi dbus su'o/ /phyir bcos la lhung ba phyir bcos gtso bo dang / rtsod pa phyir bcos cha lag yin pas lhung ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi bzhi dang por dang rtsod pa phyir bcos kyi gzhi gsum 'og tu bstan no/ /dang po la yang rang stobs dang gzhan stobs kyi phyir 'chos pa gnyis mchog dman yod pas/ dang po la gsum/ dang po dang gnyis pa yongs su sbyang ba'i gzhi 'og tu bstan/ (7bskong po gsum yang lus lta bu yin pas dang / de la 'chab pa dang mi ldan pa dgos shing 'chab pa gang la 'byung ba shes pa'i thabs yin pas dang / 'chab nyes de 'dag byed yin pas rim pa ltar ro/ /rtsod pa phyir bcos la bya ba'i rang bzhi dang / dge sbyong gi tshul dang /lhung ba'i rang bzhin rnams rtsod pa gsum yin la/ de yang lung las/ las bye ba'i gzhi mjug tu bshad kyang / 'dir lhung ba phyir bcos kyi gleng dran byas pa na las dang spyod pa tha dad du 'gyur bas de bsdum pa la dang / de la brten nas lta ba tha dad du 'gyur bas de bsdum pa la dang / de la brten nas kha na ma tho ba dang bcas par gyur na de bsdum pa la las bya ba'i gzhi la sogs pa gsum rim pa ltar rigs pas go rim de ltar bshad do/ /gnas mal gyi gzhi ni lung las rtsod pa'i gong du gsungs kyang thams cad kyi rten lta bu yin pas 'dir mjug tu bshad do/ /grangs nges pa ni/ gang zag gcig gis ma rga mtho dang nges legs kyi bde ba thob par byed pa la dang por bstan pa la ma zhugs pa 'jug zhugs nas bslab pa bsrung nyams na phyir 'chos pa rnams dgos pas gzhi bcu bdun las nyungs na mi 'dus shing / de tsam gyis dgos pa de phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bas mang mi dgos pa yin no/ /sgra don ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa phun sum tshogs pa nyid du sgrub pa'i rten nam gzhir gyur pas gzhi zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don gyi gnas la 'khrugs sdebs dang go rim legs par (8na gi sungs/ 'di nyid snying por bzung ste bshad pa la/ sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa/ thob pa mi nyams pa bsrung bar byed pa/ nyams len phyir 7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobacos pa'i thabs dang gsum du bsdus pa'i sdom pa thob par byed pa'i thabs la/ ji ltar byung tshul/de dag gi dogs gnas la mtha' dpyad pa/ cho ga'i lag len dngos/ zhan byung khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i cho ga dang bzhi/dang po ni/ lung ma mo las/ bsnyen par rdzogs par 'os pa rnam pa bcu'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rang byung dang / rang sangs rgyas slob dpon med par bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / lnga po rnams ye shes khong du chud pas dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs chen po ston par khas blangs pas dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ldan dris nas lung bstan pas dang / dge slong tshur shog ces gsungs pas dang / skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig gsum gyis dang / yul mtha' 'khob tu 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang lnga'i dge 'dun las dang / yul dbus su bcu 'dus pa'am de bas lhag pa las dang / bla ma'i cho so khas blangs pas dang /pho nyas dang / dge 'dun sde gnyis las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i yul dbus dang mtha' 'khob tu dge 'dun grangs bstan pa gnyis dang / mchod sbyin mas/ yin byung du bstan pa pho nya dang /dge 'dun sde gnyis ma gtogs pa'i gzhan rnams ni srid pa tha ma pa'i gang zag rnams la cho ga dang dge 'dun la ma bltos par bsnyen par rdzogs pas sgra yangs pa'i (8ba po bang du byas na sngon chog tu bgrang du rung mod/ sngon chog dang / dar chog gnyis su zlas phye ba'i sngon chog ni min no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan stag tshang lo tsā ba'i 'dul ṭīka tu sangs rgyas rang thong dang / rang rgyal mkhan slob med par dang /lnga sde nges pa la 'jug pas dang / bzang sde'i tshogs skyabs gsum khas len gyis dang / shā ri'i bu sogs tshun shog gis dang / 'od srungs ston par khas len gyis dang / legs sbyin nam/ su dwa ya ni dri bas mnyes pas dang / mchod sbyin ma 'phrin gyis dang / skye rgu'i bdag mo sogs lci ba'i chos khasablangs pas dang / /yul dbus su bcu dang / mtha' 'khob tu lnga'i tshogs kyis bsnyen par rdzogs zhesalung rtsa 'grel/ mdzod 'grel/ me rtag 'phreng rgyud rnams su gsungs pa rnams la snga ma phal cher sngon chog bcu'i tha snyad byas nas de dag la rang byung ma gtogs dbye bsdu sogs kyi bshad pa mdzad pa ni —8

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanami rigs te/ dang po gnyis la gzhan gyi rig byed tsam yang med la/ brgyad pa da ltar gyi cho ga yin par gleng gzhis nges shing / gzhan dgu pa yan chod rnams la'ang rang don gyi sngags lan gsum brjod pa yang ji bzhin med la/ bcu pa la'ang sngon dang da ltar gyi cha gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir dang / de rnams bshad pa'i lung de rnams las kyang bye brag smra ba'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i tshul bcu zhes gsungs kyi/ sngon chog gi tha snyad ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ni legs bshad chen por snang zhing / mchod sbyin ma 'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong chud kyi skor (9na〉pa kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i 'dul ba'i dka' gnas la dpyad pa lung rigs nor bu'i them skas las mchod sbyin ma lta bu 'phrin chog las rdzogs pa'i tshe/ sngar dge 'dun gyis gsol bzhi'i cho ga mdzad pa'i brjod pa tha ma'i cha gsum pa la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa ma thob par/ de nyid kyi 'phrin utpa la'i mdog can gyis mchode sbyin ma'i rna bar btang ba las bsnyen par rdzogs pa yin no/ /zhesakhas blang snyam mo/ /de la'ang dpyod ldan dag na re/ 'o na 'phrin chog las bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa'i mchod sbyin ma chos can/ khyod dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod gsol bzhi'i cho ga las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ khyod dge 'dun dang gang zag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i gang zag tsam las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod utpa la'i mdog can las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de 'dra'i 'phrin chog las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir zer na/ gong der ma khyab ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa'i mchod sbyin ma de rgyud nas dge 'dun la rdzogs pa yin kyang / ngos su ༄ la'i mdog can las rdzogs pa yin zhes khas blang ngo / /de la kho na re/ mchod sbyin ma 'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga chos can/ khyod sngon chog yin par thal/ khyod rab dbye las/ de bas dge slong byed pa la/ /rang byung gi ni bsnyen rdzogasadang / /ye shes khong du chud pa (9brkong / /de bzhin ston par khas blang dang / /'phrin gyis bsnyen —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logepar rdzogs pa dang / /tshur shog la sogs bsnyen rdzogs blang / /'khrul pa yin pa mnyam po la/ /'di rnams sngon gyi cho gar bshad/ ces pa'i tshig zur gyis/ 'di rnams sngon gyi cho gar bshad/ khes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi cho ga yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod 'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi cho ga yin pa'i phyir te/ /chos can yin pa'i phyir zer na/ gong der ma khyab/ gzhung des ni 'phrin chog de sngon chog dang dar chog gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sngon chog tu bstan pa min gyi sngon gyi gang zag skal ldan 'ga' zhig la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga tsam yin zhes bstan pa yin pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin du rang byung sogs kyang sngon gyi skal bzang 'ga' zhig bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i thabs la sngon chog ces sgra yangs pa'i dbang gis bshad pa yin pas sngon chog ces pa'i ming tsam gyis 'khrul nas mgo rmongs par ma byed cig /yang lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen rdzogs 'di la/ mkhas pa kha cig 'di mthong lam ma thob pa'i gong du bsnyen par rdzogs nas rdzogs rjes mthong lam thob ces 'chad pa ni rgya che rol ba sogs theg chen skabs su de ltar 'chad pa'i lugs yod kyang a mong 'dul ba 'dir de ltar khas blang du mi rung ste rgyu mtshan/ de ltar bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa'i lnga sde'i nang tshan kun shes koṇḍi spya chos can/ khyod rang rgyud la mthong lam skyes pa'i snga rol du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag min par thal/ khyod rang (10na)rgyud la mthong lam skyes ma thag tu bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod rang nyid la ston pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ma thag tu bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag gang zhig /khyod la ston pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba dang khyod kyi rgyud la mthong lam skyes pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/de der thal/ 'dul ba lung las/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das dge slong lnga po dag gi rgyud la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ de dag bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por gyur pa de'i tshe de dag de bzhin gshegs pa la shin tu mtshan nas brjod pa dang zhes de la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor bas de bsnyen par rdzogs par bstan/ kun shes koṇḍi rgya'i rgyud la mthong lam skyes pa na bcom ldan 'das —10

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te zhes pa'i rgyud la mthong lam skyes nas ston pas 'jig rten 'dir chos 'khor bskor ba'i tha snyad 'thob/ de yan chad du de dag la chos bstan kyang chos 'khor bskor ba'i tha snyad mi 'jog pa 'di mkhas pa dag gi spyi lugs yin pa'i phyir dang / 'grel pa dag las kyang lnga po rnams ye shes khong du chud pas dang zhes lnga sde rang rgyud la mthong lam skyes tshe bsnyen par rdzogasapas na ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen rdzogs dang / nges zhugs kyi bsnyen rdzogs zhes bshad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na lnga sdes mthong lam ma thob gong du lnga po de dag la dge slong dag ces dge slong du bshad pa min nam snyam na de ni dge slong lnga'i nang nas slong ba'i dge slong (10bsom la dngos btags ma phye ba'i ming btags tsam yin pas dge slong mtshan nyid par 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i gtam mo/ /snga phyir du 'dul 'dzin mang po sngon chog bcu zhesan yams su gsung bar 'dren tshul/ bya 'dul dang bu sogs sangs rgyas dang rang rgyal so so dang /dbus dang mtha' 'khob tu gsol bzhi'i cho ga zhes gcig tu 'dren/ 'ga' zhig de las go ldog pa'i rnam gzhag yod par mtsho sna pas spyir bsnyen par rdzogs tshul la bcur yod kyang / sngon chog kho na la bcur ma nges shing de 'dra'i lung gsal po med pa dang / lhag par snga ma'i lugs kyi 'dren pa dang rang rgyal rdzogs tshul tha dad du byas pa mi 'thad cing / mchod sbyin ma 'phrin gyis rdzogs tshul la/ sngon du rab byung dang / de nas lo gnyis song nas bsnyen par rdzogs tshul sogs phran tshegs kyi lung gsal po yod pas sngon chog tu 'dren mi rigs pas sngon chog brgyad kho nar nges gsung mkhas pa phal cher sngon chog la de ltar rnam grangs du ma yod pa las/ 'dir gsol bzhi'i sngon chog smos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan cho ga 'di dar chog dang rigs 'dra tsam yin pas de ltar rung ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba'i ched yin pas/ sngon chog gzhan rnams da lta bya rung ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung ba ni khungs btsun par mngon/ de'i rjes su yul thag ring po nas ston pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs pa dag /gcan gzan dang 'byung ba'i gnod pas tshe'i dus byas pa sogs (11na〉pa —/1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'barten dge 'dun rnams 'dus te gsol ba dang bzhi'i las tsam gyis cig car rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par gnang ba yin la/ tshul ji ltar na skye ba rgyu'i khyad par sngon chog gi sgo nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba la mtshams nang de na yod pa'i dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs dang ldan pa rgan rim la phyag 'tshal ba sogs gus pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol ba lan gsum du btab pa zhig dgos pa/ mdo rtsa las/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa na cha lugs 'di bzhin byas rgan rim la phyag 'tshal te thal mo sbyar tsog tsog pur 'dug cing gsol ba btab par gyur pa gsum dang zhes byung / mtsho sna pa kun mkhyen bu/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ paṇa chen blo gros legs bzang / mkhas grub bde legs nyi ma/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa sogs mang dag mthun par sngon chog la dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'am ma 'dus kyang 'dun pa dang yongs dag 'bul/ sngon chog la rab byung gi gos rnams tshang ba dang / dar chog la mkhan pos gnang / sngon chog la phyag mang po mi dgos/ dar chog la dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mtsho sna pa shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun mkhan por gsol/ /gos kyi gnyis dang lhung bzed dang / /gsang te ston dang 'jug yod dang / /sangs rgyas dge 'dun las byed la'o/ /(11ba)zhes phyag tshan bcu gcig bshad/ sngon chog la thal mo sbyar stan med par tsog pur yud tsam 'dug pas choge /dar chog la thal mo sbyar/ rtswa pha gu'i steng du stan med par 'ding ba gzar ba la yun ring por 'dug dgos/sngon chog la bdag rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad du gsol sogs bsgrub bya rang nyid kyi lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas chog /dar chog las khan pos ngo chen byas/ las slob kyis brda sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs dgos/ sngon chog la mthun rkyen tshang ba dang 'gal rkyen bar chad dang bral ma bral sogs dri ba brjod mi dgos la/ dar chog la de ltar brjod dgos/ sngon chog la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs cig car dang / dar chog la rim can du skye ba sogs yod par bzhed/ cho ga'i mtshan gzhi ni —/2

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)sngon chog la gsol bzhi'i cho ga dang ldan pa zhig dgos so zhes pa la gong gi 'phros las gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis zhes pa byung / ji ltar skye ba'i tshul ni sngon chog la sdom pa skye ba bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa cig car du sgrub dgos so zhes 'chad pa ni/ cig car rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa nye bar bsgrubs par gyur pa zhes byung / cho ga gzhan du bstan pa ni bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims dang bsnyen rdzogs cig car du bsgrub pa'i gsol bzhi'i cho ga 'di da ltar gyi cho ga las gas pa'i sngon chog mtshan ṣka pa yin no/ /zhes lar pa ni/ lta bu ni sngon gyi chog 'o/zhes dang / rgya cher 'grel du/ lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgra ni rnam pa'i tshig yin te/ sngon gyi cho (12na po'i rnam pa ni de lta bur rig par bya'i rnam pa gzhan ma yin no zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /zhes gsungs/nyes med phun tsho gos kyi dbang du byas na mtshams nang der gnas pa'i dge 'dun thams cad 'du bar bshad kyang / dmigs kyis bsal ba ni/ dgra bcom pa sag lhas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud las/ dbus dang mtha' 'khob pa dag la/ /bsnyen rdzogs yang dag bstan pa ni/ /bcu dang lnga yi tsho gis kyis sam/ /de bas lhag pas kyang ni rung / zhes bshad do/ /'di la sngon chog dngos gzhi ngos 'dzin dgos pa thams cad mkhyen pa bu dang / lung rigasagater mdzod du sngon chog g.yin rnams btags pa ba dang / gsol bzhi'i las kyi cig car bsgrub pa la mtshan nyid par ngos bzung / 'dul ṭīka rin cen phreng ba/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang /chos rje bde legs nyi ma gnyis kyi spyi don sogs mkhas pa mang po'i bzhed pa mthun par sngon chog dngos gsol bzhi'i cho gas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs cig car du bsgrub pa/ de ltar gyi cho ga'i sngon rol du gnang ba'i gsol bzhi'i las chog sngon chog gi mtshan nyid ces gsungs shing / 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon cog chos 'phel kyang de kho na ltar bzhed/ dus ston pa sangs rgyas nas lo lnga'i bar du byung ba sngon chog dang / de nas dar chog byung bar bzhed cing / khyad par ṭīka chen rin cen phreng bar/dus ston pa sangs rgyas nas lo drug nas (12bajung ste/ de'i tshe yab sras mjal ba'i 'phrin pa — 13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6po'achar gas byas de'i tshe shā ri'i bus 'char ka da ltar kyi cho gas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs/ de yang gong du smos pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs tshul rnams la yul gzhan la ma brten pa rang rgyal srid pa tha ma pa dang byang sems srid pa tha ma pas zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub mngon du mdzad pa'i tshe bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rang gi ngang gis sngon du gyur pa la cho ga'i tha snyad zur tsam yang med/ yul gzhan ston pa sangs rgyas la brten pa ni lnga dzi bzang po la dge slong dag 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'i zhes sogs gsungs pa tsam gyi mthong lam skyes pa'i tshe bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skyes pa lta bu grags pa sogs la tshur shog tshangs par mtshungs par spyod cig gsungs pa'i mod la byi byad dang / gos dang spyod lam thams cad bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bu/ 'od srungs chen pos khyod ni kho po'i ston pa'o/ /kho bo ni khyod kyi nyan thos so zhes ston par khas blangs pa lta bu/ bzang sde'i tshogs drug cus dkon cog gsum la skyab ba'i su 'gro ba khas blangs pa lta bu/ skye rgu'i bdag mo sogs kyis lci ba'i cho sgo brgyad khas blangs pa lta bu/ khyim bdag legs byin la gcig tu dge ba ni gang / thar pa'o/ /de la mkho ba ni gang / dad pa'o zhes pa'i dri ba la mnyes pa lta bu/ cho ga'i rig byed la brten pa sngon gyi cho ga sngar bshad pa ltar smin pa gsum shas che/ sgrib pa gsum shas chung ba'i bsgrub bya gsol bzhi'i las kyis cig car bsgrubs pa (13na〉lta bu ste/ rgya cher 'grel las/ sems can rgyud rnam par dag pa sha stag byung bas 'dul bya'i rim pa la mi bltos shing mkhan po dang slob dpon la sogs pa la ma bstos par yang tshegs chung ngu kho nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' rdzogs par byed par byed pa dang / de dag bsod nams byas pa yin pas nad med pa dang / ji ste de dag la nad cig byung du zin kyang de dag gi nad g.yog la sogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas lo drug phan chad na gdul bya rnams srid pa tha ma pa ma yin pa dbang po rtul zhing las 'phro zhan pas rang stobs kyis blang dor gyi gnad tshul bzhin du ma shes pas spyod lam rgod bag can du gyur cing / nad dang nyer 'tshe la sogs pa 'byung ba mang zhing —14

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)mthun rkyen sman dang yo byad rnyed dka' bas la la bro 'tshal ba la grogs med par tshe'i dus byas par brten mkhan slob dang bcas te da ltar gyi cho ga'i sgo nas rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa gnang ba yin te/ de nyid las da ltar ni de lta bu'i rgyud rnam par dag pa med pas/ des na da ltar gyi cho ga rnam par bzhag go /zhes so/ /slob dpon yon to 'od kyis bstan bcos 'dir sngon chog bkod par dgos pa med de/ da ltar gyi skabs su sngon chog byar mi rung ba'i phyir snyam na skyon med de/ sngon gyi rgyud yongs su smin pa'i gdul bya tshegs chung ngu'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i thabs sngon gyi cho ga khyad par can yod par shes nas ma 'ongs pa na de dag rang rgyud la yang 'byung ba'i phyir du spro (13ba thas 'jug pa dang /sngon chog dang da ltar gyi cho ga'i rnam bzhag so sor shes pa'i phyir du yang 'dir sngon chog gi rnam gzhag gsungs so/ /de yang shes rab can gyi mchog 'phags pa shā ri'i bu las shākya'i rigs kyi srasasgra gcan 'dzin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs/ de la 'dam bu byin nam/ rgyun gyi dbang po'i mkhan po bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin gyis bsnyen rdzogs kyi dngos po nos/ de la sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabasakyis dge slong gi dngos por bsgrub par mdzad/ rje rang byung pas sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi rjes su mthar phyin dpal gyi grags pa dgos zhes dogs slong mdzad na'ang / mkhas pa g.yin rnams la ma grags pas so ma nyi mi 'tshal/gangs can ljongs su 'dul ba'i bstan pa ji ltar dar tshul/nā ga rgyanas/ ma dros pa'i mtsho las chu bo bzhi ltar phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtshos/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang sprin gyi bcud / /'thung mkhas klu sgrub ma dros mtsho/ /bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir bsnyen rdzogs kyi/ /chu klung mtha' dag 'di las bab/ ces gsungs/ khyad par gangs 15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pocan gyi ljongs 'di'i sdom rgyun snga phyi mtha' dag shing rta chen po 'di nyid las brgyud pa'i bod yul 'dir bstan pa dbu brnyes dar rgyas su byung ba'i phyi ma'i tshe lha btsad po khri srong lde'u bsto gyis za hor gyi rgyal rigs las sdom brtson dam pa zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ thams cad yod par smra ba'i gnas brtan bcu gnyis dang bcas me mo lug gi lo la sad mi mi bdun byung ba rba bzhed las/ btsan po'i zhal nas slob dpon nga'i bod la dge slong med pas nga'i zhang blon (14na jig la dge slong btub bam zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ btub bam sad par bya gsungs nas skad labs pa tsho las thog mar bod la dad pa che ba'i rba khri gzigs dge slong byas ma thag tu mtshan rba dpal dbyangs su btags/lnga'i mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas btsan po dgyes te/ de'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas khyod bod kyi rin po che yin no zhes bka' stsal nas mtshan yang rba ratna zhes btags te/ bod kyi rab tu byung ba la snga ba de yin no/ /btsan po na re/ slob dpon gyisanga'i spyo blon dad pa can da rung rab tu byung zhig ces zhus pas/ sad cig gsungs nasarba gsal snang dang / /rba khri bzhen gyi bu sad shi ti dang / pa gor he 'dod kyi bu bee ro tsa na dang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / rma a tsa ra rin cen mchog dang / la gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub dang drug dge slong byas te/ ming yang ye shes dbang po dang / skya bo'i dus na rba gsal snang zer/ sems bskyed zhus nas rab tu byung ba'i ming / slob dpon bo dhi sa twar btags/ rba dpal dbyangs la rgya nag skad sang shi ta zer/ la la rba khri bzhen gyi bu sang shi ta zer/ de la sogs par btags nas sad mi mi drug rab tu byung ngo / /zhes pa ltar bstan pa snga dar la dge 'dun gyi sde rgya cher 'phel nas 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog bla na med pa ste/ klu sgrub rjes/ dhīḥyig 'od phreng thig pa las smin chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan des/ /thub pa'i bstan la lhag bsam brtan pos zhi 'tsho rgyal bshes tshul (14ba khrims sbyin/ /mkhan slob tshogs las bod kyi blo gsal sad mi bdun zhes bsnyen par rdzogs/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rab byung 'dul ba'i bstan pa rma med de nas byung / zhes gsungs/ rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsgrubs pa'i gtam gsan — /6

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)pas/ chu bo ri'i sgom grwa nas stod lung dmar shākya mu ne dang / bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung dang / bzhad kyi gtsang rab gsal dang gsum gyis 'dul mngon gyi dpe cha dre'u gcig gi rgyab khal dang bcasagasang thabs kyis mnga' ris su phros/ der yang bzhugs ma nus par byang lam brgyud nas mdo smad rma lung du rdo rje'i brag ra an chung gnam rdzong dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du bsgom gyin bzhugs pa/de'i tshe 'gro stag snang khri zhes pa'i rgyal po'i blon po zhig gis lo sum cu rtsa lnga pa la smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar nas btsong kha bde khams su chu phyir bon po'i bu shes rab can zhig tu 'khrungs pas mu zu gsal 'bar du btags/ nar son nas non 'jam dpal/ khang rin cen rdo rje/ skyi rgyal ba'i gtsug tor/ nam dga' ldan byang chub sogs bla ma bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos du ma nos/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal nas thar pa yi/ /bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi byed pa'i/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /dang por bdag gis rab tu byung bar bya/ /zhes gsungasanas/ gtsang gi mkhan po dang g.yos slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dge ba rab gsal du btags/ de nas ring zhig lon pa na gong (15na8 mkhan slob gnyis dmar gyis gsang ston rgya'i hwa shang ke dbang dang 'bag gis kha skong mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs shing phyis thugs rab shin tu che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ mi nyag gha'i yul du go rong seng ge grags la 'dul ba gsan/kwa 'od mchog grags zhes lho bal nas chos mang por sbyangs pa zhig khams su byon par 'bum ṭīka sogs zhus/ ri danti ga tu bzhugs pa'i tshe spa gor ye shes g.yung drung dang bar gnas brtan gragasaganyis rab tu byung bas spa bar gnyis/ ja cog gnyis/ bzhad srags gnyis/ 'al gnubs gnyis/thong mtshur gnyis sogs 'dul 'dzin mang du byon/ de dag gi skabs yum brtan dang / 'od srungs nas rgyal rabs gsum gyi bar la bod dbus gtsang na sdom pa 'bogs len lta zhog rab byung gi gzugs brnyan tshang ba yang med/ nyan bshad lta zhog nad pa'i rim gro la klog 'don re tsam byed pa na dmar po 'di rnams nag po 'di rnams kyis 'chad pa 'dra zhes pa las med pa lo bdun cu byung ngo / /—17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logede rjes smad na bstan pa cung zad tshugs pa'i skad cha dbus gtsang du slebs/ mnga' bdag tshal nasayab sras sogs la sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las cung zad zhugs nas/ klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/'bring ye shes ston/ rba tshul khrims blo gros/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes blo gros te dbus pa lnga mdo smad du brdzangs/ de'i skad gtsang gi btsan po rnams kyis kyang gsan te/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug /chang btsun ye shes (15brdzing ge /mnga' ris 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de gar rnams kyang brdzangs/ gtsang g.yo dmar gsum bsres pas mkhan po mi 'byongs gsungs nas slob dpon dang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mkhan po mdzad de rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang / 'dul ba bslabs te yar phebs nas dbus gtsang gi mi bcu btsan po rnams kyi bla mchod du gyur/ klu mes la gnas gzhi 'dzin pa'i slob ma ka ba bzhi gdung drug sogs grags pa'i ka ba bzhi ni/ gru mer tshul byung / zhang sna nam rdor dbang / rngog byang 'byung / glan ye shes rab bo/ /de bzhis rim bzhin gsol nag thang chen/ stod lung ra tsag /yer pa ba rang / rgya gser snang sogs bags nas mang du mched pas rang sde/ zhang skor/ rngog tsho glan skor du grags so/ /'bring gis ga lam spyi mo brtsigs pa nas mched pa 'bring tsho zer te/ gsang phu snye thang sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /rbas lung gyur lha khang brtsigs nas mched pa la rba tsho zer te/ rag shis ka tshal bzung ba nas mched pa la rag tsho'i/ /gtsang du lo ston gyis zha lu rgyan gong brtsigs pa nas mched pa la lo tsho/ tshong btsun gyis rtsis kyi yang dben bzung ba nas mched pa la tshong tsho ste de gnyis shin tu mang / gtsang pa gzhan gsum dang sum pa las mched ma thub pas dbus gtsang gi mi drug tu'ang byed do/ /'a zha ye shes g.yung drung gis bla chen gyi mkhan bu tre bo mchog bla la bka' drin zhus pas ngas chab gtor btang la 'ong gis gsung ba'i bar der (16na7khan po grongs pas de ga sdom par ngos bzung nas de'i rgyun spel ba la dge tshul chu gtor mar grags/ 'bre gzhen tshul gyis bla chen po'i mkhan bu ya zi bon ston la sdom pa zhus pas/ der bas zer ba'i ngang las 'das pas sdom pa thob par brtsis pas sdom pa der —18

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)bas mar grags/ 'a 'bre gnyis nas gtsang gi phyogs su gnas gzhi dang sde rgya cher 'phel tshul kun mkhyen bu'i chos 'byung dang stag tshang lo tsā ba'i sdom gsum 'grel par 'byung zhing / thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar du 'a zha'i sdom rgyun der bas ma yin tshul byung ba sngon gyi yig tshang so sor brten pas khungs che'am snyam kyang dpyad do/ /de dag gi nang nas gtso cher klu mes nas gyes pa ni/ dngos slob ka chu ba gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba'i bka' babs/ de la bu bzhi ste/ glan tshul byang / ka chu ba tshul 'byung / sne po grags rgyal/ 'dzim pa sher 'od do/ /phyi ma gsum la rim bzhin/ nyang mtsham pa rin cen bla ma/ sog tshul khrims bla ma/ ko khyim pa ye shes bla ma'o/ /de gsum dang 'dzim pa las g.yin gsum la rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims kyi gsan nas dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad de/ snga tshar phyi tshar bar tshar gyi slob ma byung / /snga tshar la dbus kyi ka ba rma tsho byang rdor dang nag po dar tshul/ gtsang gi ka ba mtha' bzhi brtson 'grus 'bar dang 'dar 'dul 'dzin/ bar tshar gyi gso tshul 'phags/ phyi tshar sa skya'i brag dmar (16brdo rje phur bu ste/ rma tsho nas bya 'dul sogasadang / 'dar 'dul nas sha mi sogs dang / kyi po rnams la bya kyi sha gsum la 'dul ba 'chad cesagrags so/ /bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo chen rin bzang sogs snga rabs pa'i sdom brtson phal cher dang /bka' gdams kyi bshes gnyen rnams bla chen gyi sdom rgyun 'di la brten nas sdom brtson mdzad pas rnam par ma dag go zhes skur pa btab na chos spong gi sgrib pa chen po gsog la/ bla chen pos bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa'i tshe kha stong ba'i dge 'dun la rgya ban de byung ba som nyir byung ba dang / chab gtor ma dang der bas ma'i rgyun yang mang gshis nyes med phun tshogs la yang shes ldan rnams dpyad pa mdzad par snang / lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍita dharmā pā la spyan drangs/ 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len mdzad pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo swā dhu pā la/ gu ṇa pā la/ pradzñā pa la ste/ pā la gsum la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du byung ste/ de rnams las brgyud pa la stod 'dul par grags shing /—19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pokun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtshos/ klu sgrub zhal gyi padma las 'khyud rgya gar shar phyogs mkhas pa'i gtso/ /dharma pā la de slob mkhan bu tshul khrims dri ldan pā la gsum/ /shad zhung 'dul 'dzin rgyal ba shes rab bra dzña pā la'i mkhan bu ste/ /stod lugs 'dul ba brgyud pa gnyis ldan gzhan las lhag ces rang gis bstod/ /de yang sgrub pa nyams len dang / /bshad pa'i rgyud dang gnyis yin zer/ /phyag len bshad pa rang bzo zhes/ /gzhan la brnag dka'i tshig mda' (17na 'phen zhes gsung / kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis bod yul du spyan drangs/ chu shul srog ma dgon par nyin gcig la mi bcu gcig bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i nang nas gro shul ba kher gad byang chub dpal dang / gtsang pa rdo rje dpal gnyis mkhan po'i gtso bor gyur/ paṇa chen la stod nas phebs pa'i tshe gtsang so ba bsod nams mdzes bya bas kho bo dge slong gi bslab pa blangs nas lhung bas skad cig kyang ma gos pa'i dge ba de rdzogs byang du bsngo ba zhu zhus pas shin tu mnyes nas thugs gar thal mo sbyar te bsngo rgyu shin tu bzang / nga'i mchod gnas byed gsungs nas zham ring du 'khrid pa de byang rdor gnyis kyi grogs su btang nas zul phu'i na bza' 'phreng gsol la 'dul ba slob par btang /paṇa chen rgya gar du theg skabs byang rdor gnyis kyis phyags phyir 'gro bar zhus pas tshad pa mi thub gsungs nas ma gnang bar gtsang so ba la brten nas 'dul ba spel/ dge 'dun bzhi sde dang ma bral ba gyis gsungs/ rdo rje dpal bas snye mo tshag mig tsho gos pa btsugs/ slob ma gzhu ba dpal dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyis bye rdzing tshogs btsugs/ byang chub dpal gyis tshogs dge 'dun sgang btsugs/de'i slob ma dbu mdzad bsod nams stobs kyis chos lung tshogs pa btsugs pas tshogs sde bzhir grags/ nyang stod rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du 'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍita sa kha che paṇa chen la bsnyen par rdzogs pas byang rdor gnyis dang sa lo nas 'phel bar paṇa chen (17ba7rgyud par grags pas/ klu sgrub rjes/ 'dzam gling yongs la snyan grags mkhan/ kha che'i mkhan po shākya shrī/ khro lo dad pa'i lcags kyu yis/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du spyan drangs tshe/ /mkhan bu'i gtsug rgyan lnga rig dbang //20

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanazhi dul gtsang mkhas sa lo tsā/ /rdor byang la sogs bsam mi khyab/ /deng sang 'di na bstan pa'i gzhi ma bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa chu bo'i rgyun/ /sa le rdor byang zhal las 'thung yin stod smad la sogs chu'i gad mo/ /tsongs pas mi ngoms reg na 'jig ces 'dul 'dzin 'ga' zhig thugs mi tshim/ /sdom pa'i rgyun dang sdom pa'i rgyu tsho gos gzu lum ma byed brtags pas long / zhes gsungs/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bu/ rgyal sras thogasamed pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po sogs phyis kyi mkhas grub phal cher paṇa chen brgyud las sdom pa bzhes pa mang zhing / paṇa chen byams pa gling pas gsang sngags mkhar du rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis las slob mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i mkhan bu kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa yin pas sdom rgyun 'di rnam par dag kyang rgyal tshab rje stod 'dul ba'i brgyud par song gshis/ paṇa chen brgyud 'phel la re'i thugs zhen gyis bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po ma mdzad skad do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse ba'i zhal snga nas kyis bdag nyid chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i skabs(18na gi nyal gyi mo la'i rtsar zhag sa mdzad pas/ khyod sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes par gyis shig /ces pa'i lung bstan pa brnyes/ yi dam gyis kyang 'dul ba'i bslab pa la brten nas ga' na la phan pa chen por 'gyur bar lung bstan pas thog mar dpon slob rnams kyi bla gos dras shing drubs pa dang lhung bzed dang gding ba la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsnams nas gzhan dag gis mthong na rab tu byung ba'i tshul 'di lta bu zhig kho na'o/ /zhes yid ches par 'gyur bar mdzad nas phyis ni lo re'am zla re tsam chos nyan par rtsol ba'i slob ma dag kyang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa la bkod pas mngon sum du gyur ba lta zhog /rgyang ring po nas thos pa dag kyang skru long g.yo bas phyogs thams cad du snyan pas khyab ste 'gran zla med par gyur —21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pozhes dang / rje btsun de'i bka' drin las zhal ma mthong zhing sa phyogs ring na gnas pa'i rab tu byung ba dag kyang dras du bsam dang gding lhung la sogs pa'i yo byad bsrel ba dang phyi rol yang sdud ma spangs te zla gam gyon ba dang zhwa'i mdog kyang gser mdog tu byed pa 'di yin no/ /'di dag ni thun mong du snang ba'i che ba tsam zhig brjod pa ste gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje la bka' stsal pa'i yi ge las/ nga lag na rdo rjes kyang ma ti bha dra kirti shrī'i yon tan gyi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so gsung / tshad ma las ni 'di'i phyi ma la dga' ldan du byang chub sems dpal 'jam dpal snying por gyur ro zhes bya ba dang / (18bsgo 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ror 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dag la yid 'khyog pa med cing shin tu mtho ba'i sa la bzhugs pa zhig 'dir sems can gyi don du byon no zhes rgya cher bsngags pa'i yul gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i bstan pa'i nyi ma gcig pu ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis kyang yar klungs rnam rgyal du tshag mig mkhan chen tshul khrims rin chen las bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /paṇa chen brgyud par rnam grangs mang na yang dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub nas/ yon tan bshes gnyen/ rin cen bshes gnyen/chos kyi bzang po/ gu ṇa pa ti/ chos kyi phreng ba/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shri/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngagasa'achang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bo dong dge legs bzang po/ sngags 'chang ā nanta pa/ snye chu ba byamasapa chos rin cen/ skye chu ba brtson khrus rgya mtsho/ skye chu ba chos rgyal dpal 'byor/ skye chu ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sgye chu ba nam mkha' dbang phyug /rje sangs rgyas 'od zer/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/ 'dir skyid ga gongs rje dpon mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal/ lha khang mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bkra shis/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan rin po che gnas brtan nye bar 'khor gnyis pa rin cen bsod nams (19na〉pa chog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slar yang phyogs kun 22

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanatu dar rgyas su mdzad do/ /gnyis pa de dag gi dogs gnas la mtha' dpyad pa ni/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i dus bsgo'i mjug tu/ kye ma gangs can khrod 'di na/ /mkhan slob khyim pas byed pa dang / /sdom pa gtor mas len pa dang / /dus bsgo hor zlas byed pa mang / /mdo dang ga rma sha tam du/ /lo zla tshesagrangs bshad pa med/ /zla ba bdun pa'am brgyad pa nas/ /lo 'go 'dzin pa'ang mdo dang 'gal/ /mang du smras na dgra sogs sdang / /ma smras lag len 'chol par spyod/ /'di 'dra'i dus la bab pa na//bdag lta bu la ci bya yod/ ces dang/ sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal gyi zhu yig thugs rje bskul ba las/khyim pa rnams kyis mkhan slob byed cing hor 'dras kha bskong sdom pa gtor mas len par byed cing bsgrub bya thag rgyas 'jal bar byed/ srog gcod rdzun smra ma byin len sogs pham pas dkris kyang mkhan slob byed cing sdom brtson gzhan la rnam pa sna tsho gos kyis skur ba 'debs/ rtsa bzhi sdom kyang lhag ma la sogs bag yangs spyod cing blang dang dor bar bya ba mi shes dge slong yin zhes bdag la bstod/ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis lag len 'chol bar spyod pa sna tsho gis shig 'byung ba'i mkhan po khyim pas byed pa ni/ rwa lo chen por/ skyo 'dul 'dzin na re/ khyed rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po mdzad pa la mkhan por 'os pa'i (19na〉(na tan ma tshang ste/ mkhan po bya ba bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu lon pa'i dge slong 'dul ba'i sde snod shes pa dgos pa la/ khyed nub kyi rigs su sha chang la longs spyod/ skabs su mi la mthu gtad btang nas gsod/ lkog tu bud med bsten pas gzhan gyi mkhan po byas na bstan pa la gnod zer zhing / gzhan yang mang po'i gseb tu chos gtam la bsnyad btags nas ga smras mang du byas pa na/ der rwa chen thugs cung zad khrosapa'i rnam pas 'di skad gsungs te/ sha chang bza' ba tsho gos kyi 'khor lo yin/ /dam nyams gsod pa sngags kyi dam tshig yin/ /bud med bsten pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /nga yis de ltar shes pa'i gnasaskabs na/ /'dul 'dzin dge slong dag dang 'gal ba med/ /de bas dam nyams log lta can khyod —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pokyang / /zhag bdun tho rangs gshegs su gsol bar bya/ gsungs pas/ mkhan po de zhag bdun na lus ngag yid gsum rengs nas 'das pas rwa chen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po la las rgya bsten pa sogs grogs su 'gyur na'ang / de rgyu mtshan du byas nas mkhan po mdzad mi rigs par mngon te/ shrī nā landa'i mkhan po gnas brtan chen po dpal ldan chos skyong lta bu'ang brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad nas birla bar grags pa'i tshe mkhan po ma mdzad cing / des mtshon nā ro ta pa sogs grub chen mang po'ang sku tshe'i stod smad kyi mdzad 'phrin mi gcig pa so sor yod cing / slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas gdul bya'i rang snang du yon tan (20na)gsum gyis sangs rgyas gzhan las khyad zhugs pa dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs des kyang bod du gsang sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon las rab byung gi mkhan slob ma mdzad/ der ma zad 'o skol gyi ston pas kyang rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i rnam pas gzhan la nyan thos lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa phog pa med pas/ tshad thub kyi dpang po rnams la 'thad mi 'thad kyi rnam dbye yod mod/ bo dong paṇa chen 'jigs bral gyis shel dkar rdor 'dzom gsang yum du bsten pa'ang rwa lo'i rnam thar dang mtshungs par mngon zhing / dus phyis rtag brtan sprul sku kun dga' snying po dang / zal mo brag sku skye snga rting 'jam mgon sku skye sogs kyis mi tshangs par spyod pa la 'dzem bag med bzhin du mkhan po'i bya ba mdzad cing / gser mdog can pa'i dge bshes su rlom pa 'dra yang mig can g.yang mchongs kyi rnam pas de dag las sdom pa len par grags shing / gar 'brug rnams ni ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus la brten nas bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs drags pas gleng gzhi bya ba'i yul ma yin par sems/sdom pa gtor mas len par 'ga' zhig sngags rnying ma'i mdo dbang gi nyan thos skabs la zur za bar 'chad kyang / mdo dbang du ma zad snga 'gyur bka' gter mang por theg pa rim pa dgu'i dbang rim bzhin bskur ba'i snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma'i gzhi rten du dgongs pa'i nyan thos dang 'brel ba'i dbang gi brda chad tsam du so thar phyogs mtshungs tsam las cho ga mtshan nyid pa'i sgo nas sdom pa —24

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phana'abogs pa (20ba)min zhing / bskur yul kyang rab byung dang khyim pa la nges pa med pas sngags gsar ma'i skabs su yang sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'i khyim pa la dbang bskur ba'i sngon dang de'i gzhi rten du gyur pa'i mi dge bcu spong gi khrims shig dgos pa dang phyogs mtshungs pas/ de nyan thos kyi so thar mtshan nyid pa'i dbang du byas na dbang gi snod du rung ba la gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med za ma dang mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa zhig dgos par 'gyur bas shes bya mtha' bkag pa'i go yul shin tu dog la/ kho na re/ de ltar yin du chug kyang / mdo dbang la gsol bzhi'i rnam gzhag kyang phyogs 'dra tsam 'dug pas mi 'thad do zhe na/ sdom gsum las/ /theg pa chen po las byung ba'i/ /so sor thar pa bshad kyis nyon/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid la yang / /so sor thar pa 'bogs pa yi/ /cho ga 'ga' zhig yod mod kyi/ /de yi cho ga phal cher nub/ /ces theg chen lugs kyi so thar gyi 'bogs choge gi lag len phal cher nub par gsungs shing dkon cog brtsegs pa'i drag shul can gyis zhus par/byams 'jam dbyangs longs sku'i cha byad can gyis khyim bdag dgu stong dang bdun stong gzugs ma bsgyur bar bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa/ sdom gsum las/ rgyal sras byams pa 'jam dbyangasasogs/ /bdag nyid chen po 'ga' zhig gis/ /mkhan po mdzad nas 'gro mang la/ /bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do zhes/ /tshig 'bru tsam zhig gsungs mod kyi/ /'on kyang de yi cho ga ni/ /mdo las gsungs pa ngas ma mthong / /zhes bstan pa phyi (21na skor la bshad srol 'di dag mkhas pa rnams kyis ma gzigs kyang snga 'gyur gyi skabs rdzul thogs med mnga' ba'i paṇa grub rnams kyis mkha' spyod o rgyan gyi yul sogs so skyes bgrod par mi nus pa'i zhing khams su bzhugs pa gzigs par brten lo paṇa rnams kyis mdo dbang gi skabs theg pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i phyag len rgyas pa ma mdzad pa'i nges pa med cing / slob dpon dang slob ma'ang rab byung dang khyim pa gos dkar can la mtha' ma bkag pas bshad ma thag pa'i lugs srol de dag gi rjes su zhugs par mngon pas/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang dge slong rnam pa bzhi yod de/ bzhi gang —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pozhe na/ don dam pa'i dge slong dang / kun rdzob kyi dge slong dang / lug lkugs pa lta bu'i dge slong dang /khrel ba dang ngo tsha med pa'i dge slong ngo / /de la ji ltar na don dam pa'i dge slong zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sam/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge slong yon tan chen po dang ldan pa chos thams cad la dbang du gyur ba'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bam/ dgra bcom pa'am/ phyir mi 'ong ba'am/ lan gcig phyir 'ongs pa'am/ rgyun du zhugs pa ste/ gang zag rnam pa bdun po 'di dag gi don dam pa'i dge slong du bsdu ba dang / skye bo gang khyim na gnas shing skra dang kha spu yang ma bregs/ chos gos kyang mi gon/ rab tu byung bas so so thar pa'i tshul khrims thamasacad kyang ma nos/ gsol ba dang / zhu ba'i las dang / gso sbyin dang / tshul gyi las (21ba)thams cad kyi nang du mi chud mod kyi/ 'phags pa'i chos dang ldan la 'phags pa'i 'bras bu thob pas na de yang don dam pa'i dge slong du bsdus te/ de dag ni don dam pa'i dge slong zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungasapas shes nus shing / deng sang gi mdo dbang 'chad nyan byed pa rnams byams 'jam dbyangs sogasagang zag khyad par can rnams dang 'dra ba ma yin kyang / de dag la mig yar lta'i tshul gyis rjes su 'jug pa ste/ deng sang gi rab tu byung bar khas 'che ba rnams kyang 'od srungs chen po dang shā ri'i bu sogs kyi ngang tshul la 'jug par mos pa lta bu'o/ /gong du bshad pa de ji ltar yin snyam na phyogs 'di la zhal 'dris chung ba'i dwags shangs zhi gcod sogs su ma zad/ sa dge'i lugs 'dzin gyi bla ma dang 'bul sdud pa thos pa chung zhing snying kham che ba 'ga' zhig gis khams sog mon kong sogs kyi dbang rtul 'dra la/ chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed gding ba gtad rjes so so'i chos skyong gang yin gyi gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag
