'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanaganyis pa ni kha gsag rnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir/ /tshig 'jam snyan par smra ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ gos kyi rgyu rung mi rung gi bye brag brtag pa/ rung ba la gos bzo ba'i tshul/ gosakyi dbye ba/ dbye ba so so'i rnam bzhag /gos la longs spyod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la mi rung ba ni/ kha tshar dang phun tshar ma bcad ba dang dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba dang / rnga mo'i bal las byas pa dang kha dog khra'o/ /dbyibs khyim pa dang mu stegs can gyi gos lta bu'o/ /rung ba bdun te/ bal las byas pa/ /shan las byas pa/ nyi 'og pa'i gos ras gos rtozar ma las byas pa rto ko tam pa las byas pa rto du gu las byas pa ste/ sag lhas/ bag gos sha na nyi 'og dang / /ras gos sha na nyi 'og dang / /ras gos dang ni zar ma dang / /(107brko to pa dang du gu la/ /chos gos rgyu ni rnam pa bdun/ zhes so/ /bal dang ras sogs las byas pa yang spu shin tu che ba chos gos rnam gsum du byar mi rung ste/ gzhung du/ spu can chos gos gsum nyid du byin gyis brlab par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / sag lhas/ skru can rnam par spangs nas ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyi nang shun bya/ che khag so/ /gnyis pa la / bkru ba/ kha bsgyur ba/ dras shing drubs pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ sa ga lhas/ dag par bya phyir sham thabs ni/ /bco blag mkhan la zhabrur mi gzhug /brtse ldan rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang / /snod kyi nang du dal bus bkru/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mi rung ba'i tshon chen brgyad spangs te rung ba'i tshon kha gsum ༷ dgos te/ sag lhas/ sngon po bcag dang ngur smig rtsi/ /'di dag rung ba'i tshon gsum ste/ /tshon chen dag gis chos gos ni/ kha bsgyur byed pa bkag pa yin/ /zhesagasungs pa'i phyir/ tshon chen brgyad ni/ sa ga lhas/ rgya skyegs le brgan rtsi dang btsod/ /sma shing rtsi dang mthing shing mtshal/ /sis ra dang gur gum ste/ /'di dag māṃ chen brgyad du 'dod/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa la/ gos gang la bya ba dang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ snam sbyar la nges par dras drubs dgos la/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ dge slong ma'i —143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ashing nga dpung chad dang rngul gzan la/ rab dras drubs/ 'bring lhan thabs/ tha ma thang thang por bya ba yin no/ /gding ba la glegs bu byed dang gnyis pa byed cing / gos gzhan rnams la snam phran dang glegs bu'i bshad pa med do/ /sag lhas/ gding ba la dra mi dgos/ /rtag tu 'bral ba yang ni med/ /(108na skom sbyar nges par dras te bcang / /gzhan dag ma nges gang gi phyir/ /'dod chung rang gi chos gos kyi/ /las kyis skyo ba bskyed phyir ro/ /zhes dang / 'dir yang snam sbyar ma yin pa dag la dras te byin gyis brlab pa'i nges pa med do/ /zhes dang / dras shing drubs pa chos gos nyid du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /mthang gos dang bla gos dang snam sbyar la'o/ /dge slong mas ni shing nga dpung chad dang rngul gzan snam pa gang yang rung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ bla gos dang / snam sbyar la dras drubs bya tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bla gos kyi rgyu la mtha' skor ma gtogos pa lhag ma rnams la glegs bu tshad ma bcu bzhi/ phyed pa bdun te dum bu nyer gcig tu dra'o/ /drub pa'i tshe glegs bu phyed dang gsum gsum bya spu non gyi tshul du sbyar nas drub bo/ /de lta bu'i snam phran bdun yod pa la/ gcig dbus su bzhag /g.yas su gsum/ g.yon du gsum/glegs bu che chung rim pa 'chol bar bya spu non gyi tshul gyis bzhag nas mthar lcags ris bskor te drub par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab kyi rab snam phran nyer lnga ma byed na snam sbyar gyi rgyu la mtha' skor ma gtogs pa lhag ma rnams glegs bu tshad ma brgya tham pa/ phyed pa nyer lnga ste dum bu brgya dang nyer lngar dra'o/ /drub pa'i tshe glegs bu phyed dang lnga lnga bya spu non gyi tshul du mthud nas drubs pas glegs bu phyed dang lnga lnga dang ldan pa'i snam phran nyer lnga 'byung ngo / /de nas snam phran gcig dbus su bzhag /g.yas su bcu gnyis/ g.yon du bcu gnyis/ glegs bu rnams rim pa 'chol bar bya spu non gyi tshul gyis bzhag pa la mtha' (108na skogs ris bskor ba'i tshul gyis sbyar nas dub bo/ /de bzhin du snam sbyar lhag ma rnams la yang shes par bya'o/ /de ltar yang mtshon gyis ma dras pa'i gos spyad par mi bya'o/ /dras shing drubs pa chos gos nyid du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /snam phran snrel zhi —144

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)nyid dang lhag ma mnyam pa nyid dang dbus nas gzhan du glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su blta ba nyid dang mtha' bskor ba nyid dag gis so zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa la drug ste/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad/ mkho ba'i yo byad/ lhag pa'i yo byad/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs/ mkho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs/ lhag pa'i yo byad phran tshegs so/ /bzhi pa la drug las/dang po la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po ni/ dge slong la lus 'tsho ba'i ched du rang don gyi bsam pas yong bar gnang ba'i rung ba tshad ldan gyis gos so/ /gnyis pa la/ bcu gsum ste/ gzhung du snam sbyar dang bla gos dang sham thabs dang sham thabs kyi gzan dang / rdul gzan dang /rdul gzan gyi gzan dang / gdong phyis dang / rnag gzan dang / g.yan pa dgab pa dang / skra gzed dang / gding ba dang / dbyar gyi gos ras chen bcang bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / sa ga lhas/ chos gos dras pa gsum dang ni/ /rdul gzan sham thabs gnyis gnyis dang / /g.yan pa dgab dang gding ba dang / /ras chen dang ni skra gzed dang / /gdong dang lag pa phyi ba ste/ /'di dag bcu gsum dbye bar 'dod/ /ces so/ /lag pa phyi ba ni/ rnam gzan gyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /gsum pa la/ bcu gsum yod pa'i dang po/ snam sbyar la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ khyad chos/ byin gyis (109na〉rlab tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ snam phran dgu yan chod du nges par dras drubs byas te byin gyis brlabs nasabacang dgos pa'i 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gyi nang nas gtso bor gyur ba'i rung ba tshad ldan gyi gosaso/ /dbye na tha skor gsum/ 'bring skor gsum/ rab skor gsum mo/ dang po la/ tha ma'i tha ma sogs gsum ste/ snam phran dgu ma/ bcu gcig /bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can no/ /gnyis pa la 'bring gi tha ma sogs gsum ste/ snam phran bco lnga/ bcu bdun/ bcu dgu'i bdag nyid can no/ /gsum pa la/ rab kyi tha ma sogs gsum ste/ snam phran nyer gcig /nyer gsum/nyer lnga'i bdag nyid can no/ /snam phran nyer lnga las lhag pa byar mi rung ste/ tshem bu'i rang bzhin can du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar yang / snam sbyar gyi snam phran dag gi dgu yan chad/ nyi shu rtsa lnga man —145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gechad de zung ma gtogos so de yan chad ni tshem bu'o/ /zhes dang / sa ga'i lhas/ snam sbyar rnams kyi tshal bu ni/ /snrel zhi bya'o dgu sogs dgu /snam phran nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /de dag dbye bas nges par bstan/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa la/ tshal bu'i tshad/ glegs bu'i grangs/ rgya khyo zhe gyi tshad/ ji ltar lo pas spyod tshul lo//dang bo ni/ glegs bus glegs bu phyed pa bya spu non gyi tshul gyis mnan pa'i 'phro dang / snam phran gyisasnam phran g.yas g.yon du bya spu non gyis mnan pa'i 'phro ni tshal bu yin la/ de'i tshad ni/ rab lasor bzhi/ tha ma la sor gnyis/ 'bring la de'i bar te/ sag lhas/ dang po tha mdag dang dbus/ /tshal bu'i sgo ni gsum du 'dod/ /de la sor ni bzhi dang gnyis/ /de'i bar la rim (109bsta bzhin//zhes so/ /gzhung las/ glegs bu dang glegs bu byed dag mnyam par bya'o/ /gzhal ba'i phyir de'i tshad kyi chags shing bcang bar bya'o/ /tshal bu dag kyang ngo / /de'i tshad kyi chags shing bcang bar bya'o/ /de'i che tshad ni sor bzhi'o/ /bya rog gi mtho gang yang ngo / /chung tshad ni sor gnyis sam/ phyed dang gsum mam/ mtheb sor gcig go /sa la chos gos 'ding bar mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tha ma skor gsum gyi snam phran ni/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa/ 'bring gi glegs bu phyed bzhi pa/ rab kyi glegs bu phyed dang lnga pa yin te/ gzhung du/ dang po gsum la ni/ de dag ni glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa la ni glegs bu phyed dang bzhi pa nyid do/ /gsum ba la ni glegs bu byed dang lnga pa nyid do/ /zhes dang / sag lhas/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa gsum/ /gsum ni glegs bu phyed dang bzhi/ /tha ma gsum gyi glegs bu ni/ /byed dang lnga par gsungs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ rab skor gsum la dpangs su khru gsum/ srid du khru lnga/ tha ma gsum la khru phyed phyed phri ba'o/ /'bring la de'i bar te/ de ltar yang byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen po dag ni/ rang gi khru gsum dang lnga dag go /chung ngu dag ni gnyis ka las khru phyed phyed phri ba'o/ /'bring rnams kyi tshad ni —/46

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)bar ma'o//zhes dang /sde tshan gsum pa de dag gis//snam sbyar zhes byar gsungs pas te//de dag tshad ni nges bstan pa//dang po khru ni lnga dang gsum//tha ma phyed dang gsum dang lnga//de gnyis bar ni bar ma yin//zhes so//bzhi ba ni/grong du bsod snyoms la rgyu ba 110na skong /dkon cog la phyag bya ba dang /dge 'dun las la 'tshogs pa dang /chos bshad nyan gyi dus su rgyan par bya ba yin zhing /chud za ba spang ba'i phyir du lus kyi sha rjen pa la mi reg cing mchan khung drod kyis snam sbyar chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir du zheng du mtho gang dang srid du khru phyed dang do yod pa'i lhan pas skyabs te longs spyod dgos te/gzhung du/bsod snyoms la rgyu ba dang /chos ston dang mchod rten la phyag bya ba dang /zhesabya ba dang /dge 'dun tsho gos pa dang ga dmasang ga dang /cho ge nyan pa nyams su myong ba las gzhan pa'i bya ba la snam sbyar bgo bar mi bya'o//de la 'dug pa nyal bar mi bya'o//'ga' yang skur ba la sbyar bar mi bya'o//lus la reg par bgo bar mi bya'o//mchan khung g.yas pa'i drod kyis de ma rung bar 'gyur ro//de ltar mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/phyogs der de la gos glan par bya'o/khru phyed dang do dang mtho gang ngo //zhes dang /sag lhas/snam sbyar dge 'dun 'dus pa dang //zas dang mchod rten phyag bya dang //grong sogs 'dun la bgo bya yis//g.yin dag tu ni bkag ba yin//rdul gyi 'jigs pas snam sbyar la//rdul gzan sbyar nas bcang bya ste//zhed du mtho gang srid du khru//byed dang do las lhag mi bya//zhes so//byin rlabs bshad pa/bzhi pa byin rlabs la/dngos dang zhar byung rgyu'i byin rlabs gnyis/dang po ni/byin rlabs bya ba'i yul de nyid/bslab pa rgan na phyag bya/min na mi dgos/gnyis ka 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas pas snam sbyar gyi phyi nang ma log par bzhi /ltab byas pa'i sne mo gcig yul gyi phrag pa g.yon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6popar bkal/ sne mo gcig gnyis ga'i (110ba〉pag pa g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag pa g.yas pas mnan te/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i cho me gos bgyis legs pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo/ /zhes gsum brjod de/ de nas thabs legs bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'tsho ba'i yo byad lhag ma rnams kyang rang rang gi ming nas smos te/ byin gyis brlab dgos pa yin te/ gzhung du/ chos gos gnang ba de nyid du byin gyis brlabs te bcang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ snam sbyar gyi rgyur rung ba'i gos khru gang yan la/ sngar bzhin byas te/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo/ /'tshal na snam phran dgu pa la sogs par bgyis te/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa sogs pa bgyi'o/ /bar chad mthong na bkru'o/ /brkyang ngo / /dra'o/ /bsdeb bo/ /gzungs gdab bo/ /drub bo/ kha bsgyur ro/ /yang na 'di la lhan thabs su glan no/ /rkyen ji lta ba bzhi du bgyis te chos gos 'di ni rung ba spyad par 'os pa'o/ /zhes pa gsum brjod de/ thabs legs byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du bla gos kyi rgyu la yang snam phran dgu pa'i tshab tu snam phran bdun pa dang / snam sbyar gyi tshab tu bla gos bcug te shesapar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bla gos ni/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi snam phran bdun pa yin la/ rab 'bring / tha gsum gyi tshad snam sbyar bzhin no/ /mthang gos ni dpangs su khru do/ srid du khru lnga 'am bzhi/ tha ma lte ba man chad pus mo yan chad de 'khor gsum khebs pa'i tshad kyang rung la/khru'i don ni rang gi lus kyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar la (111na)dum bu bdun du byas pa'i cha gnyis so/ /lus shin tu sbom pas mthang gos kyi ma 'dus na ral kha dpung chad kyis bsnon pa byed dgos par bshad de/ gzhung du/ mthang gos ni do dang lnga yang yin do dang bzhi yang yin no/ /'khor gsum khebs pa nyid yan chad kyang ngo / khru'i don ni lus kyi cha bdun las gnyis so/ /mi yogs na —148

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)ral kha dpung chad bya'o/ /zhes so/ /sham thabs ni nyin mo mthang gos kyi 'og tu gyon par bya ba/ sham thabs kyi gzan ni mtshan mo mthang gos kyi 'og tu gyon par bya ba yin zhing / tshad mthang gos bzhin no/ /rngul gzan dang de'i gzan ni nyin mo dang mtshan mo bla gos kyi 'og tu gyon par bya ba tshad bla gos bzhin no/ /gdong phyisani/ kho ra khor yug tu khru gang gi tshad dang ldan pa'o/ /snag gzan ni dge slong rnag nad can gyis sha la sbyar te bgo bar bya'o/ /tshad ji tsam dgos pa'o/ /g.yan pa dgab pa ni g.yan pa'i nad can gyi sha la sbyar nas gyon par bya ba yin zhing / tshad srid du khru drug dang / dbangs su khru gsum mo/ /skra bzed ni skra bregs pa'i tshe chos gos bsrung ba'i don du stod du gyon par bya ba ste/ sag lhas/ bsrung ba'i don du skra bzed ni/ /zheng du khru ni phyed dang gnyis/ /srid du khru ni gsum yin te/ /lhag ma brtag par mi bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gding ba ni/ gnas mal bskyab pa'i phyir du gnang ba'i gos yin zhing / tshad srid du khru gsum zheng du khru do sor drug go /dbyar gyi rasachen ni/ dbyar char chu bskyab pa'i phyir du gyon par bya ba yin zhing / tshad srid du khru dgu zhed du khru gsum dang sor bco brgyad do/ /de thamasacad kyang rung ba'i tshon (111ba)gyis kha bsgyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa mkho ba'i yo byad ni dge slong la phral du nye bar mkho ba gdan dang gding g.yogs dang gtung bu la sogs pa yin la/ de yang khyad chos bzhi ldan te/ khru gang yan chad kyi tshad du longasashing / che tshad nges pa med pa rang gzhan thun mong bsabs ma pas bcang ba/ kha dog dang dbyibasanges pa med pa/ rang gzhan thun mong ba'i ming gis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni/ yul yod na btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ yul med na mdun du shā ri'i bu la sogs pa'i nyan thos yod par dmigs te/ lha dgongs su gsol/ gos 'di dag bdag dang tshangs par mtshungasapar spyod pa rnams la mkho ba'i yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlab bo/ /zhes pa gsum brjod de/thabs legs byed pa'o/ /gsum pa lhag pa'i yo byad ni rab byung la med du mi rung ba ma yin kyang /—149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'dagos pa'i dbang gis bcang bar bya ba'i gos yin la/ de yang khyad chos bzhi ldan te/ tshad sngar bzhin/ kha dog dang dbyibs nges pa med pa/ gzhan kho na'i phyir du bcang bar bya ba/ gzhan kho na'i ming gis byin gyis brlab par bya ba'o/ /byin gyis brlab tshul ni/ snam sbyar lhag bo dang ras yug la sogs ba thogs te/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos lhag pa rung ba ma bgyis pa/ rung ba bgyid par 'os pa 'di mkhan po la rung bar bgyi'o/ /mkhan po la yid gtad de bcang bar bgyi'o/ /rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o/ /zhes gsum brjod cing / thabs legasabyed do/ /de yang snam sbyar grangs mang po yod pa yin na gcig 'tsho ba'i (112na〉rgo byad/ gzhan rnams mkho ba dang lhag pa'i yo byad ci rigs par byin gyis brlab bo/ /des na dge slong gis rang gis bdag tu bzung ba'i khru gang yan chad du longs pa'i gos thams cad yo byad gsum po gang rung du byin gyis brlab dgos te/ gzhan du spang ltung bskyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ zhwa dang lham dang ska rags dang lhung bzed kyi snod la sogs pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ mkho ba'i yo byad kyi rgyur bsngosashing / khru gang gi tshad du ma longs pa'o/ khrug pa ni/ lhag pa'i yo byad kyi rgyur bsngos shing khru gang gi tshad du ma longs pa'o/ /lnga pa la/ gang zag gang gis bsam pa ji lta bus dgos pa gang gi phyir longs spyod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mi slob pa'i gang zag gis gzhan gyi yo byad rang dbang ba'i tshul du longs spyad du rung ste/ yon yongs su sbyong ba chen po yin pa'i phyir/ slob pa 'phags pa'i gang zag ni rang la byin ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin du longs spyod nus te/ yon sbyong nus pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa min yang tshul khrims rnam par dag cing thos bsam dang sgrub pa la brtson pa'i gang zag gis gas gyi longs spyod sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i tshul gyis longs spyad du rung ste/ de ltar ston pas gnang ba'i phyir/ tshul khrims rnam par dag kyang thos bsam mi byed pa'i le lo can la ni blang ba bu lon can du 'gyur te/ skye ba phyi mar brgya 'gyur dang stong 'gyur la sogs pa 'jal dgos par skye ba'i phyir/ tshul khrims 'chal 130

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanaba'i gang zag gis gzhan gyi dad rdzas longs spyod pa bkag pa yin te/des dge 'dun gyi dad zas kham gcig tsam dang /btung ba shub gcig tsam dang /dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang dang /12bganas mal la longs spyod na phyi ma ga song du skyes nas lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba za ba dang /khro chu khol ma 'thung ba dang /lcags bsregs kyis gzhi la gom pa 'dor ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar gsungs pa'i phyir/de ltar yang mya ga las 'da' ba'i bsam bas rab tu byung ba tshul khrims dang ldan pa la ni gos stong phrag brgya pa dang /zas ro brgya pa dang /khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya pa yang 'os so//dge 'dun gyi rdzas kyang ngo //mi slob pa man chad kyi'o//so so'i skye bo la yang ngo //tshul khrims 'chal pa la ni ma yin no//le lo can la ni blangs pa dang nye bar spyad pa bu lon du 'gyur ro//zhes dang /sa ga lhas/mi slob pa ni bdag por spyod//slob pa byin pa spyod pa ste//bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa ni//rjes gnang spyod pas nyes pa med/lhag ma le los bcom pa yis/bdag nyid rnams ni bu lon spyod/khrims 'chal rnams ni nam du yang //gtsug lag khang sogs nyer spyod btag/ces gsungs so//ga gyis pa ni/rang gi lus la rma dang ngo tsha ba'i 'du shes/chos gos la rma dkrisadang ngo tsha dgab ba'i snyu shes/gang du gnang ba de ṣka du byin gyis bas pa dran pa dang /dge sbyong gi chos bzhi mtshon byed yin no snyam du bsams nas longs spyod pa'o//gzhan yang 'phral gyi bya ba byed pa'i gnas skabs su 'du shes lnga ldan du longs spyod pa yang gsungs te/'dul ba bsdu ba las/dge slong 'dul ba'i bslab ba la//gnas pa rnam pa lnga 'dod de//grong du 'jug par byed pa na//btson ra yin ni 'du shes dang //gtsug lag khang du 'jug pa na//rtag par dge stong 'du shes dang //zas la rtag 113na ) par nad kyi ni//gawo po nyid kyi 'du shes dang //nyal na dgon pa'i ri dwags ltar/ /thug phrad gnyid kyi 'du shes dang / /'jig rten mthun 'jug bya ba la/ /'on long lhags pa'i 'du shes so//de ltar gnas pa'i dge slong ni//brgya la 'os pa'i longs spyod la//gnas kyang 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi//rjes su 'jug par mi 'gyur ro//zhes pa ltar ro//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pogasum pa ni/ khyim pa dang mu stegs can las rtags kyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags te/ rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / dge sbyong gi dran pa gso ba'i ched du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams chad lhag med par bkod pa yin cing / gzhan yang / mdo rtsa las/ snam phran snel zhi nyid dang lhag ma mnyam pa nyid dang / dbus nas gzhan du glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su lta ba nyid dang mtha' bskor ba nyid dag gis so/ /zhes par rang 'grel las/ gding ba drub par byed pa'i dum bu rnams la phyed dang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nyid ces bya ba la sogs pa'i cho ga gsungs so/ /de'i phyir de srid du drub par byed pa'i dum bu'i dbang du byas nas mdo 'di byas so/ /glegs bu 'phro bzung ba'i dbus nas snam phran rnams la lhag ma gang yin pa de ni 'dir lhag ma nyid du gsungs so/ /phyogasaphyogs su zlos bur bya ste dbus kyi snam phran gzhan rnams mngon par khyab par bsgrub pa'i don du snam phran snrel zhi nyid do/ /lhag ma mnyam pa nyid dang dbus nas gzhan glegs bu 'phro phyogs su lta ba nyid do/ /glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su lta ba nyid ces bya ba ni rgyud gzhan gyi khongs su gtogasapa'i glegs bu'i 'phro de'i dngos (113ba)po dang / mtha' skor nyid dag gis sbyin pa rjes su song ba nyid de/ de ltar rnam pa bzhi po 'di rnams kyi zhes bya ba ni 'di'i don to/ /chos kyi bshes gnyen gyisamadzad pa'i rgya cher 'grel las/ de la snam phran snrel zhi nyid ces bya ba la 'dir snam phran zhes bya ba'i sgra ni srid du btang ba'i tshal bu la bya'o/ /snrel zhi zhes bya ba ni srid du btang ba'i snam phran de dag gi tshal bu rnams kyi sna drang thad du ma babs par mtho dman mi mnyam pa nyid kyis 'grub thabs su nyid du 'dug pa'o/ /de'i dngos po ni de nyid do/ /lhag ma mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba la lhag ma zhes bya ba ni dbus kyi snam phran la ma gtogs pa'i snam phran dag tshal bus non pa gang yin pa de'i lhag ma'i phyogs ni 'dir lhag ma nyid do/ /rjod byed lhag ma de dang dbus kyi snam phran du mnyam par bya'o/ /de'i dngos po ni de nyid do/ /dbus nasagayin du tshal bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su lta ba nyid ces bya ba la/ dbus zhes bya ba ni zhed du thal rang —152

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)du btang ba'i snam phran dbus ma gnyis kyi bar gyi glegs bu'o/ /de nas ga' na du glegs bu'i 'phro zhes bya ba ni/ dus de nas g.yas g.yon gzhan du snam phran zheng du thal drang du btang ba dag gi glegs bu'i 'phro'o/ /phyogs phyogs su lta ba zhes bya ba ni/ g.yas g.yon gyi glegs bu'i thams cad la khyab par bya ba'i phyir phyogs phyogs su zhes zlos bur bya ste/ g.yas phyogs kyi tshal bu rnams kyi 'phro yang g.yas phyogs su phyi brgyud du blta la/ g.yon phyogs kyi tshal bu rnams kyi 'phro yang g.yon phyogs su phyi brgyud du blta ba'o/ /de'i dngos po ni de nyid do/ /de ltar snam phran snrel zhi nyid dang lhag ma mnyam pa nyid dang / dbus nas gzhan du tshal bu'i 'phro (114na)phyogs phyogs su lta ba nyid ces bya ba de gsum gyis ni srid du btang ba'i glegs bu dag drubs pa bstan to/ /mtha' skor ba nyid ces bya ba ni chu zheng gi mtha' 'khor bar kun dga' bo'i mtha' skor gyis bskor ba'o/ /de'i dngos po ni de nyid do/ /de ltar rnam pa bzhi po de dag bsdus pa drubs pa'i chos gos gang yin pa de byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /'di skad bstan te/ ji ltar srid du btang ba'i tshal bu rnams kyi sna mtho dman du 'dug pas snam phran snrel zhi nyid du 'gyur ba de ltar chos gos de drubs par bya'o/ /snam bu gcig la tshal bus non pa'i lhag ma mnon pa ji tsam du yod pa de tsam du de las gzhan pa'i glegs bu lhag ma dag kyang de dang mnyam par bya'o/ /dbus kyi snam bu las bltos nas g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs gnyis su glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su blta bar bya'o/ /ngos bzhi kun nas khor bar kun dga' bo'i mtha' skor gyis 'phro thams cad bskor bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'grel chung yon tan 'od ma las/ dum bur bres pa lhag ma dang mnyam pa ste/ dbus ma las/ gzhan pa de dang der gtagos pa'i 'dab ma'i ngos mtha' skor yang ngo / /chos gos dras shing btsem pa'i thabs ni 'di ltar bya ste/ mdor na chosagos nyid la ltos na brda phrad par 'gyur ro/ /nang du gnas pa dang bla gab dang sbyar la yang ngo / /chos gos snam bu lnga pa dang bdun pa gnyis ni mtshon gyis ma bcad na yang rung / chos gos chen po ni ma bcad na mi rung ste sngags mi chags so/ /gnyis ni sngags ni chags te nyes byas so/ /zhes dang /—133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6geleb leb po'i ched du mnyam par bya/ chos (114na〉kos kyi tshal bu ring thung du 'dug pa ring po de'i tshad du thung ngu bya'o/ /bcal ba'i phyir chag shing bcang / ka sha drub pa'i tshul du bcal ba'i phyir chag shing bcangs kyang nyes med 'dab ma'i ngos kyang ngo / /tshal bu bsnol ma tshur 'gro ba dang zhed du 'gro ba dang tha ma skor ba zheng tshad che chung ma khyer bar mnyam par bya/ de tsam du chag shing bcang tshal bu'i zheng tshad kyi chag shing yang bcang / 'di'i mtha' ni rab tu chen por bzhi'o/ /tshal bu'i sna snol du 'gro ba dang / mtha' skor ba'i zheng ra ni sor bzhir bya'o/ /tshal bu'i zheng sgo bya rog gi rkang pa'i tshad du byas kyang rung / chung ngu phyed dang gsum pa'am mthe bong ngos so/ /tshal bu chung ngu phyed dang gsum dang mtshon gang du byas kyang nyes med de zheng tshad phran tshegs kyi 'grel pa tshul khrims skyang gis mdzad par tshal bu'i snas non par ma gyur pa'i phyogs ni glegs bu yin te glegs bu glegs bu dang / glegs bu phyed pa glegs bu phyed pa dang mnyam por bya'o/ /mthe bong dang nye bar gyur pa mdzub mo gang yin pa de'i dbus ma'i tshigs gang yin pa de'i tshigs kyang logs gang yin pa de'i steng du mthe bo'i tshigs bzhag par gyur pa la mthor grub pa gang yin pa de la 'dir bya rog gi mtho nyid du brjod pa yin la/bya rog gi rkang pa dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'di la yang sor bzhi kho na'i tshad du rnam pa gzhan gyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa yin no/ /slob dpon shes rab byed pas mdzad pa'i mdo rtsa'i 'grel par/ mtshon gyis ma dras pa'i gos mi bgo /zhes pa la sogs pa yin te/ kha tshar ma bcang mtshon gyis ma dras na/ khyim pa'i gos su 'gyur bsan dgag pa'i phyir ro/ /dras shing drubs pa'i gos la (115na)byin gyis brlab/ ces pa 'di lta bu'i chos gos gsum la byin gyis sgro mes shig pa'o/ /ji lta bu drub she na/ tshal bu dbusanas lhag ma dang mnyam pa 'dab ngos spel te gzhan gyi 'og tu bsrul cing mtha' skor ba'o/ /zhes pa yin te/ tshal bu dbus nas kha so sor gyes la tshal bu lhag ma rnams dang zheng tshad mnyam zhing tshal bu phyed du bgo ba'i thog ma rtse sprod du mi bya bar spel te/ tshal bu gzhan gyi 'og tu bsrul ba dang / tha ma 134

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)yang khor yug tu tshal bu'i tshad kyis bskor ba'o/ /'dul ba gzhi bam po re gnyis par/ gos kyi gzhi'i skabs su 'tsho byed gzhen nus gsos kyi ras yug po che phul ba la ston pa'i chos gos gsum/kun dga' bo'i bla gos dang mthang gos/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi ral chung dpung gcad rnams dras shing drubs/ de'i tshe gzugs can snying pos ston pa'i nyan thos su 'byul nas 'tsho ba par phyag btsal bar gzhan rnams kyis 'phyas par brten ston pa la chos gos rnams mtshan ma gdab dgos par gsol ba la 'phros nas/ ji skad du/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyi lus 'phags kyi ri mthong ngam/ btsun pa ma mthong lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i na bza' chos gos kyi mtha' nas zungs shig /des bzung ba dang bcom ldan 'dasakyis rgyal po'i khab na mi snang bar mdzad pas de nyid nas rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' la gshegs nas lus 'phags kyi ri bo la bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ma ga dha'i mi rnams kyi zhing mnyam zhing nye 'khor mnyam pa rnang gi khyad bar sna tshogs dag rnang rgal gyi 'brel (115bzhing mdzes pa dag gzigs nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis zhing mnyam zhing nye 'khor mnyam la rnang gi khyad par sna tshogs pa dag rnang rgal gyis 'brel par mdzes pa de dag mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo de lta bsan dge slong rnams kyis 'di lta bur chos gos dag dras te drub par bya'o/ /gnas brtan kun dga' bos dge slong rnams la smras pa/ khyed kyi 'di lta bur chos gos rnams dros la drubs shig /dge slong rnams kyis chos gos dag dras te drub par brtsams pa na/ snam bu rnams kha phyogs gcig tu bstan pa/ mi mdzes nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal mod kyi/ 'di kho nas rkyen byas nas gnang bar 'gyur ba'i gnas de yod do snyam nas des snam bu rnams kha phyogs gnyis gar bstan na 'on kyang mtha' skor med pas mdzes par ma gyur nas mtha' skor byas so/ /de nas byas shing zin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la phul la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo legasaso— 153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loralegs so/ /ngas gang gi phyir bka' stsal pa de khyed kyis shes te/ de lta bsan dge slong rnams kyis 'di lta bur chos gos rnams dras la drub bar bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing snam sbyar gyi tshal bu'i dogs gnas zhig la/ lung rigs gter mdzod du/ glegs bu phyed pa bya spu non gyi tshul du mnan pa'i 'phro dang / snam phran gyis snam phran g.yas g.yon du bya spu non gyi tshul gyis mnan pa'i 'phro ni tshal bu yin la/ zhes gsungs/ 'di las gsal ba lung sde bzhi dang 'dul ba'i dgongs 'grel bstan 'gyur du bzhugs pa rnams (116na7 ma mthong la/ de dang phyogs 'dra tsam mtha' gcod gsal byed sgron me las/ des na phyed dang lnga pa zhig dbus su byas nas de'i g.yas g.yon du snam phran bcu gnyis bcu gnyis bya spu gzhol du sbyar bas snam phran kha phyogs phyogs su blta ba zhig 'byung ngo / /gang ma'i tshal bu 'phro lhag pa tsam phyi ma'i sne mor sleb par sbyar bas/ tshal bu'i kha phyogs phyogs su blta ba 'byung ste/ mdo rtsa ba las/ dbus na gzhan du glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su blta ba nyid dang /zhes pa dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel ba/ phyogs phyogs su zhes glo 'bur byas te/ g.yas phyogs kyi glegs bu rnams kyi 'phro yang g.yas phyogs su phyi brgyud du blta la/ g.yon phyogs kyi glegs bu rnamasakyi 'phro yang g.yon phyogs su phyi brgyud du blta'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad pas/ spyir lung dang rgya gzhung 'grel bcas/ bod ṭīka snga ma rnams su 'di las gsal ba mi 'byung ba lugs gnyis su ma song bas dgos pa med pa'i stabs kyis rtogs slar mdzad pa 'dra/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi 'dul ṭīka las/ gos kyi gzhi'i skabs su dras shing drubs pa ni glegs bu drasashing drubs pa yin no/ /tshul ji ltar du drubs pa yin zhe na/ ji skad du/ snam phran snrel zhi wo dang /lhag ma mnyam pa nyid dang / dbus nas gzhan du glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su blta ba nyid dang /mtha' skar ba dag gis so/ /mthang gos dang / bla gos dang / snam sbyar la'o zhes gsungs pas drub pa bstan no/ /de'i don yang snam sbyar la snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs kyi sgo nas phye na chung ngu skor gsum/ 'bring skor gsum/ chen po (116ba〉skor gsum ste dgu yod pa las/ dang po gsum ni/—156

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)snam phran dgu pa dang / bcu gcig pa dang / bcu gsum pa rnams yin/ 'di gsum ga la glegs bu phyed dang gsum par byed pa yin no/ /'bring gsum ni/ snam phran bco lnga pa/ bstobadun pa/ bcu dgu pa rnams yin te/ 'di gsum ga la glegs bu phyed dang bzhi par byed do/ /chen po gsum ni/snam phran nyer gcig pa/ nyer gsum pa/ nyer lnga pa rnams yin te/ 'di gsum ga la glegs bu phyed dang lnga bar byed do/ /bla gos la mtha' gcig tu snam phran bdun ma/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa/mthang gos la snam phran lnga pa/ glegs bu phyed dang gnyis par byed do/ /'dul 'dzin grags rgyal gyi bslab bya chen mor/ snam phran dang glegs bu med pa'i bla gos me long ma lta bu bzhed kyang / de ni rab byung ma yin pa'i sngags par khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig gis chos gos su ming 'dogs pa yin pas lugs 'di ji ltar 'thad brtag par bya'o zhes gsungs/ lhung bzed kyi dogs gcod la/ dge legs bshes gnyen gyi gzhi 'grel las/ lhung bzed kyi tshad kyi skabs mthe bo'i lto gang zhes bya ba ni mthe bo'i sor gcig ste/ mthe bo'i tshigs dang po'i phyogs gcig nas brtsams te/ tshigs de nyid kyi phyogs gcig gi bar du sto ral nas gzhal ba ni mthe bo'i lto gang zhes bya ste/ de ni mthe bo'i sor gcig yin no/ /zhes dang / rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa dul ba'i lhas mdzad par/ kha'i cha'i mtha' kho na nas zhes bya ba ni lhung bzed kyi kha'i cha'i mtha' kho na nas nang rol gyi zhabs logs su 'o/ /mthe bo'i lto gang gis mi reg pa zhes bya ba la mthe bo'i lto gang zhes bya ba la mthe bo'i lto gang zhes bya (117na)ba ni mthe po'i tshigs dang po'i phyogs gcig nas brtsams te tshigs de nyid kyi phyogs gcig gi bar ni mthe bo'i sto ste/ mthe bo'i zhed tshad kyi sor gcig gi tshad kyis kha'i cha'i mtha' kho na nas zas la mi reg mi thug ces bya ba'i tha tshig go /'dul ṭīka rin cen 'phreng bar yang 'di dang mthun kyang 'ga' zhig sor do dang mthun ched du mthe bo'i rtse nas tshigs dang po yan la ngos 'dzin pa zhabrul/'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum zhib tu phye na/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gyi tshad/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad gos bcu gsum la/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ rngul gzan/ rngul gzan gyi gzan rnams tshad mtshungs—157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ashing / che tshad srid du khru gsum dang / zhed du khru lnga/ chung tshad srid du khru phyed gsum dang / zhed du khru phyed lnga/ bar de dag gang rung 'bring tshad/ mthang gos/ sham thabs/ sham thabs kyi gzan rnams tshad 'dra bar che tshad srid du do dang zheng lnga/ chung ba zheng du bzhi/ bar de dag 'bring / gdong phyis khru gang gru bzhi / rnag gzan ji tsam 'os pa/ g.yan pa dgab pa srid du khru drug dang dpangs su khru gsum/skra bzed srid du khru gsum/ zhed du khru phyed do/ gding ba srid du khru gsum/ zheng du khru do sor drug /'char ka lta bu lus shin tu ring bar des ma chog na srid du khru phyed do bskyed pa/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen srid du khru dgu /zheng du khru gsum sor bco brgyad du bshad la/ gding ba'i tshad so thar/ rnam 'byed/ so thar rgya 'grel rnams dang / mdo rtsa rgya 'grel bzhi/ tshig le sa ga lhas mdzad ba rnams tshang 'di ga dang mthun kyang gru bzhin byed pa'i khungs ma brnyed/ gding (117ba tha g.yan dgab ras chen ma gtogs gos gzhan rnams gzhal ba'i tshad rdul khru dang lag khrus go mi chod de/ lus khrus gzhal dgos la/ de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ khu'i don ni lus cha bdun las gnyis sgo zhes gsungs pas so//de dag gi kha dog 'dul ba lung / mdo rtsa rgya 'grel bzhi/ dge tshul gyi sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel sogasamathun par/ sa ga lhas/ rgya skyegs le brgan rtsi dang btsod/ /rma shing rtsi dang mthing shun mtshal/ /si rtse ra dang gur gum ste/ /de dag tshon chen brgyad du bshad/ /tshon chen brgyad kyis chos gos kyi/ kha bsgyur byed pa bkag pa yin/ /sngon bo btsag dang ngur smig ste/ /de dag rung ba'i tshon gsum mo/ /zhes sngon po de rams dang btsag /ngur smig ste tshos snyigs ma/ gsum gyi gos rnams kyis gos kyi kha bsgyur byed par gsungs la/ /tshon chen brgyad kyi kha bsgyur byed pa bkag 'dug kyang / deng sang btsod kyisakha bsgyur ba ni/ dper na/ bal nag gi spang ba'i skabs yul 'ga' zhig tu bal nag po las dkar po gong che na de gnyis ༷ sbyo bar gsungs pa ltar/ bod du sngon gyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnamasakyis/ rgya gar du rams rnyed par bla yang / bod du rnyed dka' ba dang / bcod 'di bod du bsgrub sla ba'i dbang du mdzad de sngon po dang bcod gnyis go brje bar mdzad pa yin nam snyam/ 'jal byed kyi —/58

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanakhru yang 'dul ba las/ rdul khru dang / lus khru dang / lag khru gsum bshad pa'i dang po ni/ mdo rtsalas/ rdul phra rab dang rdul phra mo dang / chu dang / lcags dang / ri bong dang / lug dang / glang dang / nyi zer gyi rdul dang / sro ma dang / shig dang / nas dang / sor rnams ni snga ma drug las phyi ma'o/ sor bzhi drug la khru gang ngo / /khru (118na8da dang bzhi la ni mi'i srid do/ khru bzhi la gzhu'o/ /de lnga brgya la rgyang grags so/ dgon pa'i dang po ni de'i mtha' 'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ mdo rtsalas/khu'i don ni lus kyi cha bdun la gnyis so/ /zhes dang / gsum ba ni/ ṭīkka las/ khru ni gru mo nas gung mo'i rtse'i bar ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gzhal tshul sogs ni/ mtsho sna pas/rdul khru lus khru lag khru ste/ khru gsum rnam dbye shes par bya/ /rdul khrus gzhal bar bya ba ni/ khang pa'i tshad dang khri rkang tshad/ /gding ba g.yan dgab ras chen no/ /de dag las gzhan chos gos rnams//lus khu'am lag khrus gzhal ba ste/ /lus ring ha cang lag thung dang / /de las ldog pa'i chos gos rnams/ /rang gi lus khru kho nas gzhal/ /lus tshad lag tshad 'tsham pa yis/ /lag khrus kyang ni gzhal du rung / /zhes gzung bar gsungs so/ /ral kha dpung ho ni sgo la nges bzung che ba med kyang thang sham gyi phyed las che ba mi rung ba 'dra zhing / de yang mtsho ṭīka las/ ral kha dpung chad ni rgya khyon ji tsam yod pa logs su byin gyis brlabs te sgro gu'am zungs kyis 'thud pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ko lngags ni btang snyoms su bzhal cing 'di skor la stag tshang lo tsā ba'i 'dul ṭīka tu ngo mtshar ba'i gtam snang ba 'di lta ste/ gnyis pa gos gzhi dngos la yang dgos bsdus tshig gsum las/ dgosapa ni/ gos kyi rgyu'i rnyed pa lamakhas pas log 'tsho mi 'byung zhing gos dra ba dang / drub pa dang / kha bsgyur ba dang / byin gyis rlobe pa sogs la mkhas pas/ gos mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar 'gyur bas so/ /bsdus(118na ldan la/ gleng gzhi dang / gos rgyu rnyed pa'i rnam gzhag dang / de las nga ba'i gos kyi rang bzhin dang / gos de gang zag gis longs spyad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal po gzugasacan snying pos ded dpon zhig gi chung ma la log par zhugs pa bu gcig byung ba la 'tsho byed gzhen nu —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pogasos su btags shing rgyun shes la sman mkhas par bslabs nas/ pha dang / ma yar mo dang / spun zla ma skyes dgra rnams kyi phol mig bcos pas/ sman pa'i rgyal por lan gsum dbang bskur bas nga rgyal skyes pa ri bo gangs can du bcom ldan 'das kyis zhi bar mdzad pas bden pa mthong zhing / lus 'phags kyi rgyal po'i lus gsos pas/ pa ṇa brgya stong ri ba'i ras yug yon du thob pa sangs rgyas la phul bas/ kun dga' pos/ ston pa'i chos gos gsum dang / rang gi mthang gos gcig /sgra gcan 'dzin gyi ral kha dpung chad rnams byas shing / gzhan yang dge slong du mas dbyar gyi rgyu las byung ba'i gos du ma la ji ltar drub pa ma shes pa na gos kyi gzhi gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la rnyed pa bgo ba'i cho ga dang / de la dbang mi dbang gi gang zag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bdun te/ dge 'dun ni der ga rta gos shing mi mthun pa med pa'o/ /byed pa po ni bskos pa'am mdung dor ba'o/ /dngos po ni/ dus glo bur gyi'am/ gos kyi rnyed par 'os pa'i shi ba'i yo byad do/ /tshad la/ zas ni su la sa'i sogs dang / gos ni mar me'i sogs so/ /cho ga la sbyor ba ni bsheg tu mi rung ba rnams bskyed pa'i tshul gyis bsgyur zhing gzhan de nyid du sta gon bya'o/ /dngos gzhi ni tshogs pa la brjod pa la sogs pa lnga'o/ /dgos pa (119na ji snyoms shing so sor longs spyad pa'i ched do/ /blang ba'i bslab bya ni/ 'dus pas rang rang gi skal ba dang bskos pas gzhan du song ba'i nod pa'o/ /blon po sogs kyi ched ma gtogos ma bcol bar mi nod/ khas blangs nas ma nos na gsab/ gzhan don du ma nos pa de 'god pa po la brda sprad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la dus dang/ glo bur ba'i dang / shi ba'i yo byad kyi rnyed pa gang dbang ngo / /dang po la gnyis las/ sems can las byung ba la lnga ste/ gnas kyis dang / dus kyis dang / khrims kyis dang /mtshams kyis dang / sbyin bdag gis bsgrubs pa'o/ /sems can ma yin pa las byung ba la/ mchod rten dang / dam chos dang / gzhi gzhan las byung ba'o/ /dang po la/ sangs rgyas dang brtse ru'i la phul na de nyid kyi ched du bzhag tshogs spyod dang nyan thos kyi la phul ba tshangs par spyod pas bgo /don —160

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanadam pa'i chos la phul ba mchod rten dang 'dra/ lung gi chos la phul ba chos smra bas dpyad/ gzhi gzhan gyi ljon shing la phul ba'i rnyed pa ni de nyid brgyan pa'i phyir du bzhag pa sogs so/ /gnyis pa la/sdom ldan gyi dang / rtags can gyi gnyis las/ dang po la drug las/ gang zag ni rab byung gi sdom pa dang ldan/ mtshan dang lta ba mthun/ gnas nas ma phyung / bye ba na gzhan phyogs su ma song ba ste/ chosalnga ldan no/ /dang po dge 'dun dbang ba rnams la gtabs pa'o/ /mtshams ni nor ram/ nor 'dra ba gang na 'dug par gtogos pa'o/ /dus ni gsol ba 'am dang po tha mas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /cho ga ni mtshams der shi na ro dbyung ba sogs byas te byin gyis brlabs pa (119bskong / gzhan du shi na byin gyis brlabs pa tsam bya ba'o/ /tshad ni dge tshul pha ma sum gnyis dang / bsnyen par rdzogs kha ma dang / dge slob ma/ dge slong pha ma rnams mnyam pa'o/ /rtags can gyi la rgyal po dang dkon cog tu bgo ba dang / dkon cog gsum nang ji ltar bgo ba dang / dge 'dun nyid kyi skal ba ji ltar spyad pa rnams so/ /gsum pa la gos ji ltar bsgrub ba dang / bsgrubs pa'i gos kyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la dra ba dang/ drub pa dang / bkru ba dang / kha bsgyur ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa la bdun te/ dbye ba dang /mas nyid dang / byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga dang / de'i dgos pa dang / bcang ba'i thabs dang /longs spyad pa'i cho ga dang / zhan la byin brlabs 'jig pa'i rgyu'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ 'tsho ba'i dang / mkho ba'i dang / lhag pa'i yo byad dang / yo byad phran tshegs rnams so/ /de'i dang po la bstogasum du dbye zhing / gzhan rnams la dbye grangs med do/ /mtshan nyid la dang po'i ni rung ba dang /tshad dang ldan pa dang / re re bar nges pa dang / rang ming gis byin gyis brlab bya yin pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan no/ kha cig /rang don du 'amang du gnang ba bsnan zhes zer mod kyi/ de ni rung ba dang rang ming nyid kyis zhes pas cho de do/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ khru gang yan chad du longs shing zong gosasu nges ma nges kyi blo 'byung ba/ kha bsgyur ma bsgyur gang rung gzhan gnyis ga'i ming gis byin gyis—161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gebarlab bya yin pa'o//gsum pa'i mtshan nyid ni/phal cher rung ba tshad ldan gzhan kho na'i ming gisabyin gyis brlabs pa'am/yid brtan pa gang rung gis bcang bar 120na ) bya'o//yo byad 'di khyad par bshes gnyen gyis/shig sro mang ba dang /zhal ta pa las mang ba dang /dri ma mang ba sogs brgyal gnang bar bshad do//bzhi pa ni tshad du ma chog pa'i dang /'khor du ga lha gos pa'i phran tshegasaganyis te/dang po ni/rung ba khru gang gi tshad du ma longs pa ste so so'i blo bskyed pa tsam las gas pa'i byin rlabs med pa'o//gnyis pa ni/sngas dang stan dang ska rags zhwa//sbrang skyabs sogs dang chu tshags dang //gtur bu rkang 'bob lhung bzed snod//de yi kha g.yogs la sogs so//de dag ni yo byad kyi gos sam stan du byin gyis brlab bya'o//gsum pa la/'tsho ba'i yo byad ni/btsun pa dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo//lan gsum brjod/thabs legs bya'o//de bzhin du ming brje'o//gnyis pa'i ni/gos 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi mkho ba'i yo byad du byin gyis brlab bo//gsum pa ni/rung ba yin na/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyis pa'i gos lhag pa rnam par ma brtags pa brtag par 'os pa 'di mkhan po'i legs par rnam par brtag par bgyi'o//mkhan po la yid brtan te bcang bar bgyi'o//rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o//mi rung ba yin na/sbyin bdag la yid brtan te bcang bar bya'o//bzhi pa'i ni/gos 'di yo byad kyi gos sam stan du zhes so//bzhi pa ni/lhung ba mi 'byung ba dang /dge sbyong gi dran pa gsob dang /gos la mngon zhen spong ba dang /gos mi rung ba mi 'chang ba dang /120bsko zhan ma dad pa spong ba'i dgos pa yod do//lnga pa ni/gang dang gang du byin gyi brlabs pa de mi brjed pa'i tshul gyis brlabs pa de mi brjed pa'i tshul gyis rang gi nyid la sogs pa'i chen pa dang bral te bcang ba'o/khrug pa la drug ste/chud za ba dang /ma gus pa dang /mi rung ba dang /rtags gzhan du gyur pa spang ba dang /bde 6bar gnas pa'i rkyen du bsgrub pa dang /yin byung

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)lam du 'jug tshul la mkhas pas longs spyod pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ rten nyams chud dang brjed dang bsngos/ /brlag dang spang lhung byung ba dang / /bar pa gnyis la rang gzhan skyes/ /yid brtan yul ni shi bar nges/ /de rnams byin rlabs 'jig rgyu'o/ /spyi'i bzhi pa ni/ spyir bstan mya ga las 'das pa'i bsam pas rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims dang ldan la/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang dmigs bsal de dag med kyang gos kyis bstangs par bya bas spyad par 'os so/ /tshig don la gnyis las/ gzhi'i skabs la/ gos dngos kyi dang / gos rgyu rnyed pa'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la/ drub pa dang / brkyang ba dang / mi rung ba spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ kha tshar ma bcad pa lta bus tshone gyis sogs te khyim pa'i gosayin pa'i phyir ro/ /'chad 'gyur bzhis khyad par du byas pa'i dras shing sogs/ bzhi po ni/ srid du btang ba'i glegs bu snam phran yin pas de thal mar ma btang ba'i snrel zhi dang / tshal bus ma khyab pa'i lhag ma rnams che mnyam chung mnyam du mnyam pa dang / zheng du btang ba'i glegs bu'i 'phro rnamasadabus nas phyogs su lta ba dang / tshal bu dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris mtha' bskor ba rnams la nyid ces pa dngos po'i rkyen te de'i dngos po (121na snyad do/ /dras drubs de yang mthang gos ni smad kyi nang du bgo bas nang gos zhes pa ste anta ra zhes pa nang la 'jug pa las/ mthang zhes pa nang gi brda rnying yin pa dang / bla ni steng la 'jug bas stod kyi gos dang / snam phran dras te sbyar bsan snam sbyar rnams te/ de yang phreng rgyud du/ snam sbyar nges par dras te bcang / /gzhan dag ma nges gang gi phyir/ /'dod chung rang gi chos gos kyi/ /las kyi skyo bar 'gyur phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs shing 'dir rnam pa gang yang sogs so/ /gzhan ni go bar zad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnas mal sogs te/ mal stan lta zhog tha mal par 'dug pa'i stan yan chad la dge 'dun de ma yin pa'i gding ba med par sogs/gsum pa ni srin bal sogs te/ dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba lta bu rnams su ma byas sogs/ skra las byas pa'i la ba dang / thal bas byugs pa'i gcer bu pa dang / bya 'ug pa'i sgro las byas pa rnamasal yang dag par len pa sbyar ro/ /'di'i sbom po rnams yon tan sgra'i sbom bo yin pa la sgrub byed med —163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6podo zhes bya 'dul gsung mod/ sgrub byed gong du brjod zin to/ /dor ma la sogs pa'i yan lag gi sbubs dang / gos thams cad sngo ba ni/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs sngo ba kun bkag la/ 'od ldan du thams cad ser ba dang dmar ba'ang mi rung bar 'dod mod/ slob dpon 'di ni mi bzhed pas sngo zhesazur du thon pa mdzad do/ /gnyis pa la/ rnyed pa bgo ba'i dang / rnyed pa gang dbang gi rnam gzhag go /dang po la/ tshad ni/shing bu la sa'i 'dab ma ni (121ba 'grel chung mkhan pos zar ma'i 'dab ma la bshad do/ /cho ga la sbyor ba ni/ la ba dang sogs/ dngos gzhi ni rnyed pa bgo ba la lnga bya'o/ /lnga ni deng so gos so/ /lnga po'i tha ma yan chad byed pa nyid na glo bur du 'ongs pa ni dbyar gnas lta bu la phul ba sogs nges pa'i rnyed pa ma yin pa dge 'dun la spyir spags te phul ba'i rnyed pa ni dbang ba nyid yin no sogs lnga ga'i mjug tu sogs dbyar gnas pa lta bu rnyed pa thob pa'i bya ba der sogs bsang pa'i tshad ni pa ṇa ste ma sha lnga la sogs pa'o/ /gang zag gi rnam gzhag la dus dang / glo bur ba'i dang / shi ba'i yo byad kyi rnyed pa gang dbang gnyis so/ /dang po la drug las/ gnas kyis bsgrubs pa ni/ gnas kyi rnyed pa dbang ba'i dge slong gcig nyid kyis ras yug chen brgya la sogs pa shin tu sogs/ de'i dogs gcod ni bye ba sogs/ dus kyis bsgrubs pa ni/ dbyar gnas de'i dus sogs/ dogs gcod babs pa sogs/ sbyin bdag gis bsgrubs pa ni/ rnyed pa ni sbyin bdag de rang gis ji ltar sogs te/ dusatshigs dang gnas dang gang zag sogs kho rang gis gang la phul ba de'o/ /khrims kyis bsgrubs pa ni/rnyed pa thob pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang khrims su ji ltar bcad pa bzhin no/ /de'i dogs gcod ni/ khyim bdag lta bu zhig gis dge 'dun thams cad kyi cha tshang bar phul na yang dge 'dun rang gisakhrims su gang byas de rnams dbang zhes pa'o/ /des na zas tsam yang phyogs des rjes su ma gnang bar gzhan gyis len du mi rung bar bshad do/ /mtshams kyis bsgrub pa ni/ dge 'dun tsam la phul zhing dge 'dun (122na 'di dag ces yongs su ma bcad na las kyi mtshams po che sogs yongs su 164

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)bcad nas bgo bar bya'o/ /'di la mtshams nang de na gcig la sogs pa dge 'dun du ma longs pa ni/ dge 'dun de nyid yin pas rnyed pa de dbang ngo / /lung gi chos kyi rnyed pa ni sogs dang / chos smra ba'i tshad ni/ gtsug lag gi sogs te/ 'dul ba bye brag tu bshad pa sogs las mya ngan las 'dasapa la phul ba ni mchod rten gyi dang 'dra bar bzhag go /zhes gsungs pas rtogs pa'i chos la phul ba mi dbang ngo / /shi ba'i yo byad la rab byung shi ba'i dang / rtags can shi ba'i yo byad la ji ltar dbang ba gnyis las/ dang po las/ gang zag dang / dus dang / mtshams dang / cho ga dang / dngos po'i sgo nas rnam par bzhag pa ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ mtshan mi mthun pa sogs te/ gnas nas byung ba ni ma phyung ba med na yang gnas nas ma phyung ba gzhan shi ba'i yo byad de mi dbang ste dge 'dun du mi gtogs pas so/ /'on kyang rgyu las sems ma log na de ltar yin gyi/ log na dbang ste dge 'dun du mi gtogs pa'i rgyu de btang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas nas phyung ba shi ba'i yo byad de gnas nas ma phyung ba rnams dbang ba ci zhe na/ spyir gnas nas byung ba de ni dge 'dun las tha dad pa nyid yin yang gnas nas phyung ba de'i shi ba'i yo byad de nod par bya ba nyid la tha dad ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos dang chos min gyi phyogs tha dad pa shi ba'i yo byad la ni phyogs gnyis phyogs tha dad pa yin pas phan tshun mi dbang ngo / /spyir ni skabs 'dir rab tu byung sogs te/ rim pa (122ba tha zhin khyim pa dang mu stegs su gyur pa'i nye du lta bu mi dbang ba nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis byin gyis brlab pa'am/ dang po gnas brtan nam tha ma gsar bu la rdzas de las 'ga' zhig sbyin pa ni/dang po tha ma'i las de zhes bya ba yin pas de gnyis gang rung gis byin gyis brlabs zin nas phyis 'ongs pa rnams mi dbang la de yan chad du 'ongs pa rnams dbang zhing dge 'dun gyi ched du song na phyis 'ongs pa yang dbang bar 'grel chung nas bshad do/ /'di ni dang po dang tha ma'i gang zag gnyis 163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logel byin pas sam/ yas bgrangs mas bgrangs kyi tha ma gnyis la dang por sbyin pas kyang de zhesabya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gshin po dang gshin rdzas gnyis kyi nang nas gshin rdzas gtso che ste/ mtshamasagang na byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i spyod 'dug pa sogs gnyis kyi phyir mtshams kyi bar du yod pa la ni/ sum brgya par/ gtsug lag khang gi mtshams kyi bar shi na/ /gang du mgo bo bzhag pa dbang ba yin/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ shi rdzas dang / nor bcol ba gnyis kyi phyi ma gtso che ste/ mtshams gang na nor dang 'dra ba sogs mdo gnyis kyi phyir nor dang 'dra ba ni/ sum brgya par/ gang la de yi rdzas ni gtams gyur pa/ /mi de nor dang 'dra bar bya zhes bshad/ /ces so/ zhar byung grogs mched lta bu phan tshun spyad dngos bskur ba na bskur bar bya bas ma spangs pa ni bskur bya de nyid kyi yin la/ des spangs na bskur bar byed pa nyid kyis yin la des spangs na yang de nyid kyi yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du (123na〉nga sogs te/ 'ba' zhig /mi mthun pa'o/ /'di ni 'du shes 'khrul pas mi chags pa yin la/ ro dbyung ba dang rim gro sogs te/ 'di ni cho ga khyad par can nyams pas mi chags pas so/ /lnga pa la bzhi las/ khyim gyi nang na yod pa ni khyim bdag gis gang la byin pa dbang ba ni lhung bzed sogs te/ sbyin bdag des sbyin pa'i sgo nas nges par mi byed na des 'phongs shing khas blangs pa'i rtsol ba dang ldan pa de dbang zhing / de yang du ma cig car slong na spyir dang mthar gyis na dang po dang slong ba med pa nyid sogs na dang dang por khyim der song sogs/ bu lon gyi yo byad bu lon pa dbang ba ni bu lon sogs te 'di ni bka' gnyan bas dge 'dun gyi bgo tshar na'ang bsdus nas gzhal lo/ /gshin po de dang bu lon pa de lhan cig 'jal len rnam par bzhag pa na tshong pa las ras yug chen nyos te bu lon pa la gzhal/ bar chad 'dug na sbyin par bya ba nyid rin de sprad pas chog gi chad pa'i ras yug wo de nyid spyod dgos pa ma yin pa dang /thag pa la rgyu skrun gto 'dug na blang bar bya ba ras yug nyid blangs pas chog gi khu skrun de nyid blang dgos pa ma yin pa'o/ /bu lon pa bka' gnyan yang des grogs tshangs sogs las gsar pa —166

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)byed pa po lag gi bla la sogs pas dkon cog sogs te/ 'ded mkhan dngos su med pas gzhal mi dgos sam snyam pa'i dogs gcod do/ /yo byad drug nad g.yog dbang ba ni nad g.yog sogs te/drug ni chos gos gsum dang stan dang lhung bzed dang chu tshags so/ /'on kyang khyim pa lta (123ba)bu drug po de spyir mi dbang ba la mi sbyin zhing / dbang na gzhan du gnas par sogs kyang ngo / /mdor na rab byung shi ba'i yo byad dbang ba'i dge 'dun du gtogs pa la chos bzhi tshang dgos te/ rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan/ mtshan mthun/ gnas nas ma phyung / gzhan phyogs su ma song ba'o/ /de'i steng du nad g.yog gi yo byad dbang ba la chos gnyis bsnan te/ nad g.yog dngos su byed bzhin pa'am de'i ched du gzhan du song ba'o/ lle ba'i yo byad bgo ba la dbyar rnyed gos rnyed bzhin du mtho dman mi byed de/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa yang thams cad mnyam por dbang bas so/ /nad pas ma shi gong du byin na de dbang ba ni/ nad pas sogs te bstos med du byin zin pas so/ khre zin pa nyid kyi dus na bstos pa dang bcas te sbyin bya'i rdzas nyid bsgrub pa'i tshul du byin pa'i nor bdag mi dbang ste/ sum brgya par/ kho bo 'das nas sbyin zhes byin pa ni/ /de shi na yang spyin par mi bya ste/ /sdom brtson bu la sogs pa bstos bral phyir/ /bstos dang bcas pa'i sbyin pa byin pa min/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa rtags can gyi la/ bzhi las bu la so gos la byin pa de dbang ba ni khyim na sogs/ rgyal bo dang dkon cog tu bgo ba so gos ni/ glang po sogs/ dkon cog gsum nang du bgo ba ni/ dbyig dang gser dang gzhan brdungs su byas sogs/ mu tig rnams/ gal te rin po che gzhan sogs te sangs rgyas nyid kyi thob ba gcig byed pa'o/ /mtshal ma/ mthing sogs tshoni rtsi chen po'o/ /mu tig de dag ni btags te sogs dang / mu tig de ma yin pa sogs/ glang (124na)chen sogs kyi theg pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan gyi srog shing der rung sogs de 'dra las ga' na dag dang sogs/ dge 'dun gyi bzhag pa sogs gsum du bya ba ni dge 'dun gyi sngar smos las gzhan ni sogs/ myur du mi 'grub pa'i dam rgya ni/ bu lon 'phral du mi khugs pa'i yi ge'o/ /gzhan gsum ni —167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logemu stegs kyi bstan bcos dang / myur du khugs pa'i dang / gos 'tshe pa'i mtshon no/ /gzhan rnamasani rtogs sla'o/ /gnyis pa phran tshegs la sogs pa'i skabs byung la/ phran tshegs dngos dang / phran tshegs dang bcas pa gzhan nas yang ba'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ gos sgrub pa'i dang / longs spyod pa'i dang / zhar byung lam du 'gro ba'i dang / bcos legs bya ba'i dang dur khrod pa bsten pa'i dang /bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi spros pa'o/ /dang po la dra ba dang / drub pa dang / bkru ba dang / kha bsgyur ba bzhi las/ dang po la tshad ni/ glegs bu sogs/ gzhi ni sal sogs/ dra spyad ni dre'u sogs/gnyis pa la gnas ni lci ba'i sogs/ 'tshem spyad ni/ bya gag gi shog shing dang / smyug ma'i tshal busade btsem par bya'o/ /der ma zad khab kyis kyang sogs/ tshul ni mi 'jil sogs so/ /gsum pa la/tshul ni btso sogs/ snod ni gzhed sogs/ bkru bya la dogs bcod ni phyag dar sogs so/ /bzhi pa la sbyor ba tshon sbyar ba ni/ tshon bzang po sogs dngos gzhi/ gos gzhug pa ni sngar dang po sogs/mjug skam pa ni gzar thag sogs/ bsgyur dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa (124ba ji/ tshon gsar pa rnams ni gos gsar pa la sogs/ bsgyur ba'i gnas ni/ bang rim sogs/ mjug gi byi dor ni/tshon gyi las byas zin nas sogs/ longs spyod pa la mi rung ba dgag pa ni/ bcags pa sogs/ rung ba bsgrub pa la kha dog dang dbyibs dang gzhi dang bya ba dang gnas dang snod rnams rung ba bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni 'di la sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ sham thabs sogs te/ shur bu sogs bzhi ni/ da ltar grags pa'i sger chung dang / lhas ma gru bzhi dag ska rags spungs btags ma dang / da ltar grags pa'i sgom thag lta bu'o/ /tshom bu sogs bzhi ni/ gser skud kyi shar bu gsum mam bzhi'i tshom bu la mdo mdor nor bus spras pa dang / gser las byas pa'i tshar tshar grog sgal gyi bar ril bu can gser skud kyis ༷ / thog mar dril bu g.yer kha btags pa'i 'og pag dang / gser las byas pa zla gam dang gru gsum gyis brgyan pa'i 'og pag dang / gser las byas pa'i lu gu rgyud rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ bzhi sogs te rkang pa bkru ba sogs mi gtsang ba'i byi dor ro/ /—168

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)bzhi pa ni/ brtul ba sogs te bla gos der dang snam sbyar de la sogs rnag gzan de'i kha bsgyur ba de ni btsag gis gzugs so/ /'dzag pa de'i skam pa dang sha bkrar mi 'gyur ba da la ni sogs lnga pa ni/ cho me gos dag sogs/ drug pa ni/ gtur bu sogs/ gsum pa la/ sbyor ba rang gnas su dang / dngos gzhi lam du dang / 'jug gzhan gnas su ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sang sogs gnyis pa la ngag gi dang / lus kya (125na〉1da lam gnyis kyi dang po ni/ lam du sogs/gnyis pa ni/ lam du sogs/ gsum pa la/ 'gron po'i dang gzhi po'i bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ rgan rim sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ rkus shes sogs/ gang la dbul bar bya ba gtong mkhan 'gyas lhung nas brlag na des gzhal zhing des ma blangs par btang na yang ngo / /bsu ba'i rgyas bshad lhung bzed dang sogs/ 'gron po des kyang dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi sogs/ gnas brtan des 'gron po de sogs/ bzhi pa ni/ chos gos kyi mtha' zegs sogs/ lnga pa ni/ bdag dur khrod pa'o sogs/ dur khrod sbyi pas na bdag gis bdag gir sogs/ drug pa la gsum gyi sbrang g.yob bcang ba ni/ sbrang g.yab sogs dang po ni/ log pa'i 'tsho ba char gtogos dang bcas pa spangs te yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba la brten pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub par bya'o/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba la lnga ste/ tshul 'chos kyi sgo nas rnyed pa bsgrub pa/ kha gsag /gshogs slong / thob kyis 'jal ba'i sgo nas rnyed pa bsgrub pa/ rnyed pas brnyed pa 'dod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rin cen 'phreng bar/ tshul 'chos rnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir/ / dbang po sdom par byed pas te/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha gsag rnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir/ /tshig 'jam snyan par smra ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhogs slong seng ni thob bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rdzas la bsngags byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thob kyis 'jal ba rnyed pa'i phyir/ /mngon sum gzhan la smod byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ rnyed pas brnyed pa rnams 'dod pas/ /sngar thob pa la bsngags byed pa'o//zhes te/ rnga yab kyi gzugs can no/ /sbrang skyabs bcang ba ni/ sbrang sogs te/ phya ther chung ngu'i dbyibs can no/ /bsil yab bcang ba ni/ tsha bar ni sogs te/ yu ba la gong du bkag zin pas/—169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobasil yab kyi lus khra khra sogs/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gos kyi rgyud dang rang bzhin dang / skabasabyung gzhan bshad pa'o/ dang po la bzhi las/ gzhi gang las byung ba gang du bcad pa ni/ bu dang sogs/ rin de ji tsam du sogs/ lan cig phul ba de sbyin bdag gi dad pa spel ba'i phyir du yang dang sogs/ rtsig pa la phul ba yin na sogs/ sal phul ba yin na zhes rdzing bu'i yang ngo zhes pa'i bar re re la rdzing bu'i sal phul na zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /gzhung kha cig las rdzing bu'i sal phul ba de ni sogs / spyir dkon cog gi sogs/ shing rta'i 'phang lo'o/ snod spyad 'bru ba sogs/ sangs (125ba)rgyas rje btsun la sogs pa mchod pa 'di la gnas gcig gi nang du dge slong ma de dag gi sogs snod spyad 'gengs pa de gsol gnyis kyis bsko/ gnas brtan gyis rin btab pa de lasabaskyed cing mtho ba'i thabs kyis btsong ba'o/ /rin btab pa des ni gnas brtan de las nyo ba dang 'jal ba mi 'bab bo/ /bud med nyo bas ni rin de ltar bskyed par mi bya'o/ /gang zag gang gisalong spyad pa ni/ mya ngan las sogs te/ gos sogs gsum ni rkan pa ṇa 'bum ri ba dang / ro'i rnam pa brgya yod ba'i zas dang / khang brtsegs mi lnga brgya shong ba'am/ ne sdu'i sna lta bu lnga brgya yod pa'o/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi sbyin bdag gi rdzas su ma zad dge 'dun gyi rdzas kyang ste/ de yang dge 'dun mi slob pa sogs kyi yang dbang ngo / /de dag ni len pa bzhi las bdag pos len pa yin la/ dbang phyug gis len pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /ma byin par len pa ni tshul khrims 'chal ba zhes te/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag /zos par 'gyur ba mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ yul 'khor bsod snyoms spyod pa min/ /zhes dang / khyad par dge 'dun gyi rdzas la spyad pa dang / gtsug lag khang du gom pa gcig bor ba'i rnam smin bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad do/ /tshul khri mas dang ldan yang brtson 'grus med pa'i le lo can la ni sogs te/ de ni bu lon gyis len par bshad do/ /dge 'dun gyi bzhag pa la sogs pa'i spros pa ni/ dge 'dun gyi mtshams kyi sogs te/ kho rang gi der ma zad dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa yang 'os so/ /sngar (126na)—170

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)bshad pa'i bgo rdzas gzhan dag ces pa'i lcags sogs tshon rtsi ni gur gum sogs tshon chen po lnga las ga' na pa'o/ /tshon chen sgol ba ni sogs/ de dag gta' mar gzhag par sogs/ /tshon chen gyis bsgyur ba de gang zag gi gos su byin gyis sogs pha ma la zas dang gos kyis bstangs pa ste/phan gdags par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i brda rnying yin gyi/ sbyin pa btang bar bya'o zhes pa'i don ma yin no//stongs dang grogs/ stobs gdab par bya'o zhes sogs dang gcig go /gnyis pa la brten pa dang / bcang ba dang / spyad pa'o/ /dang po la rtags nyams pa spang ba ni/bye brag sogs te/ sdo pa so so la mtshan ma so sor bshad pa sogs 'dir 'chad mod kyi/ rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa ni ston pa sku mched lta bu 'dra 'dra rnams mi nor ba'i ched du'o/ /'bral spang du bshad pa'i rkyen de lta bu de dag med par snam sbyar ma dras pa des sogs/ dras shing drubs pa chos gos nyid du zhes pa'i chos gos ni 'dir 'grel chen gyi snam sbyar la dgongs par lung rigs du mas bsgrubs so/ /mu stegs 'khod na sogs/ gos lhag mi rung ba ji ltar bsten pa ni/ spu can sogs te/ rkyen dgos med na'o/ /skru can de la mi bca' ba ma yin pa'i bgo ba'i sogs/ seng ba dag ni/ rkyen dgosayod na longs spyad du yang rung mod kyi/ med na bcang ba'i don tsam du bdag gir bya'o/ /dri ma dang shig la sogs pa'i gnod pa med na lwa ba spu can de sogs/ /par sig gi yul nas byung ba'i lwa ba dang / spu shin tu ring ba'i be'u phrug dang / tshon bkra ba'i par tang khra bo rnams ni rim pa bzhin (126bsko cang rin che ba dang / me tog lta bu'i ri mo yod pa dang ha cang bkra bas bkag go /'chags sar par tang khra'o yin na gding ba sogs/ par tang de rnyings nas bcos par sogs/ spu can dang spu dma' ba sogs las gzhan pa'i par sig gi lwa ba sogs ni sbyin bdag de dbang ba'i bsam pas de la yid gtad de bcang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snam sbyar sogs te/ yo byad bcu gsum mo/ /phreng rgyud du dbye grangs cud zad mi 'dra ba tsam du bshad do/ /sngags byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags bshad pa rnams ni 'di'i 'grel —/71—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pochen na gsal lo/ /chos gos gnang ba bcu gsum po rnams rang ming de nyid du sogs/ mkho ba'i yo byad kyi gos kyang byin gyis brlabs te bcang la de ni sogs/ de gnyis las g.yin lhag pa'i yo byad du ma yang yid brtan gyis rung bar sogs/ de'i spros pa ni/ sems sogs/gsum pa ni/ gos ga bur la sogs pa'i dri dag gis sogs/ snum gyis gos na thal chu lta bus rtsub par sogs/ zhan byung gi bslab bya ni/ nged grogs mched lhan cig pa nyid kho na la gtod cig /ces ma bgo na gcig dang / bral ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi phyir 'doms pa la byin pa ni bcol ma gtong pa yang dag pa'i sogs/ 'chol zhing 'doms par byed pa dang bcas pa'i 'doms byed ma yin pa la mi sbyin te/ bdag po ma yin pa la'ang byin par 'gyur bas so/ /spyon pa sogs las dge slong gis blang bar mi bya ste brkus khag 'byung bas so/ /phas bu re zhig bskrad pa la sogs/ yang rnyed na blang ba ni khro ba/ mi brtan pa'i ched do/ /gsum pa la/ gos(127na jid kyi spros pa/ de'i zhar byung /nad pa'i kun spyod/ skabs snga ma mthar dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod rten sogs/ bse ru ma gtogs pa'i nyan rang dge 'dun du gtogs pas bgor rung bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten pa dang / sa zhing dang / lha 'bangs la sogs pa rnyed pa'i 'byung khungs dang / gro nas la sogs pa zasakyi don dang / gnas khang dang khang khyim sogs bsko bas nye bar 'tsho ba dang / sman la sogs pa'i nad pa'i rung ba ste lnga po 'di ni bgo bar mi bya ste/ snga ma dkon cog mi gcig pa dang / gzhan bzhi ni 'du ba'i sgo la gnod pas so/ zas kyi don yin kyang la phug lta bu'i rtsa ba dang / shing tog lta bu'i 'brasabu dang / bu ram shing ni bgod rung la bdag gir bya ba'i phyir ma yin pa zhal ta dang / byi dor la sogs pa'i don du ni lnga po yang rung ba'i skabs yod do/ /dbyar gyi rnyed pa la ni dbyar gnas dus kyi mtshams dang / dgag dbye'i rjes su byed pa'i mtshams gnyis las/ dbyar gyi mtshams de'i dbang gis 'jug ldog bya ste/ de ni gnas kyis bsgrubs pa'i rnyed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dbyar rnyed thob pa la dbyar ma ral ba mi dgos te/ dbyar ral sogs/ 'on kyang dge 'dun du gags pa dgos te —172

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanaganas nas sogs/ dbyar mtshams du ma khri la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis sogs te/ kun las bsdusanas so/ /du mar gnas pa de las gzhan pa mtshams gcig tu sogs rnyed pa'i thob tshul gyi tshad ni/dge tshul dang sogs te/ shākya 'od kyis/ dge tshul sum cha gcig gcig dbang ba yin/ (127ba)bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod ba cha gnyis te/ /zhes bshad do/ /dge slong pha ma'i thun mong du phul ba ni/ dge 'dun las phyed phyed du mi bgo yi/ /gang zag gi grangs las bgo bar bya'o/ /dang por dge slong la dmigs shing zas kyi dus su dge slong ma rnamasamed kyang de'i rnyed pa'i dus su sleb na de rnams kyang dbang zhes pa ni zas kyi sogs/ gnyis pa ni/stan dang sogs te zas dang 'brel bas 'an byung ngo / sam pru sta ni mnyam pa dang bi sa pa 〉lta ni mi mnyam pa ste dug med dang dug bcas kyi don du bshad pas na/ ma la srog med pa'i sam grwa lta zhes pa ni yi ge nor ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dge slong chos gos sogs bzang ngan 'bring gis dang stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs ma yin pa'i rdzas lhag mas mi bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sham thabs ska rags kyi ma bcings sogs gos kyi gzhi rnam par bshad pa rdzogs so/ /zhes pa blo gsal dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir du bkod pa'o/ /bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen zas bzhi bshad pa/bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen zas mtha' gnyis su ma lhungs par bsten tshul ni/ sman gyi gzhi la kun mkhyen klu sgrub rje'i legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi sman gzhi'i zur bkol rin cen phreng ba las bshad pa'i rang lugs snying po cung zad bsdus na/ sman gyi ngo bo ni spyir dri ro reg bya gsum gang rung gis bsdus pa'i kham zas/ de dang zas bzhi'i zlas phyi ba'i kham zas don gcig ste/ mdzod las/kham gyi zas ni 'dod pa yi/ /skye mched gsum gyi bdag nyid do/ /gzugs skye mched ma yin des//—173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('arang dbang grol la mi phan phyir//zhes gsungs/'dir bstan sman gyi ngo bo kham zas gang zhig/bcas ldan dge slong la rung ba'i rigs su gnas pa de/dbye 12ni sko dus drang sogs bzhi/dang po dus rung sman gyi ngo bo/sman bzhi gang rung gang zhig/rab tu byung bas snga dro kho na longs spyod du rung ba'i rigs/dbye na bza' ba dang bca' ba/dang po la tshig ler/sna tshogs 'bras chan zan dang sha/byed dang 'khur ba bza' ba lnga/zhes dang /sum brgya par/nas chan snum 'khur 'bras ga nya dang sha/'di dag srog gnas bya phyir bza' bar bya/zhes dang /'grel chen sogs su/gos chan/zan dron/sha dang /snum 'bur/lde gu dang lnga la bshad cing /de dag tu ma 'dus pa phye mar/'o 'dzar/zho dang /dar ba/thug pa la sogs pa rnams kyang dus drang yin la/'dir lde gu dang skyo ma gcig cing /skyo ma thug pa zan dron gsum gyi khyad rim par/bzar bu gyen du bsgreng mi nus pa/nus pa/sor mo lnga'i rjes dod pa rnams yin pa dang /bu ram bsgar ma ni sa kyang zhag bdun pa yin pas/rab byung dag gis kyang dgongs dus spro zhing longs spyod pas cho go pa yin no//bca' ba lnga ni tshig ler rtsa ba sdong bu me rtag 'bras//lo ma yang ni bca' ba lnga/zhes pa ltar yin la/de yang rtsab ni/cu lu la phug/gro ma sogs/sdong bu ni/bu ram shing sogs/me rtag ni/utpal padma sogs/'bras bu ni/rgyan 'bru/kham star sogs lo ma ni/thu lu dang /la phug sogs kyi lo ma/sgra bshad ni/rab byung dag gis snga dro longs spyad du rung zhing phyi dro'i char mi rung bsan dus rung /byed las ni/bkres pa'i nad sel/gnyis pa thun tshod du rung ba'i sman gyi ngo bo ni/sman bzhi gang 124jung gang zhig/thun tshod kyi mtha' can du byin gyis brlab tu rung ba'i rigs gnas kyi btung ba/dbye na sman bzhi so so'i rgyu las byung ba/tshags kyis btsags pa'i rtsam thang dang rus thang shin tu sla ba bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba lta bu dus rus gi rgyu las byung ba/dar sing chur khu lta bu chu dang 'dres pa'i dwangs ma tshags kyisabatsags pa thun tshod kyi rgyu las byung ba/sbrang bur gyi dwangs ma shin tu sla ba lta bu zhag bdun pa'i rgyu las byung ba/a bar skyur gsum sogs kyi khu ba /na tu sla ba lta bu 'tsho bcang gi rgyu las byung ba/sgra

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (3)bshad ni/thun tshod kyi mtha' can du byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod rung bas so//byed las ni skom pa'i nad sel/gsum pa zhag bdun pa'i sman gyi ngo bo ni sman bzhi gang rung gang zhig/zhag bdun gyi mtha' can du byin gyis brlab rung ba'i rigs/dbye ba'am mtshan gzhi 'bru mar/zhun mar/bu ram/sbrang rtsi/mar gsar/hwags sogs/sgra bshad ni zhag bdun du byin gyis brlab rung bas so//byed las ni/gtso bo rlung nad sel ba sogs/bzhi pa 'tsho bcang gi sman gyi ngo bo ni/sman bzhi gang rung gang zhig/ji srid 'tsho'i bar du byin gyis brlab rung ba'i rigs gnas/dbye na 'jig rten na sman du grags pa'i rtsa ba/sdong bu/lo ma/me tog/gos bu lnga/dang po ni/gla sgang /shu dag/bong dkar lta bu/gnyis pa tsan dan/shug pa/sle tres lta bu/gsum pa/ba sha kha/nim pa'i lo ma lta bu/bzhi pa nim pa/ba sha kha/klu shing gi me rtag lta bu/lnga pa/a bar skyur 129na tshe gsum ni le sham lta bu yin/sgra bshad ni/ji srid ma shi'i bar du byin gyis brlab rung ba/byed las gtso bor 'dus pa'i nad sel bar byed/sman bzhi po de dag kyang dus rung la byin brlabs med cing byin len byas nas snga dro'i dus longs spyod/phyi ma gsum ni dus dang /dus min thams cad du longs spyod du rung ba yin mod/byin gyis ma brlabs na/snga dro byin len byas pa gung dang /phyi dro byin len byas pa a tshwa kyi mtha' las 'das na gsog 'jog tu 'gyur/thun tshod du rung ba byin gyis brlabs na brlab dus snga dro yin pas de nas thun rpā kyi mtha' 0 longs spyad chog/de las 'das na gsog 'jog dang spang lhung gnyis ka 'byung /zhag bdun pa byin gyis brlabs na brlabs pa'i snga dro nas zhag bdun gyi bar longs spyad chog de las 'das na gsog 'jog dang spangs lhung gnyis car 'byung /'tsho bcang byin gyis brlabs nas ji srid ma shi'i bar longs spyad du rung bas 'di la gsog 'jog dang spang lhung gnyis ka mi bskyed/kha cig/'tsho bcang nad las grol nas bcangs na spang lhung bskyed ces dang /kha cig ji srid 'tsho'i bar du byin gyis brlab gsung ba lung gis zin zo med 'dra/des na bcas ldan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'dage slong gis gnang ba'i dus kyi dmigs bsal med par mtha' de dag las 'das par 'chang na gsog 'jog dang / de zos na gsog 'jog can zos pa'i lhung byed 'phog pas de las ma 'das par longs spyod pa'am/ yang na gzhan la sbyin pa'am/ yang na byin len dang byin brlabs bshig par bya ste gsog 'jog bsrung ba'i thabs bla na ma mchis pa'o/ /zhes dang / sman gyi khyad chos la zlas(129ba)la brten pa'i sman gyi lhung ba bsrung tshul dang / zas de bstan tshul lo/ /dang po la/ thun mong ba rung chu'i rnam gzhag /thun mong ma yin pa bsrung tshul so so gnyis/dang po la drug gi gang la 'thor ba'i gzhi sman phyi ma gsum rung pa tshad ldan te/ slob dpon sbrang ma'i rkang pa can gyi so thar ṭī kar/ mi rung ba dang dus rung dang / khol ba'i gnas skabs rnams la ni/ /rung chu 'thor bar mi bzhed do/ /zhes bshad/ gang 'thor na zan dang ma 'dres pa'i chu gtsang ma skol grangs min pa'i rang bzhin gyis grang ba/ gang gis 'thor na bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa/ 'on kyang rdzogs pas go ni chod/ tshul ji ltar 'thor na ku sha la sogs pas chu 'thor ba'i tha snyad byas pa tsam/dus nam gyi tshe 'thor na sman byin rlabs byed na snga dro dang / de min nyi ma phyed yol nas skya rengs ma shar bar du/ dgos pa ni/ dngos kyis sman phyi ma gsum la rung chu ma btab par longs spyad na bsnyen par rdzogs pa la bshags bya dang / ma rdzogs pa la bsdam bya'i nyes byas 'byung bas de khegs pa rgyud kyi dgos pa phyi dro dang mtshan mo longs spyad du rung mi rung gi bcas pa'i mtshams zin pa'i ched yin/nges tshig ni dus min du longs spyod rung ba rung bar nges pas so/ /byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yul dge slong zhig gi drung du/ rang las bslab pa rgan na phyag byas/ sman byin rlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad pa zhu/ yul des chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin mdzad par zhu zhes brjod/ de nas mkhan po 'am/ slob dpon nam/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol (130na thad ga ming 'di zhes bya ba'i thun tshod du rung ba'am/ zhag bdun pa'am/ 'tsho bcang gi sman 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnamasakyis thun tshod du rung ba'am/ zhag bdun pa'am/ ji srid 'tsho bcang du rung bar byin gyis brlab bo/ /—176

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)lan gsum dang thabs legs bya/ zhu mkhan des sman byin rlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che/ yul des chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ zhes brjod/ spyod lam yul de'i mdun du cog pur 'dug ste/ sman de gnyis char gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du bzhag /g.yas pas steng nas bkab ste bya ba yin/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa ni gsog 'jog tu song ba'i nyes pa khegs pa dang / dge slong nad pas byin len bya mi dgos par tshegs chung ngus bde ba la reg par gnas pa dang bcas pa'i mtshams zin pa'i ched yin no/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa sman la brten nas lhung ba bsrung tshul la/ gsog 'jog gi spang lhung bsrung tshul/ byin len ma byas par za ba'i lhung byed bsrung tshul/ dus min du za ba'i ltung byed bsrung tshul/ spangs pa za ba'i lhung byed bsrung tshul/gsog 'jog byas pa za ba'i lhung byed bsrung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bcas ldan dge slong gis gzhi sman rnam bzhi gang rung rung ba tshad dang ldan pa/ ngo bo yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang nyid dbang zhing gnas skabs dbang byar yod pa/ rang ngam rang dang 'dra bas byin len byas la/ byin len ma zhig pa/ lha'i bdud rtsi min pa'o/ /'dir rung ba zhes pa ni/ rang gi lag nyar song ba ni mi rung ba'i zas yin la/ de lta (130ba tshe rgya la sogs pa min pa/ tshad dang ldan pa ni mgul du mid rin chog pa/ ngo bo rdzogs pa ni tsha chu/ 'gyur byed kyi chu/ rnyog chu sogs ni zas kyi ched yin pas ma rdzogs pa'o/ /rang dang 'dra ba zhes pa lnga ste cho ga'i sgo nas 'dul ba'i lag len tshul bzhin byed pa rnams 'dra/ de byed pa dang mi byed pa mi 'dra/ de bzhin du sdom pa'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa nang phan tshun 'dra/ rdzogs pa dang ma rdzogs pa lta bu mi 'dra/ lta ba dang mtshan mthun pa rnams 'dra/ mthun pa dang mi mthun pa rnams mi 'dra/ mchog dang mchog min gyi sgo nas pham pas ma gos pa phan tshun 'dra/ gos pa dang ma gos pa mi 'dra ba las 'di lta bu'i 'dra ba'i lnga tshar tshang na 'dra ba'i tha snyad 'thob la/ mi 'dra ba la gang rung gcig mi 'dra bas chog ces 'dul 'dzin snga ma dag bzhed kyang 'dra ba la'ang lnga tshar tshang dgos pa'i nges pa med bas de lta bu/ lha'i bdud rtsi gnang —177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ab yin zhing de dang 'dra ba'i dkon zas 'ga' zhig la'ang mtshudas sa ma snyam na/ sman phyi ma gsum la ni byin gyis brlakhas pa'am ma brlabs kyang rjes su 'brel ba dgos te/ de gsum byin gyis ma brlabs par byin len byas nas rang dus las 'das te gsog 'jog tu song ba la ni nyes byas tsam zhig 'byung gi spang lhung mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang / sman bzhi byin len ma byas par 'chang ba la nyes pa ma bcas pa 'dra na'ang byin len ma byas par za ba la ltung byed 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di yang dran dgos so/ /bdag nyid ni/ dge slong pha ma dang dge slong ma gsum gang rung yin pa ste/ dge slob ma la gsog (131na 'jog gi spang lhung ma bcas kyang lhung ba bcas 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam pa la 'du shes ma 'brul zhing za ba'i ched du rang dus 'das nas kyang / 'chang 'dod kyi bsam pa rgyun ma chad pa/ sbyor ba de ltar 'jog par rtsom pa/ mthar thug rang rang gi dus las 'das pa na/ gsog 'jog gi spang lhung dngos gzhi grub/ ces dang / des na 'tsho bcang gi sman byin gyis brlabs pa des spang lhung mi bskyed de/ ma shi'i bar du rang dus las 'das pa min la/ shi nas rten bor bas spang lhung mi bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sman phyi ma gnyis byin gyis ma brlabs pas spang lhung gtan nas mi bskyed dam snyam na ma yin te/ tshes gcig la bu ram gyi sman gcig rnyed nas byin gyis brlabs/ de'i nyin nam tshes gnyis nas bdun gyi bar la bu ram gyi sman gzhan brnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs kyang zhag brgyad pa'i skya rengs shar ba'i tshe de thams cad kyi spang lhung bskyed pa'i phyir te/ byin gyisabarlabs pas rang stobs dang / ma brlabs pa rnams la shan dang 'dres pa'i skyon gyis shan stobs kyi spang ltung bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni shan 'dres pa'i skyon no/ /des na sman la shan brdeg byed byin gyis brlabs pa zhig dgos pa'i gnad rtogs na dka' ba'i gnad las rang grol te/ rang stobs kyi gsog 'jog gi spang lhung bskyed pa la/ sman byin gyis brlabs pa zhig dgos pa'i gnad kyis yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na thun tshod kyi mtha' ji ltar snyam na bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dgongs pa (131ba〉sgod thun tshun la mdzad pa lung gis grub ste/ sman gzhir/ bcom ldan 'das —178

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag btung ba brgyad po 'di dag ni/dus su byin gyis brlabs/dus su mnyes/dus su btsugs/dus su byin gyis brlabs nas dus su longs spyad par bya zhing /dus ma yin par yang longs spyad bar bya ste/nam gyi thun dang po thal nas ni longasaspyad par mi bya'o//zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro//'o na nad pa la mas mo'i thun phyi ma gnyis la skom pa'i nad byung na ji ltar bya snyam na/de'i tshe sgod thun 'das nas kyang byin rlabs byas te longs spyad pas rung zhes rong ston chen pos tshig le'i ṭi skar bshad pa ltar legs so//gnyis pa byin len ma byas par za ba'i lhung byed bsrung tshul la/lhung ba'i rnam gzhag dang /byin len gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/dang po ni rtogs sla/'on kyang gnang ba'i dus la ma brgyags lta bu/gnas sgra mi snyan/zan gcod kyi cho ga byas pa/na ba/mu ge'i dus rnams su byin len mi dgos te de ltar byas cho go pa gnang ba'i phyir ro//'o na zan gcod kyi cho ga ji lta bu snyam na/tshig le las/lam du song tshe lam brgyags dag/khur khyer su yang med pa na/brje ba yi ni 'du shes kyis//rang nyid kyis ni khur bar bya//brje ba gzhan dag med pa na//nyi ma dang po zan bcad byas//gnyis pa la ni spar gang tsam//bza' yi de las lhag pa min//nyi ma gsum par spar ba gnyis//de las phar ni ci bder bya//zhes gsal bar bshad pa bzhin byin len stob mkhan gtan ma rnyed pa'i tshe nyi ma gcig zan 132na sta da par bya'o//de nas nyi ma dang bo la spar ba gang bza' 'o//nyi ma gnyis pa la ni spar ba do bza' 'o//gsum phan chad ji tsam gyis cho go pa bza' la byin len byed mi dgos pa yin no//'di lta bu'i zan gcod kyi cho ga ni/dge slong mtshams dam por thugs dam la zhugs pa 'dul ba la gces spras byed pa dag la nye bar mkho zhing /cho ga 'di byas nas/shin tu bkres pa'i tshe/shing tog rung ba ma yin pa dang /dus min za ba sogs kyang gnang ba yin te/rgya cher 'grel las/dge slong zan bcad byas pas/rgyan 'bru la sogs pa'i shing tog rung ba ma byas pa dang /byin len ma byas pa dang /lag nya blangs pa dag kyang dus ma ༷na par yang bza' bar bya ba nyid yin no//zhes

bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa byin len gyi rnam gzhag la gsum gyi byin len dngos ni/ gzhi chu dang so shing ma gtogs pa'i sman rnams bzhi rung ba tshad ldan/ de yang kha bshal ba'i chu la byin len mi dgos kyi/sgom pas gas bar bya ba yin na byin len dgos/ mi rung ba ni ngo bo'i sgo nas btsong sgog sha rjen pa/ rta sha /bong sha /glang po che'i sha sogs/ cho ga'i sgo nas mi rung ba/ lag nya can/ mtshams btsosazhag lon/ rjen btsos/ gsog 'jog tu song ba'i zas sogs/ stobs pa po spyir bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa/ byin len stob par 'os pa/ zhe thag pa nas stob 'dod pa/ zas de gyen du 'degs nus pa/nod pa po'i slo g.yas g.yon rgyab dang / de las mtho bar bsdad pa ma yin pa/ lag pa gnyis gyen du bkan pa dang bcas pa/ dmigs (132ba thas la bslab byin dge slong gis dge slong rnam dag la byin len chags/ dge slong rnam dag kyang pha ma phan tshun gcig gis gcig la byin len chags/ dge slong pha nang khul du'ang bslab pa g.yel bas mi g.yel ba la chags/ lta ba tha dad pas chags/mchog min pas mchoge la chags pa sogs/ byin lan nod pa po ni/ dge slong pha ma dge slong ma dang gsum gang rung yin pa/ langs pa min par sal 'dug bzhin pa/ lag pa gnyis gyen du bkan nasalen pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du rags pa mtshams gzhan gyis bar ma chod par mtshams gcig gi nang du chud pa'o/ /byin len stob pa po bsdad pas kyang chags mod/ ma gus pa spang ba'i phyir langs dgos zhes gdams so/ /bsam pa 'du shes ma 'byul zhing / rang ngam rang dang 'dra ba za ba'i phyir du stob 'dod dang len 'dod kyi bsam pa rgyun ma chad pa sbyor ba lag pa gnyis gyen du bkan pas stob pa'o//len par brtsams pa/ mthar thug len pa po'i lag pa'am lag pa dang 'brel ba'i snod du 'thob pa/rags pa mtshams gzhan ni/ rdo ba/ dbyug pa/ rtsig pa/ bar mtshams kyi bu ga nam mkha'/ srog chags/ gos la sogs pa zheng dang dpangs sor bzhi yan dang dkyus khru gang yan gyi bar chod pa/ kha cig cung zad rgyug pa'i chu dang me don byed nus pa'ang 'dod/ 'o na cog tse sogs kyi steng du zhe na/ 180

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)byin len nod pa'i gzhi yin na chags te khri dang khri'u sogs kyi steng du chags par bshad pa'i phyir/dmigs bsal lag pa gnyis kas mi bde na gcig gis dang / thag nye ba nas mi bde na ring pa nas stabs kyang (133na sbra yi pa/ spe'u dang glang po che cang shes lta bus mtho sa nas stabs kyang chog pa/tshig le las/ byin len bya'o mi bde na/ /rgyang ring nas kyang rung ba nyid/ /ces dang / 'di la cang shes glang po rta/ /spre'u yis kyang rung ba nyid/ khes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dge 'dun la zan stob pa'i lag bde ba dge slong gis byas cho go pa'i dmigs bsal yang yod de/ dge slong de la zas rnamasabasnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhig gis byin len byas nas/ dge slong des dge 'dun la zas rnams 'brim par bshad pa'i phyir te / rtsa bar/ dge slong byin len byas pas brim pa nyid ni rung ba nyid yin no/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /lhag ma de dag spangs zin pa rang gi gnas mal du dge slong rang gi bza' bar byed na ni lhag bor gyi cho ga dgos par snang ste/ de ma byas na spangs pa za ba'i lhung byed dam/ nyesabyas gang rung gis reg par 'gyur bas so /gnyis pa byin len 'jig pa'i rgyu ni/ lung bar sdoms las/ 'phrogs dang 'dril dang reg pa dang / /bsngos dang dge slong min gyur dang / /dngos po 'gyur dang skye ba 'gyur/ /dor bas kyang ni byin len 'jig /ces brgyad dang lung gzhan las/ spang lhung phyir bcos kyi tshe zas de spangs pa dang / me chu la sogs pas zas de brlag pas kyang 'jig bar bshad de bsdoms pas 'jig rgyu bcu yod do/ /gsum pa byin len gyi dbye ba ni/ lung las/ byin len ni lnga ste/ lus kyis lus la bya ba/ lus dang 'brel bas lus la bya ba/ lus kyi
