brtags la/min na bar chad dang mi ldan pa gda' lags zhes brda sprod/de rnams kyi tshe dge slong gzhan zhig gis bsgrub bya'i gding ba nyis bltab byas pa'i glegs bu phyed pa mdun phyogs la 'ong ba byas te bting ba'i steng bsgrub bya 'grengs nas bzhag go/gnyis pa na sgrub bya de ston pa'i sku 'di la shākya seng ge dngos yin snyam pa gyis la phyag gsum dang /mkhan po la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug/mdun du tsog tsog bur thal mo snying gar sbyar nas 'dug tu bcug la/khyed rab tu 'byung ba'i bsam pa skyes pa de legs/de'i rgyu mtshan/dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo las/khyim pa rnamasani me'i 'obs na gnas pa lta bu/rab tu byung ba rnaXs ni bsil ba'i khang pa na gnas pa lta bu'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorazhes pa la sogs pa gsungs shing / cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dod pa dag (190ba)ni rab tu bsten byed cing / /bu dang chung ma dag la sred bskyed nas/ snang bar bya ba'i khyim la brten pa de/ /bla med byang chub dam pa gzhar mi thob/ /gang dag 'dod pa lci skam me bzhin spongs/ /bu dang chung ma dag la sred spangs nas/ khyim gyis skrag ste khyim nas mngon byung ba/ /de dag byang chub mchog 'di rnyed mi dka'/ /gang dag khyim na gnas par byed bzhin du/ /byang chub dam pa mchog 'di thob pa yi /sangs rgyas gang yang sngon chad ma byung ste/ /ma 'ongs pa na'ang mi 'byung gnas pa med/ /rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs nas/ /dben par dong ste dgon par gnas byed pa/ /nyon mongs spangs te bdud ni bcoms nas su/ /byang chub rdul med 'dus ma byas 'tshang rgya/ /zhes gsungs/de yang rab byung dman pa mu stegs kyis rab tu byung ba ma yin pa/ cho ga'i zur du shākya seng ge shākya'i rgyal po gtso bo de rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag rab tu 'byung ste/ zhes 'byung bas/ 'o skol gyi ston pas 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal srid 'byor pa dang khab spangs nas/ nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bcad rin thang med pa'i gos dang / ngur smrig gi gos brjes nas gsol te/ rab tu byung ba bzhin du rab tu 'byung ba yin/ rab tu byung ba'i don ni/ saṃ spo ta'i skad la/ pra brdzi ta zhes rab tu spangs pa'i don yin/ de zag bcas 'khor ba'i dngos po thams cad las rgyab kyis phyogs shing spangs pa yin pas/de la brje ba gsum dgos/ rtags cha lugs brje ba khyim pa'i rtags cha lugs spangs/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha (191na〉sdugs su bsgrub ba'i pas tshangs/ bsam pa brje ba ni 'jig rten pa rnams kyi 'dod pa bsten pa'i bsam pa la nyes dmigs lnga yod pas/ de spangs nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes nas 'khor ba la yid 'byung / myang 'das kyi phan yon mthong nas myang 'das thob par 'dod pa'i dad pa dgos/ de nas 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ 'khor ba'i duḥkha las thar bar byed pa'i skyabs/ dkon cog gsum la ston pa dang skyabs dngos dang / zla grogs zhus nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa bsgrub snyam pa dgos shing / 'di theg pa thun mong ba yin pas/ myang 'das gsum —260

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanapo gang rung du sems bskyed kyang / nges 'byung gi bsam pa'i go chod mod/ 'on kyang da res 'dir bsam pa rab bskyed de/ sems can thams cad kyi don du mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o/ /de'i phyir duḥkha thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa'i khyim gyi gnas yongs su spangs te/ khyim pa'i rtags lugs rnams spangs/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs yang dag par blangs nas/ ji srid ma shi'i bar du bsrung snyam pa gyis/ de rnams spos pa'i brjed tho ru ming spo ba yin pas/ sde pa'i ming gi mtha' can/ dpal dang / 'od zer dang / grags pa dang / bzang po'i mtha' can nam mkhan po'i ming gi mtha' can du spos la/ ming de nas smos la 'di'i rjes zlos kyis byas la/mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar (191ba'i rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tsho gis rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ shākya seng ge shwakya'i rgyal po/ gtso bo de rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag rab tu 'byung ste/ khyim pa'i rtags spong ngo / /rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par len to/ /lan gsum bzlas/ de rab byung du bsgrub pa'i thabs yin no/ khyod rang legs so gyis bya/ bsgrub byas legs so bya'o/ /de ltar rab tu byung nas khyim pa'i rtags spong bar smras pas/ de nyams pa'i phyogs mthun dkar po dang / kha tshar can dang / thams cad kha dog gcig pa dang / tshon chen dang / skra dang kha spu ring por 'jog pa dang /'breg pa'i phyogs ma yin pa breg pa dang / khur 'bur ba la sogs khyim pa'i spyod lam rnams spong ba dang / rab tu byung ba'i rtags len par khas blangs pa de nyams pa'i phyogs mthun mu stegs can gyi rtags/ spyod lam/ brtul zhugs dang / bka' thub rnams spangs nas/ rab tu byung ba'i gtsang sbra dang / cha byad dang / brtul zhugs la gnas par bya'o/ khyen tu bsdun/ mkhan pos chos gos/ lhung bzed sogs byin pa bskon pa'i rjes su/ 'o na khyod rab tu byung bar 'dod pa shin tu legs pa yin/—261

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6polegs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mdo las/ khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba gnyis la khyad par shin tu che bar gsungs te/ dus gsum (192na)gyi sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu byung ba'i rten kho nas sangs rgyas pa yin gyi/ khyim pa'i rten la sangs rgyas pa su yang med/ khyad par khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis dus bskal pa'i bar du/ rang gi bu dang chung ma sogs sbyin par btang ba'i bsod nams las/ rab tu byung bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa dag pas dgon par gom pa gcig bor ba bsod nams che ba sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs/de lta bu'i rab byung bsgrub pa la/ brje —ba gsum dgos pas rtags cha lugs brje ba legs par grub pa yin/ bsam pa brje ba khyim pa'i nyes dmigs dang / rab tu byung ba'i phan yon dran par byas nas/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rab tu byung ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa blangs te/ ji srid ma shi'i bar du bsrung snyam pa'i bsam pa khyad par can dung pa zhig bskyed mdzod/ de dag mi brjed pa'i brdar ming spo ba yin pas/ khyod rang ming 'di zhes bya ba gyis la/ ming de nas smos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol nas/ legs so'i bar bya/ 'di'i bslab bya la khyim pa'i rtags spangs te/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs dang ldan pa mkhan po la gus pa sogs byed dgos so/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni zhu dang mkhan po dang po dang /rab byung zhes pa'i don legs par bshad zin to/ /dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga sogs bshad pa/da ni gnyis pa dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i (192bsko ngos gzhi'i cho ga brjod na/ khyad chos bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i/ /'dul 'dzin slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /dge tshul don gnyer bsgrub bya la/ /262

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)sdom pa skye dang gnas pa dang //gnas pa khyad par 'gyur ba dang //rten nyid mdzes par byed pa yi//'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi bral dang //yul rgyud rtags dang bsam pa dang //cho ga mthun pa'i rkyen lnga po//tshig don gsal bar brda sprad de//dge tshul nyid du nye bar bsgrub//de ltar bshad pa'i rgyu tshogs las//'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi bral dang //mthun rkyen dang po gsum po yi//bshad pa btang sgoms gyur kyang sla'i//nges sting sdom pa skye ba la//med du mi drang gces pa'i chos/khyu yi kun slong thob 'dod dang //dus kyi kun slong thob shes dang //'gal rkyen bar go bzhi bral dang //mthun rkyen phun tsho gos sum ldan dang //nges khrung bsam pa'i gsal 'debs te/khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa yi//bsam pa mas pa'i rkyen nyid dang //sdom pa 'bogs byed cho ga'i tshig/'khrul med cho ga mas pa'i rkyen//phun tsho gos bstan pa 'phel rkyen dang //bsgrub bya nyid la phan sems kyi//snying rje drag pos kun blangs te//bsgrub bya'i blo yul 'char bde ba//btang snyoms ma shor gces spras su//nan tan mdzad pa gnad kyi don/khris 'dis thog mtha' rnams kyi yang //sdom pa'i skye tshul mtshon par bya//dge tshul nyid du sgrub pa yi//dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i khog phubs so//de yang cung zad bshad na//mkhan pos dge tshul nyid du nye bar sgrub par byed pa'i 193nadage slong chos bcu gcig dang ldan zhing /dge tshul du sgrub pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa zhig la/mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa wo po dge slong che ge mo zhes bya bas/tshe dang ldan pa 'di nyid la dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa zhig bkas gnang bar zhu/zhes brjod la gtad/des kyang ci tshe dang ldan pa 'di'i bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag gam/zhes dri/mkhan pos yongs su dag go zhesakho na nyid mchi yin gda'o zhes lan bto/de nas slob dpon gyis bsgrub bya de ston pa'i sku dang /slob dpon rang la phyag gsum gsum 'tshal du bcug/mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug ste thal mo snying gar sbyor du bcug nas/khyod dge tshul gyi sdom pa len pa la/dgag pa'i tshul gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi spangs pa/sgrub pa'i tshul gyis mthun // lnga tshang ba zhig dgos pa la/'gal rkyen sdom pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poskye ba dang / gnas pa dang / khyad par du 'gyur ba dang / mdzes pa la bar du gcod pa ste bzhi med pa dgos te/ mkhan po bas bar chad dris/ khyod rang gis lan btab pas dag par rtogs pas grub pa yin/ mthun rkyen la yul dang / rgyud dang / rtags dang / bsam pa dang / cho ga mthun pa'i rkyen dang lnga las/ dang po yul mthun pa'i rkyen ni/ skyabs 'gro'i yul du gyur pa'i dkon cog gsum 'gog lam gyi steng nas 'jog pas/ de la yid ches kyi dad pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ kun rdzob brdar mtshon pa'i dkon cog gsum/ sangs rgyas ston pa'i sku gzugs rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can (193ba)dngos su bzhugs pa zhig dgos pa tshang / chos lung gi chos las kyi cho ga 'di na bzhugs pa 'di nyid kyis tshang / dam pa'i chos ma nub pa zhig dgos na de'ang tshang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa gang zag las skye bas/ dge 'dun med ka med min na'ang / zhu ba'i dus su dge 'dun longs pas dge 'dun yang tshang / mkhan po chos bdun ldan la mkhan por gsol ba btab pas khas blangs pa zhig dgos na/mkhan po ba yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bzhugs shing / de la khyod rang gis gsol ba btab pas/ zhal gyis bzhes pa ngos grub pa yin/ slob dpon chos bcu gcig dang ldan pa la/ mkhan po'i tshig gis bskos pa zhig dgos te/ khyod la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bskyed pa'i cho ga'i brda sprod pa de bdag gis 'grub rung du yod pas yul du gang dgos tshang /gnyis pa rgyud mthun pa'i rkyen la/ rgyud tshogs su ma tshang ba/ sdom pa rnying pas rgyud ma bkag pa/ nyes med phun tshogs kyi sdom pa skye ba la tshigs snga ma sngon du song zhing chags pa zhig dgos te/khyod rang gsum man chad du gnas pa dang / rtsa lhung 'chab bcas byung ba ma yin pa dang / da ci nas rab byung / dge bsnyen sogs byas ma thag pa yin pas thams cad tshang / gsum pa/ rtags mthun pa'i rkyen lus kyi byi byad kyi rtags skra dang kha spu bregs shing / breg tu ma gnang ba'i phyogs ma bregs pa/khrus byas pa/ gos kyi rtags bla gos mthang gos rung ba tshad dang ldan pa mkhan pos gnang zhing bston pa/ gding ba/ chu tshags rung ba tshad ldan mkhan pos (194na)gnang ba/ snod spyad kyi rtags lhung —264

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabazed rung ba tshad ldan mkhan pos gnang ba/ mdor na rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs dang ldan/khyim pa dang mu stegs kyi rtags cha lugs dang mi ldan pa zhig dgos te/ khyim pa dang mu stegs kyi rgyalamatshan can la yang mi skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bas po tshun chod kyis thams cad tshang bar yod pa yin/bzhi pa bsam pa mthun pa'i rkyen la/ rgyu'i kun slong thob pa 'dod/ dus kyi kun slong thob shes/'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral/ mthun rkyen phun tshogs sum ldan/ de thams cad nges yang gis bsam pas zin pa zhig dgos/ rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod ni skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhe thag pa nas rang la len 'dod yod pa zhig ste/ khyod rang gis ched du gnyer nas bsgrubs pasatshang / dus kyi kun slong thob shes ni/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa la thob par shes pa'i bsam pa skye rung zhig dgos te/ de yang khyod la skye rung du yod pas tshang ba yin/ 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral ni/nges pa lnga ni sems can dang / yul dus gnas skabs yan lag go /zhes pa ltar/ sems can ngesapa ni sems can 'ga' zhig la gnod 'tshe spong nus 'ga' zhig la spong mi nus snyam pa ni/ semasacan nges pa yin la/ de lta bu'i bsam pa dang bral nas/ sems can thams cad la gnod 'tshe spong nus snyam pa zhig dgos/ yul nges pa ni yul 'ga' zhig tu dge tshul gyi spang bya rnams spong nus/yul thams cad du mi nus snyam pa ni yul nges pa yin la/ de dang (194ba)bral nas yul thams cad du dge tshul gyi spang bya rnams spong 'dod yod pa zhig dgos/ dus nges pa ni/ lo gcig dang zla ba gcig la sogs par dge tshul gyi bslab bya la slob nus/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar slob mi nus snyam pa ni dus nges pa yin la/ de dang bral nas/ dus de nas ji srid ma shi'i bar du dge tshul gyi bslab bya mtha' dag la slob snyam pa zhig dgos/ gnas skabs nges pa ni 'thab mo la sogs pa'i gnasaskabs su spang bya spong mi nus/ de las gzhan du spong nus snyam pa ni/ gnas skabs nges pa yin la/de dang bral nas gnas skabs thams cad du spong 'dod yod pa zhig dgos/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa la yan lag nges pa tshang mi dgos te/ mdzod las/ sdom pa sems can thams cad la/ /yan lag rgyu la —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6podabye ba yod/ ces gsungs pa yin/ 'on kyang dge tshul gyi spang bya bcu'i nang nas/ 'di bsrung 'di mi bsrung snyam pa'i nges pa dang bral ba zhig dgos pas nges pa lnga bral yang cha 'dra zhig tshang dgos/mthun rkyen phun tshogs sum ldan ni/ gang la sdom pa blang ba'i yul/ mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang / byed pa las kyi cho ga la sdom pa bskyed pa'i nus pa yod cing / rang nyid kyis kyang bslab bya la slob nus so snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ lnga pa nges 'byung gi bsam pa ni/de thams cad myang 'das kyi bsam pa brtan pos zin pa zhig dgos te/ 'tsho ba ma phyed pa'am/ rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs nas rab byung len pa 'jigs skyobs kyi tshul (195nasgo sems dang / phyi mar lha mi'i dpal 'dod nas rab byung len pa legs smon gyi tshul khrims su 'gyur gyi/ de gnyis nges 'byung gi bsam pas ma zin pas so thar gyi sdom par mi 'gyur/ de nas so thar gyi sdom par 'gyur ba la myang 'das kyi bsam pa brtan pos zin pa zhig dgos/ myang 'das kyi bsam pa'i don 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la yid 'byung nas myang 'das don gnyer gyi bsam pa drag po la zer ba yin/ de yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams pa na/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal drag la rgyun ring ba sran gyis mi bzod pa yod/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal shin tu ya nga ba yod/ dud 'gro la gcig la gcig za ba dang / gsod pa dang / bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal sogs brjod kyi mi lang ba yod/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pa/ mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba/ yod pa rnams gsog bsrung gi sdug bsngal/ med pa rnamasa'atshol 'gro'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa rang res nyams su myong bas grub pa 'di yin/ lha ma yin rnams la rang bzhin gyis lha'i dpal la phrag dog pas rtag tu 'thab rtsod dang / lus bcad cing bral ba'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ lha rnams la yang bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba cis kyang sa la 'bab pa bzhin du slar 'og tu lhung nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur zhing / khyad par 'chi ltas lnga dang nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga byung ba'i tshe ngan 'gror skye bar shes (195ba)pa na/ dmyal ba'i sdug —266

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabasngal las ches cher che ba'i sdug bsngal yod de/ lha rnams 'chi bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba ji snyed pa/ /mnar med sems can dmyal ba yis/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhesagasungs thun mong du 'gro ba de thams cad skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las ma thar bas sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can/ sdug bsngal ba'i chos can yin te/ mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing sgom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zasanyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thungs pas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / khyud bla ma las/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med ltar 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ ces gsungs pas/ de ltar 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du rig par bya'o/ /des na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las gtan du thar ba'i myang 'das la don gnyer gyi bsam pa drag po bskyed dgos/ myang 'das la chung ngu nyan thos/ 'bring rang rgyal/ mchog sangs rgyas kyi myang 'das gsum yod pa las 'di theg pa thun mong ba yin pas rang gi blo dang 'tsham par gsum po gang blangs kyang go chod mod/ 'on kyang nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi myang 'das gnyis/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las legs par grol bar yin kyang / rang don gyi spang rtogasayongs su ma rdzogs/ gzhan don gyi 'phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung / mthar (196na〉ngas rgyas thob pa la bar du gcod pas shing tshig pa'i mgal dum bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu mi rung ba'i skyon dang bcas pa yin/ rgyu mas des na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod pa zhig dgos/ de yang rang gcig pu'i don du ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du thob par 'dod pa zhig dgos te/nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can de thams cad kyis rang gi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med cing / sems can re res kyang pha ma lan grangs du ma byas phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pa la/ de thams cad 'dod ni bde ba 'dod/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang thabs mi mkhas pas sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la longs spyod —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorade ngan song gsum ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba kham po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling tog gis ni mig ldongs/ thar pa'i lam gyi brten ba'i 'khar ba dang ni bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bus ni ma zin/ mtho ris kyi lam nasabardeg 'chos shing / ngan song gsum gyi g.yang khar 'grim pa 'di rnams shin tu snying rje bar 'dug /snying rje byas nas ba 'ag pas mi phan/ de rnams sdug bsngal las skyabs/ bde ba la 'god dgos te de'i nus pa bdag la med/ de ma zad tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs 'jig rten pa'i mthu bo che rnams la'ang med/ 'o na su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod de/ rdzogs (196ba)pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i sgo nas sku las 'od zer sna re spros pas kyang sems can tshad med pa myang 'das la 'god nus/ gsung gis chos thun re bshad pas kyang sems can tshad med pa myang 'das la 'god nus/ thugs ting nge 'dzin sna re la bzhag pas kyang sems can tshad med pa myang 'das la 'god nus/ mdor na dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad myang 'das la 'god pa'i nus pa sangs rgyas kho na la 'dug pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos so/ /sangs rgyas de yang rgyu med rkyen med du mi 'byung gis/ rgyu tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags te zag med kyi shes rab kyis sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs nas thob dgos pa yin/shes rab de mnyam par bzhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin las 'byung ba yin/ ting nge 'dzin de tshul khrims rnam par dag pa las 'byung ba yin te/ sman gyi gzhi las/ dge slong dag tshul khrims goms par byas na ting nge 'dzin yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin goms par byas na shes rab yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ zhes rab goms par byas na 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug las sems yang dag pa kho nar rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bshad/ de na sangs —268—

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)rgyas kyi rgyu'i gtso bo tshul khrims yin/ tshul khrims kyi gtso bo dge tshul sogs kyi sdom pa yin pas/de blangs la (197na)bsrung snyam pa'i bsam pa khyad par can dungs pa bskyed mdzod/ nges 'byung gsal 'debs shin tu bsdu na/mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ ci la longs spyod kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod las mi 'dug pas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las thar ba'i skyabs dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sems can thams cad kyi don du thob par bya dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa khyad par can dungs pa zhig bskyed mdzod/ces brjod/lnga pa cho ga mthun pa'i rkyen la sbyor ba sngar song dngos gzhi dang / mjug da lta nyid du bsgrub pas rgyu rkyen thams cad tshang zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa skye ba yin pas sngar bshad pa bzhin skyabs su 'gro ba'i don dran par byas te/ dus 'di nas ma shi'i bar du dge tshul gyi bslab gzhi bcu po/ yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du ma tshang ba med par bsrung snyam pas/ spang bya bcu spong ba'i dge tshul du bzung du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyis mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral rnams kyi mchog cho sel skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogasarnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge tshul (197ba'i btsun pas bzung du gsol/ 'di rang don du brjod pa'i sngags yin pas gnyis pa'i yang rjes zlog gyis zhes brjod/gsum pa'i skabs su gsum pa 'di la skyabs brjod bdag brjod gong du song / gzhan brjod pa'i thog mar dge tshul gyi sdom pa skye ba yin te/ mdor/ dper na/ gas brjod pa'i dus na dge —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'atshul nyid bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas dge tshul du zhes pa'i tshig rdzogs pa dang khyod la sdom pa skye/nged khyod kyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin zhing / dge tshul du zhes pa'i skabs su nged kyi skad gzengs mtho ba dang / se gol gyis brda sbyor bas/ de dus bdag gi rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa skyes pa'i dus 'di kho na yin snyam pa'i thob blo skyes pa shin tu gal che ba dang / slob dpon du gyur nas btsun pa zhes mi brjod par slob dpon zhes brjod dgos pa yin pas ma yengs par yid la zhog la/ gsum pa'i yang rjes zlos gyis zhes brjod/ mjug tu de dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i thabs yin no/ khyod rang legs6gyis bya/ slob mas legs so zhes brjod do/ /des dngos gzhi'i cho ga grub/ mjug gi cho ga la gnyis yod pa'i dang po thob dus go ba de/ mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dge slong che ge mo mdzod cig ces bsgo/ des kyang las la ngan dang pho tshod mi bya bar nyin mtshan gyi cha legs par brtags/ nyi ma rdzogs pa'i sar phyin te thur ma sor bzhi pas grib tshod gzhal/ thur ma de'i grib ma sor bzhi la/ skyes bu gcig dang / sor gsum man chad la rkang pa'i tha snyad byas/ dus tsho'i la sogs pa thams cad blo la byang zhing (198na)nges po byas nas khyod dge tshul du bsgrub pa la cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum yod pa'i sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyis khyod kyi rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par thob pa yin/ mjug gi cho ga la gnyis yod pa'i dang po bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang /gnas ma yin dang shes pa'i phyir thob pa'i dus go ba la/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang gnas ma yin pa dang / bsnyen bkur rang gi ngo bo/ gang la brten nas go zhing rig par bya ba/ rig par bya ba'i phan yon dang lnga/ dang po bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ni/ dge slob mtshan mthun la sdom pa mchog dman gyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir dge slong thams cad bsnyen bkur gyi gnas yin/ dge tshul mnyam po la rang las grib ma sor gcig gi dus kyis rgan pa rnams bsnyen bkur gyi gnas yin/ gnyis pa bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ma yin pa ni/ sdom pa mchog yin kyang rten dman pa yin pa'i phyir/ dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma dang / dge tshul ma rgan gzhen thams cad dang / mtshan mthun pa'i dge tshul rang —270

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanalas bslab pa garsha zhe pa rnams dang / dge bsnyen dang khyim pa la sogs pa bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ma yin/ gsum pa bsnyen bkur rang gi ngo bo gral gong du gtong / rnyed pa dang por 'bul/ phyag 'tshal ba sngon du ldang ba byed pa sogs gus pa'i las rnams yin/bzhi pa la/ lung dang dme sha tam nas gsum las ma gsungs kyang/ dge tshul gyi di ba nas lo smos par gsungs shing / gzhi 'grel las/ zla ba dang / ngo dang / tshes grangs kyang smos par gsungs pa dang bstun na/ da lo'i lo 'di che ge'i (198ba〉spo yin/ de la dus tshod dgun dang / dpyid dang /dbyar dang / dbyar thung ngu dang / dbyar 'bring po'i dus dang lnga las dgun gyi dus yin/ de la dgun zla bzhi yod pa las dgun zla che ge yin/ de thams cad la mar ngo sngon du 'gro ba'i mar ngo yar ngo gnyis las che ge yin/ de la tshes bco lnga yod pa las tshes che ge yin/ de yang nyin mo'i cha shas bcu bzhi dang / mtshan mo'i cha shas brgyad de nyin mtshan gyi cha nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ mdze sha tam las/snga dro dang gung dang phyi dro dang / mas mo thun dang po dang thun dang po'i phyed dang gung thun dang gung thun gyi phyed dang thun tha ma dang thun tha ma'i phyed dang / skya rengs ma shar ba dang / skya rengs shar ba dang / nyi ma ma shar ba dang / nyi ma shar ba dang / nyi ma brgyad cha shar ba dang / bzhi cha shar ba dang / gung tshigs ma yol ba dang / nyi ma bzhi cha lus pa dang / brgyad cha lus pa dang / nyi ma ma nub pa dang / nyi ma nub pa dang / rgyu skar rnams ma shar ba dang / rgyu skar rnams shar ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nyin mo'i cha che ge'i dus/ grib tshod skyes bu 'di dang / rkang pa 'di'i dus bkra shis pa'i gnas gtsug lag khang che ge mor/ mkhan po bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag che ge mos thog drangs/ mkhan slob 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su khyed kyis dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa yin pas de ltar yid la bzhag nas/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas rnams gral gong du zhog /rnyed pa dang por phul/ phyag dang sngon du ldang ba la sogs pa gus pa'i las gyis/ las su bsko ba byung na sngon la rang res byed pa yin/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ma (199na)yin pa rnams kyi gral 'gor sdod/ bsnyen bkur dang por 'grim pa byung na dang du long /27/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6podage slong ma dang dge slob ma'i phyag ma len/ de ma yin pa rnams kyi phyag dang bsnyen bkur stob pa dang du long / dge tshul bslab pa mnyam pa byung na gcig gis gcig la phyag bya mi dgos/ gral mgyogs gral byas pas chog ste/ mdo rtsa bar/ dus mnyam pa rnams ni/ gcig gis gzhag la phyag mi bya'o/ /sngar 'ongs pa nyid dang po yin no/ /zhes gsungs/lnga pa phan yon ni dngos su sdom pa thob pa'i dus shes pa dang / de la brten nas bsnyen bkur gyi gnas la bsnyen bkur byas/ gnas ma yin pa'i bsnyen bkur stob pa dang du blangs pas sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa dang mthun/ 'jig rten pa'i chos dge ba la gnas pas dge legs thams cad kyi rgyur 'gyur ba gleng bzhir shes so/ /de dag thams cad mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi bsam pas zin par byas na sangs rgyas thob pa'i phan yon yod pas/ de rnams thugs la bzhag nas phyag len la thebs par mdzod/ de mjug chog dang po lags/ gnyis dzi dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas gsung bar 'gyur bas der snyan gtod bya'o/ zhan tu bsdu na/ khyod dge tshul du bsgrub pa la cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum yod pas/ rjes kyi cho ga la gnyis las dang po bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang gnas mo yin pa shes pa'i phyir du dus go ba la/ khyod kyi rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa'i dus/ lo'i dbang du byas na lo skor bcu gnyis yod pa las lo 'di che ge yin/ de la dus tshigs lnga las/ dgun (199ba)dus yin/ de la zla ba bzhi yod pa las dgun zla che ge yin/ de la yar ngo dang mar ngo gnyis yod pa las yar ngo yin/ de la tshes bco lnga yod pa las che ge yin/ de la nyin mtshan gyi cha gnyis las nyin mo yin/ de la cha shas bcu bzhi yod pa'i che ge'i dus yin/ grib tshod skyes bu che ge dang / rkang pa che ge'i dus su/ gtsug lag khang che ge mo sa mkhan po che ge las/ khyod kyi dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa yin pas de rnams yid la bzhag nas bsnyen bkur gyi gnas gyi gnas dge slong rnams dang / rang las rgan pa'i dge tshul rnams gral gong du zhog /rnyed pa dang por phul/ phyag dang sngon du ldang ba sogs gus pa'i las gyis/ de ltar byas pas g.yin rgyud kyi bslab pa la gus par byas pa'i phan yon —272

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanayod/ dge slong ma dang dge slob ma'i phyag ma len/ rang las bslab pa gzhen pa'i dge tshul dang /dge tshul ma rgan gzhen thams cad dang / dge bsnyen pha ma sogs kyi phyag dang bsnyen bkur dang du long / de ltar byas pas rang rgyud kyi bslab pa la gus par 'i byas pa phan yon yod/ dus mnyam pa byung na gcig gis gcig la phyag bya mi dgos/ gral mgyogs gral byas pas chog /de ltar byas pas dngos su sdom pa thob pa'i dus shes/ ston pa'i bcas pa dang mthun zhing / nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i phan yon yod pas de rnams thugs la bzhag nas phyag len la thebs pa mdzod/ de mjug chog dang po lags/ gnyis pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas gsung bar 'gyur bas de la snyan gtod mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas (200na)slob dpon gyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas gsungs pa de rnams kyang sems la bzhag nas lag len la thebs par byed dgos pa yin/ da mjug chog gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir bslab pa brjod pa ni/ sdom pa thob pa tsam gyis mi chog bsrung dgos/ ma bsrungs na sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ste/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste/ /la la'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba ste/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba sdug bsngal yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ legasapar bsrung dgos shing bsrung lugs ni/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyis spang bya bcu po yid kyis spangs shing lusang ga gis de las slar log pa bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang dus 'di nas ma shi'i bar du spang bya bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa yid kyis spangs nas/ lus ngag gis slar ldog snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ yan lag dang po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags—273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6popa dgra bcom (200ba)pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang / glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos nyug pa dang / rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang / khri stan mthon po dang / khri stan chen po dang / dus ma yin pa'i zas dang / gser dngul len pa spangs te/ gser dngul len pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di che khi / bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang /rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang /glu gar dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos nyug pa dang / rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang / khri stan mthon po dang / khri stan chen po dang / dus ma yin pa'i zas dang / gser dngul len pa spangs te/gser dngul len pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag bcu po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /thabs yin no/ /legs so bya'o/ /de ltar dngos su blangs pa'i bslab pa bcu las rtsa ba bzhi las 'das na pham pa dang 'dra ba'i nyes byas/ yan lag drug las 'das na bshags bya'i nyes byas/ sdom pa blangs pa'i phyogs mthun las 'das na bsdam bya'i nyes byas/ 'chang ba la sogs pa nyes med du gnang ba rnams la nyes pa med par shes par gyis la legs par (201na)srungs shig /ces brjod do/ /de ltar dge tshul du gyur nas khyim pa yin na 'phags pa tshun chad kyis phyag bya ba'i gnas su gyur ba yin te/sag lhas/ de ltar dge tshul byas ma thag /'di la khyim pa thams cad kyis/ phyag 'tshal smon par 'gyur ba ste/ /gang phyir khyim gyi 'ching grol phyir/ tshul ngan rab rib mun bsal te/ /ngur smrig gosamachog 'dzin pa yis/ /nyi ma shar ltar lhang nga ni/ /phul phyin de ni shin tu mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dga' spro rgya chen po gyis/ de thams cad mkhan po'i sku drin las byung ba yin pas mkhan po la phyag gsum tshol la sku drin che lags zhes brjod/ des kyang sku drin che lags zhes brjod/ gzhan —274

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanarnams kyis me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te/ gong gis smon lam bzhi gdab po/ /de dag gis ni/ dge tshul grib tshod dang / bslab pa brjod pa tha ma yin/ zhes pa'i don legs par bshad zin to/ tshigasasnga ma dge tshul du sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /tshigs phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i cho ga bshad pa/gnyis pa tshigs phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i cho ga la/ sdom ni/ dang por bya dang mkhan po dang / /chos gos gnyis dang lhung bzed gnyis/ /gsol ba'i las dang blo mthun dang / /spro bya gsol ba gsang ston dang / /zhu dang gsol dang gsol ba dang / /dri dang las dang grib tshod dang / /nyin mtshan dus tshod gnas rnams dang / /lhung dang dge sbyong mchog 'dod dang / /tshul khrims mnyam dang tshul 'brel dang / /dul dang dgos dang ma brjod dang / /gus pa dang ni bsgrub bya (201ba tha/ /mu stegasaganas pa byin pa yi/ /sde tshan yang dag bsdu ba yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag gi don bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i cho ga la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba'i cho ga la don tshan brgyad yod pa'i/dang por bya dang zhes pa'i don/ yo byad tshags su gzhug cing / dkon cog gsum dang slob dpon mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir du dang por bya ba ni/ bsgrub bya de lo nyi shu lon nas bsnyen rdzogasa'adod na/ de'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed de/ rang la med cing mkhan po la yod na sbyin zhing /med na g.yar po la sogs tshun chad kyis btsal la yo byad tshags su gzhug /mkhan pos las slob dang / gsang ston dang / kha skong bar 'os pa'i dge slong rnams la tshig gis gsol ba gdab /de rnams thams cad kyis kyang rang gi rgyud so sor brtags nas/ las gral la ma 'dus pa'i gong du lhung ba rnams mthol ba dang / bshags pa dang / bsdams pa dang/ byin gyis brlab par bya bas phyir bcos te/ rang rgyud dag par byas la 'du bar bya'o/ /—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gemakhan po'am des bskos pas gnas mal bshams/ rgan pa'i mtha' logs su ston pa'i sku gzugs bzhugs su gsol ba dang / de'i spyan sngar mchod pa ci 'byor ba bshams zin cing / bsgrub bya'i chos gos gsum rgyu dang kha dog dang / che chung gi sgo nas dngos kyi byin rlabs 'chags mi 'chags legs par brtags la/ 'og tu gding ba nang du bzhi bltab byas steng mthang gos brgyad bltab byas pa/ de steng bla gos brgyad bltab byas pa/ (202na ti steng snam sbyar brgyad bltab byas pa rnams brkyang ste mgo mjug dang phyi nang ma log par byas nas mgo bo mkhan por bstan pa bzhag lhung bzed dang / gding ba chu tshags kyang de'i logs su bzhag /mkhan po'i mdun du me tog dang / bsgrub bya'i stan du rtswa pha gu dang bcas pa sta gon bya'o/ /dge slong thams cad 'dus pa dang / bsgrub bya de rgan pa'i mtha' logs su bzhag /mkhan pos thams cad kyi phyag tu me tog phul nas/ /phyag bya ba lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas nas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal nas dge 'dun la bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ dge slong mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po che ge mos las kyi slob dpon bkas gnang ba zhu/ dge slong mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po che ge mos gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon bkas gnang ba zhu/ che ge mos dbu mdzad rnams kyis las kyi kha skong mdzad nas tshe dang ldan pa 'di la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa zhig bkas gnang ba zhu/ dngos de ltar g.yar ngo 'phyar zhing mchis lags/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ mkhan po dang bsgrub byas ston pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa la me tog gtor ro/ /de nas bsgrub bya la ston pa'i sku gzugs 'di la ston pa dngos kyi 'du shes zhog la phyag gsum gyis/ bdag nyid dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi nang du 'jug pa'i bsam pa drag pos dge slong re re la phyag gsum gsum gyis (202ba tshe pos brjod/ phyag pus mo'i lha nga gnyis/ lag mthil gnyis/ mgo bo ste yan lag lnga sa la reg pa'i phyag gam/ dge slong rnams kyi —276

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)skyid pa la 'khyud cing mgo bos rkang ba la gtugs pa'i phyag bya ste/ phyag g.yin gyis go mi chod do/phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe dge slong re res tshe dang ldan pa 'di'i rgyud la bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa myur du thob par gyur cig ces smon lam btab cing me tog gtor ro/ /gnyis pa mkhan po dang zhes pa'i don/ mkhan po mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir mkhan por gsol ba btab pa ni/bsgrub bya de rtswa'i steng nas mkhan po la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug ste/ mkhan po'i mdun du pha gu'i steng du rtswa bting ba la rting pa gnyis kyis mnan nas tsog tsog pur thal mo snying gar sbyor du bcug nas/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos po don du gnyer ba de shin tu legs/ legs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ dge slong zhes bya chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /dge slong zhes bya rdo rje'i srog shing yin/ /dge slong zhes bya duḥkha spong ba yin/ dge slong zhes bya rgyal ba'i sras po yin/ /dge slong zhes bya nyon mongs srog bcod de/ /dge slong zhes bya thar pa'i lam 'gro yin/ /dge slong rang gi ngo bo bsdams pa ste/ /zhes gsungs/sngon chog dang da chog gi khyad par bshad pa/de lta bu'i bsnyen rdzogs su sgrub par byed pa la/ sngon gyi cho ga dang da ltar gyi cho ga gnyis su gsungs pa las/ dang po ni/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pa sngon gyi rgyud yongs su smin pa'i gang zag rnams la/ dge slong dag tshur shog la (203na slongs par spyad pa spyod cig ces gsungs pa'i mod la/ skra dang kha skru rang gi ngang gis byi/ lus la chos gos snam sbyar gyon/ lag tu lhung bzed dang bya ma bum thogs/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bu'i spyod lam can du gyur pa la/ bar snang gi lha rnams ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ sgra byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhi gnas 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6polus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /zhes ched du brjod par byed do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag tshur shog ces gsungs pa tsam gyis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs thob pa yod do/ /zhes pa'i snyan pa la brten nas rab byung ba bsnyen rdzogs don du gnyer ba rnams yul thag ring po nas 'ongs pas/'ga' zhig ni chu dang g.yang sa la sogs pa 'byung ba'i bar chad/ 'ga' zhig ni stag dang seng ge la sogs pa gcan gzan gyi gnod pa'i dbang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du ma phyin par tshe'i dus byas/ de ston pa'i snyan du gsol bas/ kye ma nga'i nyan thos rnams thag ring po nas 'ongs pa shin tu ngal bar gyur to snyam du dgongs nas/ de phyin sa der gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par bya bar gnang ngo / /zhes gsol bzhi'i las kyis cig car rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa gnang nas/ der dge slong rnams kyis bsgrub bya la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas pa/ de dag la mkhan slob med pas legs par ma sbyangs shing / (203ba〉spyod lam rgod bag can du gyur pa la khyim pa ma dad cing mu stegs can rnams 'phya bar gyur la/ dge slong 'ga' zhig nad g.yog med par shi bar gyur pa'i skabs de ston pa'i snyan du gsol pas/ sngar dge tshul gyi skabs bshad pa ltar/ nga'i nyan thos rnams gcig gis gcig bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir dang / zhes pa nas/ dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab pa'i gnas rnams nye bar lung 'bogs pa'i don gyis na mkhan po ste/ don thams cad yang dag par grub pa'i dpal mya ngan las 'da' ba la khad nye ba'i dge slong gi dngos po sgrub par mdzad du gsol zhes zhu ba 'bul ba yin pas/ btsun pa'am slob dpon nam/ sngar rab byung gi mkhan po yin kyang / cho ga tha dad yin pas sngar gyi rab byung gi mkhan po 'di la/ da bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po zhu snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mkhan por gsol gyis/ mkhan po bdag gi mkhan po mdzad du gsol/ mkhan po mkhan pos bdag bsnyen par rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /lan gnyis bzlas pa'i rjes su gsum pa 'di la cho ga dum bu gsum yod pa'i/ dum bu gnyis—278

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)rdzogs pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar gsol ba btab pa khas blangs pa de dus/ nged khyed kyi bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan por gyur pa yin no/ /btsun pa'am slob dpon yin na mkhan por gyur nasabatsun pa zhes mi brjod par/ mkhan po zhes brjod dgos pas/ de ltar yid la theg la gsum pa'i yang rjes zlos gyis zhes brjod/ mjug tu thabs(24na than no/ /legs so zhes brjod/ shin tu bsdu na/ khyed bsnyen par rdzogs pa byed pa la mkhan po zhig dgos/ mkhan po la ci rung rung gi mi chog gis/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu bar ma chad du lon pa btsun pa brtan pa'i yon tan lnga phrugs su sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gang rung dang ldan pa/ mkhas shing phan thogs kyi yon tan te/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge slong la mkhan por lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba 'debs dgos/ de nged kyisahrūb rung du yod pas/ bdag mya ngan las 'das pa la khad nye ba'i dge slong gi dngos po sgrub par byed mkhan mdzad du gsol snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos kyis/btsun pa'am mkhan po dgongs su gsol nas/ thabs legs kyi bar bya'o/ /gsum pa chos gos gnyis dang lhung bzed gnyis/ zhes pa'i don yo byad mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir chos gos dang lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs nas sbyin pa ni/ phyag gsum 'tshol la nged kyi mdun du shog cig ces bsgo/ grogs byed pas chos gos gsum po so sor bltab pa phrag pa g.yon pa la bkal nas/ 'di la dngos dang 'di la rgyu'i byin rlabs 'chags par gda'/ byas la brda sprad/mkhan pos kyang de la mang du thos pa'i dge slong 'di zhes bya bas tshe dang ldan pa 'di'i lhung bzed dge 'dun la ston pa'i grogs ldan mdzod cig ces bsgo/ de nas mkhan po dang bsgrub bya gnyis ka 'grengs te gnyis da'i lag pas snam sbyar bzung nas/ 'di snam phran dang glegs bu du ma sbyar bas na snam sbyar zhes bya ba/ khyim pa dang mu stegs (204bcan dang rab tu byung ba bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa man chad las rtags kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'gyur ba yin pas/ 'di dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/—279

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorabadag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa/ rung ba sbyang bar 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo/ /lan gsum bzlas la/ de snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab pa'i thabs yin no/ khyed rang legs so gyis byas la/ phrag pa g.yas ngos su sgos la bzhag /bla gos dang mthang gos kyi bshad pa la spro na dge tshul gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin byas la/ 'di dge slong gi yo byad bla gos dang mthang gos su byin gyis brlab snyam pa gyis la rjes zlos gyis byas pa mngags la/snam sbyar gyi gnas su bla gos dang mthang gos zhes 'jug gzhan 'dra/ thabs legs snam sbyar ltar byed/ grogs ldan pas de blangs te bltab pa bshig /de bzhin du snam sbyar phyir 'ong ba byas bla gos nang du byas nas sbrags te bzhag /mthang gos nyis bltab byas pa bsgrub bya la bskon/ de steng du bla gos snam sbyar sbrags pa bskon pa'i phrag pa g.yon par bkal/ g.yas kyi sne mo g.yon gyi phrag pa'i steng du bzhag g.yas kyi dpung ba phyir phyung ste mkhan pos kyang bskon zhing thal mo snying gar sbyar bcug pa'i mgo bor me tog bzhag nas/ smon lam bzhi bo thams cad kyis gdab po/ /snam sbyar bskon ma thag tu myur du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ched du rtsa 'am/ gding ba'i steng na 'dug pas dge 'dun la phyag gsum bya'o/ /(20ldan〉kal te gos dras shing drubs pa med pa 'am/ dngos kyi byin rlabs 'chags pa med na chos gos gsum gyi rgyu rung ba so sor bltabs te slob ma'i phrag pa g.yon pa la bkal/gnyis gas snam sbyar gyi rgyu bzung la bshad pa gzhan 'dra ba la 'di snam sbyar gyi rgyur byin gyis brlab snyam pa gyis la rjes zlos kyis/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gosa'adi snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo/ /'tshal la bar chad ma byung na snam phran dgu pa la sogs par bgyi ste/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa la sogs par bgyi'o/ /bkru'o/ /brkyang ngo / /dra'o/ /bsdeb bo/ /gzungs gdab po/ /drub po/ kha bsgyur ro/ /yang na 'di la lhan thabs su glan no/ /rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyis te chos gos 'di ni rung ba spyad par 'os pa'o/ /lan gsum bzlas la thabs legs bya'o/ /bla gos la gzhan 'dra ba la snam phran bdun par bgyi ste/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum bar —280

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabagyi'o/ /mthang gos la snam phran lnga par bgyi ste glegs bu phyed dang gnyis par bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod gzhan sngar gyis 'gre'o/ /lhung bzed ston pa'i dge slong gis lhung bzed kyi nang du me tog gam sman cung zad bcug la/ lhung bzed lag pa g.yon par bzhag g.yas pas kha bkab/ rgan pa'i mtha' nas brtsams te dge slong re re'i mdun du 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas pas rgan gzhen gyi bye brag gis btsun pa'am tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed 'di mi chung ngam mi che 'am/ mi skya 'am zhes 'dri/ re re nas lhung bzed bzang ngo (2tsob)zhes brjod/ gal te de ltar mi brjod na nyes byas so/ /ston mkhan de la dge slong gzhan zhig gisaston lugs sngar bzhin bya/ mkhan pos legs par brtags nas 'grim du bcug pa yin na mkhan po la bstan mi dgos/ de lta ma yin na dgos gsung ngo / /de nas lhung bzed de mkhan slob gnyis ka 'greng ba'i lag pa g.yon par bzhag /g.yas pasasteng nas bkab la bshad pa la spro na dge tshul gyi skabs ltar byas nas/ 'di dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad lhung bzed du byin gyis brlab snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed zas la spyad par 'os pa drang srong gi snod 'di bslang ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab bo lan gsum bzlas thabs legs bya'o/ /de nas gding ba dang chu tshags ster lugs dge tshul gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya/ des khyed bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i yo byad mngon du gyur par byas pa yin no/ /re zhig dge slong 'di'i phyi la song zhig ces brjod/grogs byed pa'i dge slong des kyang bsgrub bya de'i lus tshags legs par byas/ las mi thos pa'i sayin na dang / thos tshe rna ba bkag las gral nas mthong sar gding ba bting ba'i steng du kha tshur bstan nas 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas pa'i tshul du bzhag la/ rang nyid las gral du 'khod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa gsol ba'i las dang zhes pa ni/ phyag len la phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa'i sgo nasalas gral gyi dge slong rnams kyis lhung ba la bshags bsdams tshul bzhin du byas te bsdams bya nyes 281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobyas yan chad kyis ma gos (206na)par byed dgos pa da lta phyag len la dge 'dun rnams 'dus ma thag par mdzad pa bde/ las byed pas gsang ston bsko ba'i thog mar las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba gnyis gda' ba la/ lhung ba thun mong ba byin gyis brlab pa 'di las gral ma 'dus pa'i gong du bya bar gsungs kyang der bya ba ma grub pas 'dir bgyi/ yul dus kyi stabs kyis bshags par ma nus pa'i lhung ba thun slong ba thams cad las la mi sgrib par bgyi ba'i slad du/ gsol ba'i las kyis byin gyis brlab par bgyi bas/ dge 'dun spyod lam bstun nas gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las lags la bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na gang gi mdun du bdag cag lhung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi ba/ bdag cag las dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la dge slong gi mdun du lhung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyid par spro ba su yang ma mchis na/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis deng ltung ba de byin gyis brlabs te bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad la/ slad kyis dge slong gi mdun du lhung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /lnga pa blo mthun dang zhes pa'i don/ dge 'dun thugs mthun pa'i phyir gnas la blo mthun bgyi ba ni/ las mdzad pa'i gnas 'di nye 'khor dang bcas pa tshun chad/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi 'phrin las kyi gnas su thugs bstun pa gsol ba'i (206ba〉pas la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa 'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang / phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su bzhed na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad grub pa 'am/ brgyas pa 'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang /phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi —282

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gsol ba thal/ brjod pa mjug bsdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa 'am/ bgyis pa 'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang / /phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcasapa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su bzhed do/ /de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad grub pa 'am/ bgyis pa 'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang / phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa 'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang / phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig /gang (207na jig mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa 'am/ bgyis pa 'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang / phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su blo mthun par bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ grub pa zhes pa bskal pa chags pa'i tshe rang grub pa 'am/ de'i 'og tu gtib chad pa la sogs pa rang grub pa ste/skyes bu'i rtsol ba la ma bltos pa'o/ /bgyis pa zhes pa skyes bu'i byed pas mngon par bsgrubs pa'o/ /lags pa ni zin pa ste bya ba byed pa'i gnas la sogs pa rung ba'o/ /cho ga'i skabs su gang rung las gsum kha brjod mi dgos so/ cho ga de dkyus gcig la bsnyen rdzogs du ma zhag gcig la sbrel nas byed na/ lhung mthun byin gyis brlab pa dang / gnas la blo mthun gnyis cho ga phyi ma rnams la byed mi dgos so/ /drug pa spro bya gsol ba gsang ston dang / zhu dang zhes pa'i don/ de nas las byed pas mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bya ba'i gsang ste ston par gsol ba btab 283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (/popa de gang yin zhes dri/ des bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba lags zhes lan gdab/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyed mkhan po ming 'di zhes bya bas tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gsang ste ston par spro 'am/ des kyang spro lags zhes lan gdab/ las brgya rtsa gcig las/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i rten la bya ba'i las rigs brgyad las/ 'dir (207ba tshe nasang ste ston pas lkog tu bar chad dri ba'i phyir/ gsang ste ston pa bsko ba la thugs bstun pa gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad pa zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gsang ste ston par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gsang ste ston to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /de nas gsang ston des bsgrub bya'i gan du phyin la rang la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug /mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug tu bcug ste/ thal mo snying gar sbyor du bcug la/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la mngon du gyur pa bcu tshang dgos shing / de'i nang nas yongs su dag pa mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ba/ bar chad kyi chos dang mi ldan pa zhig dgos/ bar chad yod med ngas dris pas shes pas khyod la dri bar bya/khyod kyis kyang cho ga las/ 'di ni khyod kyi bden pa'i dus 'di ni 'byung ba'i dus te/ zhes pa'i don bden par smra ba'i dus dang / 'byung ba ste yang dag pa'i mtha' smra ba'i dus yin pas lan drang por thob cig /tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /'di ni khyod kyi bden pa'i dus 'di ni 'byung ba'i dus te/kho bos khyod la cung zad dri yis/ khyod ma 'dzems par byos la yin pa la yin zhes spros/ ma yin pa la ma yin zhes lan thob cing / khyod skyes pa yin nam/ des yin lags zhes sogs/ (208na〉dro ba dang mthun pa'i lan gdab bo/ /skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan nam/ lo nyi shu lon nam/ khyod kyi chosagos gsum dang lhung bzed tshang ngam/ khyod pha ma gson pas ma gnang ba ma yin nam/ khyod bran ma yin nam/ brkus pa ma yin nam/ rnyed btson ma yin nam/ rtsod pa can ma yin nam/ btsongs pa ma —284

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)yin nam/ rgyal pos bkrabs pa ma yin nam/ rgyal po la bsdigs pa ma yin nam/ rgyal po la gnod pa'i las byed pa ma yin nam/ rgyal po la gnod pa'i las byas sam byed du bcug pa ma yin nam/chom rkun par grags pa ma yin nam/ za ma ma yin nam/ ma ning ma yin nam/ dge slong ma sun phyung ba ma yin nam/ rku thabs su gnas pa ma yin nam/ tha dad du gnas pa ma yin nam/ gnas par mi bya ba ma yin nam/ mu stegs can ma yin nam/ /mu stegs can zhugs pa ma yin nam/ pha bsad pa ma yin nam/ /ma bsad pa ma yin nam/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa ma yin nam/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa ma yin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba ma yin nam/ sprul pa ma yin nam/ dud 'gro ma yin nam/ zhes dris la/ bsgrub byas ma yin lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ khyod la la la'i bu lon mang yang rung nyung yang rung bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'jal mi nus pa cung zad kyang chags pa med dam/ khyod sngon rab tu byung ba ma yin nam/ khyod pham par gyur pa bzhi las lhung ba gang yang rung ba zhig byung ba ma yin nam/ ji ltar khyod da lta rab tu byung ba yin nam/ khyod kyis tshangs par (208ba〉spyod pa legs par spyad dam/ zhes dri/ des legs par spyad lags zhes brjod/ khyod kyi ming ci/ des bdag gi ming 'di zhes bgyi/ khyod kyi mkhan po'i ming ci/ don gyi slad du mtshan nasasmos te bdag gi mkhan po'i ming 'di zhes bgyi/ zhes brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /mi rnams kyi lus la lus kyi nad rnam pa 'di lta bu dag 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ mdze dang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang / 'brum phran dang / sha bkra dang / khyi sngo dang /g.ya' ba dang / slog pa dang / rkang shu dang / skem nad dang / nem pa dang / brjed byed dang / bkres rngab dang / /skya rbab dang / rkang bam dang / mtshan par rdol ba dang / rims dang / rims drag pa dang / nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / 'dus pa dang / / rimasanyin re ba dang / rtag pa'i rims dang / /rims ldang dub pa dang / shu ba dang / gsud pa dang / skyigs bu dang / lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / lhog pa dang / yan lag tu zug pa dang / skran dang / khrag —285

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pond dang / mkhris nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang / skyug bro ba dang / chu 'gags pa dang / ngal ba dang /lus tsha ba dang / rtsib logs tsha ba dang / rus pa la zug pa ste lus kyi nad 'di lta bu 'di dag las gang yang rung ba dang / 'di lta bu gzhan dag kyang khyod kyi lus la med dam/ des med lags zhes brjod do//tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /khyod la da lta ngas dris pa de nyid dge 'dun gyi dbus su yang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa mkhas pa rnams khyod la (209na 'dri yis/ der yang khyod kyis ma 'dzem par byos la/ yin pa la yin zhes smyos/ ma yin pa la ma yin zhes lan thob cig /khyod ma bos kyi bar du ma 'ong par sdod cig /de ltar na khyod bar chad kyis dag 'dug cing / ngas dge 'dun la zhus la yong gi zhes brjod la/ des dge 'dun gyi nang du 'ongs te rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag gi mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la bar chad kyi chos rnams gsang ste rjes su bstan na/ de yang bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi na/ ci mchi zhig gam thams cad kyis gal te yongs su dag na'o/ /zhes brjod/ ma brjod na nyes byas so/ /de nas bsgrub bya la dge 'dun gyi nang gi shog cig ces brjod la/ gding ba'i steng nas dge 'dun spyi la dmigs pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug la/rang nyid gral du 'bad do/ /bdun pa gsol ba dang zhes pa'i don gsol ba mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bsgrub bya de dang por ston pa la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug /de nas dge 'dun la phyag gsum 'tshal du gzhug /de nas las slob pas de la phyag gsum tshol la/ nged kyi mdun du pha gu'i steng du rtswa bting ba la rting pa gnyis kyis mnan nas/ tsog tsog pur thal mo snying gar sbyor la 'dug cig ces bsgo/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa don du gnyer ba de/ dge 'dun (༄09ba)rgyalas kyis sgrub dgos shing / las brgya rtsa gcig yod pa las slob dpon dul ba lhas/ dgos ched kyi sgo nas las rigs bcu gsum du bsdu ba mdzad kyang / slob dpon thogs med kyi gzhi sems can la bya —286

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)ba dang / sems can ma yin pa la bya ba gnyis su bsdus shing / de la 'dir sems can la bya ba yin/de la khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i rten la bya ba gnyis las/ 'dir tha ma yin/ de la bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / /ma rdzogs pa'i rten la bya ba gnyis las tha ma yin/ de la sbyin pa'i las dang / mi mthun pa'i las gnyis las 'di sbyin pa'i las/ de'i nang nas kyang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa sbyin pa'i las yin bas/ sbyin pa'i las mtshan nyid pa thams cad la gsol ba lan gsum du gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba 'debs dgos/ gsol ba gang la 'debs na/ gang las sdome pa thob par 'gyur ba'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba/ kha skong gi chos dang ldan pa/ mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba ste mtshan nyid gsum ldan la gsol ba 'debs de yang cho ga'i tshig zur nas bdag bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bya ba 'byung / bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni so: ta'i skad du u pa sa spata zhes yang / de yang u pa ni nye ba/ sa spa ta rdzogs pa ste skyon thams cad dang bral zhing / yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa la khad nye ba'i dge slong gi dngos po bsgyub tu gsol zhes bya ba'i don yin/ drang du gsol bya ba ni ba snyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'i cha nas ldan pa'i sar phyag (210na〉rkyang ba'i tshul gyes drang du gsol zhes bya ba yin/ rjes su gzung du gsol ba ni sngon med pa'i sdom pa sbyin pa'i sgo nas rjes su gzung du gsol zhes bya ba yin/ rjes su bstan du gsol ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral ba'i phyir thar pa'i lam stan du gsol bya ba yin / thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis zhes pa ni/ dge 'dun ni sdug bsngal gyi 'dam du bying ba rnams yongs su skyob par mdzad pas na thugs brtse ba can no/ /thugs brtse ba'i slad du zhes pa thugs brtse ba sngon du btang nas yin gyi lan du phan 'dogs pa'i blos ni ma yin no/ /thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol ni thugs brtse bas kun nas bslangs te/ ci nas kyang bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol bya ba yin pas don de rnams dran pa'i sgo nas/ dge 'dun mtha' dag gis gsan pa'i rjes zlos tshig zur chag pa dang nor ba ma yin pa byed tshig so so nas ma 'chol bar/—287

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( /poskad che la brjod pa dag pa gyis la/ kho bo'i ngag rdzogs pa'i rjes su rjes zlos tsheg zur lam pa gyis shig /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/dge 'dun la bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ dge (210ba)'dun btsun pa rnams kyis drang du gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag rjes su gzung du gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ /thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di rang don du brjod pa'i sngags yin pas lan gsum brjod dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'i yang rjes zlos mdzod/ yang gsum pa'i yang rjes zlos mdzod/ de ltar lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ dge 'dun gyis kyang cang mi gsung ba'i sgo nas gnang ba byin pa yin/ des bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa dang / gsol ba mngon du gyur pa byas pa yin/shin tu bsdu na/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la dge 'dun la lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba 'debs dgos pas/ nged kyi rjes zlos gyis/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol nas/ thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol gyi bar lan gsum brjod do/ /brgyad pa gsol ba dang / dri dang zhes pa'i don/ yongs su dag pa dge 'dun thugs yid ches pa la sogs pa'i don du nang du bar chad dri bar bya ba'i phyir sngon 'gro gsol ba'i las bgyid/ khyed rang rjes zlos bgyi mi 'tshal/ dge 'dun spyod lam bstun nas gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ mkhan po ming 'di zhesabagyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal te/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di (211na/zhes bgyi bas/ dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun —288

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanagyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / bdag gis dge 'dun gyi nang du mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la bar chad kyi chos rnams dri bar bya'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya la nged la phyag gsum phul la/ sngar bzhin pha gu'i steng du 'dug cig ces bsgo la/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la rgyud bar chad kyi chos dang mi ldan pas yongs su dag pa zhig dgos/ bar chad can bsnyen par rdzogs na sdom pa mi skye ba 'am/ skyesakyang rgyun mi gnas pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa yod pas/ khyod la'ang phan mi thogs/ bsnyen par rdzogs par byed mkhan la yang nyes pa 'byung ba yin/ bar chad med na khyod rang la yang sdom pa skye bas don chen po 'grub/ nged kyis kyang chos ldan gyi 'phrin las byas pas ston pa la bya ba byas par bshad cing bstan pa la phan pa yin/ bar chad gsang ston gyis dris pas chog mod snyam na/ bar chad 'ga' zhig glo bur du 'byung ba yang srid/ sngar ma dran pa dran pa'ang srid pa la sogs dgos byed 'ga' zhig kyang yod mod/ gtso cher dge 'dun thugs yid ches pa'i don du nang du 'dri ba yin pas lan drang por thob cig /tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /'di ni khyod kyi bden pa'i dus/ 'di ni 'byung ba'i dus te/kho bos khyod la cung zad dri yis khyod ma 'dzem par byos la yin pa la yin zhes (211ba〉sgos zhes pa nas/ 'di lta bu gzhan dag kyang khyod kyi lus la med dam zhes pa'i bar sngar gsang ston gyi dris pa ltar dri'o/ /de yan chad kyis sbyor ba'i cho ga song / gnyis pa las dang zhes pa'i don/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /mkhan slob bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod dang / /rdzogasapa'i yo byad yongs dag dang / /gsol pa las rnams ma gyur te/ /mngon gyur bcu yi sgo nas ni/bsnyen rdzogs nyid du nye bar bsgrub/ /de ltar bshad pa'i rgyu tshogs las/ /mngon gyur lhag ma brgyad po yi/ /bshad pa btang snyoms gyur kyang bla/ /mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa rnams/ /thugs dgongs gsum po gsal gdab cing / /las kyi slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa bskyed pa la/ /med du mi rung gces pa'i chos/ /bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod bsam pa'i rten/ /khyad chos lnga dang —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( /7)ldan pa dang / /gsol bzhi'i cho ga go bde'i ngag /'brul med blo las then nus pa'i/ /mngon gyur gnyis la nan tan gyis/ /bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub pa gnad du che/ /bstan rtsa'i dge slong sgrub byed kyi/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i khog phubs so/ /de yang cung zad bshad na/ las 'chags pa'i rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa tshang na/ las mtshan nyid dang ldan par byas pas/ sdom pa thob par 'gyur bas/ gdamasangag gi bshad pa med kyang chog ste/ /bshad pa ma gtso/ rgyu rkyen tshang ba gtso ba yin/ 'on kyang ngesa'abyung gi bsam pa gsal gdab cing thob shes kyi yid ches pa'i nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir gdams (212na)ngag gi bshad pas cung zad brda sprad na/ grub pa'i mtha' las/ rgyu drug rkyen bzhi'i nang nas rgyu rkyen lnga las skye bo zhes brda sprad kyang rung / 'gal rkyen bzhi spangs mthun rkyen lnga tshang ba las skye bo zhes brda sprad kyang rung mod kyi 'dir gcig las 'phros pa'i bcu pa'i skabs las/ mngon du gyur nas bsnyen par rdzogs par 'gyur ba bcu ste/ ston pa mngon sum du gyur nas bsnyen par rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas mngon sum du gyur pa dang / chos mngon sum du gyur pa dang / mkhan po ma' sum du gyur pa dang / slob dpon mdzo sum du gyur pa dang / bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod mgo sum du gyur pa dang / bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa'i yo byad mngon sum du gyur pa dang / yongs su dag pa mngon sum du gyur pa dang / gsol ba mngon sum du gyur pa dang / las mngon sum du gyur pa rnams so/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar bcu las/ ston pa mngon sum du gyur pa ni dge 'dun la 'dul 'dzin snga ma rnams 'chad cing / 'di la dge 'dun grangs tshang ba/ kha skong gi chos dang ldan pa/ mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba gsum dgos/ dang po ni/ yul dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa la dge slong bcu yan chad/ mtha' 'khob tu lnga yan chad dgos te/ lung du/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa la ni bcu la sogs pa'o/ /mtha' 'khob dag tu med na 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang lnga la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ sdom tshig dang de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ (212brkong po ni/ 'greng yul 'dun —29()

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanasogs phul ba min/ /ma rdzogs nyams dang mtshams med min/ /sdig sa tha dad 'khrul bcas min/ /mtshams mtshan dkon cog gzhan med pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gzhi'i skabs nas 'byung ba bcu/ zhu ba'i skabs nas yang ba gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ las gral der mi 'dug par 'greng ba ma yin pa/ gang la las bya ba'i yul bsgrub bya de nyid ma yin pa/ 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa phul ba ma yin pa/bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ma yin pa/ rdzogs kyang pham pa 'chab bcas kyis gos pa ma yin pa/ mtshamasamed dang nye ba'i mtshams med byas pa ma yin pa/ ston pa'i bslab pa la yid mi ches pa'i sdig lta can ma yin pa/ spo mgu spyod pa la sogs pa dman pa'i sa na gnas pa ma yin pa chos phyogs las lta ba tha dad pa'i chos ma yin phyogs pa ma yin pa/ bsdam bya nyes byas yan chad kyis gos pa'i 'khrul bcas ma yin pa'o/ /'o na so so skye bo'i dge slong las kyi kha stong du rung ba rnyed dka' bar 'gyur te/ bsdam bya nyes byas yan chad kyis gos pa'i 'khrul bcas ma yin pa dgos shing 'brul bcas las kyi kha skong du mi rung ba'i phyir snyam na skyon med de las gral la 'dus pa'i dus su lhung ba thun mong byin gyis rlob pa gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las byed la/ de byas pas dge 'dun lhag ma man chad kyi lhung bas lasachags pa la sgrib pa'i nyes pa 'dag pa'i phyir te/ 'khrul pa dang bcas pa yang ngo/ /bsdam par bya bas kyang yin gyi/ bshags par bya ba 'ba' zhig gis yin par mjad do/ /byin(213na gyis brlabasapas dag pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ mtshams gzhan ma yin pa/ mtshan gzhan ma yin pa/ dkon cog gzhan ma yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir mtshams la rags pa mtshams gzhan dang / nam mkha' mtshams ga' na gnyis/dang po ni/ rtsig pa dang / me dang / /chu la sogs pas bar chod pa lta bu'o/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'dug pa lta bu'o/ /des na bsgrub bya bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la/ dge slong rnams mtshams nang gcig tu lhan gcig tu gnas pa'o/ /gnyis ge ni/ skyes pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa la dge slong pha'i dge 'dun dgos pa yin gyi/—291—

rgya ra dbang nge pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tsom/ 6podage slong ma'i dge 'dun gyis bsnyen par rdzogs par byar mi rung ba lta bu'o/ /bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa la nges par mtshan mthun dgos pa ma yin te/ de gnyis ga'i dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ las byed pa'i dge slong la sangs rgyas ma yin pa zhig dgos te/ las kyi gzhin / rgyal ba ni mi mthun pa byed pa nyid ma yin no/ kha skong bar byed pa nyid ma yin no/ /des byas pa las ma yin pas mi 'chags so/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa lam 'dusapa'i mi mthun pa dang / 'dus pa phyir log gi mi mthun pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ las gral der 'du bar 'os pa'i dge slong 'ga' zhig ma 'dus pa ni ma 'dus pa'i mi mthun pa yin la/ de dang bral nas der 'du bar 'os pa'i dge slong thams cad las gral der 'dus pa'o/ /gnyis(213ba)pa ni lasagral der gnas pa'i dge slong gis chos ldan gyi las 'di byar mi rung ngo zhes ldog par byed pa ni/'dus pa phyir ldog gi mi mthun pa yin la/ de dang bral nas der gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis cang mi gsung ba'i tshul gyis las la gnang ba ster bar bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa sangs rgyas ma gyur la/ skyabs 'gro'i yul du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dkon cog dang /kun rdzob brdar mtshon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs gnyis/ dang po ni gdul bya gzhan ngor rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag sangs rgyas su mtshon par byed pa'i theg chen mi slob pa'i lam gyi bden pa la 'jog ste/ mdzod las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ste/ /sangs rgyas dge 'dun byed pa'i chos/ /mi slob pa dang gnyis ka dang / /mya ngan 'das la skyabs su 'gro/ /zhes gsungs shing/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas dkon cog la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /gsum pa la skyabs 'gro'i yul du gyur pa dang / kun rdzob brdar mtshon pa'i chos gnyis/ dang po ni 'gog bden gyis bsdus pa'i myang 'das yin la/ de nyid la yid ches kyi dad pa dang ldan pa'o//gnyis pa la lung dang rtogs pa'i chos gnyis/ dang po ni lung sdebazhi 'am/ de'i dgongs 'grel gyi —292

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabastan bcos dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ las gral de na gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa la brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis (214na skong ldan pa'i mkhan por 'os pa'i dge slong la mkhan por gsol ba btab cing / khas blangs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /lnga pa la las kyi slob dpon dang / gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon gnyis/ dang po ni kha skong gi chos dang ldan zhing / dge 'dun gyi dbus su gsol bzhi'i cho ga brda sprod pa la mkhas pa zhig la/mkhan pos tshig tsam gyi sgo nas las slob tu bskos pa'i dge slong dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni kha skong gi chos dang ldan zhing / 'gro min bzhi dang bral ba/ lkog tu bar chad dri ba la mkhas pa dge 'dun gyis gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis gsang ston du bskos pa'i dge slong dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /drug pa la lus kyi rten dang / bsam pa'i rten gnyis/ dang po ni sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad dang mi ldan zhing / rgyud tshogs su ma tshang ba/ sdom pa rnying pas rgyud ma bkag pa/ tshig snga ma dge tshul man chad sngon du song zhing chags pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod/ dus kyi kun slong thob shes/ 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral gyi bsam pa mthun rkyen phun tshogs gsum ldan gyi bsam pa/ de thams cad nges khrung gi bsam pas zin dgos pa'o/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag ni gong du bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /bdun pa yo byad mngon du gyur pa la/ lus kyi byi byad kyi rtags/gos kyi rtags/ snod spyad kyi rtags dang gsum/ dang po ni/ breg par 'os pa'i skra dang kha spu bregasashing khrus byas pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyim pa dang mu stegs can las gos kyi rtags kyi khyad par du 'phags(214ba/zhing / dge sbyong gi dran pa gso ba dang / sems chags bral du bsgyur ba mtshon byed du chos gos rnam gsum mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs nas gnang ba de nyid gces spras su 'chang dgos te/ snam sbyar pags pa dang 'dra bar ro/ /chos gos lhag ma yang ngo /zhes bya ba ni chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi rgya cher 'grel las/ /ji ltar pags pa rlung dang nyi ma dang char la sogs pa dag las bskyab bar bya ba ltar dge slong gi snam sbyar yang de bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ /—293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6po zhes gsungs / dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dang / sbyin bdag gi gdan gsar pa bskyab ba'i phyir du glegs pu phyed dang gnyis pa'i bdag nyid can gyi gding ba mkhan pos gnang ba ltar du bcang dgos/gding ba bcang bar bya'o/ /de ni 'thug na tshig rkyang rung ngo / /sengs pa ni nyis rim mo/ khra khra bo mi rung ngo / /de la glegs bu'i 'phro bya'o/ /'og rol gyi sum cha'i dang por ro/ /glegs bu gcig pa byin gyis brlab par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ khyim pa dang mu stegs can las snod spyad kyi rtags kyi gnas khyad par du 'phags shing / /dge sbyong gi dran pa gso ba dang / /lhung bzed kyi nang nas zas la longs spyod pa bzhin du/ rang gi sems rgyud chos la longs spyod pa mtshon byed du lhung bzed mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs nas byin pa ltar gces spras kyi sgo nas 'chang dgos te/ /lhung bzed med par rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par mi bya'o/ /chung ngu dang / chen po dang / skya bas kyang mi bya'o zhes dang / lhung bzed mig bzhin du bskyang bar bya'o/ zhes(215na sko sung / srog chags la gnod 'tshe spang ba'i phyir du chu tshags mkhan pos gnang ba ltar 'chang dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rjes khyad par du byas pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa yongs su dag pa la mngon du gyur pa ni/ bar chad med pa zhig dgos te/ gsang ste ston pas lkog tu dris/ nged kyis dge 'dun gyi dbusasu dris pas bar chad med par rtogs pas tshang ba yin/ dgu pa gsol ba mngon du gyur pa ni/ dge 'dun la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i phyir gsol ba lan gsum du 'debs pa la rang gi ming dang / mkhan po'i ming dang / dge 'dun zhes pa brjod pa ma chad pas gsol ba gdab dgos te de gsum brjod pa chad na mi skye ste/ mdor de gnyis kyi ming ma smos na mi skye'o/ /dge 'dun gyi na yang de'i skye gnasakyis mi skye'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang cho ga lhag chad med par lan gsum du gsol ba btab pasatshang ba yin/ bstob las mngone du gyur pa la/ las mkhan gyis bsgrub bya'i ming dang / mkhan po'i ming dang / dge 'dun gyi ming rnams ma brjod pa'am/ gsol ba dang brjod pa gang rung chad na mi skye ste/ lung las gang zag lnga bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ bdag gi ming ma brjod pa dang / 294

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)mkhan po'i ming ma brjod pa dang /gsol ba chad pa dang /brjod pa chad pa dang /bsnyen par rdzogasapar mi shes pa'o//zhes gsungs/mdor na gsol ba dang /bzhi'i las tshig phyed kyang ma 'khrul ba/tshang la ma nor ba ma 'khrugs pa/blo las thon nus pa zhig dgos pa da lta nyid du 215bsgo' du 'gyur bas sdom pa skye ba'i rgyu tshogs thams cad tshang ba yin no/zhan tu bsdu na/khyod bsnyen rdzogasabyed pa la mngon gyur bcu'i sgo nas bsgrub dgos shing /mngon gyur gzhan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis tshang /bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bskyed pa la bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa mngon du gyur pa bsam pa'i rten/rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod/dus kyi kun slong thob shes/'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral/mthun rkyen phun tsho gos sum ldan/de thams cad nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin dgos so//zhes sngar dge tshul gyi skabs bzhin brda sprad/da hril gyis dril na mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa la sems dang ba'i sgo nas/sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/de'i don du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa blangs la ma shi'i bar du bsrung snyam pa gyis/rjes zlos bgyi mi 'tshal/dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun/thugs dgongs gsum po gsal btab nas gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu zhing /lhag chad byung na gso bar zhu/dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal nas/ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bsadage 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol te/skyes pa yang lags/skyes pa'i dbang po dang yang ldan/lo nyi shu yang lon/'di'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed kyang tshang /bar chad kyi 216nachos rnams kyang yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi ste/tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang /dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/mkhan po ming 'a/ zhes bgyi bas bsnyen pas rdzogs par mdzad do//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6po'adi ni gsol ba'o/ /gsol ba thal/ brjod pa'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal nas/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol te/ skyes pa yang lags/ skyes pa'i dbang po dang yang ldan/ lo nyi shu yang lon/ 'di'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed kyang tshang / bar chad kyi chos rnams kyang yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi ste/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ mkhan po ming 'di zhes bya bas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni (216ba)gsungs shig /brjod pa dang po thal/ gnyis pa la thugs gtad par sdo kyi byas la gnyis pa bya/ ga sdo/ma pa'i skabs rna las chag tha/pa yin te/ mdor/ brjod pa tha ma gang yin pa'i cha gsum pa la grub pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas mchi ste yan chad ngo bo brjod pa/ de nas gsol na'i bar bya ba brjod pa/ de'i slad du man chad byed pa brjod pa yin pas/ ngo bo brjod pa dang bya ba brjod pa gnyis rdzogs pa gsol na zhes pa 'gag pa dang snyam du khyod la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye/ nged khyod kyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ gsol na zhes pa'i skabs su/ nged kyi skad gzengs mtho ba dang / se gol gyi brda sbyar bas/ de'i dus nga'i rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba'i dus 'di yin snyam pa'i thob blo skyes pa shin tu gal che zhing /de'i slad du zhes pa'i tshig byung ba dang sdom pa skyes tshar/ dge slong du gyur snyam du ma yengs par soms shig /dge 'dun rnams brjod pa gsum pa la thugs gtad par zhu byas la gsum pa bya/ las kyi mjug sdud la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mkhan po ming 'di zhes bya bas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar —296

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gal te cho ga nor ba'am dge slong song ba la sogs pas las zhabrugs nas bskyar dgos na/ gsol ba skyor na/ btsun pa dag yang gsol ba bgyi'o/ /byasal bskyar/ brjod pa skyor na btsun pa dag yang rjes su bsgrag go byas la bskyar/ gnyis ka skyor na btsun (217na)pa dag yang gsol ba bgyi zhing rjes su yang bsgrag go byas la bskyar ro/ /de ltar gsol bzhi'i las kyis khyod kyi rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'chal tshul gyi rgyun sdom zhing 'gog par byed pa'i chu lon lta bu thob/ dge slong du gyur bas dga' ba sgoms shig /des dngos gzhi grub/gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po che ge mos mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nasabaskos pa'i de slong des grib tshod 'jal lugs dang / cho ga gzhan thams cad dge tshul dang 'dra ba la/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas yin min gyi skabs su bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ni rang las grib ma sor gcig gi dus kyis rgan pa'i dge slong rnams bsnyen bkur gyi gnas yin/ gnas ma yin pa ni rang las gzhone pa'i dge slong rnams dang / sa gzhan na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams dang / rten dman pa dge slong ma rnams dang / dge slob ma dang / dge tshul pha ma/ dge bsnyen pha ma la sogs pa bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ma yin/ bsnyen bkur rang gi ngo bo bsnyen bkur gyi gnas rnams la bsnyen bkur byed lugs dang / gnas ma yin pa rnams kyi bsnyen bkur dang du len lugs dge tshul ltar slob/dge slong rang dang / bslab pa mnyam pa byung na/ gcig gis gcig la phyag bya mi dgos/ gral mgyogasagral byas pas chog pa yin te/ mdo rtsa bar/ dus mnyam pa rnams ni zhes lung 'dren/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud las/ gnyis sam gsum po dag kyang rung / /dus gcig la ni bsnyen rdzogs na/ /na tshod bye brag yod gyur kyang / /(217bskon bo med cing gsar bu med/ /phan tshun phyag kyang yod min te/ /rnyed pa gral rim bzhin du'o/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa phan yon ni zhes pa nas/ mjug chog gnyis ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bas gsung bar 'gyur bas/ der snyan ga rta de mdzod ces brjod do/ /de nas lasabyed pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas gsungs pa de rnams kyang shes par byas nas phyag len la —297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)gdab 'tshal/ mjug chog gnyis pa thob pa'i sdom pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir gdams ngag bcu gcig brjod pa la dge slong gi bslab bya mdor bsdus te brjod pa dang / de la bslab tshul gyi gdams ngag brjod pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ bslab bya'i gtso bo rnams dngos su brjod pa dang /dngos su ma brjod pa blangs pa rnams shes pa'i thabs brjod pa dang gnyis kyi dang po la/ brten bya 'tsho ba dang / bsrung bya tshul khrims dang / nyams len spyod pa dang / rtogs pa lta ba rnam dag la gdams pa dang bzhi'i dang po la spyir gdams/ bye brag tu phye ste gdams pa dang gnyis kyi dang po ni/bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa des gang la brten nas 'tsho ba'i gnas rnams ma shes na lhung bar 'gyur bas/ mdor/ bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa la mi brjod par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/gnas brjod dgos la/ de'ang dge slong gi dngos po thob nas nyams pa bzhi spang dgos pas/ 'tsho ba nyams pa spang ba'i phyir tshangs par spyod pa rnams kyis brten par bya ba yin pa'i phyir gnas te rang g.yin du gnas pas gos dang zas dang / gnas mal (218na〉〉 gsum/ nad pas de'i steng du sman dang bzhi bsten pas/ sems las su rung bar 'gyur la/ de'ang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba zhig dgos so zhes spyir 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /bzhi po 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par
