rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des de ltar rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi gnas su gsungs te/ de la gnas na dge slong legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la bzhi'i dang po gos mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la bslab pa ni/ spyir 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong dag rab tu byung bas ni mtha' 'di gnyis la brten par mi bya/ bsnyen par mi bya/ bsnyen bkur mi bya ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/'dod pa rnams la 'dod pa'i bsod nyams kyis rjes su brtson pa dman pa ngan pa/ tha chad/ ma rabs gang yin pa dang / bdag nyid dub pa la rjes su brtson pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ 'phags pa ma yin 298

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanapa/ gnod pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa'o/ /khyed sa mtha' 'di gnyis la mi brten par dbu ma'i lam mig byed pa ye shes byed pa/ nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ba/ mngon par shes pa dang / rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba yod de/ zhes gsungs pas/ ngan pa dang nyung ngu chung ngusachog mi shes par bzang po dang / mang (218ba)po la sred pas bkag pa las 'das te/ bzang po la spyod pa 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang / rtsol med du rnyed cing gnang yang bag 'khums nas spyod mi nus pa rang gi lus sems gdung bar byed pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis spangs nas dbu ma'i lam brten dgos pas/ dang po gos bzang po la sred pas tshegs dang 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrub cing zhen pas longs spyod pa 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' spong ba 'dir gda'/ bzhi gang zhe na/gos kyi nang na phyag dar khrod ni rung ba rnyed kyang sla ba ste/ de la gnas na dge slong legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur ro/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod ji srid 'tsho'i bar du phyag dar khrod gos kyis 'tsho bar spro'am/des spro zhes brjod par bya'o/ /mdo rtsar/ mya ga las 'das pa'i bsam pas rab tu byung ba tshul khrims dang ldan pa la ni gos stong phrag brgya pa dang / zas ro mchog brgya pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya pa yang 'os so zhes rang nges khrung gi tshul khrims rnam dag dang ldan/ dge ba'i phyogs la brtson pa lhur byed pa yin na/ sgrub pa'i tshe na tshegs dang 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrub mi dgos longs spyod pa'i tshe na chags zhen dang mngon zhen drag po mi skye na gos kā rṣa pa ṇa 'bum ri ba yang longs spyad pas chog go zhes 'doms pa/ gnyis pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spong ba 'dir gda' lhag par rnyed na dar ram/ ras yug chen nam/ be'u ras sam/ dar la'am/ mon dar (219na'am/ be'u ras yug chen nam/ be'u ras dmar po 'am/ be'u phrug gam/ la dmar ram/ yul kā shi ga'i ras phran nam/kha dog ran pa'am/ kha dog ngan pa'am/ bal gos sam/ sha na'i ras sam zar ma'i ras sam rasagos sam/ du ku la'i ras sam/ ko tam pa'i ras sam/ nyi 'og gi gos sam/ gzhan yang gos rung —299—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)ba gang / dge 'dun nam/ gang zag las rnyed na de yang khyod kyis long la tshod zin par gyis shig /ji ltar khyod gnas 'di lta bu la dam 'cha'am/ 'cha' lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa zas mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la gnyis yod pa'i dang po/ 'dod chen gyis mi rung ba'i zas bzang po tshegs kyis bsgrub cing spyod pa spangs nas/ sbyin bdag la blangs pa'i bsod snyoms kyis 'tsho dgos so zhes 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' spong ba 'dir gda'/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /zas kyi nang na bsod snyoms ni rung ba rnyed kyang sla ba ste de la gnas na dge slong legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur ro/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsod snyoms kyi zas kyis 'tsho bar spro'am/ des spro lags zhes brjod do/ /gnyis par chos ldan gyis rtsol med du rnyed pa la chags zhen med pa'i sgo nas zas bzang po la yang longs spyad par bya'o/ /zhes ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spong ba 'dir gda'/ lhag par rnyed na 'bras chan nam/ skyo ma'am/ thug (219ba)pa 'am/ lnga ston nam/brgyad ston nam/ bcu bzhi ston nam/ nya ston nam/ rtag ras 'khor ram/ mgron du bos pa'am/'phral la bos pa'am/ spags pa'am/ gakṣ-i na yang zas 〈cong ba gang / dge 'dun nam/ gang zag las rnyed na de yang khyod kyis long la tshod zin par gyis shig /ji ltar khyod gnas 'di lta bu la dam 'cha'am/ des 'cha' lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gsum pa gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la gdams pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'dod chen gyis mi rung ba'i khyim dang / gnas mal bzang po tshegs kyas bsgrub cing longs spyod pa spangs te/ shing drung gi gnas mal gyis kyang 'tsho bar bya dgos zhes ston pa 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' spong ba 'dir gda'/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /gnas mal gyi nang na shing drung ni rung ba rnyed kyang sla ba ste/ /de la gnas na dge slong legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / /bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur ro/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod ji —300

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / 9)srid 'tsho'i bar du shing drung gi gnas mal gyis 'tsho bar spro'am/ des spro lags zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa rang chos gnyis ldan gyis rtsol med du rnyed na/ khang mig lnga brgya pa yang zhen med du longs spyad pas chog go zhes ston pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spong ba 'dir gda'/ lhag par rnyed na khang pa 'am/ snga khang ngam/ khang pa brtsegs pa'am/ ba ji dze/khang ngam/ sang mos bskor ba'am/ ba gam mam/ khang bzang ngam/ sgo khang gi steng gi bsil(220na skyong ngam/ khang steng gi yol khang ngam/ yolakhang ngam/ spang leb khang ngam/ sa phug gam/ brag phug gam/ ri phug gam/ rtswa'i spyil bu 'am/ lo ma'i spyil bu 'am/ 'chag sar byas pa'am/ 'chag sar ma byas pa 'am/ bya bas su byas pa'am/ bya skyibs su ma byas pa'am/ gzhan yang gnas mal rung ba gang dge 'dun nam gang zag las rnyed na de yang khyod kyis long la tshod zin par gyis shig /ji ltar khyod gnas 'di lta bu la dam 'cha'am/ des 'cha' lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sman mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la gdams pa la gnyis yod pa'i dang po 'dod chen gyi sman mi rung ba dang / bzang po tshegs kyis bsgrub cing longs spyod pa spangs nas gzhan gyis sman bkol te khu ba bkus shing bton nas rtsigs ma bor ba'i sman gyis kyang 'tsho dgos so zhes ston pa 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' spong ba 'dir gda'/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /sman gyi nang na bkus ste bor ba ni rung ba rnyed kyang sla ba ste/ de la gnas na dge slong legs par gsung pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur ro/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bkus te bor ba'i sman gyis 'tsho bar spro 'am/ des spro lags zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa rang chos gnyis ldan gyis rtsol med du rnyed na sman bzang po'ang zhen med du longs spyad pas chog go zhes ston pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spong ba 'a dir gda'/ lhag par rnyed na zhun mar ram/ (220ba〉khru mar ram/ sbrang rtsi'am/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'am/ dus su rung ba'am/ thun —30/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)tshod du rung ba'am/ zhag bdun pa'am/ 'tsho ba'i bar du bcag pa'am/ rtsa ba'i sman nam/ sdong bu'i sman nam/ lo ma'i sman nam/ me tog gi sman nam/ 'bras bu'i sman nam/ g.yin yang sman rung ba gang dge 'dun nam gang zag las rnyed na de yang khyod kyis long la tshod zin par gyis shig /de ltar khyod gnas de lta bu la dam 'cha'am/ des 'cha' lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bzhi la brten na 'tsho ba ma nyams pa yin te/ lung du de'i 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa yin na de lta bu ni 'tsho ba nyams pa ma yin pa'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de'i steng du tshul khrims ma nyams pa zhig dgos/ lung du tshul khrims nyams pa ji lta bu zhe na/ phas pham pa bzhi las gang yang rung ba'i lhung ba byung bar gyur la/ che khu zhugasungs pas/phas pham bzhi spang dgos pas/ de la spyi dang bye brag la gdams pa gnyis kyi dang po/ dge slong gi dngos po 'jig par byed pa rtsa ba'i lhung bar 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi char gtogs pa dang bcas pa spang dgos so/ /zhes spyir 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /bzhi po 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des de ltar rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi lhung bar 'gyur ba'i chos su gsungs te/ dge slong gis de byas na byas ma thag tu dge slong du mi rung bar (221na)'gyur/ dge sbyong du mi rung / shwakya'i sras kyir mi rung / dge sbyong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur te de'i dge slong gi tshul zhig par 'gyur zhing / /nyams pa bcom pa lhung ba pham par gyur pa ste/ dge sbyong gi tshul phyir blang du med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ dper na shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad na sngon por 'gyur du mi rung la/ 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag la gdams pa la bzhi las/rtsa ltung bzhi po kun slong dug gsum gang rung gis sbyor bar khyad par med mthar phyin cing rdzogs par byed pa ni mi tshangs spyod dang ma byin len 'dod chags kyis/ srog gcod zhe sdang gis/ rdzun dug —302

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)gsum gang rung gi rdzogs par byed de/ mdzod du/ gsod dang gnod sems tshig rtsub po/ /zhe sdang gis ni mthar phyin byed/ /log g.yem brnab sems ma byin len/ /chags pa yis ni rdzogs par byed/ /log par lta ba gti mug gis/ /lhag ma gsum gyis rdzogs par 'dod/ ces bshad pas/dang po nang sems can la chags pas mthar phyin par byed pa mi tshangs spyod spang bar gdams pa ni/mi tshangs spyod byas na sdom pa lhag ma med par spyod cing / dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par byed pas spang dgos de'i char gtogs chags sems kyis bud med la blta ba tshun chad spang dgos so zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'dod pa dang 'dod pa la chen pa dang / 'dod pa la 'chums pa dang / 'dod pa la lhag par zhen pa ni/(221ba tha com ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas smad do/ /'dod pa spangs pa ni bsngags te bor ba dang / bsal ba dang / zad pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gog pa dang / nye bar zhi ba dang / nub pa ni bstod do/ /bkur ro/ /bsngags so/ /snyan par brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod deng phyin chad chags pa'i sems kyis bud med kyi yul la mig gtad de/mig gis blta bar yang mi bya na/ gnyis kyis gnyis sprad de/ mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa'i chosabasten pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ yang dge slong gang dge slong rnams(dang lhan cig bslab pa 'angs par gyur pas/ bslab pa ma phul/ bslab pa nyams par ma byas par mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa'i chos bsten na tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa dang /lhan cig kyang rung ste dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyis/ gnas par mi bya'o zhes bya ba 'di bka' stsal to/ /dge slong gis gnas de lta bu byas na/ byas ma thag tu dge slong du mi rung bar 'gyur/dge sbyong du mi rung / shākya'i sras kyir mi rung / dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur te de'i dge sbyong gi tshul zhig par 'gyur zhing nyams pa bcom la lhung ba pham par gyur pa ste de'i dge sbyong gi —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)tshul phyir blang du med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ dper na shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad na sngon por 'gyur du mi rung la 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur (222na)du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /deng phyin chad khyod spyad pa ma yin pa dang / /bya ba ma yin pa dang / spyad pa ma yin pa spang pa de la dran pa dang bag yod pas sems shin tu bsrung bar brtson par gyis shig /ji ltar gnas 'di lta bu la mi spyod dam/ des mi spyod lags zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa phyi rol yo byad la chags pas mthar phyin par byed pa ma byin len spong bar gdams pa ni/ ma sha ka lngas mtshon pa kā rṣa pa ṇa bzhi cha brkus na pham par 'gyur te/ de'i char gtogos til gyi phub ma tsam yang mi rku ste/ mdor na rku ba'i sbyor dngos mjug gsum thams cad spang dgos so zhes pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyen cig /ma byin par len pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas smad do/ /ma byin par len pa spangs pa ni bstod do/ /bkur ro/ /bsngags so/ /snyan par brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod deng phyin chad rku sems kyis gzhan kyi til gyi phub ma yang ma byin par mi blang na ma sha lnga'am/ ma sha ka lnga las lhag pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ tshe dang ldan pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des yang dge slong gang gzhan dag gi grong na 'dug pa'am/ dgon pa na 'dug pa ma byin pa rku ba'i grangs su gtogs pa blangs na ji tsam ma byin par blangs pas de rgyal po'i blon po chen pos bzung nas de la 'di skad ces/ kye mi khyod ni rkun ma'o/ /byis pa'o/ /blun pa'o/ /rku ba'o zhes zer zhing / bsod dam/ 'ching (222ba yom sgyugs kyang rung ste/ dge slong de ltar ma byin par len na dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyis/ gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes bya ba 'di bka' stsal te/dge slong gi gnas de lta bu byas na/ byas ma thag tu dge slong du mi rung bar 'gyur/ dge sbyong du mi rung/ shākya'i sras kyir mi rung / dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur te/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul zhig par 'gyur zhing nyams pa bcom pa lhung ba pham par gyur pa ste/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul phyir —304

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)blang du med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ dper na shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad na sngon por 'gyur du mi rung la 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /deng phyin chad khyod spyad pa ma yin pa dang / bya ba ma yin pa dang / spyad pa ma yin pa spang ba de la dran pa dang bag yod pas sems shin tu bsrung bar gyis shig ji ltar gnas 'di lta bu la mi spyad dam/ des mi spyod lags zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa dug gsum gang rung gis sbyar nas zhe sdang gis mthar phyin par byed pa srog gcod spong bar gdams pa la/ dbang po drug 'dus kyi mi'am/ dbang po gsum 'dus kyi mir chags pa bsad na pham par 'gyur bas spang dgos shing / de'i char gtogs grog sbur gsod pa srog gcod kyi sbyor dngos mjug gsum thams cad spongs shig ces 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /srog gcod pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas smad do/ /srog gcod pa spangs pa ni bstod do/ /bkur ro/ /bsngags so/ /snyan par brjod do/ /deng phyin (223na〉da tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis bsams bzhin du srog chags grog sbur yang bsad par mi bya na/ mi'am mir chags pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ yang dge slong gang mi'am mir chags pa la bsam bzhin du rang gi lag dar te srog gcad dam/ de la mtshon byin nam/ de la mtshon thogs pa gnyer ram de 'chir bcugs gam/ de la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod kyang rung ste/ de la 'di skad ces/ kye mi khyod 'tsho ba sdig pa mi gtsang ba ngan pa 'dis ci zhig bya/ kye mi khyod gson pa bas shi sla'o zhes zer zhing sems kyi 'dod pa dang / sems kyi kun tu rtog pa dag gis rnam grangs du mas de 'chir bcug gam/ de la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod de/ de yang rtsom pa des dus byas na dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyis/ gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes bya ba 'di bka' stsal te/ dge slong gisaganas de lta bu byas na/ byas ma thag tu dge slong du mi rung bar 'gyur/ dge sbyong du mi rung / shākya'i —305

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6posras kyir mi rung / dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur te/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul zhig par 'gyur zhing / nyams pa bcom pa lhung pa pham par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul phyir blang du med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ dper na shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad na sngon por 'gyur du mi rung la 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /deng phyin chad khyod spyad pa ma yin pa dang / bya ba ma yin pa (223ba tshe dang / spyad pa ma yin pa spang ba de la dran pa dang bag yod pas semasashin tu bsrung bar brtson par gyis shig /ji ltar gnas 'di lta bu la mi spyod dam/ des mi spyod lags zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa dug gsum gang rung gis sbyor zhing gang rung gis mthar phyin par byed pa/ rdzun smra ba spang bar gdams pa la mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smras na pham par 'gyur bas spang dgos la/ der ma zad ku re bzhad gad kyi phyir shes bzhin gyi rdzun phra mo yang byar mi rung ste rdzun gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad spang dgos so zhes pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /rdzun du smra ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas smad do/ /rdzun du smra ba spangs pa ni bstod do/ /bkur ro/ /bsngagasaso/ /snyan par brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod deng phyin chad tha na bzhad gad bya bar bsams te shes bzhin du/ rdzun du smra bar yang mi bya na/ bsams bzhin du mi'i chos bla ma smra ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ yang dge slong gang mngon par mi shes shing / yongs su mi shes la /mi'i cho ge bla ma mtha' dang / 'phags pa dang / bye brag thob pa dang / shes pa dang / mthong ba dang /reg par spyod pa med la/ med bzhin du/ 'di shes so/ /'di mthong ngo zhes khas 'tshes pa las/ de lhung ba byung ba rnam par dag par 'dod nas/ dus g.yin zhig na dris kyang rung / ma dris kyang rung / 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag /bdag gis ni mi shes par shes so/ /zhes smras/ ma mthong (224na)bar mthong ngo zhes smras te/ gsog gsob rdzun du smras so zhes zer na mngon pa'i nga rgyal ma gtogs —3(16

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)te/ dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyi/ gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes bya ba 'di bka' stsal te/ci zhig shes she na/ sdug bsngal shes so/ kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam shes so/ /ci zhig mthong zhes na lha rnams mthong ngo / /klu rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnamasadang / dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus phrul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams mthong ngo / /lha rnams kyis bdag mthong ngo / /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnamasadang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams kyis kyang bdag mthong ngo / /lha rnams kyi sgra thos so/ /klu rnams dang /gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams kyi sgra thos so/ /lha rnams kyis kyang bdag gi sgra thos so/ /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha'i lding rnams dang dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang sha za rnams dang /grul bum rnams dang / (224ba)phrul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams kyis kyang bdag gi sgra thos so/ /lha rnams blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /klu rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang sha za rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /lha rnams bdag blta ba'i phyir 'ong ngo / /klu rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang /mi'am ci rnams dang lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang sha za rnams dang grul bum —307—

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams kyang bdag blta ba'i phyir 'ong ngo / /lha rnams dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed / so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed do/ /klu rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha'i lding rnams dang dri za rnams dang mi'am ci rnams dang lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang sha za rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams bdag dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed do/ /lha rnams bdag dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu'ang lhan cig gnas par byed do/ /klu rnams dang gnod sbyin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / (225na)mi'am ci rnams dang lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang sha za rnams dang grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed do/ /ma thob bzhin du bdag gis mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang mi rtag pa la sdug bsngal ba'i 'du shes dang / sdug bsngal ba la bdag med pa'i 'du shes dang / zas la mi mthun pa'i 'du shes dang / 'jig rten thams cad la mngon par mi dga' ba'i 'du shes dang / nyes dmigs kyi 'du shes dang / spong ba'i 'du shes dang / 'dod chags bral ba'i 'du shes dang / 'gog pa'i 'du shes dang / 'chi ba'i 'du shes dang / mi sdug pa'i 'du shes dang rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par bsnags pa' 'du shes dang / rnam par bam pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par 'bus bzhigs pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par zos pa'i 'du shes dang / rnam par dmar ba'i 'du shes dang / rnam par mthong ba'i 'du shes dang / rus gong gi 'du shes dang / stong pa nyid du so so rtogs pa'i 'du shes thob —308

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabo/ ma thob bzhin du bdag gis bsam gtan dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched dang / rgyun du bzhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir (225bas 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu dang / rdzu'aphrul gyi yul dang / lha'i rna ba dang / sems kyi rnam grangs dang / sngon gyi gnas dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / zag pa zad pa thob bo/ /bdag ni dgra bcom pa rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa dang / gnyis ga'i cha las rnam par grol ba yin no/ /zhes bya ba ste/ dge slong gis gnasa'adi lta bu byas na byas ma thag tu dge slong du mi rung bar 'gyur/ dge sbyong du mi rung / shā kya'i srasakyir mi rung / dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur ste/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul zhig par 'gyur zhing / nyams pa bcom pa lhung ba pham par gyur pa ste/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul phyir blangs du med par tsor ro/ /'di lta ste/ dper na shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad na sngon por 'gyur du mi rung la 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur du mi rung ba bzhi no/ /deng phyin chad khyod spyad pa ma yin pa dang / bya ba ma yin pa dang / spyad pa ma yin pa spangs pa de la dran pa dang bag yod pas sems shin tu bsrung bar brtson par gyis shig /ji ltar gnas 'di lta bu mi spyod dam/ des mi spyod lags zhes brjod do/ /de ltar bzhis pham pa bzhi char gtogos dang bcas pa bsrungs pas/ tshul khrims ma nyams par 'gyur te/ lung du phas pham pa bzhi rnams kyi gang yang rung ba'i lhung ba ma byung ba gang yin pa de lta bu ni/ tshul khrims nyams pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /de'i steng du yang spyod pa ma nyams pa zhig dgos la/ lung du/ spyod pa nyams pa ji lta bu zhe na/bslab pa'i rjes su mthun zhing 'tshams pa'i tshig gi lam dag gis smad na yang dag par mi sgrub pa'o —3lha)

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)zhes gsungs pas (226na〉de'i gnyen por/ gsum pa nyams len spyod pa rnam dag la gdams pa la/ lnga yod pa'i dang po la/ dge sbyong la med du mi rung ba'i dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos la gdams pa ni/ dge sbyong ni dul ba dang / zhi ba yin la/ de'i rang bzhin du byed pa bzod pa yin te/ rab tu byung ba g.yin la gnod pa dang / gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes de dang bral na dge sbyong ma yin par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan la phar mi gnod par ma zad/ tshur gnod pa byung kyang lan mi byed par bzod pa bsgom dgos so zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /bzhi po 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ de ltar rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos su gsungs te bzhi gang zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis deng phyin chad bakhi she yang slar mi bshin bar bya ba dang / khye thos kyang slar mi khro bar bya ba dang / brdegs kyang slar mi brdeg par bya ba dang / mtshang brus kyang slar mtshang mi 'bru bar bya ba'o/ /ji ltar gnas 'di lta bu la spyod dam/ des spyod lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa spang blang la nan tan du byed pa'i rgyu mchog tu 'dod pa'i don grub par gdams pa la khyed kyi bsam pa la/ gnas bzhi la brtan pa dang /ltung bar 'gyur ba bzhi spong ba dang / dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi nyams su len pa ni/ shin tu dka' bas bdag gis mi nus shing / bdag bde ba don du gnyer bas 'dod pa'i don ma grub snyam na dka' ba de dag la slob dgos kyang / (226ba tshe ka' na gyis nan gyis khur du bkur ba ma yin gyi/khyed rang snga mo nas mchog tu 'dod cing / don du gnyer ba'i don/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa yang dag pa nyid kyis rang gi ngo bo rdzogs shing rgyas par thob pa yin pas/ da gnyen po bskyed pa bsrung dgos zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /khyod sngon bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob kyang ci ma rung snyam du smon pa gang yin pa de/ da khyod mkhan por 'os pa dang / slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis 3/0

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanadang / dge 'dun mthun pa dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las mi g.yo ba bzhag par mi 'os pas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /gsum pa gnas brtan rnams dang tshul khrims mnyam par gyur pa la nges par sbyar ba ni/ khyed kyi bsam pa la de lta na yang gnas brtan bgres po rnams dang tshul khrims mi mnyam pas 'dod pa ma grub cing / de rnams kyi slob pa bzhin bslab mi nus so snyam na de lta ma yin te/ de rnams dang rang bzhin dang bcas pa spong ba dang / chos kyi longs spyod gsum gyis tshul khrims mnyam por thob pas/de rnams ji ltar slob pa bzhin bslab dgos so zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i dge slong gis bslab pa gang la bslab par bya ba de la/ de ring bsnyen par rdzogos pas kyang bslab po/ de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gis bslab pa gang la bslab par bya ba de la/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya len pas kyang bslab po/ de ltar na tshulakhrims nyid (227na)) sa mnyam pa dang / bslab pa nyid kyis mnyam pa dang / so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa nyid kyis mnyam pas khyod kyis deng phyin chad bsgrub par bya'i/ mi bsgrub par mi bya'o/ /bzhi pa yongs 'dzin la gus pa 'jig rten pa'i tshul dang 'brel ba'i gzugs brnyan la nges par sbyar ba ni/ gnas brtan rgan po rnams dang mnyam pa gsum gyis mnyam pas su la'ang rag ma las pas gus pa dang bsnyen bkur bya mi dgos sam snyam na/ 'jig rten na bu bzang pos pha la gus pas zhabs tog byed cing bsgo ba nyan/ pha bzang pos bu legs par skyong ba bzhin du/ mkhan posakyang khyod chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas phan gdags shing / na na nad g.yog gis kyang rjes su bzung dgos/ khyod kyis kyang mkhan po la gus pa'i sgo nas bsnyen bkur bya zhing / gnas pa'i tshul khrimasamatha' dag la gnas dgos so zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ deng phyin chad khyod kyis mkhan po la pha'i 'du shes nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /mkhan pos kyang khyod la bu'i 'du shes nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /khyod kyi deng phyin chad mkhan po la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /mkhan pos kyang —31/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pokhyod shi'am sos kyi bar du nad g.yog bya'o/ /lnga pa grogs la gus pa dul bar gnas pa la nges par sbyar ba ni/ de lta na yang mkhan po las g.yin pa'i dge slong rnams dang mnyam pa gsum gyis mnyam pas gus par bya mi dgos kyis mnyam 'grogs kyis chog gam snyam na/ de lta ma yin te/ lung phran tshegs las/ kun dga' bo khyod 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten pa dang / dge ba dang lhan cig gnas pa dang / dge ba la brten nas sdig (227ba)pa'i grogs po dang mi brten/ sdig pa dang lhan cig mi gnas/ sdig pa la ma brten na 'di ni tshangs par spyod pa'i phyed yin no/ /zhes de skad ma zer zhig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo/ de ni tshangs par spyod pa kun tu mthar phyin pa/ ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /grogs ni yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yan pa'i phyir gus par byed dgos so zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ deng phyin chad khyod kyis tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams dang / gnas brtan rnams dang / bar ma rnams dang / gsar bu rnams la gus pa dang bcas pa dang / zhe sa dang bcas pa dang / 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i dbang du 'gyur bar gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar lnga po des gdams pa bzhin bsgrubs na spyod pa ma nyams shing rnam par dag par 'gyur te/ lung du bslab pa'i rjes su mthun zhing 'tsham pa'i tshig gis lam dag gis smras na yang dag par bsgrub pa de lta bu ni spyod pa nyams pa ma yin no zhes dang / ma mo las ji ltar na spyod pa ma nyams pa yin zhe na/ mi spyad pa mi spyod cing / dge slong gi bslab pa la yang slob pa yin te/ de lta bu ni spyod pa ma nyams pa zhes bya'o/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa lta ba dag pa'i phyir spong pa dang klog pa gnyis kyi dgos pa rjes su bsgrub pa la nges par sbyar ba ni de ltar mchog du 'dod pa'i don grub pas gnas brtan rnams dang mnyam par gyur pas/ bla ma dang grogs la gus par byas nas sos dal du bsdad pas chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/don grub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas thos bsam sgom gsum la (228na skor bad de lung sde snod gsum la —312

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)mkhas pa dang / mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyi rgyud phyug par byed dgos so zhes pa 'dir gdang/deng phyin chad khyod kyi lung nod par bya/ bklag par bya/ kha tan du bya'o/ /phung po la mkhas pa dang /khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa lamakhas par bya'o/ /ma thob pa thob par bya ba dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba dang / mngon sum du ma byas pa mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir/ khyod kyis brtson pa mi dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar bslab pas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis yang dag pa'i lta ba skyes pas lta ba ma nyams par 'gyur te/ lung du/ lta ba'i rnam pa drug cu rtsa gnyis las gang yang rung ba'i lta ba la mngon par ma zhen pa de lta bu ni lta ba nyams pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /de rnams bslab bya'i gtso bo gal che che rnams brjod pa yin/gnyis pa ma brjod pa yang dag par blangs pa yongs su shes pa'i sgrub par 'gyur ba nyid kyang brjod par bya ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i spang blang de tsam la nan tan du byas pas chog gam snyam na mi chog 'dir bslab bya'i gtso bo tsam zhig brjod pa yin/ dge 'dun lhag ma la sogs dngos su ma brjod pa rnams kyang / thabs 'di dag gi bang shes par byas la bslab dgos so zhes 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ 'di dag ni kho bos khyod la bslab pa'i gzhi che long che long tsam zhig brjod par zad de/gzhan dag ni zla ba phyed phyed cing so so thar pa'i mdo 'don pa/ 'don pa'i tshe thos par 'gyur ro/ /(22sha bskos na dag kyang slob dpon dang / mkhan po dang / mkhan po gcig pa dang / slob dpon gcig pa dang / gtam 'dres pa dang / phebs par smra ba dang / smon 'drin dang / 'grogs shes rnams kyang rgya cher ston par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bslab pa de rnams la slob tshul la khyad du gsod pa'i gnyen por gus pa la sbyar/ bsgrub par bya ba'i thabs brjod ba bag yod la sbyar ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de ltar bslab bya thams cad shes par bya la/ shin tu rnyed dga' ba'i dal 'byor thob/ mjal dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal nas/ bstan pa'i snying bo bsnyen par rdzogs pa thob —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)pas ci nas kyang dal 'byor chud ma zos par bslab gzhi rnams la ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du ma shi bar du mgo dang gos la me 'bar ba ltar yongs su bskyangs shing / gus pas rjes su bsgrub pa lhur long zhig ces 'doms pa 'dir gda'/ shes rab mchog gi bstan pa la/ khyod ni bsnyen par rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dal dang 'byor ba rnyed dka' bas/ /'di dag ji lta bzhin du sgrubs/ /mdzes pa rab tu byung ba dang / /yongs su dag pa bsnyen rdzogs par/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rab mkhyen te/ /bden pa'i mtshan gyis bka' stsal to/ /gnyis pa ni gus pas bslab dgos la/ de'i thabs gang yin snyam na/ bsgrub bya bsnyen rdzogasasgrub byed kyi thabs bag yod la sbyor ba 'dir gda'/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod bsnyen par rdzogs zin gyis bag yod par sgrubs shig /'di tshig nyung yang don rgya che ba ste/ chos mngon par / bag yod pa gang zhe na/ (229nasgo chags pa dang / zhe sdang med pa dang / gti mug med pa dang / brtson 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas nas dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom zhing / zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams la sems bsrung ba ste zhes bshad pas/ spang gnyen la blang dor phyin ci ma log pa byed pa'i gzob pa lhur len pa ni bag yod pa ste/ des sgrubs shig /so so thar par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub dang / gzhan yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa/ dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas thob bo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par bsgrub pa'i cho ga legs par grub pa yin/ de'ang gtso bor mkhan po pa'i bdag rkyen las byung ba yin te/ rang gis mdzad dgos rnams rang gis mdzad/ gzhan la bsgo dgos rnams bskos nas mdzad pas drin che ba yin pas phyag gsun / tshol la bka' drin che zhes brjod/'di'i dngos bstan gyi bsdu tshul rnams gzhung lugs brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyi yig char gsal ba 'tsham par go bas cung zad las dbri bsnan ma dgos shing long yod rgyas par spro na 314

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanathams cad mkhyen pa bus mdzad pa'i las chog chen mo'i kun tshang rgyas pa nyid las lhag par ma mchis/ bsgrub bya mang zhing yul dus kyi rtsol bas bsgrub dgos tshe cho ga dang phyag len rnams dkyus bzhin las bcos bslad byar med cing bshad pa la nges pa med pas nges par dgos pa'i brda sprod rgyu rnams ngo 'phrod (229ba)phyin don gyi snying por hril gyis dril chog pa blo ldan rnams kyi mthong rgyud dang blo gros kyi dpyad pas chog la rnam dpyod kyi spyan ring por mi rkyong zhing smra ba'i ljags rkan phugs su sgril ba rnams la snag shog gi gron du zad pas dpe brjod mang du ma bris so/ /zhan byung khyil pa la phan gdags pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga bshad pa/bzhi pa zhar byung khyim pa la phan gdags pa'i cho ga la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ba dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ nyin zhag gcig gi bar bsrung ba yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa dang gnyis/ dang po la nang gses kyi mang du yod pa'i gtso bo kha che ba dang thun mong ba'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen ni/tshigs snga ma'i skabs su khyed rnams rab tu byung bar byed pa la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang dgos zhes pa'i tshig phrad dor nas/ khyed rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir snying po zhig len dgos/ de la tshul mang du yod kyang bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ zhes rgyu ba bcud kyi sems can dang / mi rgyu ba snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi gzhi rten sa chen po yin pa ltar tshul khrims 'di yang yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yin pas de la rab tu byung ba dang / khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa gnyis las khyim pa la gsum du yod pa'i bye brag yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang dgos zhes pa nas bzung ste phyogs mthun yin pas yid kyis —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63/bsdams (230na 〉 nas legs par srungs shig gi bar dkyus ltar las/ bslab pa brjod pa'i snga rol du dus go brjod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa zhig bya/ dge bsnyen la gsum du gcod dgos pas bsgrub bya mang po yod na de tsam 'tsham zhing / rgyas par spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen gnas kyi skabs kyi sgos chos rnams dor ba'i bshad pa rnams btang bas chog go /cho ga'i skabs klu sgrub rjes mdzad pa'i snying po rab gsal las/ kha che dang thun mong ba'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshe bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes brjod pas chog la/ nyi 'og pa yan chad ltar na bdag spang bya lnga spong ba'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes brjod dgos pa ni/ grub mtha'i gnad dam par shes dgos te/ kha che ba dge bsnyen yin tshad rtsa bzhi spong bas khyab pa khas len/ nyi 'og pa dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang ldan mi ldan gnyis su phye/ ldan pa tsam la'ang rtsa ba gcig tsam spong ba/ gnyis tsam spong ba/ bzhi char spong ba'i sdom pa khas len pa'i gnad kyis so zhes byung /tshangs spyod dge bsnyen la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa mi tshangs spyod du bsgyur ro/ /phal cher spyod pa ni/ rtsa ba bzhi tsam bsrung ba'i phal cher spyod pa'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ bslab pa brjod (230ba)dus/ log g.yem bsgyur mi dgos/ 'di dper brjod tsam ste rtsa bzhi gang rung zhig dor nas chang bsrungs pas kyang chog /sna 'ga' bsrung ba ni/ gang bsrung rgyu 'dod pa gtso yang dper na srog gcod dang ma sbyin len gnyis spong ba'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes brjod cing / bslab pa brjod pa'i skabs yan lag phyi ma'i skabs su ma sbyin par len pa zhes kha bsgyur/ sna gcig bsrung ba ni gang bsrung rgyu de gar 'gyur ro/ /de yang brgyad stong 'grel chen du/ dge bsnyen ni skyabs gsum yongs su 'dzin pa dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga yongs 'dzin pa'o/ /dge bsnyen ma yang de bzhin yin pa'i phyir rnam pa gnyis te/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol —3/6

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)zhes bya ba dang / dkon cog gsum la skyabs su song nas bslab pa'i gzhi lnga yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol zhes 'dul ba las gnyis su smos pa'i phyir zhes bshad de/ dzi pa gzhan gyi 'dul ba la yod par snang gi /gzhi thams cad yod smra'i 'dul ba la de lta bu mi snang zhing / sna gcig spyod pa sogs kyi dge snyen gyi cho ga gsungs pa'ang mi snang rung / nyi 'og pa'i lugs ltar/ bla ma gong ma rnams rigs pa bsgres nas/ sngar yongs rdzogs kyi cho ga de nyid 'don pa kha spos su mdzad pa bzhin du brjod par snang ba 'dul 'dzin phal cher la grags shing mdzad kyang nyi 'og pa dang mdo (231na ji pa'i 'dod tshul gyi gnad ma shes pa'i skyon yod par dogs pas dpyad dgos/ 'on kyang phyag len 'di grags che zhing thog mar spang bya lnga spong bar khas blangs nas rjes su yongs rdzogs bsrung ma nus na sna gcig sna 'ga' sogs blo dang 'tsham pa zhig bsrung ba'i don du 'chad pa'ang yod/ go mi zhes pa btsun pa'i skad dod yin pa la 'byul nas rab byung gi gzugs brnyan gyi yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen la 'chad pa yod na'ang / khyim pa ji srid 'tsho bar du yan lag brgyad spong bar khas blangs pa la ngos 'dzin pa khungs dag pa 'dra ste slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mi bzhin no/ / skyabs 'gro la/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su 'gro zhing /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs gsum 'dzin par btsun pas bzung du gsol zhes dge bsnyen du mi gtogs pa'i skyabs sdom mtshan nyid pa bzhed kyang theg pa 'og ma la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa sbyin pa la nyi 'og pa rnams skyabs 'gro nyid kyis dge bsnyen du 'gyur zer ba la/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba rnams dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ma blangs pa'i dge bsnyen du mi 'gyur te/ dge slong gi sdom pa ma blangs par dge slong du mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /zhes zer ba la/ mdo sdo pa rnams de gnyis mi mtshudas te/ dge bsnyen ni dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa med kyang dge bsnyen du 'gyur te/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen yin no zhes mdo sde pa skyabs gsum 'dzin pa dge bsnyen du 'dod/ bye brag smra ba skyabs —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (/7)gsum 'dzin pa dge bsnyen du mi 'dod do/ /de la mdo sde pa ltar dge bsnyen sbyar (231bsko skyabs 'gro tsam gyi dge bsnyen du zhes pa dang mthun par spang bya lnga po'i dmigs bsal med pa'i skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du 'gro bas len lugs kyang theg chen pa dang ma 'dres par 'og nas 'byung ba ltar len dgos shing / 'di la skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya las g.yin ma byung bas g.yin rnams las sla ba 'dra zhig snang yang / chos la skyabs su song bas sems can la gnod 'tshe spong ba srog gcod/ tshig rtsub sogs kyis kyang pha rol gyi lus sems la gnod/ rku 'phrog sogs kyis longs spyod la gnod/ g.yin gyi mchis brang la spyad pas bdag po dang gzhan gyi sdom pa sogs la gnod/phan tshun mthun par mi mthun pa'i phra ma byas pas rgyun rnal du phebs pa la gnod/ de dag kun gyi rtsa ba myos 'gyur gyis byed pas rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga po skyabs 'gro'i khongs su 'gro bar ma zad rab byung gi btung ba gzhan dag nas kyang rags rim cam tshang bas de ltar na skyabs 'gro ni rgya shin tu che bas sna gcig spyod pa'i dge bsnyen de don du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang khyad par med pa 'dra zhig byung bar dogs mod 'on kyang chos mngon par bag yod pa gang zhe na/ ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang med pa/gti mug med pa dang / brtson 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas nas dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom zhing /zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams la sems bsrung ba ste zhes pa'i don ltar na so skye'i rgyud kyi so thar rigs brgyad kyi spang bya las rgya che ba zhig byung yang gong 'og gnyis gar mkhas pa rnams kyi dogs sel rnam dpyod kyi mgrin pa (232na tshe sna degs dgos so/ /len pa'i cho ga la yang bye brag smra bas skyabs 'gro'i rjes su / bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge bsnyen du btsun pas bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod pas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa yin/bslab pa brjod pa khas blangs pa'i tshul gyis bya ba ni/ bslab bya shes pa'i phyir brjod pa yin te/gsol bzhi'i las kyis dge slong du gyur nas/ mjug tu gdams ngag brjod pa dang 'dra zhes 'chad/skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa len pa ni shin tu phan yon che ste/ mdo sde rgyal mtshan dam pa las/ 'jigs —3/8

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanapas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ /phal chen ri dang nags tshal dang / /ljon shing dag la skyabs 'gro ste/ /skyabs de gtso bo ma yin te/ /skyabs de dag la brten nas ni/ /'jigs pa kun las thar mi 'gyur//gang zhig sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun dag la skyabs 'gro ba/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang / /sdug bsngal yang dag 'gags pa dang / /bde gzhi mya ngan 'das byas nas/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'jig rten gyi lha dang ri ra ba khang khyim ljon shing sogs kyis gnasaskabs kyi skyabs yong yang gtan gyi skyabs gnas su mi 'os pas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol ba'i skyabs ni dkon cog gsum ste/ de la yang ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba bye brag tu smra bas/sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun du byed pa'i chos lam bden yin gyi gzugs sku min zer yang / mdo sde pa'i lugs kyis/ sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos/ sangs rgyas mi (232ba〉slob pa'i lam bden chosasku dang gzugs sku gnyis kyi bdag nyid dang / dge 'dun du byed pa'i chos slob mi slob kyi lam bden gzugs sku dang bcas pa dang chos mya ngan las 'das pa so sor brtags 'gog rnams yin zhing / skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan sangs rgyas rang nyid sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas shin tu dul ba'i bdag nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad du gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / gdul bya 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i thugs rje che ba dang / zang zing gi mchod pa thams cad kyis mnyes par bya ba ma yin gyi/ sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya ba yin pa ste rgyu bzhis sangs rgyas skyabs su 'os la/ de lta bus bstan pa'i chos gang yin pa dang / de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gang yin pa de yang de lta bu kho nas skyabs su 'os pa yin/ de lta bu'i yon tan shes nas ji ltar 'gro na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la brten nas dang ba'i dad pa dang / de'i rgyur las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa sngon du bto nas phyi rol pa'i ston pa dang / des bstan pa'i chos dang de sgrub pa'i gang zag la gtan gyi skyabs su 'os pa'i yon tan med pas khyad par shes dgos pas de dag gi bye brag la yang sangs rgyas ni rang mngon par byang chub pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos dkon cog ni mngon —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid/ dge 'dun dkon cog ni gzhan gyi man ngag gis yang dag par bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sangs rgyas ni lung legs par 'bogs pa'i (233na)'phrin las/ chos ni nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal spong ba'i dmigs pa'i 'phrin las/ dge 'dun ni spro ba mngon par 'phel bar byed pa'i 'phrin las can/ sangs rgyas ni bsnyen bkur la gus pa/ chos ni mngon du bya ba la gus pa/ dge 'dun ni chos mthun pa po'i dngos pos lhan cig 'grogs la gus pas zhen par bya/ sangs rgyas la ni mchod pa dang / rim gro nye bar sgrub pa'i sgrub pa/ chos la ni rnal 'byor gyi sbyor ba goms par bya ba'i sgrub pa/ dge 'dun la chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod thun mong gi sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas la 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni sogs/ chos la thog mar dge ba sogs/ dge 'dun la legs par zhugs pa sogs so sor dran pa'o/ /sangs rgyas la ni sems can gcig gi dbang du byas pa'i bsod nams mchog 'phel bar 'gyur te/ rkang 'ganyas thams cad kyi nang nas mchog gcig pu yin chos la ni chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i bsod nams mchog 'phel ba/ dge 'dun la ni sems can mang po'i dbang du byas pa'i bsod nams mchog 'phel bar 'gyur ba des bsam pa phun sum tshogs par byas nas khas len tshul ni/rgyal po dang sha za chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las skyabs 'tshol ba ni 'jigs skyobs kyi tshul khrims/ phyi ma bde 'gro thob pa'i phyir du skyabs 'tshol ba legs smon gyi skyabs 'gro yin pas de snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i nges pa med/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba don du gnyer ba'i skyabs 'gro skyes bu 'bring gi skyabs 'gro/ sems can (233ba)thams cad kyi ched du sangs rgyas don du gnyer nas skyabs su 'gro ba skyes bu chen po'i skyabs 'gro yin pas phyi ma gnyis gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i sems can de rnams sdug bsngal de las skyob pa'i phyir sangs rgyas la de'i thabs ston pa'i ston pa zhu/chos mi gnas pa'i myang 'das de mngon du byas la skyabs dngos zhu/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun —32(/—

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)la de sgrub pa'i grogs zhu/ de phyin chad phyi rol pa'i lha khyab 'jug /dbang phyug sogs ston par 'dzin pa dang / de'i chos sgrub pa dang / de sgrub pa'i gang zag rnams grogs su 'dzin pa spangs la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa gyis la/ 'di'i rjes zlos bgyi/ cho ga dngos gzhi gong dang 'dra ba la/ bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs gsum 'dzin par bzung du gsol zhes 'don pa bsgyur/bslab bya la gnyis su yod pa'i so so'i bslab bya ni/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba'i/ /dge bsnyen nyid du dam bcas pas/ skyabs ni gsum po bsrung bar bya//mu stegs kun la gus pa yis/ /mchod dang phyag 'tshal mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / mdo rtsar/ lha gzhan la phyag mi bya'o/ /mchod pa mi bya'o/ /bkur sti mi bya'o/ /gnas su phyin na mngon sum du 'greng ste segol gyi sgras go bar byas nas gtsug lag gi tshigs su bcad pa gdon pas de la phan gdags par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi rol pa'i lha dang 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mchod mi bya zhing / lha rten gyi rtsar phyin na se gol gyi sgra sngon du 'gro bas/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu (234na7sa byung / zhesapa lta bu zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad 'don zhing phan gdags/ sku gzugs dang mchod rten dngos bstan lta ci/ byis pas rtsed mo'i phyir gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa byas pa la yang sangs rgyas rjes su dran nas gus par bya zhing / 'gom yugs sogs mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur spang / dge ba gang byasasangs rgyas dang mi 'bral bar bsngo/ chos kyi bslab bya la sems can la gnod 'tshe spongs/ theg pa che chung sogs ris su bcad de chos la brten pa'i sgrib pa mi gsog /sangs rgyas kyi gsung khyad du sod pa dang / glegs bam mer bsreg pa sogs chos la mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur spangs/ chos nyan bshad byed pa'i gang zag la gus pa dang phan gdags pa las mi gus pa dang gnod pa mi bya zhing chos bshad pa'i dge ba myang 'das su bsngo/ dge 'dun gyi bslab bya la grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs/ dge 'dun bzhir longs pa'am rgyun bzhugs sogs dge 'dun gcig la'ang gus pa lhur len pa las brnyas pa spang zhing / mtha' na lhan pa ser po gcig tsam la'ang sangs rgyas kyi na bzar —32/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gemos nas 'gom yugs mi bya/ der ma zad tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dge slong la yang mi brnyas par gus par bya ste/ sngon glang po che'i rgyal pos/ rngon pa ngur smrig gi gos gyon pa la/ /chos gos tshon chen gyon pa 'di dag ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las ni sgrol mdzad pa'o/ /zhes gus pa bskyed pa'i tshul sogs la brten nas dge 'dun rjes su dran par bya/ thun mong ba'i bslab bya la/ sdud pa las/ /slob (234na〉pa gus ldan bla ma bzang po de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsung / zhes skyes bu dam pa yun du bsten pa la brten nas de las byung ba'i yon tan thams cad dam cha shas nas rang la 'gos par 'gyur/ theg pa che chung gi chos rnams nyan pas thos pa'i shes rab kyis spang gnyen gyi blang dor legs par shes par 'gyur/ thos pa de tshul bzhin yid la byas pa la brten nas bsam byung gi shes rab dang / de'i don yang nas yang du goms par byas pa la brten nas sgom byung gi shes rab 'phel/ chos mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su mthun pa ste phan pa'i chos de lam de sgrub pa bden bzhi bsgom pa yin/ dran shes bzhin gyi dbang po'i sgo bsdams nas bya ba ma yin pa las ldog nas dge ba la sbyor zhing / ma nus na'ang mi dge ba'i phyogs su ma lhungs pa byed/ sdom pa gsum po rgyud tshod dang bstun nas len pa'am ma nus na'ang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bslab/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sems can la bu gcig pa ltar brtse bas sras bcas rgyal ba mnyes pa'i phyir du sems can la gnod 'tshe spong / nyin mtshan dus drug gam ma 'grub na nyin mtshan re rer 'byor na mchod pa rgyas pa dang / ma 'grub na chu gtsang tsam gyi mtha' brten te dngos bshams yid sprul gyis mchod/ legs nyes ci byung yang skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol (235na thar dkon cog la gsol ba gdab cing / srog la babs kyang skyabs mi spang ba sogs sgrub pa'i mchod pas mchod / gal te bslab bya'i gtso bo nyams pa/ log lta skyes pa/ thar pa mi 'dod pa/ gang zag g.yin la dkon cog gsum 'bul ba'i brda sprad —322

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / 'dipa/ lha gzhan la brten par bzung du gsol/ mu stegs can du bzung du gsol/ zhes bsam pa thag pas brjod pa/ shi 'phos pa rnams kyis sdom pa gtong la/ tshe 'phos pa la ma ga rta gos pa'i rgyu gzhan gyis btang ba slar bskyar du rung ngo / /phan yon ni phag mo'i rtogs brjod las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste/ /lha yi lus ni spangs nas kyang / /mi yi lus su skye bar 'gyur/ /chos dang dge 'dun la'ang sbyar bas tshe 'di dang phyi mar mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba lasabasrung / ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las thar/ las nyone las dgrol bas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyisagos par mi 'gyur/ shes bya'i sgrib pa las grol bas zhi bde'i lam du mi gol bar mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa sogs nyes pa thams cad las bsrung ba chen por 'gyur/ skyabs su ma song bar theg pa gsum gyi chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas kyang rku thabs su gnas pas 'grub par mi 'gyur/ mdor na legs tshogis thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas mdo sde rgyan las/ 'jig rten ji srid sems can gyi/ /gnod dang phun sum tsho gos pa kun/ /bzlog cing 'byor par bya ba'i phyir/ /sangasargyas skyabs chen nyid du 'dod/(235ba༄sa sogs phan yon shin tu che bar gsungs pas dga' ba bsgoms la thal mo snying gar sbyor la bka' drin che lags zhes brjod du 'jug go /nyin zhag gcig tu bsrung ba'i bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa sogs bshad pa/gnyis pa nyin zhag gcig tu bsrung ba yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa la/ don rnam par bshad pa dang cho ga dngos gnyis kyi dang po ni/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sdom gsum 'grel pa legs par bshad pa zla 'od nor bu las/ /so thar len pa'i tshul la lugs gnyis bshad/ /nyan thos lugs la rigs bdun ji srid 'tsho/ /'bri gung pa dag nyan thos lugs la yang / /byang chub bar du —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6polen zhes rnam dbye 'chol/ /sdom pa'i ngo bo khyad med 'gyur sogs dang / /bslab phul sogs kyang sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu/ /min par thal ba'i gnod byed rig pa'i thog /byung tshe sems bskyed kyis ni zin pa dang / /ma zin rnam dbye phye nas len smra mod/ /'o na sems bskyed kyis zin rtsod gzhi sa /bzung bas gnod byed sngar bzhin cis mi mtshungs / /shi 'phos lha dang byis pa'i dus nyid nas/ /dge slong 'gyur na 'dul ba'i gzhung las bkag /bsnyen gnas gtso cher nyin zhag gcig pa'i mtha'/ /nyan thos sde gnyis blang yul len pa'i rten/ /tha dad che ba rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gtam/ /theg chen don zhags rtog pa nas gsungs yin/ /bsnyen gnas nang par 'bul dang 'chol zhes pa/ /chos pa rgyus med mun sgom tsam du zad/ /bsnyen gnas bsrung tshe lha sgom 'dod pa yang / /bsnyen gnas nyan thos gzhung lugs gtso che dang / /lha sgom gsang sngags khyad chas ma shes gtam/ /(236na/snon kyang sngagasanas gsungs pa'i bsnyen gnas sdom/ /bsrung na bya rgyud lugs bzhin mdun bskyed kyis/ /yi dam sgom pa phan yon che bar thob/ /theg chen lugs la thun mong min pa yi/ /cho ga mang byung ding sang dgos nus chung / /des na bsam pa theg chen nyer bzung nas/ /cho ga nyan thos lugs byed gnad kyi don/ /ces sdom tshig gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin/ nyan thos kyi lugs la so so thar pa rigs bdun po de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du len pa dang / bsnyen gnas de sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du len zhing yul kyang mdzod 'grel las/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa de yang dge 'dun nam gang zag las te/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma'i sdom pa rnams ni dge 'dun las so/ /g.yin dag ni gang zag las so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dge 'dun ni bzhir longs pa dang gang zag ni dge slong pha ma gang rung la byed dgos pas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i las chog tu/ 'dul ba'i bsnyen gnas dge slong las len pa'i nges pa mi snang ste/ lung las khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhan la bsnyen gnas 'bogs par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/yang mdzod 'grel las/ g.yin las mnos pa ni legs par spyad pa tsam du 'gyur gyis/ bsnyen —324

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)gnas kyi sdom pa ni bar ma yin no zhes dang / stag tshang lo tsā bas kyang 'di dang mthun par gsungs shing / lung gong ma'i don/ gzhan dag ces pa'i don/ gang la ngos 'dzin na dge tshul pha ma/ dge bsnyen (236ba)pha ma/ bsnyen gnas sdom pa lnga po de las dar chog la gzhan ngos 'dzin rgyu med do/ /de yang legs spyad tsam la nges pa med pa/ mdzod 'grel las/ de ltar byas na bshan pa dang / /byi byed pa dag gis nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i bsnyen gnas kyang 'bras bu yod par rung ngo / /zhes gsungs shing / legs smon tsam la sangs rgyas pa'i cho ga kho na la brten pa'i nges pa med pa klu sgrub rje'i gsal ba'i sgron me las/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa tsam zhig phyi rol pa rnams la yang yod pa/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ma byon gong du yang yod pas/ nges khrung gi bsam pa med kyang / legs smon tsam gyi bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skye ba'i gnad kyis/ ga sgo sbyong 'dod spyod lha lus yid 'ong ba/ /skyes pa bud med dag la stsal bar bgyi/ zhes gsungs pa yin/'di'i rigs bsgres nas/ sbyin sdom phyi ma bdun la'ang / 'jigs skyobs tsam dang legs smon tsam dang / nges khrung gi sdom pa gsum du 'byed pa ni mi rigs te/ de dag nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas slangs te/ cho ga nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs kho na la brten nas skye dgos pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa sogs len pa skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byed pa yang gnad de kho nas yin te/ rgya cher 'grel las/ nges khrung gi bsam pa brtan po med par sus kyang skyabs su 'gro ba bsgrub par mi byed ces bshad pas so/ /'on kyang gsung rigs 'ga' zhig las/ sdom pa de brgyad la 'jigs skyobs legs smon/ nges khrung gsum du phye ba lta bur snang ba (237na ji/ ring ba'i rgyu dus kyi kun slong tsam la dgongs pa ste/ nye ba'i rgyu dus kyi kun slong nges 'byung gi bsam pas ma zin na sdom pa de dag mi 'chags pa'i phyir ro/ /des na brnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ma gtogos rigs phyi ma bdun la so thar gyi sdom pa'am nges 'byung gi sdom pa yin pas khyab ces bya'o/ /—325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6posdom pa skye ba'i rten yang mdzod las/ za ma ma ning sgra mi snyan/ /mtshan gnyis ma gtogs mi rnams la / /sdom min sdom pa'ang de bzhin la/ zhes za ma ma ning / sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa'i gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med la skye ba nyan thos bye smra ba'i lugs yin pa 'dul mngon gzhir bzhag na 'di gtso che/ mdo sdo pa rnams dud 'gro sogs/ /'gro ba gzhan la'ang skye bar bshad/ blang ba'i yul yang dge bsnyen sogs/ gang yang rung las blang bar gsungs/ klu gzhen nu tsam pa zhes bya bas dus bzang la yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i klu chen po rnams dusabazang la rgya mtsho nas byung ste/ gso sbyong len pa la sogs gsungs pas bsnyen gnas gyi sdom pa dud 'gro dang yi dwags kyi 'gro ba la sogs dang / za ma dang ma ning la yang skye bar 'dod cing / drang srong gnas mchog gis zhus par/ khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba gang yang rung ba chog shes pa zhig la len par gsungs te/ lung las/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis mang po la bsnyen gnas phog par gsungs pas dge slong kho na las len par ma nges par bshad pa ni/ mdzod 'grel las/ de la gzhan du (237ba〉gis pas ni legs par spyad pa tsam du 'gyur gyis/ bsnyen gnas gyi sdom pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du gsal sgron las bye brag smra ba rnams bcom ldan 'das gyi so thar sdom pa nyin zhag gi mtha' can dang / ji srid 'tsho'i mtha' can gnyis las ma bshad pas nyin zhag lnga sogs kyi bsnyen gnas sdom pa mi 'thad ces ba ched do/ /mdzod 'grel las/ phyin chad sdom pa skye ba la yang rigs pa dang 'gal ba ni med pa'i phyir ro/ /phyin chad po 'di su la yang ma bstan pas bye brag tu smra ba rnams ni mi bzhed do zhes bshad do/ /des na rang lugs nyan thos thun mong ba'i bsnyen gnas sdom pa ni/ bye smra ltar nyin zhag gcig gi mtha' can du khas len pa 'di rigs pa yin no/ /zhes gsung pa ni 'thad par mngon/ mdo sde pa'i lugs de nyin zhag phyed pa'i bsnyen gnas lta bu ste/ de ni bar ma'i dge ba tsam las bsnyen gnas dngos min no/ /deng sang khyim pa rnams kyis len pa'i yongs grags kyi bsnyen gnas ni 'di kho na yin la/326

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)theg pa chen po'i bsnyen gnas ni/ so thar dang mi 'dra bar rang nyid kyis rten gyi drung du len zhing /sang nang par zhes nyin zhag gcig tu khas len par mtshudas kyang / len yul gang zag dang / rten sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang bcu gcig zhal lta bu'i sku dang phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa dang spyan drangs pa sogs rten gyi khyad par/ len tshig ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / btsun pa dgongs su gsol sogs(238na tharjod bya mi 'dra ba/bsam pa cho ga 'dis blangs pas gso sbyong gi sdom pa sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar dang sngon du gang zag gam dge 'dun las blangs pa'i dge slong dge tshul gyi sdom pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung snyam pa'i khyad par dbye thub pa theg chen gyi sdom pa shes pa'i steng nas 'jog pas nyan thos gzugs can gyi sdom pa dgag gtong gnyis byung dogs mi dgos/ spang bya yan lag brgyad du mtshudas kyang so thar la nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha spang mi dgos shing / stag tshang lo tsā ba'i 'dul srid tu/ sha g.yin rang la bsngos nas bsad par mthong thos dogs gsum gang rung gis shes na sogs te/ bshan pa'i tshong 'dus nas dge bsnyen dad pa can gyis blangs nas za bar gnang ngo / /sum brgya par/ ya rabasarnams kyis nya dang sha gnang gang / /gnod dang brtse med ro sogs la chags dang / /yongs su btsal ba'i sems dag spangs nas ni/ /lhung bzed 'ongs pa de la brtag ste bza'/ zhes so/ /stag gi god ma ni btsog pas bkag go /zhes zer mod/ khu rnams kyis ni lhag mar byas pa'i sha /gang yin de mchu'i than skor bor te za/ zhes dang / 'dir yang de bzhin du bshad na ce spyang dang khā las stag btsog pa'i rgyu mtshan med pas/ stag ni shin tu chags shing bstos pa dang bcas pas bkag go /ngo po'i sgo nas mi rung ba ni glang po che sogs te klu ni sbrul lo/ /rmig gcig pa ni rkang lag gi rmig pa kha hrag med pa bong bu sogs bya shing rta mo sogs/ skyin gor sram du grags pa'o/ /dre'u srin ni sa las (23shab〉skyes pa'i 'bu ring po'o/ /bcad pa las byung ba ni de ltar bkag pa las byung ba zhes pa yin pa/327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pozhar byung 'o ma la dogs pa dpyad pa ni/ glang po sogs te/ sha bsngos par shes na zhes pa nas bzung ste nad pa ma yin pa'i dbang du byas nas rtsa 'grel gyis bstan te/ nad pa la ni mi'i sha bkag pa'i shugs las gzhan rnams gnang bar grub pas so/ /des na gang dag 'dul ba nas sha ma gnang ngo zhes zer ba dag gis ni 'dul ba mi shes pa'i rmongs pa dang / rang nyid sha mi za ba'i nga rgyal dang /g.yin la zhe sdang ba'i nyon mongs kyis kun nas bslang ba'i ca co bsgrags pas lhas byin gyi bslab pa'i gzhi la gnas par bstan to/ /'on kyang snying rjes kun nas bslangs te gzhan rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pa'i drang don yin na shin tu ngo mtshang zhes byung bas theg chen gyi gso sbyong blangs tshe nges par sha dang sgog btsong sogs spong dgos pa lang gshegs las/ dri nga 'phags pa min pas bsnyen/ /mi bsnyen par yang byed pa ste/ kha ni gcan gzan rnams kyi zas/ /bzar mi rung bar thub chen gsungs/ /zos na nyes pa gang yod dang / /ma zos pa yi yon tan dag sha za de la gang yin pa/ /blo gros chen pos shes par gyis/ /'brul pa dang ni gnyen bshes dang / /khu chu khrag las byung ba'i phyir/ /'byung po rnams ni dngang 'gyur bas/ /rnal 'byor can gyis sha mi bza'/ sha rnams dang ni sgog btsong dag /chang dag rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ke'u dang sgog skya de bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu spang / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ khe yi phyir (239na ji sems can gsod/ sha yi phyir ni nor sbyin byed/ /gnyis ka sdig pa'i las can pas/ lle nas 'o dod 'bod par lhung / /bcol 'tshol 'du shes de med na/ /rnam gsum dag pa'i sha yang med/ /rgyu med las ni yod min pas/ /de yi phyir na bza' mi bya/ /rnal 'byor pa ni de dag gis/ /des na thams cad spang bar bya/ phyogs bcu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /thams cad rab tu smod par 'gyur/ /gcig la gcig ni za bar byed/ tshe nas gcan gzan rigs su lhung /dri mi zhim pa smad pa dang / /glen pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /phal cher gdol pa'i rigs su skye/ /rngon pa dme sha can rigs dang / /yang na phra men rigs su skye/ sha za'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ khren po —328

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabyi la la sogs pa'i/ /mngal kun tu ni skye bar 'gyur/ /glang po 'ching dang sprin chen dang / /sor mo 'phreng ba'i mdo dag dang / /lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo 'di las/ /ngas ni sha ni rab tu bkag /ces gsungs pas shes nus the du/ /'di skor la mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i sdom gsum 'grel pa las/ de ltar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la cho ga mi 'dra ba'i gnad gnyis yod pa de lta na skabs su bab pa bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga ji ltar byed snyam na dge bsnyen dang 'dra bar bsnyen gnas la yang grub mtha'i dbang gi cho ga mi 'dra ba gnyis 'byung ste/ skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas nas bslab bya brgyad khas len gsum byed pa mdo sde'i lugs dang / skyabs 'gro brtsom byed du byas/ bdag bsnyen gnas par bzung du gsol lan gsum byed pa kha che bye smra ba'i lugs (239ba〉na nyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni 'dul lung sogs las ma bshad kyang mdzod rang 'grel las shugs las bshad pa'i lugs dang / dang po ni/ gnas 'jog nas bshad pa'i lugs dang / byang sa dang sdom brgyad 'grel pa sogs las bshad pa'i lugs dang /gong du bshad pa ltar gyi rigs pas grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i lugs ni/ mdo sde pa rnams cho me can/ khyod kyi lugs la bsnyen gnasasdom pa'i rten dang / blang yul sogs kha che bye smra dang mi 'dra ste/ dud 'gro sogs 'gro ba gzhan la'ang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skye bar mdo mdzangs blun sogs las bshad pa ltar 'dod cing / blang pa'i yul yang dge bsnyen sogs sngom ldan gang yang rung ba las blang bar gnas 'jog gi mdo sogs las bshad pa ltar 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la paṇa shāka pas/ dud 'gro so sor thar pa yi/ /sdom pa'i rten du khas len pa'i/ /nyan thos sde pa yod dam ci/ /zhes dris nas/ de'i rang lan du/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi las phye ba'i mdo sdebs/ dud 'gro sor sdom gyi rten du khas mi len te/ des so thar gyi rnam gzhag 'dul ba dang mi 'gal bar khas len pa gang zhig /'dul ba las dud 'gro sor sdom gyi rten yin pa bkag pa'i phyir/ des na theg pa che chung gi mdo sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa dag la thar —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorapa yin te/ mdo sdomadzangs blun las/ klus bsnyen gnas bsrung bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ gzhan la bsnyen gnas phog par bshad pa'i phyir dang / de dag ni bar ma dge ba tsam yin gyis/ sdom par bzhed (240na)pa'i tshad ldan su yang med do/ /de ltar na/ 'dul bar bsnyen gnas dge slong las/ /len cing mi yi rten du bshad/ /mdo sde las ni dud 'gro sogs/ /'gro ba gzhan la'ang skye bar bshad/ ces brtan na gnad dang 'khrul pa med do zhes 'chad par byed do/ /de yang grub mtha' gong 'og gi gnad rnams ma dgongs pa'i skyon yin te/ bstan bcos bye brag tu bshad pa la gtso bor byed pa la bye brag tu smra ba dang / theg chung gi mdo gtso bor byed pa la mdo sde pa zhes 'jog pa yin pas/ mdo sde pas mdo las bsnyen gnas sdom pa blang ba'i yul dang /rten bshad pa de tshad ma byed ces pa'i grub mtha'i gnad yin pa'i phyir dang / gzhan du na/ theg pa che chung gi mdo sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa ste/ grub mtha' smra ba su yin dris na lan rnal ma med pa'i phyir dang / khyad par khyed rang gis mdo sde pas nyin zhag lnga'i mtha' can gyi bsnyen gnas sdom pa khas len par 'og tu bshad pa de mi 'thad par thal/ mdo dzi pas bsnyen gnas sdom pa'i rnam gzhag 'dul ba dang mi 'gal bar khas len pa gang zhig /'dul ba las de 'dra ma bshad pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum e dran/ 'dul ba la bsnyen gnas dge slong las/ zhes sogs gzhung 'chol mi dgos/ 'dul ba dang mdo las de ltar bshad pa de/ bye mdo gnyis kyi so sor khas len pa grub mtha'i gnad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di lung rigs shin tu phra bar snang ngo / /'o na/ 'bri gung dgongs gcig pa dang /bka' gdams pa la la bsnyen gnas da nang blangs pa sang zhogs 'bul chog (240ba)byed dgos zer pa ni sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du zhes tshig gis bcas de khas blangs pas dus mtshams rdzogs pa'i mthar sdom pa rang shugs kyis gtong ba ma go ba ste/ de ltar na dge slong gis 'chi ba'i dus su sdom pa 'bul chog dgos pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /—330

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabye smra ba la de ltar yin mod kyang / mdo sdeb la lugs gzhan yod dam snyam na/ mdo sdo pa'i lugs bzhin du sngon lan gcig zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad la bdag bsnyen gnas par bzung du gsol zhes khas blangs nas/ phyis skya rengs shar nas yun 'ga' song zhing zan zos pa'i rjes sogs ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshe/ bsnyen gnas len na yang nang par gzhan la 'bul mi dgos te/ nang par skya rengs shar ba phan chad sdom pa de bsrung bsam pa med pa'i phyir na nang par sdom pa gtong bar nges so//klu sgrub rje'i sdom gsum 'grel par/ bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa'i lugs 'di la bsnyen gnas chos can/ khyod sang nang par 'bul chog mi dgos te/ khyod mtshan mo 'das nas skya rengs shar ba'i tshe rang shugs kyis gtong ba'i phyir/ de la kho na re ma grub ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dus bzang gsum la sogs pa'i bsnyen gnas stabs cig tu blangs nas bsrung ba yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ khyod kyi 'khrul gzhi thams cad de lta bus byas par snang mod/ jo bo rje'i phyag bzhes su mdo sde ba'i lugs su gragasapa bzhin thog mar bsnyen gnas slob dpon las stabs cig tu blangs nas/ phyis rang ji ltar nam 'dod pa'i tshe len pa ste bsrung na yang / de ltar stabs cig tu blangs nas bsrung ba'i sdom pa chos can/khyod sang gi skya (241na 'angs shar nas gtong ste/ khyod bsrung ba'i gang zag de la khyod sang nang par phan dus rtag tu bsrung ba'i bsam pa med pa'i phyir te/ gang zag des khyod nam 'dod pa'i nyin zhag re re kho nar blangs pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ des na nyin zhag gcig pa'i bsnyen gnas stabs cig tu blangs pa'i lugs 'di la yang chos can/ bsrung zin pa'i rjes su 'bul mi dgos te/ nyi ma phyi ma'i skya rengs shar pas gtong ba de'i phyir ro/ /gzhung 'di la paṇa shāka pas mdo sde pa'i lugs bzhin du/ ji ltar 'dod tshe len zhes pa/ dus gcig stabs su len nam ci/ /zan zos nas kyang nod ces pa/ 'di'i don du khas len na/ /de 'dra bye brag smra ba yi/ /dmigs ba yin gyi mdo sde pa'i/ /gzhung lugs yin par 'gal ba med/ /bsnyen gnas stabs cig len pa de/ /mdo sde'i gzhung lugs gang las byung / /zhes pa'i dri ba mdzad do/ /—331

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6 spu'adi la dri ba'i sgo nas dgos pa bkod pa/ dri lan gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam bshad mdzad pa snga ma rnams kyis thog mar slob dpon la zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus bzang gsum gyi bsnyen gnas stabs cig tu blangs nas phyis nam 'dod pa'i tshe bsrungs pas chog pa 'di/mdo sde pa'i lugs bzhin du zhes pa'i skabs kyi mdo sde pa'i lugs yin zhing / de'i rgyab brten ni/mdzod 'grel las/ gang gi tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen par bya'o/ /zhes sngon yang dag par blangs pa byas pa des ni zas zos nas kyang nod par bya'o zhes 'dren par mdzad cing /(241ba 'di nyid jo bo rje'i phyag bzhes dang / rang re dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gong ma rnams kyis kyang phyag bzhes yin no/ /zhes mtha' dpyod rgyas par gsung /de yang bye mdo gnyis kyi sdom pa len pa'i khyad par ni/ lung rig gter mdzod las/ bye brag tu smra ba'i/ mdo sdo pa'i/ theg pa chen po'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po la/ dang por len pa'i cho ga dang /phyis khas len pa'i cho ga gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi drung du sngar bshad pa ltar gyi kun spyod dang ldan pas/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nabs bzung sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par btsun pas gzung du gsol/ zhes pa'i cho ga'i tshig lan gsum du brjod pa'i rjes su rtsa ba bzhi/ chang / phyi dro'i kha zas/ mal che mtho/ gar sogs phreng sogs spong ba'i bslab pa'i gnas brgyad la bslab tshul brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ g.yin rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dang bco lnga gnam gang la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par btsun pasagazung du gsol zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'di ltar blangs pa' dgos pa ni/ ma 'ongs pa na tshes brgyad la sogs pa dus khyad par can —332

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanagyi dus su zas la longs spyad pas rjes su yang slob dpon gyi drung du (242na〉snyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs pas skye ba'i ched yin te/ mdzod rang 'grel du/ gang gi tshes brgyad la bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o zhes sngon yang dag par khas blangs pa des ni/ zan zos kyang nod par bya'o/ /gzhan lasanod par bya ba'i bdag nyid las ni ma yin no/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ dang por len pa'i dang / phyis len pa'i chog gnyis/ dang po ni/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol / zhes pa nas dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nasabazung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dang bco lnga dang / gnam gang la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par btsun pas gzung du gsol/ zhes brjod pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar tshes brgyad sogs la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i gang zag des/ phyis rten gyi drung du yang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa rang nyid kyis blangs pas skye ba yin te/ mdo sde pa yi lugs bzhin du/ /ji ltar 'dod tshe len na yang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa theg chen gyi lugs ni lugs 'di la mkho chung bas dkyus ltar ma bris la/ mdo sde pa'i lugs 'di ni gang las bshad snyam na/ nang par g.yin las nod par bya/ zhes pa'i mdzod 'grel las/ nang par ni re zhig nyi ma ma shar ba'i tshe ste/ nyin zhag gi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir zhes spyir btang dang /gang gis tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes sngon yang dag par khas blangs pa des ni zan jos nas kyang (242bskod par bya'o/ /zhes dmigs gsal gnyis gsungs pa'i dmigasabasal 'di mdo sde pa'i lugs bzhin du ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshe bsnyen gnas len zhes pa de yin par 'chad/lung rigs gter mdzod du/ thog mar slob dpon las lan cig blangs nas slar brjod de zan zos pa'i rjes su'ang slob dpon la blangs chog pa bye smra rang lugs su gsungs par mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sdom gsum 'grel par/ des na nang par ni re zhig ces sogs 'grel —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pob snga ma de bye smra'i lugs dang / gang gis tshes brgyad la zhes sogs 'grel pa phyi ma las 'phros pa'am/ dmigs bsal gyi tshul du byung ba ste mdo sde pa'i lugs yin te/ 'grel ba snga ma'i thad kyi 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las sdom pa ni slong bar byed pa yang dag par len par nges pa'i sems pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe kho na skye/ zan zos nas nod pa ni gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes nyi ma ste skya rengs shar ba'i tshe len pa kho na bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs bstan pa'i phyir dang / gang gis tshes brgyad la zhes sogs bye smra rang lugs kyi dmigs bsal yin na 'grel bshad kyang de dang mthun pa zhig dgos pa las/ nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe kho na skye'o zhes pa'i nges bzung gi tshig gis mi mthun pa dngos su bsal bas 'grel bshad de 'dor rigs par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa gnyis 'gal ba phyi ma ltar na bye smra lugs la zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshig bsnon pa dgos med du song zhing / gsal ba'i sgron me las/ dmigs bsal gyi cho ga ni/ dang po slob dpon gyi drung du blangasanas/ phyis 'bogs(243na)pa po med kyang rang nyid kyis rten gyi drung du blangs pas skye ba yin te/ de'i tshul ni/ rten dang mchod pa bshams/ de'i mdun du rang nyid tsog tsog pur 'dug ste/ mdun gyi rten de nyid kyi 'bogs par bsam/ slob dpon gyi tshab tu lha dgongs su gsol/ zhes bcug ste cho ga gzhan sngar dang 'dra bar byas pas sdom pa skye ba yin no/ /yang mdzod 'grel las/ gang gis tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o zhes/ sngon yang dag par khas blangs pa des ni/ zan zos nas kyang nod par bya'o zhes pa 'di mkhas pa 'ga' zhig mdo sde pa'i lugs kho na la sbyor ba snang yang / mdo sde pa'i lugs dang cha 'dra ba ma gtogs bye smra bas kyang khas len par snang ste/ de'i dmigs gsal gyi cho ga yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs/ des mdzad pa'i sdom gsum gyi 'grel pa'i gser mdog can pa'i lan du snga rabs pa'i bsnyen gnas stabs gcig len pa'i cho ga lung gi khungs med gsung ba brtag par bya ste/ mdzod 'grel las/ gang gis tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes sngon yang dag par —334

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanakhas blangs pa des ni/zhes pa des/zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad kyi bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa cho ga las dus gcig tu blangs pa zhig yod par dngos su bstan pa gang zhig/des bstan na dus bzang gzhan rnams la'ang mtshudas pa'i phyir/rtags dang po grub ste/de ltar blangs pa'i gang zag des/zla ba phyi ma'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma shar ma thag rang rgyud la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skyes kyang 243bti'i nyin bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i bsam pa brjed de zan zos na yang slar sngar blangs pa'i sdom pa dran pas gsal 'debs pa tsam gyi phyir du bsnyen gnas gzhan la nod kyang chog ces pa ni/zan zosanas kyang nod par bya'o//zhes pas bstan pa yin pa'i phyir te/de'i 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las/sdom pa ni blang dor byed pa yang dag par len par nges pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/nyi ma shar ba'i tshe kho na skye'o//zan zos nas nod pa ni gsal bar bya ba'i phyir ro//zhes gsal bar bshad 'dug pa'i phyir ro//de la mkhas pa paṇa shāka pa na re/mdzod 'grel de'i don/tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas la gnas pa dam bcas pa tsam la dgongs kyi/cho gas blangs pa ma yin no//zhes kho bos bshad zin pa ma yin nam zhe na de ltar bshad pa des/'grel bshad 'di la thugs bsam ma bcug pa'i skyon yin te/tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skyes kyang /nyi ma shar zin tsha ba zos rjes bsnyen gnas len pa zhig 'grel bshad 'dis bstan pa las nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe skyes pas bsnyen gnas sdom pa de sngar dus gcig blangs pa'i cho ga gcig las ma skyes na/sngar gyi dam bca' de las skyes pa'am/phyis kyi cho ga de las skyes pa gang rung du khas blang dgos pas/mkhas pa'i bzhad gad chen po yin pa'i phyir ro//yang gzhan la brjod pa'i rigs pa'i gnod byed de yang mi 'jug ste/tshes gcig gi nyin dusabazang gsum gyi bsnyen gnas stabs cig tu blangs pa'i tshe/tshes gcig gi nyin bsnyen gnas 244nakyi sdom pa mi skye ste/de nyid de bsrung bar khas ma blangs pa'i phyir ro//'on kyang de'i wo cho ga de blangasapa la dgos pa yod de/phyis tshes brgyad sogs dus bzang so so la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skye ba'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poched yin pa'i phyir/ phyis kyi sdom pa de chos nyid kyi thob pa yang min te/ sngar tshes gcig gi cho ga de la bltos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rnam gsal gyi dpe brjod par bya ste/ mchod sbyin ma 'phrin gyi bsnyen rdzogs byed pa'i tshe/ dge 'dun sde gnyis kyi u pa la'i mdog can gyi gam du gsol bzhi'i cho ga byasapa'i tshe/ mchod sbyin ma'i rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skyes sam ma skyes/ skyes na bsgrub bya med pa'i sdom pa skye ba bzhad gad yin zhing / ma skyes na cho ga de byas pa la dgos pa med par thal de byas pa'i tshe sdom pa skye rgyu ma byung ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum e dran/gnyis pa mdzod 'grel gyi don min zhes pa'i skabs su/ mdzod 'grel des/ phyogs snga'i 'dod pa la gnod byed du song ba yin gsung ba la'ang brtag ste/ phyogs snga mas/ sngar dus gzhig len pa'i cho ga byas nas phyis tshes brgyad sogs la gtan nas blang du mi 'dod par khas blangs na/ khyed bden yang phyis blangs pa'i yul rnyed na blangs kyang skyon med la/ ma blangs kyang bsrungs pas chog ces khas blangs pas gnod byed med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i lung rigs 'di shin tu 'phrod cing rno bar snang ngo / /bshad tshul gsum po mi mthun tsam byung ba lung rigs gter mdzod kyi de ga gzhung thog tu phebs pa 'dra'o/ /bye mdo gnyis kyi bsnyen (244ba)gnas la nyin zhag ga khrig par grags kyang zhib tu byas na/ bye brag tu smra bar da nang skya rengs shar nas sang skya rengs ma shar gyi bar nyin zhag phyugs gcig tshang la mdo sde pas zan zos nas blangs na nyin zhag tshang ba mi yong ba'i khyad par yod cing /sdom gsum las/ la la bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa yi/ nang par bsnyen gnas 'bul dgos zer/ /bsnyen gnas mtshan mo 'das pa na/ /gtong phyir 'di la 'bul mi dgos/ /mdo sde pa yi lugs bzhin du/ /ji ltar 'dod tshe len na yang / /nang par phan chad bsrung ba yi/ /bsam pa med phyir sdom pa gtong / /de yi phyir na 'bul mi dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang bsgrub nus/ de nyid las/ la la bsnyen gnas 'chol ba thos/ /'di 'dra gang na'ang bshad pa med/ ces gsung dgos pa'i don la dga' —336

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)gdong 'grel chen du/'du shes zhan cing cho gel dbang za ba 'ga' zhig/rang bsnyen gnas bsrung bar mi khom na tshab la gang zag la 'chol ba'i lugs byed de/de 'dra bka' bstan bcos gang nasakyang ma gsungs pas mi bya'o zhes gsung pa 'di dang /paṇa chen don yod dpal bas 'dod yon la sred pa che ba la la na re/chang 'thung ba lta bu'i tshe na bsnyen gnas 'tshol pa yin no zhes zer ba thos so//zhes gsung ba snga ma dang tshig mthun par sems shing /kun mkhyen go rams pa'i sdom gsum ṭīkka gsung rab dgongs gsal las/chos rgyus chung ba la la na re/bsnyen gnas bsrungasanas slar nas bsrung 'dod na/nang par ga' na la 'chol dgos te/gzhan du na 245na skor len du med pa'i phyir ro//zhes pa dang /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sdom ṭīka gi dgongs pa gnyis mthun par snang ba snga ma gnyis ltar na bsnyen gnas kyi sdom ldan des chang 'thung ring gzhan la 'chol lo zhes dang /phyi ma gnyis ltar na tshes dgu lta bu'i nang par sdom pa de gzhan la bcol nas zla ba rting ma'i dus tshur len pa lta bu'i zhe 'dod bskyar ba don du lugs ga de 'dra mi 'thad par gsung ba mthun/bka' gdams bya yul ba sogs 'ga' zhig gis tshes bco lnga la bsnyen gnas 'bogs na lha shākya thub pa dang /tshes brgyad la 'bogs na sman bla dang /gnam stong la 'bogs na snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgom bzlas rnams tha dad du ma byas na dus de dang de la bsnyen gnas bsrung du mi 'dod zer ba'ang so thar gyi skabs shin tu mi rigs te lha sgom pa dang sngags bzla ba gsang sngags kyi lugs yin pas 'dir mi 'jug cing /gal te med ka med yin na dge tshul slong sogs kyi kyang lha sgom sngagasabazlas ma byas na sdom pa nyams par 'gyur zhing /des na gsang sngags lta ci smos/pha rol tu phyin pa tsam yang blor mi chud pa'i dge slong dag rnam dag ma yin par smra dgos par thal zhing /de 'dra yod pa'i khungs chag lo chos rje dpal gyis rgya gar du byon pa'i lam yig las/rdo rje gdan du dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang zhes bya bar brgyad stong pa'i rgya dpe zhig khur nas byon pas dkon gnyer
