nyan thos na re chos ci yin zer/chos rjes pradzha pā ra mi ta ho zhes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin gsungs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6popas/ khong na re (245ba/byod dge slong legs pa zhig 'dug pa la theg pa chen po'i chos rgyab la khur ba de ma legs/ de bor zhig chu la skyur zhig zer nas sna 'gebs su byung / theg pa chen po sangs rgyasakyis ma gsungs/ klu sgrub zer ba'i dbang po rno ru re ba zhig gis bcos pa yin zer/ zhes gsal bar byung bas shes so/ /yang lung sman gyi gzhi las/ dge slong sa ri'i dug zhi ba'i phyir du rma bya chen mo'i rigs sngags gsungs pa dang / yang yangs pa can du yams nad zhi ba'i don du yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i gzungs gsungs pa dang / gnas mal gyi gzhi phran tshegs las gsang sngags phan par byed pa bzung bar bya'o/ /sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ de ni nad la sogs pa zhi ba'i thabs su sngags kyi yig 'bru tsam bzla bar gsungs kyi/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa de'i sngags bzlas pa sogs ma gsungs shing / spyir yang lha dang drang srong sogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags nus pa can yang 'ong bas sngags bzla rgyu thams cad gsang sngags kyi khongs su ga la gtogs/ bya yul ba'i lugs de 'dra gsang sngags rnying ma'i skabs dus chen bcu la gso sbyong blangs te lha sgom pa'i rnam gzhag 'dra mthong nas gzhogs drud de byas 'dra ba/ paṇa chen na bza' pa'i kha 'bar ma ltar khungs dang rgyu mtshan ma ches par mthong tshad bsre ba de 'dra rang nyid ston pa'i me long ngo/ /de yang theg chen so thar ni gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ dge slong pha ma'i sdom pa ma gtogos pa'i so thar gzhan rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis len par(246na gi sungs pa dang / cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdor/ sngon bskal pa mngon par dga' ba la/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba zhes bya bar rgyal ba ri rab lta bu la 'khor los sgyur rgyal dge ba'i bkod pas rjes su mthun pa'i bzod pa thob nas rab tu byung zhing sras snying rjes cher sems rgyal sar bskos pas de nyid kyang / rab byung yon tan du ma bsngags pa zhes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs mod kyi/ /de ltar legs kyang snying rjer gyur pa na/ /'gro la phan phyir rgyal srid bdag gis bsgrubs/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar bdag ni tshangs spyod cing / gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa blang bar bya/ zhes gso sbyong yan lag brgyad ji srid 'tsho'i —338—

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / 6)bar du blang bar gsu pas pa dang / 'phags pa don yon zhags pa'i rtog pa las/ gso sbyong gi sdom pa rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis len par gsungs pa la sogs pa rnams kyi lag len nyan thos kyi lugs la byas na zhwa dpe lham khebs su 'gyur zhing lag len phal cher kyang deng sang nub la/ ma nub pa don zhags rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i theg chen gyi bsnyen gnas su grags pa nyin zhag gcig pa'i mtha' can dang / skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa byang chub snying po'i bar len pa spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa sogs theg chen so thar gyi lag len 'ga' zhig ma nub par yod la/ mdo nas tshig gis zin tsam ni dkon cog brtsegs pa'i khyim bdag drag shul can gyas zhus par/ rgyal sras byams pas mkhan po mdzad nas/khyim bdag dgu stong dang / rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs kyis mkhan po mdzad nas(246ba〉〉 bdag bdun stong rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa mkhan po byams pa la sogs pa dbu skra ring zhing rgyan dang bcas pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya khyim pa'i cha lugs can bsnyen par rdzogs tshul 'di 'dra ni sngon gyi cho ga 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul kho na yin no/ /smyung gnas sogs kyi skabs don zhags nas bshad pa'i gso sbyong blang ba 'di la theg chen lugs kyi bsnyen gnas su grags kyang sngar bshad pa ltar nyan thos lugs kyi bsnyen gnas dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa de dag chos rgyus chung ba rnams kyis dbye ba mi byed par/ smyung gnas kyi skabs kyang nyin snga ma so thar rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi bsnyen gnas len pa sogs rnam dbye med pa'i lag len sna tsho gos dar nas bstan pa dri bcas su byed do/ /don zhags nas bshad pa'i bsnyen gnas de bsnyen gnas yin kyang so thar gyi bsnyen gnas ma yin pas mtshon dbye tshul gyi spu risamang du yod pas gsal ba'i sgron mer rab dbye las/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid la yang / /so sgo thar pa 'bogs pa yi/ /chog 'ga' zhig yod mod kyi/ /de yi cho ga phal cher nub/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba yi/ /cho ga'i lag len 'ga' zhig yod/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa la'ang rigs brgyad la sogs pa'i cho ga sngar byung mod/ dge bsnyen pha ma sogs rigs phyi ma bdun 'bogs—339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6popa'i cho ga'i lag len ding sang nub nas med cing / rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga /ding sang lag len ma (247na〉kyib par yod ces gsung gi /so thar rigs brgyad kyi sdom pa la/ nyan thos dang / thun mong ba'i cho ga blangs pa zhig dgos/ zhes pa dang / don zhags rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pas bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'i go mi chod ces pa de 'dra gtan nas ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba yang / sde snod kyi sgo nas 'dul ba/ mngon pa/mdo sde/ rgyud dzinas bshad pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bzhi/ grub mtha'i sgo nas/ bye smra'i lugasamado sdo pa'i lugs/ grub mtha' smra ba gong ma'i lugs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i lugs dang bzhi/ mdo sdonas bshad tshul/ kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa mdo nas bshad pa'i tshul dang / drin lan bsang pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i tshul gnyis yod/cho ga'i sgo nas dbye na/ bye smra lugs kyi cho gas blang ba/ mdo sde lugs kyi cho gas blang ba/nyan thos thun mong ba'i cho gas blang ba/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi cho gas blang pa dang bzhi/ zhes rgyas par dbye ba rnam dpyod dang ldan pas gsung ngo / bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa len yul la/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i 'dul ba'i spyi don du dge bsnyen gyis bdag bsnyen gnas par gzung du gsol zhes 'bul chog tu 'gro ste/ zhes dang / gnad 'di ma go bar dge tshul dang / dge bsnyen gyis bsnyen gnas len 'os par 'dod pa'i grub mtha' ngan pa 'di byung ngo zhes dang / dge bsnyen gyis bsnyen gnas par yan lag rnams bsrungs pa tsam gyis gso sbyong la gnas par 'gyur ro/ khyu (247bsgo tshan de'i phyir/ khyim pa'i gso sbyong dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa mu gsum ste/ snga ma yin la phyi ma min pa ni/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyis nyin zhag gi gso sbyong rang gis khas blangs pa lta bu dang / phyi ma yin la snga ma min pa ni dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang mi ldan pas blangs pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa lta bu dang / gnyis ka min pa ni nyin zhag phyed pa'i bsnyen gnas lta bu dang / so thar gyi sdom pa dang mi ldan pas phog pa'i bsnyen gnas lta bu dang / nyin zhag gcig tu srog gcod rkyang pa —340

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)spong ba'i bsnyen gnas lta bu yin pa'i phyir/zhes dang /paṇa chen shāka mchog gis yongs rdzogs dang tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen: sdom pa la gnas pas gnas 'jog gi mdo dang /dge bsnyen gyi sdom brgyad dang /don yod zhags pa'i cho ga las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa tshang mar nod du rung ba ma yin te/rtsa ba bzhi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ba'i sdom pa la gnas bzhin du/rtsa ba bzhi nyin zhag gcig tu bsrung bar khas blangs pa la dgos pa med par ma zad/de ltar len pa de sdom pa snga ma'i gtong rgyur song ba'i nyes dmigs yod pa'i phyir/zhes khrung la/klu sgrub rje'i sdom gsum 'grel par/khyed rang gis khyim pa'i gso sbyong dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa la mu bzhi bshad cing /bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yin la gso sbyong ma yin pa ni dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang mi ldan pas blangs pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa lta bu gso sbyong yin la/bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ma yin pa ni yongs rdzogs 248na ) dge bsnyen gyi nyin zhag gcig pa'i gso sbyong gzhan la ma bltos par rang gis blangs pa lta bu/gnyis ka yin pa ni yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyis nyin zhag gcig pa'i gso sbyong blangs pa lta bu/ gnyis ka min pa ni nyin zhag phyed pa'i bsnyen gnas lta bu'o//zhes bshad pa de thugs la e gsal/de thugs la gsal na nyin zhag gcig pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs ma thag pa'i yongasardzogs dge bsnyen chos can/khyod kyi rtsa bzhi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spong ba'i sdom pa de bto bar thal/khyod de lta bu'i sdom pa yod bzhin du rtsa ba bzhi nyin zhag gcig gi mtha' can du spong ba'i sdom pa khas blangs ma thag pa yin pa gang zhig/de de'i gtong rgyu yin pa'i phyir/'khor gsum e dran/de la mkhas pa na re/yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen des bsnyen gnas par khas blangs nas yan lag lhag ma bsrungs pa tsam gyis gso sbyong la gnas par 'gyur ro//zhes khas blangs kyis/bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad tshang bar nod par khas ma blangs pas skyon med ce na/shin tu yang mi rigs te/mdzod 'grel las/yan lag brgyad tshang bar nod bar bya'i/༷ tshang bar ni ma yin no//zhes bshad pas/yan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6polag brgyad tshang bar ma nod pa'i bsnyen gnas sdom pa/ mkhas pa dgyes pa'i dga' ston ma yin pa'i phyir dang / dge tshul gyis bsnyen gnas par khas blangs na dge tshul sdom pa'i gtong rgyur 'gyur na/yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyis bsnyen gnas par khas blangs na dge bsnyen (248ba)sdom pa'i gtong rgyur mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / gsal ba'i sgron mer/ mkhas pa shākya mchog ldan sogs 'ga' zhig dge tshul pha ma yan chad kyi rab tu byung bas 'di blang du mi rung ste/ rtsa bzhi ji srid 'tsho'i mtha' can du bsrung ba'i sdom pa yod bzhin du rtsa bzhi nyin zhag gcig gi mtha' can du khas blangs na/ sdom pa snga ma de'i gtong rgyur thal ba'i skyon yod gsung ba ni rigs pa tshig la shor ba ste/ de ltar na yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyis kyang de blang du mi rung bar 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan khyed rang gis bkod pa de'i phyir ro/ /des na khyim pa/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong sogs gang gis kyang blangs chog ste/sman bla'i mdo chog sogs las de ltar bshad pas so/ /zhes pa'ang byung pas/ paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas la mu gsum dang bzhir dbye ba ni na yams tsam las rang tshig dang mi 'gal ba'i tshig don dpyad pa'i mdzub btsugs mi snang zhing / kun mkhyen klu sgrub rje'i gsung 'di skor nus pa che bar ma zad dge bsnyen gyi spang bya lnga po nyin zhag gcig pa'i mtha' can du khas ma blangs shing / glu gar sogs khas blangs pa'i dbye tshul shin tu dka' la/ nyan thos kyi bsnyen gnas/ dge tshul slong gis blangs pa tshad thub gyi rigs la byung tshod mi 'dug pas paṇa chen bsod grags pa'i gsung de yang paṇa shāka pa ltar don zhags sogs nas bshad pa'i bsnyen gnas la dgongs pa 'dra/ sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'i khyim pas bsnyen gnas blangs pa bsnyen gnas yin la gso sbyong min pa mi 'thad rgyu med kyang yongs rdzogs dge (249na〉snyen gyis gso sbyong blangs pa de gang zag gam rten gyi drung du blangs na cho ga gcig pas bsnyen gnas ma yin pa'i mur 'gro don med pas cho ga med par yan lag brgyad spong snyam tsam gyis ni go chod na nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum spong snyam pa tsam gyis de dge slong du thal ba'i skyon yod cing / sdom pa gzugs can du 'dod pa'i lugs kyi yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyis —342

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)nyan thos lugs kyi gso sbyong blangs na gnyis kag stegs can yin bas/paṇa chen gnyis ka zhabs 'dred lhan cig tu shor/theg chen lugs la bsnyegs na dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gzugs can theg chen gyi bsnyen gnas shes par 'dod pas/ shes pa'i sdom pa blangs nas nyin zhag gcig spong bar khas blangs pasagazugs can gyi sdom pa ma shi bar du khas blangs pa la dang lung pa mi gcig pas gto me don yang mi 'dug cing / zhe 'dod de 'dras don zhags sogs gsung rab gzhan gyi bshad khungs la chu bun gyi tsho so rgya las ma 'das pas mi gsung bar gsol ba 'debs shing / bsnyen gnas ma yin la khyim pa'i gso sbyong yin pa'i cho ga theg pa gong ma rnams dang gtan nas ma 'dres pa'i nyan thos rang skad cig 'chad rgyu yod na dgongs ja bu ram dang bcas nyan par spro ba lags/ byang sems dang sngagasasdom thob pas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa de gnas 'gyur du 'dod pa'i lugs ltar na nyan thos kyi bsnyen gnas blangs pas khas blangs kyi ldog chas dge bsnyen gtong ngam kha gsor 'gro la dpyad rgyu zhig snang ngo / /mi bskyod rdo rje'i nyi ma chen por bsnyen (249bskonas dge bsnyen gyi gso sbyong yin gsung ba theg pa che chung gi dbye ba dod nas gsungs ma gsungs la the tshom 'dug cing / dgas rgyud pa'i rigasakyis lung rigs lod pa'i dam bca' med par na yams kyis gzhan zer tshig rjes 'brang bar mtha' ma bkag /kun mkhyen bu'i las choge tu 'di dge bsnyen rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gso zhing sdig pa spyong bas dge bsnyen gyi tshes brgyad sogs la rtag tu bsrung dgos shing dge bsnyen gyi gso sbyong yin pas gso sbyong zhes gsungs/ 'o na dge bsnyen min pas de mi byed dam zhe na/ mdzod du/gzhan la'ang bsnyen gnas yod mod kyi/ /skyabs su ma song ba la med/ /ces pas dge bsnyen ma yin pa gzhan gyis kyang dkon cog gsum la skyabs su song nas bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'dod na skye/skyabs su ma song na mi skye'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon byang chub bzang po'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobashad pa'i gzhung las kyang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang sgrel nas gsungs te/ ji skad du/ de lta bu 'di ni yan lag lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom par 'gyur ro/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa brgyad blang bar 'dod na nyi ma 'char ba'i sngon du de blang bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / des mtshon 'dul 'dzin la la bsnyen gnas de khyim pa'i gso sbyong yin pas dge bsnyen gyi blangs chog par bzhed pa snga rabs kyi bshad tshod mtha' dag la cha ma 'tshal mod/ chos rje bu ston rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa yongs grags yin pas nyan thos rang skad la de (250na skor blang rung ba'i khungs shig yod dam snyam pas/ kho bo'i mig dkyus thung ngus ma brnyed kyang dpyod ldan rnams kyis spyan gyi zur mda' rgyang ring du 'phen par zhu/ so thar rigs bdun gang thob kyang theg chen gyi bsnyen gnas len par tshul khrims phung po'i mdor/ /rigs brgyad sngon du song ba yis/ /nyin bzhin du ni gso sbyong blang / /'di ni tshul khrims rnam dag 'gyur/ zhes dang / don yod zhags pa las/ bcom ldan 'das gang yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong pha'am/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen pha'am/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ de las gzhan pa'i sems can su yang rung bas/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i ched du yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la smyung bar bgyis te/ gzhan mi smra bar don yod zhags pa'i snying po lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das des tshe 'di nyid la phan yon nyi shu rtsa gcig 'thob bar 'gyur te/ zhes dang / rje btsun rtse mo'i gzungs choge las/ de ltar mchod pa'ang gtor ma'i rjes la/ 'phags pa'i rjes su bzlas pa byed par bsam zhing rang gi gso sbyong gi tshig lan gsum brjod la bdag sdom pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /'di ni rab tu byung ba'i phyogs la'ang bya dgos te/ sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / zhes bya ba la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i lugs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / sman bla'i mdo chog las/ 'jam dpal g.yin yang 'khor gyi dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag dang /gzhan yang dad pa'i rigs kyi (250ba)bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i —344

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas te/lo gcig gam zla ba gsum du bslab pa'i gzhi rnams 'dzin/zhesasogs gsungs pas kyang shes nus so//gnyis pa cho ga dngos la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/dang po sbyor ba la/gnas khang byi dor byas/me tog phreng rgyud las/dga' ston dus tshe sku gzugs ni//rgan po'i gong du rtag tu bzhugs//sangs rgyas choge dang dge 'dun dang //'jig rten gsum snang khyab bdag yin//zhes slob dpon gyi mtha' logs su bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar mchod pa ci 'byor ba bshams/mdzod las/dma' bar 'dug smra bzlas pa yis//mi brgyan nam ni nang par sa/bsnyen gnas yan lag tshang bar ni//nang par gzhan las nod par bya/zhes bsgrub bya grangs su ma bcad pa ji tsam tsho gis pa dag khrus byas gos rgyan gsar mchod mi bya zhing /skya rengs mtha' ma shar ba'i lag ris mthong dus 'tsho gos te phyag lan gsum btsal/stan med pa'am dma' bar lus kyi spyod lam bus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sal btsugs shing /nad pa yin na spyod lam gang bde byas thal mo sbyar nas 'dug par bya'o//gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/mdo las/mir gyur pa yang rnyed par dka'/dal ba 'byor pa phun sum tsho gos pa yang rnyed par dka'/zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir mi'i lus dang /de'i nang nas kyang mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spang zhing /dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i mi'i 25na tshe rtsa sa rnam par dag pa 'di/bshes spring las/rgya mtsho gcig na gnya' shing bug pa dang /rus sbal phrad pa bsakyang dud 'gro las/mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/dam chos spyod pas de 'dras 'tshisapar mdzod//ces rgya mtsho chen po na gser gyi gnya' shing bug pa gcig pa dang /rus sbal long ba zhig yod pa lo brgya tsam na chu'i rlabs kyis gnya' shing de chu'i khar g.yeng ba dang /rus sbal de yang steng du 'ong ba gnyis 'phrad de phug par mgrin pa chud pa dper bzung nas mi khom pa'i gnas rnamasasu lus grangs med pa blangs pa'i mthar/dal 'byor gyi mi lus lan re tsam brnyed pa 'di chud ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pozos par gtan gyi bde 'bras bsgrubs nas snying po zhig len dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs rdzings lta bu ni mi lus te/ de la brten nas thar pa rin po che'i gling du bgrod par byed pa yin la/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa tsam gyis cho go gam snyam na/ bshes spring las/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub gnyid kyi log pa las/ /sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /zhes rlung gis bskyod pa'i chu'i lha ba ni skad cig la 'jig pa ltar tshe la snon pa nyung zhing 'grib byed bar ma chad du yod pa/ (252na〉nga khyim gru rdzings/ zas sogs gson rkyen rnams kyang 'gyel ba/ rdib pa/ mi 'phrod pa ste 'chi rkyen du song bas mtshon/ dbugs 'byung rngub dang gnyid log pa'i bar du mi 'chi bar sad rgyu yod pa ngo mtshar che bar gsungs shing / rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i tshangs cod ma las/ rnyed dka' don che'i dal 'byor thob pa yang / /stobs kyis mi bzlog 'bros par mi nus pa'i/ /stobs ldan 'chi bdag pho nya bkye ba dang / na dang rga bas zin par mthong na yang / /nam 'chi nges med 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /thams cad dor nas 'gro ba shes ba'i na du/ /lo zla zhag rnams don med 'da' byed pa'i/ /rab rmo mes bdag la brtse ba'i dus la bab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / spyod 'jug las/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ zhes da lta gzhen pa'i dus tshe 'di'i mdun bshoms byas nas nam phugs phyi ma'i bde ba sgrub snyam na de 'dra phar bzhag /do nub lta bu gza' gdong thug pa 'am/ g.yang du lhung ba lta bu glo bur ba'i rkyen zhig gis tshe'i dus byas nas sang gi gnas skabs su bar do'am/ da lta'i lus 'di dang dbyibs mi 'dra ba zhig tu mi skye ba'i nges pa med pas phyi bskol gyi dbang du ma song bar dal ba don ldan du bsgrub dgos te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mgo 'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ /de la bzlog phyir bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid —346

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /de bas ches mchogo dgos pa gas ma mchis/ /zhes tshe 'dir gces spras su bya yul ni lus yin la/ de la gnod pa'i me mgo (252na skong gos sogs la 'bar na de zhi bar byed pa'i thabs la spyir rigs med/ bye brag tu chos bsgrub pa'i bgegs su 'gro ba zhig 'dug na ldog byed de yang bgol te brtson pa chen pos bsgrub dgos par gsungs shing / bsgrub bya dam pa'i cho ge de yang dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ sbyin sogs chos gsum de dag phal mo che/ bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de nyid de//sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu/ /zhes pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nang nas sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa gsum yin zhing / de'i nang nas kyang tshul khrims ni/ sgo so skye bo rnams dang gsung skyes dang / /rang byang chub la bdag nyid nges rnams dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi nges par legs pa dang / / mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las ga' na med/ /ces mngone mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyu'i gtso bo tshul khrims bsrung ba la rag lus shing / de nyid las/ sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni 'gro ga na'ang // skye bo tshul khrims rkang pa nyams las 'byung / /zhes tshe rabs snga ma rnams su rgya cher btang bas mtshon/ bzod pa bsgom pa sogs phar phyin gzhan gyi tshogs ji tsam bsags pa'i 'brasabu lha mi'i rten la longs spyod pa'ang tshul khrims kyi rjes su 'gro zhing / tshul khrims ma bsrungs ba dang /nyams na gos bu dud 'gro sogs 'gro ba gzhan gyi rten la longs spyod dgos pas bslab khrims la gnas par rag lus la/ de la'ang 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ khyim pa'i sdom pa dang po gsum//zhes pa'i (252ba) nang tshan ji srid 'tsho bar du bsrung ba dge bsnyen pha ma'i khrims/ nyin zhag gcig gi bar du bsrung ba yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims dang gsum las/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni bya sla zhing phan yon shin tu che ba/ gnas 'jog gi mdo las/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu klung chen po lnga dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu bum pa'i grangs kyis bzung bar nus kyi/ bsnyen gnas kyi phan yon gyi tshad bzung bar mi nus shing / 'dzam bu'i gling gang ba'i dgra bcom pa la rin po che la sogs pa'i yo byad —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pothams cad sbyin pa'i bsod nams kyis bsnyen gnas kyi bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang mi 'gro/stong gi char yang mi 'gro/ zhes khrims lan cig blangs nas bsrungs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad gzhal mi nus par ma zad/ 'bras bu gnas skabs su lha mi'i rten bzang po rgyud mar 'byung zhing 'o skol gyi ston pa'i bstan pa la bsnyen gnas kyi khrims bsrungs pa la brten nas bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas lnga pa ma pham mgon pos 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'dus pa dang por skyes nas grol ba thob bar gsungs pa/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang / /de bzhin zla gcig tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /yan lag brgyad legs mnyam gzhag cing / /bsnyen gnas gso sbyong byas nas ni/ /nga yi bstan la lhags so zhes/ /don 'di rab tu gsung bar 'byung / zhes byung la/ de bas kyang ches lhag pa bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan brgya byin gyis/ /zla ba yar gyi tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la//bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrungs na/ (253na8 ni nga dang nga 'drar 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ko shi ka khyod de skad ma zer cig /zla ba yar gyi tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrungs na/ /de ni nga dang nga 'drar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / gnas skabs su yang sdom pa dang mi ldan pa dag gis rgya mtsho tsam gyi mar khu la ri rab dang mnyam pa'i sdong bu btsugs te mar me spar te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod pa bas sdom ldan zhig gis mar me chung ngu sbar te mchod pa bsod nams che bas mtshon te rnam dkar gyi las byas so cog gi 'bras bu 'phel che ba sogs rgyu mtshan sgo du mas tshul 'di la 'bad par rigs shing / phan yon de ldan gyi sdom pa len par byed pa la/ mdo rtsa bar/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po med par so so thar pa'i sdom pa mi skye'o/ /zhes sdom pa skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo nges 'byung gi bsam pa yin/ de gang gi sgo nas brda sprod pa/ mdo sdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gzhig la gcig —348

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanazas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / lung gzhin/ gang na mi gnas lha rnams mi bzang ngo/ /gang na zhi med srid pa mi bzang ste/ /'tsho ba thungs pa'i mi rnams mi bzang ngo / /mya ga 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes khams gsum gyi 'khor (253ba tha ni sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin te ga song gsum gyi nang nas tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe nye 'bor gyi dmyal ba sogs bzod dka' shin tu mang bas/ bshes spring las/ sems can nyes par spyod pa spyod rnams la/ /yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang / /bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogasapa'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ zhes dang / tshangs cod mar/ rab 'bar lcags kyis sa gzhir me lces bsreg cing lus la mtshon chas char pa 'bab/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus gsal zhing la bston zangs zhun sdud cing phur bus lce la 'debs/ /gangs ris bskor ba'i 'khyags pa'i sbubs chud bu yug 'tshubs pa'i rlung gis btab pa yis/ /la la chu bur brgya byung la lar rdol zhing lus ni tshal pa dum bur gas/ /zhes tsha grang gi sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par dka' zhing myong bya'i sdug bsngal de yang / bshes spring las/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /ra btu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la/ /'ol yang mi 'gro char yang mi phod do/ /zhes mi zhig gi lus la mdung thung sum brgya dus gcig la btab pa'i sdug bsngal gyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi char yang mi phod la/ sdug bsngal de ni yud tsam la tshe'i dus byed pasayun ring myong mi dgos shing / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni che yang yun ring po'i bar du myong dgos pa yang sos lta bur mi lo khrag khrig chen po gcig dang / khrag khrig drug dang / ther 'bum chen po gnyisayod pas mtshone te/ tsha dmyal rnams la rim (254na gyis log por 'phel zhing / grang dmyal yang mdzod las/ til rjang nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus bsgyur/ zhes tshe tshad la bsams na snying 'gas par 'gyur zhing / zhi ba —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)lhas/ lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /me tshogs 'di dag gang las byung / /des na de dag thams cad ni/ /sdig sems yin pa thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad sngon bsags kyi sdig pa'i las kyi 'byul snang du gsungs pas/ bshes spring las/ de ltar sdug bsngal na tu mi bzad lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sngon bsags kyi sdig pa'i las de ma zad kyi bar du sdug bsngal myong dgos par gsungs pas/ snang tshul de dag la dpags na/ de nyid las/ sdig can dbugs 'byung 'gag pa tsam zhig gi /dus kyi bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas gnam stong du/ /mi 'jigs gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs pa bskyed par gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ / rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs/ de las yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal chung yang / yang de nyid las/ yi dwags dag na'ang 'dod pas phongs pa yis//bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa/ /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis//bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad (254ba7sten 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / tshangs cod mar/ gdong ni skrasakhebs kha ni skams shing chu klung mthong ste btung phyir brgyugs pa na/ /ral gri mdung rnams thogs pa'i skyes bus 'gegs shing chu yang rnag khrag nyid du mthong / kha ni khyab kyi mig tsam sba bas mgrin 'gags zas sgom rnyed kyang spyod mi nus/ /zos shing 'thungs rnams 'bar nas tshig cing bshang gcis 'tsho la rang sha bcad de za/ /zhes phyi nang gi sgrib pa can bkres skom la brten pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu che zhing las kyi 'khrul snang gis mngone sum gyis grub pa rnams kyang go ldog pas/ bshes spring las/ yi dwags rnams la sos rka'i dus su ni/ /zla ba tsha la dgun ni nyi ma grang / /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur 'di dag gis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis klung yang skam par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs shing / sdug bsngal yun ring du myong dgos pa'ang / mdzod las/ yi dwags rnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ zhes —350

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)gsungs shing /bshes spring las/bar bcad med par sdug bsngal bsten gyur pa//nyes par spyod pa'i las kyi zhags pa ni//sra bas bcings pa'i lus can kha cig lo//lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs/de las cung zad chung ba'i dud 'gro yang /de nyid las/dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang //bcing dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tsho gos pa//zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni//gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang /sha dang pags pa'i ched du gsod par 'gyur//dbang med gzhan dag 255na ldag pa lag pa dang /lcag dang lcagasakyus btab pas btab ste bkol//zhes dang /tshangs cod mar/rmonges pa'i mun chen 'thibs pasalam dang lam min 'byed la blo yi nus pa bral//gcig la gcig gsod lha mi'i gzhan dbang gyur pas brdeg dang bkol ba'i sdug bsngal 'bab//ces dud 'gro la byings na gnas pa dang /kha 'thor ba rnams bsran par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu mang zhing tshe tshad kyang /mdzod las/dud 'gro rnams/mchog ring bskal pa'o/zhes ring ra dang /thung bar nges pa med par wo re kṣe la'ang skye 'chi byed pa yod/de ltar ga song gsum ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba de las bzhal tshe bde 'gro rnams ming dang don mthun ba'i bde ba la spyod pa yin na'ang mi rnams la/tshangs cod ma las/mi yi gnas na'ang longs spyod dbang phyug gis//mngon par mtho na nyams kyi dogs pa dang //mtho ris yon to 'byor bas phongs pa na//'dod bde 'tshol bar 'gyur bas sha thang ngo //bde bar 'dod nas de yi thabs bsgrubs pas//bde ba thob pa de las ches lhag pa'i//lus kyi sdug bsngal sems kyi yid mi bde//rnam pa du mas kun nas mnar bar 'gyur//zhes mi rnams la yang dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad kyis dogs pa/gnyen sdug pa dang bral gyis dogs pa/yod pa gsog bsrung /med pa 'tshol 'gro/khas drag po dma' por song ba/phyug po dbul por gyur pa/gtso bo dmangs su 'bab pa sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas shing /de 255bdag rnams/mdzod las/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loke'adi na ma nges tha ma ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ ces gsungs/lha ma yin ni/ bshes spring las/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ /dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ /de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so/ /zhes dang / tshangs cod mar/ lha rnams dpal la zhabrug pa'i phrag dog me chen 'bar bas yid bde'i go skabs bcom/ /'thab rtsod las byung lus bcad dral zhing g.yo sgyus bslad pas bden mthong skal med/ /ces lam rgyud lnga'i skabs lha min rnams dud 'gro dang lhar 'dren pa'i lugs gnyis yod na'ang / mi shin tu mi srun pa la mi ma yin zer ba ltar lha'i nang tshan nas bden pa mthong ba'i skal ba med pa sogs sgo du ma nas lha ma yin du btags shing / phrag dog gi dbang gis 'thab rtsod la brten nas lus bcad dral gtubs sogs brjod kyis mi lang zhing / 'dod pa'i lha rnams kyang bshes spring las/ /lus kyi kha dog mi sdug gyur pa dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog 'phreng rnyings dang / /gos la dri ma 'chags dang lus la ni/ /sngon chad med pa'i rdul 'byung zhes bgyi ba/ /mtho ris 'chi 'pho spron bgyid snga ltas lnga/ /lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'byung ste/ /sa steng mi rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba dag /spron par byed pa'i 'chi ltas rnams dang 'dra/ zhes dang / tshangs cod mar/ lusamadzes rin cen rgyan gyis rab brgyan nas/ khang bzang dga' ba'i tshal du gnas bcas shing / /yun ring 'dod pa'i bde la longs spyod pa/ /mtho ris dpal la rol (256na)pa'i lha rnams kyang / /mi 'dod 'chi ba'i ltas kyis zin pa na/ yid 'phrog snying la bcags par gyur pa yi/ /lha yi mdzes ma yid 'ong skyed mos tshal/ /bdud rtsi kha zas gos bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /lha bu gzhon nu rnams dang myur du bdag /mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral bar mthong ba'i tshe/ /gnas der skyes pa'i lus kyi bde ba las/ /ches cher lhag pa'i yid kyi sdug bsngal gyis/ /bskyed pa'i mya ngan me lce 'bar bas bsreg /tshe rabs mang por legs par spyad pa'i las/ /'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu spyad pas zad/ /bag med dbang gis ngan 'gro'i rgyu bsgrubs pas/ /slar yang ngan song gnas su ltung bar 'gyur/ /—352

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanazhes 'dod lha rnams lha'i bde ba phun sum tsho gos pa la longs spyod kyang /'chi ltas lnga dang nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga shar ba'i tshe ngan song gi gnas gzhan dag tu skye tshe ma skyes gong nas sdug bsngal nyams su myong zin pa lta bu'i tshor ba drag pos mnar bar 'gyur bas/mdo las/lha rnams 'chi bar gyur pa'i tshe//sdug bsngal 'byung ba ji snyed pa//mnar med sems can dmyal ba yi//bcu drug char yang mi phod do//zhes gsungs pa ltar bde 'gro ba rnams kyang zag bcas kyi bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal kho na las ma 'das/gzugs gzugs med kyi lha rnams la sdug bsngal mngon 'gyur ba de lta bu med kyang /tshangs cod ma las/'dod la 'dun pa'i rnam rtog gnod sems med/gnyid dang yid la gdungs pa'i spyod pa spang /lus dang sems la gnod pa'i sdug bsngal bral/ting 'dzin stobs kyisayun ring bder gnas 256ba pa//gzugs dang gzugs med lha yi gnas thob kyang //'du byed sdug bsngal 'ching las ma grol bas//sngon gyi ting 'dzin 'phen pa zad pa na//phyir yang 'og tu lhung nas rgyud mar 'khor//ces bsam gto dang gzugs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba kho nar stims klas kyang sngon gyi 'phen pa zad pa na/zo chun gyi 'byud mo ltar gnas 'og mar 'khor zhing sdug bsngal nyams su myong ste/mdor na lha mi'i dbang phyug rnams dang nyi zla la sogs pa'ang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhi sha stag yin pa'i phyir/bshes spring las/brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni//las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng lhung //'khor wa ba nyid du gyur nas ni//'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur//zhes dang /lha yul 'dod bde shin tu wo po dang //tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar//mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yis//sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo//nyi ma zla ba nyid thob rang lus//'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te//slar yang mun nag smag tu phyin gyur nas//rang gi lag pa brkyang ba'ang mi mthong 'gyur//zhes gsungs shing don hril gyisabasgril na khams gsum 'khor ba 'di skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/zad mi shes pa/gting mi dpogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6popa/ gnod pa dang 'jigs pa ya nga ba'i gnas de las pha rol tu brgal dka' bas rgya mtsho dang chos mtshungs pa ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can/ sdug bsngal gyi khong 'tshangs can yin pas 'khor ba nas cis kyang thar (257na〉bar byed snyam pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa thebs pa gal che/ de ltar bsam pa bskyed nas sdom pa skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas nas khas len dgos pas skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis/ rang yang 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yi/ /'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus/ /zhes tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug sogs gtso bo gsum gyis thog drangs 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams rang nyid 'khor ba las ma grol bas gtan gyi skyabs su mi rung la/ gtan gyi skyabs su 'os pa ni/ mdzod las/ gang zhig gsum 〈skyabs 'gro de/ /sangs rgyas dge 'dun byed pa'i chos/ /mi slob pa dang gnyis ka dang / /mya ngan 'das la skyabs su 'gro/ /zhes yul dkon cog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos pas/ cho ga thad so la bsam pa yar ldan du byas nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can rnams srid pa'i nyes brgya las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs/ sangs rgyas la skyabs ston pa po/ chos mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa 'gog pa'i bden pa la skyabs dngos/ dge 'dun la skyabs ston pa'i zla grogs zhu/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste/ sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa len/ spang bya yan lag brgyad spong ba'i bsnyen gnas par gzung du gsol snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyisarnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs(257ba)su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par btsun pas gzung du gsol/ lan gsum bzla ba dang sdom pa skye ba'i brda sprod pa sogs dge bsnyen kyi skabs ltar bya/ 'di ni bye brag smra ba rang lugs kyi sdom pa len tshul dngos bstan yin zhing / lan cig sdom —354

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanapa blangs nas rjes ma la brjed de zas zos zin nas dge slong zhig gi drung du sdom pa blangs na skye ba'i ho du dus 'di nas bzung ste zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dang /bco lnga dang /gnam gang la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par zhes cho ga bsgyur nas len/deng sang sdom pa lan cig 'di ltar phab nas rting ma rnams la rang nyid kyis ston pa'i sku gzugs kyi drung du len pa mdo sde pa'i lugs yin zhing /dus rtag tu sdom pa len yul gyi gang zag rnyed dka' zhing de ltar blangs pa la phan yon chen po 'byung bas gu yangs pa'i dbang du byas nas 'dul 'dzin rnams phyag len du mdzad do//mjug gi cho ga bshad pa/gsum pa 'jug gi cho ga ni/de ltar sdom pa thob pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog par bsrung dgos te/dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste//la la'i tshul khrimasaduḥkha yin/khrims khrims ldan pa bde ba ste//tshul khrims 'chal ba duḥkha yin//zhes dang /dge slong dag srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni bla yi/tshul khrims nyams shing 258na ton ga pa ni de lta ma yin no//de ci'i phyir zhe na/srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi/tshul khrims nyams shing zhig bas ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par lhung ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa ltar/tshul khrims nyams pa la brten nas mngon mtho dang nges legs la rgyab kyis phyogs te rtsa ba'i lhung ba byung na dmyal ba dang /yan lag gi lhung bas yi dwags dang dud 'gror skye ba sogs brnag par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal skye ba 'bum phrag tu myong bar gsungs shing /tshul bzhin bsrungs na lha dang mi'i srid pa rgyun mar 'dzin zhing de'i rten la legs par spyad pa'i mthus/mgon po klu sgrub kyis/mi yi chos lugs legs spyad pas//lha yul bgrod par thag mi ring //lha dang mi yi them skas la//'dzegs na thar pa gam na

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6ge'adug /ces ring por mi thogs par thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur la/ de ltar tshul bzhin du bsrung bar rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ zhes lag tu bstar rgyu de rang la lkog tu gyur na blang dor bya mi nus pas/ ji ltar ngosa'adzin na tshul khrims kyi yan lag /bag yod pa'i yan lag /brtul zhugs kyi yan lag dang gsum du 'dus/ dang po ni srog gcod/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ brdzun de bzhi spong ba'i bslab bya las/gtso bor zhe sdang gis bskyed (254)pa/ srog gcod pa ni rang las rgyud tha dad pa'i mi'5 mir chags pa rang nyid kyis dug dang rig sngags dang / mtshon gyis bsad pa'am/ g.yin gsod du bcug na sdom pa 'di rtsa ba nas 'jig pas rtsa ltung yin zhing / de'i char gtogs pa srog chags grog sbur yan chod/ srog dang phral na/ mi dge ba bcu'i nang tshan gyi srog gcod kyi las lam dngos gzhi rdzogs pas de byas na/ sdom pa de'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba'i yan lag gi nyes pa tsam yin pas srog gcod kyi mi dge ba mtha' dag bsrung / yo byad la chags pas bskyed pa/ ma byin par len pa ni gzhan gyi bdag tu bzung ba'i gser se ba bcu 'am de'i dod thug gi dngos po rku 'phrog thabs kyis phral ba sogs byas na rtsa lhung du 'gyur zhing / de'i char gtogs pa khab skud tsam yang brkus nas thob blo skyes na/ mi dge ba bcu'i nang gi ma byin len bslab bya dang 'gal ba'i yan lag gi nyes pa yin pas spang / sems can la chags pas bskyed pa mi tshangs par spyod pa ni rang gi mchis brang sogs kyi me'i sgo gsum gang rung du bcug reg nyams su myong ba dang / rang gi khyim thab tu blangs pa min pa la bgrod pa ni bgrod bya ma yin pa la bgrod pa de yin kyang / sbrum ma dang na ba dang sneng ba dang bcas par bgrod pa lta bu dus ma yin par bgrod pa/ dkon cog gi rten sogs kyi drung du bgrod pa ni gnas ma yin par bgrod pa/ kha dang bshang lam sogs su bgrod pa yan lag ma yin par bgrod pa ste/ log g.yem (259na tha zhi po de ni mi dge ba bcu'i nang tshan gyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rtsa lhung yin pas/ nges par bsrung zhing tha na chags sems kyis lta reg kyang spang / gtso bor gti mug gis bskyed 356

khrul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanapa 'du shes bsgyur te/rdzun du smra ba ni mi'i chos/bla ma zhes pa lha klu gnod sbyin sogs ma mthong bzhin du mthong ba dang /gtam 'dres par smra ba dang /bsam gtan gyi mnyam gzhag la brten pa'i mngon shes rtsa snyul med kyang yod do zhes smra ba/rgyun zhugs/lan cig phyir 'ong /phyir mi 'ong ba/dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bus mtshon te yon to khyad par can ma thob bzhin du thob par smras pasags gyi don go ba na rtsa lhung du 'gyur ṣka /de'i 4 gtogs pa gas bslu ba'i rdzun rdzo che phra gang smras kyang mi dge ba bcu'i nang 3 gyi rdzun du 'byung bas spang dgos/gnyis pa bag yod kyi yan lag ni/myos 'gyur chang spong ba ste/de la 'dul ba sum brgya pa ltar na/sbyar ba'i oṃ dang /bcos pa'i 4 gnyis/dang po ni/0 ba khos mnan par byas pa sbyar ba'i chang /zhes pa ltar/nas dang sa sogs btsos phabs btab bsnyal ba las byung ba'i chang ni sbyar ba'i chang zhes bya/gnyis pa ni/gos bu la sogs khu bar bcos pa ni/bcos chang rgyan chang bu ram chang 'drar bstan/ces pa ltar/rgun cha bur chang la sogs pa sems myos par byed pa ni bcos pa'i chang zhes bya'o//yang mdzod 'grel las/'bru'i chang ni zas las sbyar ba'i btung ba'o//sbyar ba'i chang ni rdzas las sbyar ba'i 259ba tshe ku cho ba'o zhes 'bru'i chang nas dang 'bras sogs kyi chang bu ram shing gi chang sogs la bshad pa mi mthun pa gnyis 'gyung ba bshad tshul tha dad pasa'adul bar rang bawo dang cas pa'i kha na ma tho ba so sor byas te rtswa'i rtse mo tsam yang 'thung mi rung bar gsungs la/mngon par rang gi garsā pos sems dbang du 'du na sems ma myos kyi bar du btungs kyang 'gal ba med par bshad pa gnyis phyogs 'di la lugs snga ma gnyis gtso che zhing desamatshon du ba rngub pa sogs bag med pa'i spyod lam mtha' dag spong dgos/gsum pa brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ni gar sogs phreng sogs kyi yan lag/mal che mtho'i yan lag/phyi dro'i kha zas spong ba'i yan lag dang gsum gyi dang po nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangasate glu len gar brtse ba rgyun gyi 'dogs gyon byed bzhin pa min pa'i rgyan gos gsar pa dang mdzes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logeched du dri bzang lus la byug me tog dang rin po che'i phreng ba sogs sgeg chos rnams bsrung /gnyis pa ni gser dngul sogs rin po che'i khri chen po dang khru gang yan chad kyi khri mthon pos chags sems kyis 'dug nyal spong / gsum pa ni/ zan dron/ 'bras chan/ sha /nya sha /snum 'khur te/bza' ba lnga char gtogs skyo ma/ lde gu/ thug pa sogs dang / la phug dang nyung ma lta bu rtsa ba/ bu ram shing lta bu sdong po/ la phug yungs kar gyi lo ma lta bu 'dab ma/ padma utpal sogs me tog /rgun 'brum kham star sogs 'bras bu ste/ bshad ma thag pa rnams phyi dro'i kha zas yin pas spang dgos te ji skad (260na'i/ rang gling skya rengs dang po sogs bzung nas/ /nyi ma phyed bar 'di ni dus yin te/ /de yol gang zhig dus rung za byed de/ /nyes byas lcags gi gong bu'i zas rnams za/ /zhes 'byung bas gling ni gnas pa dang skyes pa gnyis las/ gnas pa gtso che ste dper na nub gling lta bur phyin tshe de'i nyi ma'i phyed yol na za mi rung bas shes nus shing / dus yol nas kyang za rung ba 'bru mar dang zhun mar dang sbrang bur bsgar ba ka ra lta bus ni zhag bdun pa'i sman yin pas bsten rung / zhes dang yan lag brgyad po 'di spangs pa'i phan yon kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ srog gcod spangs pas rdo rje'i lus dang ldan par 'gyur/ ma byin len spangs pas sen mo ring zhing dra bas 'brel/'dod log spangs pas dbang po tshang zhing lus rgyas/ rdzun du smra ba spangs pas lces gdong pa khebs pa/chang spangs pas seng ge'i stabs kyis gshegs pa/ dus ma yin pa'i zas spangs pas tshems bzhi bcu ma nyams shing dkar ba/ phreng sogs spangs pas lus la tshul khrims kyi spos kyis byugs/ gar sogs spangs pas lus mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan par 'gyur/ khri stan che mtho spangs pas stan gsum la sbyor bar 'gyur/ dkon cog gsum dang mkhan slob la yan lag lnga sa la gtugs te phyag byas pas dbu'i gtsug tor dang ldan par bshad pas/ de ltar dgra bcom pa rnams kyis spang (260ba)bya brgyad bo 'di yid kyi sgo nas spangs/ lus ngag gis slar log pa bzhin du bdag gis kyang sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bsnyen gnas kyi spang bya brgyad char gtogs dang bcas pa yid kyis spangs te/ lus ngag 358

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanagis slar ldog snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/srog gcod nga las slar log pa de bzhin du/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas//dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o//yan lag dang bo 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo//rjes su bsgrub bo//rjes su bgyid do//gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len ba dang/mi tshangs par spyod pa dang /rdzun du smra ba dang /'bru'i chang dang /bcos pa'i chang /myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang /glu gar dang /rol mo'i sgra dang /phreng ba dang /spos nyug pa dang /rgyan dang kha dog lang ba dang /khri yā mthon po dang /khri stan wo po dang /dusam yin pa'i kha zas spangs te dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'a nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du ma byin par len pa dang /mi tshangs par spyod pa dang /rdzun du smra ba dang /'bru'i 261na slong dang bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang /glu gar dang /rol mo'i sgra dang /phreng ba dang /spos nyug pa dang /rgyan dang /kha dog 'amang ba dang /khri stan mthon po dang khri stan chen po dang /dus ma yin pa'i kha zas spangasate dus ma yin pa'i zas las slar ldog par bgyi'o//yan lag brgyad pa 'dis bdag 'phags ba dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo//rjes su bsgrub bo//rjes su bgyid do//thabasayin no//legs so zhes brjod/phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug la rang gnas su btang ngo //ring nas tshogs gnyis sprin gyi zegs rdul nyer brtsegs chos gzugs gangs can sa 'dzin las//ma smad thugs rje'i chu klung rnam bzhi chad med 'gro blo'i dad mtshor legs babs pas//yid srubs sder bcas snying dbus rab 'bar byin za'i rtse mo lha yi lam bsnyeg kyang //myang 'das bsil ba'i bde bar sbyar tshe khyod zhabs ris bral gtsug ༷sten shākya'i rgyal/gang gis ljags yangs ma la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poya nas tshul gnas bslab pa'i tsan dan ngad/ /'phags bod kun tu 'dren mkhas dri bzhen 'dul 'dzin rim par byon rnams kyis/ /skal bzang 'gro mkhar 'phrin las nyin 'byed khrims kyi lag len 'od zer gyis/ bstan pa'i pad tshal rnam par bzhad las rgyal rnams dgyes mchod sbrang rtsi dngar/ /sā la'i ljongs 'dir snga phyi bar dar so thar cho ga yi/ /phyag (261ba tha zhes 'khrul med bdud rtsi dpang gyur mkhas mang thugs mtsho nas/ /nyer 'thon thar 'dod lha yi bcud len brlang spyod sgra gcan tshogs/ gtan bde'i mgrin pa chad kyang mtho ris srog gi zungs su gyur/ khyad par kha che'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa'i/ /bzhed srol chu klung log rtog rnyog ma'i dris/ /sbags rnams rnam dag cho ga ke ta das/ /bsrungs tshe myang 'das bzhin ras ci yang gsal/ /blos byas ra gan nyes bshad gser chu yis/ /nyer sbags rmongs pa'i tshong 'dus gzhi mdo mā /bkram nas phan bde'i nor 'phrog chom rkun ding / /dbyar gyi srin bu'i grangs 'khur mchi ma bku/ /bdag bde na bun yongs bral lhag bsam gangs/ /dkar min rang 'dod dzo ri bsnyil ba'i khrod/ /sdig 'bras rnga ma gyen slong 'byong g.yag rwa//gnas ngan len sgo 'bigs la gdengs pa bzhin/ /lnga phrag drug par thub bstan slebs pa'i gtam/ /snyan gyi bu ram dngar yang so thar sdom/ /'bogs byed cho ga bam myag rul ba'i dris/ /dad dung sems kyi sna sgor 'khrun des nongs/ /bden tshig dbyar rnga 'byog po'i sprin rum nas/ /bsgrag tshe gzhan sems bsrung nus rma bya'i mngal/ /'dzin yang sdig lta'i ngan spyod skyin thang gis/ /'dul bstan lo tog rtsad nas phyung gis dogs/ /pha mes phor gtsang mas bcag dzo ru'i snod/ /bzang 'dzin blo yi dri ma dbyangs can chus/ /bkrus pas lung don rigs lam nas (262na tsher dren par/ /rjes su 'brang pa gzur gnas rangs pa'i yul/ /kun mkhyen bus kyang thams cad mgu ba'i thabs/ shes pa'i blo gros phra zhes thugs 'byung na/ /rmongs bdag mi smra'i brtul zhugs ma bzung bas/ /tsu ta'i yul gyi rkang gnyis bsgrub pa bzhin/ /rnam dag khrims 'dzin mkhas che glang po'i snar/ /bag yod lcags kyus rab btab gom 'gros kyis/ /nges legs lam bgrod myang 'das shā li'i tshal/ /yangs por spyod pa'i sa —360

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanamakhan gcig tu rmad/ /zang zing 'khor dang snyan grags ched min par/ /thub dbang ring lugs byi dor byar sems blo/ /rdul bral ston gyi bco lnga'i zla ba'i ngos/ /ri dwags gzugs shar mig gsum pas mi khebs/ /bsod nams byas pa'i sa bon lhag bsam chus/ /skyed du bsrings pa rnam mkhyen yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bde skyid ro bdar spyod la lus can kun/ /legs bris tshogs bshul rkang rjesagasal nus shog /bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /'dzam gling skye rgu'i legasabyas mchode stong cher/ /nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol mig gi mtshan par shes/ /snga nas ma brnyed bar du g.yo med shog /dras drubs gos sogs phra mo'i bcas pas kyang / 'i ka thub tshems dkar 'phreng mdzes ston byed pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs yid bzhin nor/ /srid zhi'i rgyal mtshan tog tu 'bar bar shog khyud dul nang rtags phyir shar ngur smig gis/ /nges par klubs pas rnam dag (262bcu ga yi/ bslab gzhin 'gro mang bkod pa kun bzod ma'i/ /dpal mo'i mngal khur brjed dang ldan par shog /chos la dbang za mgrin bzang gzig shun can/ /ma yin thub gsung snying gi gces nor du/ /'chang ba'i bstan 'dzin dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / /g.yung drung srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /khrims gnyis gser shing mchog dman gnya' ba mā /rab lci gnam bskos mi bdag sku tshe dang / /chab srid dga' ba brgya ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /pho brang chen po'i 'dun sar dar drag shog /'jig rten gsum gyi rgud mun nyer sangs mthar/ /phan bde'i nyi ma bod yul dgung sngon nas/ shar ba'i dge legs snang ba 'od po che/ /sum rtsen yongs dbang dpal la 'gran nus shog /grags skam smig ma'i tshal du skyes tsam ma yin par/ rnam dpyod mes smin gzhen nu'i lus can rgan po'i blo/ /mkhas mang 'chi med 'dun sar bgrod la spobs mtho bas/ /srid zhi'i legs pa'i cha kun ding bsags dngom par shog /thub gzhung thig le mchog mar rjes chags sde bzhi'i zhal sgo'i rigasabyed las/ /rgyal bstan 'jig rten gsum du snang sprul phan bde'i 'od kyis mu bzhi'i lha/ /ragasapa'i gzugs su mngon sum mthong la mya ngan med dang mes dbon gyi/ /rnam thar dkon cog mthus—361

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pospyon snyan grags srid pa'i khongs las brgal bar shog /ces 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin bo che'i rtsa bar gyur pa dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sdom pa rab tu byung ba dang khyim pa rnams kyis thob par byed pa'i zlo ga 'brul spong rnam rgyal gser (263nasgo dog ces bya ba 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i gdan sa zhe gsum pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bka' bstsal zhing / /ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang dkon cog nyi ma/ rgyal ba'i sras po shes rab 'phel ba'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ gnas rnying chos rje kun dga' bde legs kyi rnam sprul ngag dbang kun dga' bde legs/ shar pa chos rje dge 'dun grags pa/ byang pa chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ rgyal legs bshad gling dang khyab bdag bla ma pha bong kha pa'i gdan sa pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ khal kha dza ya paṇḍita khu thug thu/ skyid shod chos rje'i sku skye ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ snar thang mkhan po kong po ngag dbang bkra shis sogs don gnyer can mang pos 'bad pa chen pos bskul ba dang / sdom gsum las/ blun po sbyangs pa chung ba rnams/ /'di 'dra spyod pa bden mod kyi/ /mkhas pa sbyangs par rlom pa yang ri bong 'chal bzhin 'di la spyod/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can 'phel gyur na/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod mi gnod/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod la smyos/ /gal te 'di 'dra'i chos log gis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mi gnod na/ /mu stegs sogs kyi chos log kyang / /sangs rgyas bstan la ci ste gnod/ / ces dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brangs pas bstan pa la mi phan par ma zad bstan pa dri bcas su byed la/dbang rnon chos (263ba)kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin legs par dpyad nas yid gtan du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ de nyid las/ bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa la//mi phyed pa yi dad pa yod/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /'khrul par spyod la bdag ma dad/ces gsungs pa ltar/ bstan pa rin po che dri ma dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyi kun nas blangs te cho ga gzhag pur ma bltos par rigs bral mkhas pa mang po'i gsung —362

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / 9)rab la dpyad de blo gsal rnams go ba bskyed pa'i ched du mtha' gcod dang bcas te 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu ngur smig gar gyi rnam par rol ba rje btsun dkon cog chos 'phel gyi bka' drin la brten nas gzhung lugs 'di la thos bsam cung zad bgyis shing / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan nye bar 'khor gnyis pa mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por bstan pa rin po cher yongs su zhugs la bka' drin nos pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am ming gzhan tshangs sras bshad pa'i rdo rjer 'bod pas 'o skol gyi ston pa zas gtsang gi sras gtsang gi sras po/ drag po zhes pa lcags sprel la sku bltams nas lo nyis stong drug brgya so dgur slebs pa stod 'grel ba'i lugs la a thesi zhes pa phyogs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa gyi yi zhes pa sa mo lug gi lo/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i dbang du byas na sbal ti dgra bcom pa dang / 'dul 'dzin (264na)skyor mo lung pa rnams rten 'brel mdo 'grel gyi rjes su ngas nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug la lo 'go /kha che paṇḍita chen po shākya shrī bha dra rjes 'brangs jo bo stan gcig pa rnams mdo nyi snying gi rjes su 'brangs nas hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu drug la lo 'go /rje btsun sa skya pa dang / mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa sogs 'dul 'dzin phyi ma mang po zhig mngon pa mdzod kyi rjes su 'brangs nas hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug la lo 'gor mdzad pa'i lugs gsum las phyi ma nyid grags che bas/ 'dul mngon pa lugs kyi lo 'go thog mar tshes shing dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa zung 'jug gi go 'phangs mngon du mdzad pa'i dus dran gyi tshe gangs can gyi lte ba pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa dpal grong sngags ram pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa so so thar pa rigs brgyad kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo// //—363—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poso thar gyi tshul khrims la dga' ba'i dpyod ldan tshogs la phan byed nyung ngu rnam gsal sgron ma bzhugs so/ /na maḥ sa spru dzñā ya/ grangs med bskal ba'i dga' tshal yangs par rmad byung tshogs gnyis sa bon 'bras/ /dri med smon lam drod gsher gyis smin mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i shing / /chos phung bye ba'i yal 'dab stug po'i phan dang bde ba'i grib bsil la/ /'gro ba kun gyi ngal gso bla med thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal gyur cig /thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras po des/ /legs gsungs 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs nor bu'i dbya/ /lung rig shing rta bzang pos 'dren mkhas pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas grub lo paṇa tshogs la 'dud/ /blo gros rab yangs mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar/ /snyan grags rgyud mang glu dang lhan cig tu/ /thub bstan do rar sgyur mdzad tsong kha pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po gtsug na mdzes/ /srid 'dir ches dkon legs bshad lus phra'i bzhin/ /mkhyen dpyod mchog gi me long ngos shar ba'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi zur mig dkyus ring gis/ /skal bzang gzhen nu'i dga' ston 'phel la 'dud/ /gang de'i lar rtsod rtsom pa'i nyi zer gyis/ /thub bstan 'dab stong rnam par ba 'ad pa na/ /bsngags (2na tharjod snyan pa'i glu dbyangs 'khrol ba dang / /lhan cig lag pa'i ku mud snying khar zum/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi/ /drin las bdag 'dra'i blo gros chos phras kyang / /'dul ba'i gzhung lugs smra ba'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /mi zad spobs pa'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho/ /gsung rab mang por dpyod pa'i 'od dkar can/ /blo gros rlung gis 'dren par nus min pa'i/ /dang po'i las can mi shes mun pa'i tshogs/ /sel byed nyung ngu rnam gsal sgron me spar/ /de la 'dir 'o skol gyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis dang por byang chub —364

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar rdo rje gdan gyi spo la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ 'gag pa med pa yan lag drug cu'i gsung gis thog mar lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa'i gdul bya rnams la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sgo nas smin grol gyi lam la bkod par mdzad pa'i gsung rab thams cad bsdu na sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'du ba'i ya rgyal lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa brjod byar byed pa 'dul ba'i sdosnod ni/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i (2ba〉ko 'phang don du gnyer ba rnams kyis thos bsam sgom pas gtan la dbab par bya ba'i gnas yin te/ ji skad du/ bshes springs las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes dang 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang / /mthar thug 'bras bu byang chub gsum/ /thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis so so thar/ /mnyan pa'i phyir na 'bad par bya/che'i/so/ /gzhung lugs 'di'i brjod bya ni/ sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba/ nyams na phyir bcos pa/ /thun mong du mkho ba las kyi rnam gzhag dang bzhin 'dus pa las/ skabs 'dir bshad par bya ba ni mi nyams par bsrung bar byed tshul yin/ de la gzhan la brten pa/ rang la brten pa/ mi mthun phyogs ngo shes pa/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba/ bde bar gnasapa'i rkyen bsten pa dang lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ mi mthun phyogs ngo shes pa dang / bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen brten pa gnyis kyi don gnyer mkho rags rim tsam 'bri ba la/ spang bya mi mthun phyogs ngosa'adzin pa dang / bde bar gnas pa'i mthun pa'i rkyen bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ pham pa sogasadangos bstan dge slong la sbyor ba ma gtogs bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa rnams la ma bshad kyang / 'dra mtshudas kyi sgo nas so sor grangs mang nyung gi spang bya yod pas/ da ltar gyi cho gas nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa la sdom gsum rim gyis nod dgos pas/ khyim pa'i phyogs kyi —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pospang bya dang / rab tu byung ba'i spang bya (3na)gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying por/ sna gcig sna 'ga' phal cher spyod/ /yongs rdzogs spyod dang tshangs spyod dang / /skyabs 'gro tsam gyi dge bsnyen du/ /zhes rnam grangs mang du gsungs kyang / yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi spang bya ni/ srog gcod/ma byin len/ log g.yem/ brdzun smra/ chang 'thung ba rnams yin no/ /skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi skabs su dgos pa'i bslab bya/ phyi rol pa'i lha la skyabs su mi 'gro ba/ grogs mu stegasacan dang mi 'grogs pa/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spong ba rnams ni/ 'dir ma zad bar ma sogasaskyabs 'gror khas blangs pa thams cad la dgos so/ /gnyis pa rab byung gi spang bya la/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang / rdzogs pa gnyis/ dang po la/bar ma dang / dge tshul gnyis las/ dang po la/ dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro 'dor ba/ mkhan slob la ma gus pa byed pa/ khyim pa'i rtags len pa/ rab byung gi rtags sbong ba rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ dngos bstan spang bya rags gtogs bcu bshad pa dang / shugs la so sor phra zhib kyi sgo nasadabye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i lhung ba bzhi'i steng du chang / gar sogs/ phreng sogs/ mal stan che mtho/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas/ gser dngul len pa rnams yin no/ /'di'i steng du bar ma'i bzhi bsnan pas rtsa ba'i spang bya bcu bzhin bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ srog gcod kyi pham 'dra'i char gtogasapa/ dud 'gro gsod pa/ srog chags gnas pa'i chu la 'debs pa/ de la spyod pa/ ma byin len gyi char gtogs/ khang pa/ khang chen/ rin po che (3ba〉pa khab ral byed pa/ mi tshangs spyod kyi char gtogs/mtshan mi mthun pa dang lhan cig nyal ba/ brdzun smra'i char gtogs/ gzhi med/ bag tsam/ dge 'dun dbyen/ de rjes phyogs/ khyim sun 'byin pa/ shes bzhin du brdzun smra ba/ zhal ta ba la longasaspyod cung zad sbyin pa la bshes ngor skur ba 'debs pa/ zhal ta ba la 'phya ba/ zas cung zad tsam la chos ston no zhes skur ba 'debs pa/ lhag ma'i skur ba 'debs pa/ bslab pa khyad du gsod pa/ bzhi ga'i char gtags pa/ gso sbyong / dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye/ gnas kyi slob dpon bsten pa rnams—366

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)las bzlog pa ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis po 'di gong ma'i steng du bsnan pas char gtogs kyi sgo nas sum cu rtsa drug /yan lag drug gi nang tshan rol mo'i sgra/ rgyan 'dogs pa/ spos byug pa/ kha dog 'chang ba bzhi po logs su bgrangs pas/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas bzhi bcur dbye'o/ /de dag kyang bsdu na tshul khrims/ bag yod brtul zhugs kyi yan lag gsum du 'du zhing / 'di dag gi los don rnams gib par bshad na blo dman rnams mgo bo 'khor bar 'gyur bas 'jigs te re zhig de tsam mo/ /gnyis pa dge slong gi spang bya la/ lhung ba sde lnga las/ dang po pham pa'i sde tshan la bzhi yod pa'i/ 1 mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa ni/ pho mo ma ning mi dang dud 'gro sogs gang gi'ang / gson po'am lus phyed du logs pa'i ro lta bu'i kha/ bshang lam zag byed gsum po gang rung du nor bu bcug cing reg pa las byung ba'i bde ba rdzogs par nyams su myong ba na mi tshangs pa spyad pa'i pham par 'gyur te/sa rga lhas/ kha shun sodang pags rim las/ /nor bu 'das na phas pham ste/ zhes so/ /'dis mtsho ni te/ gong 'og (4na lo mas cad du gleng gzhi/ /nyes dmigs/ gos bu/ bsam pa/ sbyor ba/ mthar thug sel ba/ lhung med/ bslab bya sogs nib par yod na'ang / blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnamasakyis rtsod dus kyi kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston chos rje dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gleng 'bum chen mo sogs sngon gyi mkhas pa'i yig cha che chung rnams la bltas pas shes par 'gyur la/ skabs 'dir blo kha dma' ba rnams la tshig nyung ba'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa tsam byas pa yin no/ /rna ma byin len gyi pham pa ni/ gzhan gyi dngos po rin thang tshang ba rang gis dngos su brkus pa'am gzhan nur bcug pa'o/ /rin thang gi tshad ni rgya gar du 'gron bu bzhi brgya kursha pa ṇa'i bzhi cha'i sgo yin la de dang mnyam pa'i dngos po brkus pa la bshad de/ ji skad du/ kārsha pa ṇa'i bzhi cha brkus/ de brkus tshul khrims zhig par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bod du mu ge med pa'i tshe nas khal gcig tsam dang / mu ge byung ba'i tshe nas khal phyed tsam gyis kyang longs par mngon/ gtso bo ni yul so so'i —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorarin thang gi skabs thob rtsi dgos par sems so /3 srog gcod kyi pham pa ni/ mi'am mngal du yod pa'i mer mer po la sogs pa mtshon dug rig sngags sogs kyis bsad pa'o/ /gzhan gsod du bcug kyang rung ste/ mdzod las/ dmag la sogs pa don gcig phyir/ /thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/ zhes so/ /4 brdzun du smra ba'i pham pa ni/ mi'i rten la bsgrub par sla ba'i chos ma yin pa/ de dag gi gong ma'am bla ma lta bur gyur pa'i yon tan zhig ma thob bzhin du thob ces smras pa ste/ dper na lha ma mthong bar lha mthong zhes pas mtshon te/ rang nyid sangs rgyas ma yin par sangs rgyas (4ba〉kyi khas len pa mngon shes dang grub rtags sogs med bzhin du yod par khas 'che ba sogs kyang 'di'i grangs su 'gro zhing / dus dbang 'gas 'byung nye bar snang ngo / /sgrib pa lnga ni mi'i chos yin la/ de zad par byas pa ni de'i gong ma ste/ ji skad du/ 'dir ni sgrib pa rnam pa lnga/ /mi rnams kyi ni chos su thos//de zad bla ma'i chos su 'dod/ ces so/ /gnyis pa dge 'dun lhag ma la bcu gsum yod pa'i/ /5 khu ba 'byin pa'i lhag ma ni/ g.yin gyi kha/ bshang lam/ zag byed gsum gang rung ma yin pa'i lus kyi cha shas sam/ rang gi sor mo lta bus khu ba 'byin pa'o/ / 6'dzin pa'i reg pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ chags sems kyis bud med kyi sha rjen pa la reg pa'o/ /7 'khrig tshig smra ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ chags sems kyis kun nas bslang ba'i bud med la 'khrig tshig sogs btsog gtam sna tsho gis smra ba'o/ /8 bsnyen bkur bsngags pa 'a dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ chags sems kyis bud med la 'khrig pas bsnyen bkur na legs so 'iXs bsngags pa brjod pa'o/ /6 smun byed pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ 'phrin lan gsum bskyal ba'i sgo nas sngar mi mthun pa'i skyes pa dang bud med 'khrig pa bsten pa la mthun par sbyar ba'o/ /'di ni rang gi dngos su ma byas par g.yin byed du bcug kyang rung te/ /ji skad du/ rang ngam gzhan byed 'jug kyang rung / /—368

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabud med skyes pa phrad na ni/ /dge 'dun lhag ma'i ral gri yis/ /rang gi mgo ni gcod par byed/ /ces so/ /10 khang pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ gzhi ma dag pa'i sar rang don du tshad las 'das pa'i khang pa brtsigs pa'o/ /11 khang chen gyi dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ gzhi dang dngos po ma dag pas dge slong bzhi yan chad kyi don (5na'i khang pa brtsigs pa'o/ khang pa'i tshad ni ldang pa na lag mi 'thogs pa/ nyal na rkang lag brkyangs bskums mi 'thogs pa/ 'gro na phyogs rer gom pa gsum gsum bgrod thub pa sdod na skyil krung bca' ba la mi gnod pa'o/ /12 gzhi med kyi lhag ma ni/ dge slong gzhan la pham pa'i mthong thos dogs gsum med bzhin du sgro btags nas skur ba btab pa'o/ /13bag tsam gyi dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ dge slong gzhan la skur ba 'debs pa'i gzhi bag tsam yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas pham pa'i skur 'debs byas pa'o/ /14 dbyen byed pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/dge 'dun gyi dbyen gyi gzhi la zhugs pa la/ dge slong gzhan gyis byed pa la lan gsum bar du bzlog kyang mi nyan pa'o/ /15 de rjes phyogs kyi dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa de'i grogs dge slong gzhan gyis byed pa la lan gsum gyi bar du bzlog kyang mi nyan pa'o/ /16 khyim sun 'byin pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ spyod pa ngan pas khyim bdag dge 'dun pa la dad pa bzlog par byas pa na/ de'i nyes pas rang bskrad pa na sgrod pa po'i dge 'dun la skur ba 'debs par/ gzhan gyis bzlog kyang mi nyan pa'o/ /17 bka' blo mi bde ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ rang nyid la lhung ba byung ba la gzhan gyis gleng ba na dang du mi len pa'i bka' blo mi bde ba ste g.yin gyis bzlog kyang mi nyan pa'o/ /spang lhung sum cu la/ 18 'chang ba'i spang ba ni/ chos gos kyi rgyur ma bsngos pa'i khru gang gi tshad du longs pa yan chad kyi gos rang nyid dbang ba byin gyis ma brlabs par zhag bcu ma rdzogs kyi bar du 'jog pa'o/ /19 'bral ba'i spang ba ni/ chos gos rnam gsum dang nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi bar du bral ba'o/ /20 zla 'jog gi spang ba ni/ chos gos kyi rgyur bsngos (5ba)pa khru tshad du longs—369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67/shing 'khor gsum mi khebs pa'i gos byin gyis ma brlabs par zla ba gcig gi bar du 'chang ba'o/ /gos byin gyis ma brlabs par zhag bcu 'das pa'i bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar ba'i dus gos de la brten pa'i zhag bcu 'chang ba'i ltung ba 'byung bar ma zad de'i rjes su rnyed pa'i zhag bcu ma song ba zhig la yang / shan stobs kyis zhag bcu 'chang ba'i lhung ba 'byung ba dang / thog mar zla 'jog gi lhung ba 'byung ba'i gos zhig rnyed pa'i rjes su chos gos yongs rdzogs rnyed na zhag bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar ba'i tshe/ snga mas zhag bcu 'chang ba'i ltung ba skyed nus pa sogs shan gyi skor rnam grangs mang bar yod kyang / phra zhib kyi rigs pa mang na/ las dang po ba rnams su ma zad mthon po'i go sar snyeg pa'i 'gying bag can mang po la'ang khab mig tu mdzub mo tshud par mi 'dug pas re zhig de tsam mo/ /21 chos gos zhakhyur 'jug gi spang ba ni/ rang gi nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma la gos rnying pa 'brur bcug pa'o/ /22 gos len pa'i spang ba ni/ rang la chos gos rnam gsum yod bzhin du 'khor gsum khebs pa'i tshad du longs pa'i gos nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma la bslangs pa'o/ /23 slong ba'i spang ba ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la bshad ma thag pa ltar bslangs pa'o/ /24 slong ba rigs pa slong ba'i spang ba ni/ chos gos rnam gsum med pa'i dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs zung gcig las lhag pa bslangs pa'o/ /25 spags pa slong ba'i spang ba ni/khyim pa nye du ma yin pas blos gang spogs kyis sbyin pa las lhag pa'i bzang po zhig dgos zhes bslangs ba lta bu'o/ /26 so so nas spags pa slong ba'i spang ba ni/ khyim (6na tshe khog nas thun mong du phul ba dang pho mo gnyis so sor phul ba'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /27 bskur ba'i spang ba ni/ gos nyo ba'i rin gyi rin po che zhal ta ba la gtad nas lan gsum gyi bar du bskul ba dang lan gsum gyi bar du mthong sar bsdad pa las lhag pa'i gos blangs pa'o/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa la/ 22 srin bal gyi stan gyi spang ba ni/ srin bal kho na las grub pa'i 'khor gsum khebs pa'i mtha'i tshad du longs pa'i stan byed pa'o/ /29 bal nag gi stan gyi spang ba —370

'dul ba'i las cho go rnam rgyal gser mdog / 'dini/ bal nag po 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i stan tshad gong dang 'dra ba'o/ /30 cha gnyis bsres pa'i spang ba ni/ stan la cha bzhin bgos pa'i cha gnyis las lhag pa bal nag gis byas pa'o/ /31 lo drug gi spang ba ni/ lo drug gi bar du longs spyad rgyu'i rang la stan yod bzhin du stan gsar pa ched du byasapa'o/ /32 mtho gang gi spang ba ni/ gding ba gsar pa grub pa'i tshe/ rnying pa nas bde bar gshegasapa'i mtho gang gi tshad tsam zhig ma glan par dor ba'o/ /33 lam du bal thogs pa'i spang ba ni/chags sems kyis kun nas bslang ste bal la sogs pa'i khur chen po khur nas nyi ma gcig gi rgyang grags las 'das pa phyin pa'o/ /34 bal 'khrur 'jug pa'i spang ba ni/ rang gi nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma la bal 'khrud pa dang khel ba dang 'tshed du 'jug pa'o/ /35 rin po che la reg pa'i spang ba ni/ chags sems kyi sgo nas gser la sogs pa'i rin po che la reg pa'o/ /36 mngon mtshan can gyi spang ba ni/ chags sems kyis nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la gser la sogs pa khye spogs byed bcug pa'o/ /37 nyo tshong byed pa'i spang ba ni/ rin po che ma yin pa'i dngos po (6ba bzhan la khye spogs byed pa'o/ /bcu tshan gsum pa la/ 38 lhang bzed zhag bcu 'chang spang ni gos dang 'dra/ 39 nyung bzed lhag po 'tshol ba'i spang ba ni/ rang la lhung bzed yod bzhin du khyim pa nye du ma yin pa la lhung bzed 'bad pas btsal ba'o/ /40 thags 'thag tu 'jug pa'i spang ba ni/ khyim pa nye du ma yin pa la gla rngan ma byin par thags 'thag tu bcug pa'o/ /41 'thag pa bskyed pa'i spang ba ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pas thags btags nas rang la ster bar khas blangs pa na 'thag mkhan la gla rngan byin nas sbyin bdag gi blo dang mi 'tsham pa'i bzang rin chen po 'thag tu bcug pa'o/ /42 byin 'phrog gi spang ba ni/ dge slong gzhan la dngos po byin pa slar phrogs pa'o/ /43 brtad pa las byung ba'i spang ba ni/ dbyar gyi rnyed pa dbyar mtshams kyi nang du longs spyad pa'o/ /44 dgon pa ba'i 'bral ba'i spang ba ni/ dge slong dgon pa bas cho me gos dang bral nas zhag bdun phan chad 'das pa'o/ /45—371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poras chen gyi spang ba ni/ dbyar khas len gyi snga rol zla gcig yan dang / dgag dbye grol nas/ zla phyed phan 'das par ras chen btsal ba dang bcangs pa'o/ /46 bsngos pa gzhan du bsgyur ba'i spang ba ni/ dge 'dun la bsngos pa'i yo byad rang nyid la bsgyur ba'o/ /47 gsog 'jog gi spang ba ni/sman gsum po gang rung dus las 'das par bcangs pa'o /lhung byed 'ba' zhig pa bcu tshan dgu las/ dang po la/ 48 brdzun smra'i lhung byed ni/ pham lhag sbom po nyes byas bzhi'i nang tshan gyi brdzun ma yin pa shes bzhin du brdzun smra ba'o/ /49 skyon brjod pa'i ltung byed ni/ dge slong rigs rus ༅ pa dang dbang po ma tshang ba la de'i skyon brjod pa'o//50 phra ma (7na) byed pa'i ltung byed ni/ bsams bzhin du dge slong g.yin phan tshun du phra ma bcug nas phye ba'o/ /51 skyon 'dogs byed pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong gzhan dag gis rtsod pa zhi bar byas pa skyon 'dogs kyi sgo nas slar rtsod pa slong ba'o/ /52 bud med la chos ston pa'i lhung byed ni/ skyesapa g.yin med pa'i sar bud med la tshig lnga drug las mang ba'i chos ston pa'o/ /53 bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig 'don pa'i lhung byed ni/ rgod bag gi bsam pa'i sgo nas bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu chos kyi tshig gdangs sna tshogs kyis 'don pa'o/ /54 gnas ngan len byed pa'i lhung byed ni/ pham lhag gi rigs byung ba la spo mgu lta bu spyod pa na/ rang nyid de'i lhung ba gleng bar ma bskos bzhin du bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la smra bar byed pa'o/ /55 mi chos bla ma bden par smra ba'i ltung byed ni/ rang nyid kyis mi chos bla ma'i yon tan thob pa de dgos pa khyad par can med bzhin du yul bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la smra ba'o/ /56 skur ba 'debs pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge 'dun spyi'i bya ba byed pa'i dge slong la spyi rdzas kyi steng nas 'os pa byin pa la dge 'dun la skur ba 'debs pa'o/ /57khyad gsod kyi lhung byed ni/ bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo 'di rnams kyi ci bya zhes khyad gsod kyi tshig smra ba'o/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa la/ 58 sa bon dang / skye ba 'jig pa'i lhung byed ni/ ljon shing gcod pa dang / me sogs kyis rung ba ma byas pa sa bon gyi rigs nyams par byas pa'o/ /59 'phya ba'i lhung 372

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanabyed ni/ dge 'dun gyi gnas mal stobs pa'i bya ba byed pa'i dge slong la dngos su 'phya ba'am gzhan la smod pa'i zol gyis yo ba'o/ /60 bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge 'dun gyi phyir bcos(7ba〉pa dgod pa'i ched du lhung ba gleng ba na khas mi len par thabs sna tshogs kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /61gnas mal las gyur pa'i lhung byed ni/ rang nyid kyis longs spyad pa'i khri la sogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi gnas mal nyi ma rlung char pa sogs kyis chud zos su 'jug pa'o/ /62 gding ba las gyur pa'i lhung byed ni gtsug lag khang du rang gi gding ba'i 'og tu bting ba'i rtswa dang lo ma la sogs pa rjes su ma bsdus pa'o/ /63 skyod pa'i lhung byed ni/ gnod sems kyis dge slong gzhan gnas khang nas phyi rol du 'don pa'o/ /64 phyis gnon byed pa'i ltung byed ni/ rang gi lus kyis dge slong gzhan brdzis shing gnon pa'o/ /65 rtsa ba 'byung ba la 'dug pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong g.yin la gnod semasakyis de'i steng gi khri rkang rang gi lus kyis mnan te pha rol po la gnod par 'gyur ba'i thabs byed pa'o/ /66 srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la longs spyod pa'i lhung byed ni/ chu la srog chags yod pa shes nas longs spyod pa'o/ /67 rim pa lhag par rtsig pa'i ltung byed ni/ char chu byung ba'i dus su gnod pa srung ba'i g.yogs ma byas par/ nyi mabs tseg la rtsig pa rim pa gsum las lhag pa brtsigs pa'o/ /bcu tshan gsum pa la/ 68 dge slong ma la chos ston pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong ma'i ston par ma bskos ba'i na du chos ston pa'o/ /69 nyi ma nub kyi bar du chos ston pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong ma'i ston pa yin yang 'jigs pa yod pa'i sar nyi ma nub nas cho se ston pa'o/ /70 zas cung zad tsam gyi phyir du chos ston no zer ba'i lhung byed ni/ phrag dog gi sgo nas dge slong ma'i ston par bskosapa'i dge slong la bza' btung lta bu gzhi gcig la brten nas skur pa 'debs pa'o/ /71 gos byin pa'i lhung byed ni/ (8na snya du ma yin pa'i dge slong mar gos byin pa'o/ /72 gos byed pa'i lhung byed ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma'i gos 'tshem pa'o/ /73 lam du 'gro ba'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig rgyang grags las 'da' bar byed pa'o/ /74 dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur 'jug —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur zhugs te chu'i rgyun phyogs sam ldog phyogs gang rung la rgyang grags kyi bar phyin pa'o/ /75 dben pa skyabs yod du 'dug pa'i ltung byed ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang lha na cig dben pa skyabs yod du sdod pa'o/ /76 'greng ba'i lhung byed ni/ 'greng ba dang sdod pa tsam ma gtogs sngar ltar ro/ /77 zas sbyor du 'jug pa'i lhung byed ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma brgyud nas khyim bdag la rang gi bza' btung sbyor du bcug pa'o/ /bcu tshan bzhi pa la/ 78 yang yang za ba'i ltung byed ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la dus rung gi kha zas kya bsod snyoms nyin gcig la gnyis gsum bslangs pa'o/ /79 zas za ba'i lhung byed ni/ mu stegs kyi rab byung yod pa'i khyim du zhag gcig las lhag pa gnas te za ba'o/ /80 lhag pa len pa'i ltung byed ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa la dus gcig la lhung bzed gsum las lhag pa len pa'o/ /81 spangs pa za ba'i lhung byed ni/ byin len byas pa'i zas bsam sbyor gyis spangs pa slar lhag por ma byas par za ba'o/ /82 spangs pa stobs pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong gzhan gyisaspangs pa'i zas lhag por ma byas bzhin du byas so zhes bstabs pa'o/ /83 'dus shing za ba'i lhung byed ni/ mtshams nang du bsam pa mi mthun pas kun nas bslang ste logs su 'dus(8bti za ba'o//84 dus ma yin par za ba'i lhung byed ni/ gling 'di'i nyi ma phyed yol nas sang gi skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du dus rung gi sman za ba'o/ /85 gsog 'jog byed pa'i lhung byed ni/ sman gsum po gang rung longs spyad pa'i lhag ma gsog 'jog byas nas longs spyod pa'o/ /86 byin len ma byas pa za ba'i lhung byed ni/ sman bzhi po gang rung byin len ma byas par za ba'o/ /87 zas bsod pa slong ba'i lhung byed ni/ nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa las bslangs pa'i zas bzang po zos pa'i nyin gcig la slar khyim bdag gzhan la zas bzang po slong bar byed pa'o/ /bcu tshan lnga pa la/ 82 srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la longs spyod pa'i lhung byed ni/ rang don du srog chags gnas pa'i chu la khrus sogs byed pa dang rtswa la longs spyod pa'o/ /89 nyal po byed —374

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanapa'i khyim du gnas pa'i lhung byed ni/ pho mo nyal po byed sar 'dug ste de la bar du gcod par byed pa'o/ /90 nyal po byed pa'i khyim du 'greng ba'i ltung byed ni/ 'dug pa dang 'greng ba'i khyad par ma gtogos sngar ltar ro/ /91 gcer bu la zas sbyin pa'i lhung byed ni/ dgos pa khyad par can med par phyi rol pa la gtogos pa'i bud med la gos zas ster ba'o/ /92 dmag la lta ba'i lhung byed ni/mtshams kyi nye 'khor las 'das te dmag la lta zhing smod pa'o/ /93 dmag gi nang du gnas pa'i lhung byed ni/ dgos pa khyad par can med par dmag gi nang du zhag gcig las 'das par gnas pa'o/ /94 bshams pa dkrugs pa'i ltung byed ni/ dgos pa khyad par can ma yin par dmag dang go mtshon dkrugs pa'o/ /95 brdeg pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong la rang gis brdeg gam gzhan brdeg tu 'jug pa'o/ /96 brdeg par gzas(9na)pa'i lhung byed ni gong dang 'dra/ 97 gnasang na len 'chab ba'i lhung byed ni/ dgos pa khyad par can ma yin par dge slong gzhan la lhung ba byung ba shesabazhin du 'chab pa'o/ /brgya tshan drug pa la/ 94na gcod du 'jug pa'i ltung byed ni/ gnod sems kyi sgo nas grogasadage slong la dus rung gi zas bkag pa'o/ /99 me la reg pa'i ltung byed ni/ rgod bag gi dbang gis me la reg cing rtse ba'o/ /100 'dun pa phyir sgyur ba'i lhung byed ni/ dge 'dun las la mi mthun pa med par bya ba'i phyir du 'dun pa phul bar slar 'dun pa phyir bzlog tu bcug pa'o/ /101 nub lhag por nyal ba'i lhung byed ni/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ngang lhan cig tu mtshams nang gcig tu nub gnyis las lhag par nyal ba'o/ /102 sdig lta mi gtong ba'i lhung byed ni/ ston pa'i gsung la yid mi ches pa'i sdig lta skyes pa rkyen gyis bzlog pa'i mtha' la ma gtong ba'o/ /102 spangs pa rjes su phyogs pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge 'dun gyi gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong dang lhan cig spyod lam mthun pa'o/ /144 dge tshul bsnyil ba sdud pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge tshul slong ma gtogos sngar ltar ro/ /105 gos kha ma bsgyur ba gyon pa'i lhung byed ni/ rung ba'i tshon gsum gyis kha ma bsgyur ba'i khru gang du —373—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6polongs pa'i gos/ gzhan gyi g.yogs med par gyon pa'o/ /106 rin po che la reg pa'i lhung byed ni/rgod bag gi bsam pas nor bu dang rnga bo che rol cha mtshon cha rnams la reg pa'o/ /107 khrus byed pa'i ltung byed ni/ nad pa dang tsha ba'i dus zla ba gsum ma gtogs zla ba phyed kyi snga rol du khrus byed pa'o/ /bcu tshan bdun pa la/ 108 dud 'gro gsod pa'i lhung byed ni/ bsams bzhin du dud 'gro che phra gsod pa'o/ /109 'gyod pa skyed (9ba)pa'i ltung byed ni/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi yon tan sogs la smod pa'i sgo nas dge slong gzhan yid mi bde bar 'jug pa'o/ /110 bud med dang lhan cig tu nyal ba'i lhung byed ni/ skyi g.ya' bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas dge slong la g.ya' sgrog pa'o/ /111 chu la rtse ba'i ltung byed ni/ rgod bag gi bsam pas chu la rtse bar byed pa'o/ /112 bud med dang lhan cig tu nyal ba'i ltung byed ni/ mtshams nang gcig tu bud med dang nub gcig lhan du gnas pa'o/ /113 dngangs par byed pa'i lhung byed ni/ dge slong la mtho 'tsham pa'i bsam pas 'jigs pa sna tshogs ston pa'o/ /114 jed pa'i lhung byed ni/ mtho 'tsham pa'i bsam pas dge slong gi gos lhung bzed sogs yo byad sped pa'o/ /115 ma byin pas nye bar 'tsho ba'i lhung byed ni/ rang dang rdzas mi gcig pa'i dge slong gi gos ma byin par longs spyod pa'o/ /116 skur ba 'debs pa'i ltung byed ni/mthong thos dogs gsum med bzhin du dge slong la zhibs mas ban du lhag ma'i skur ba 'debs pa'o//117 bud med dang lhan cig tu lam du 'gro ba'i ltung byed ni/ bud med dang lhan cig tu rgyang grags las 'das par lam du 'gro ba'o/ /bcu tshan brgyad pa la/ 11/ rkun po dang lhan cig tu lam du 'gro ba'i lhung byed ni/ gzhan gyi dngos po brkus pa'i gang zag dang lhan cig tu rgyang grags las 'das par 'gro ba'o/ /119 nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i lhung byed ni/ bsgrub bya mngal bshol dang bcas pa'i lo nyi shu ma lon par shes bzhin du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'o/ /120 rko ba'i lhung byed ni/ dgos pa khyad par can med par sra zhing 'thas pa nas sa sbar ba gang longs pa yan chad du bskos pa'o/ /121 mgron du 376
