'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (phanaganyer ba las ring du 'dug pa'i lhung byed ni/10na〉gran bdag gis zhag gi grangs kyi bsnyen bkur byed pa na/dus las 'das pa'i bsnyen bkur longs spyod pa dang /zhag grangs med na zla ba bzhi las lhag par longs spyod pa'o//122bslab pa nye bar 'jog pa spong ba'i lhung byed ni/bslab bya la bslab pa'i thabs gzhan gyis brjod pa la khyad gsod byed pa'o//123nyan rna byed pa'i ltung byed ni/phan tshun mi mthun pa'i bsam pas gzhan dag gleng mo byed pa la lkog tu nyan pa'o//124mi smra bar 'gro ba'i lhung byed ni/las gral du 'khod nas/'dun pa ma phul bar g.yin du 'gro ba'o//25ma gus pa'i lhung byed ni/dge 'dun gyis bcas pa'i chos ldan gyi bya ba la ma gus pa'i tshul gyis 'da' ba'o//126chang 'thung ba'i lhung byed ni/myos 'gyur gyi rigs 'thung ba ste/myos 'gyur la brten pa'i bag med pas/gzhan ma dad par byed nus na lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo //127phyi dro grong du 'jug pa'i lhung byed ni/nye du ma yin pa'i khyim du gung yol nas sang gi skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du gnas pa'o//28grong du rgyu ba'i lhung byed ni/rang grong gzhan du rgyu ba la brten nas/dge 'dun spyi'i gdugs tshod dus las yol ba'o//129rgyal po'i pho brang du nub mo 'gro ba'i lhung byed ni/mtshan mo rgyal po'i btsun mo dang bcas pa'i pho brang du 'dug pa'o//130khyad du gsod pa'i lhung byed ni/gso sbyong gi dus su bslab bya shes bzhin du khyad du gsod pa'o//131khab ral byed pa'i lhung byed ni/khyim pa nye du ma yin pa la rwa dang rus pa sogs kyi khab ral 'tshos su bcug nas len pa'o//32khri rkang 'chos pa'i lhung byed ni/khri rkang khru gang las mtho ba 'chos pa'o//33shing 10ba thal gyis gos par byed pa'i lhung byed ni/dge 'dun gyi khri la bsams bzhin du shing bal g.yogs pa'o//134gding ba chad lhag byed pa'i lhung byed ni/gding ba srid dang zheng gi tshad las lhag pa 'chang ba'o//135g.yon pa dgag bya tshad las lhag pa'i lhung byed dang /136dbyar gyi gos ras chen tshad las lhag pa'i lhung byed dang /137chos gos tshad las lhag par byed pa'i lhung byed gsum ni sngar ltar ro// 77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6 7)bzhi pa sor bshags la bzhi las/ 138 dge slong mar zas len pa'i sor bshags ni/dge slong mas rang nyid 'tsho ba'i ched du bsod snyoms bslangs pa slong pa'o/ /139 gal rims su ma phebs par 'grim du 'jug pa ma bzlog pa'i sor bshags ni/ sbyin bdag gi gnas su dge slong ma la rang la dmigs bsal gyis zas 'dren par bskos pa'o/ /140 bslab pa bral te khyim du 'jug pa'i sor bshags ni/ khyim gyi bslab pa'i sdom pa byin pa'i gang zag las bsod snyoms len pa'o/ /141 nags ma brtags pa las gyur pa'i sor bshags ni/ 'jigs pa yod pa'i sar chom rkun yod med ma brtags par zas za ba'o/ /nyes byas la brgya dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i sdo tshan brgyad las/ gos kyi sde tshan la/ sham thabs kyi bdun ni/ 142 mtha' gnyis zlum por ma gyon pa/ 143 pus mo las yar brdzes pa/144 long bu las mar 'jol ba/ 145 mdun phyogs su mar sna lug pa/ 146 ya mtha'i mgo bo thur du lteb pa/ 147 ya mtha' la mtho dman du byas pa/ 148 ma mtha'i kha ma mnyam par lug pa/149 ska rags kyi bar bar na sham thabs don pa'o/ /stod g.yogs kyi gsum ni/ (11na)150 ma mtha' zlum por ma gyon pa/ 151 bus mo las yar brdzes pa/ 152 long bu las mar 'jol ba'o/ /khyim du 'gro ba'i sdo tshan la/ shin tu bsdams pa lnga ni/ 153 dran shes ma bsten pa/ 154 gosalegs par ma gyon pa/ 155 ca co'i gtam mang du smra ba/ 156 mig phyogs kun tu lta ba/ 157 gnya' shing gang las ring bar lta ba'o/ /mgo bo g.yogs pa sogs lnga ni/ 158 mgo la gos g.yogs pa/159 sham thabs('doms(snang bar brdzes(pa/ 160 gzan phrag pa g.yas g.yon la bkal ba/ 161lag pa gnyis mdun nas gnya' bar bsnol ba/ 162 rgyab nas ltag par bsnol ba'o/ /mchong ba sogs ni/ 163 'gro na mchonges nas 'gro ba/ 164 tsog bus 'gro ba/ 165 rkang pa'i brang gisa'agro ba/ 17 gru mo brgyang nas 'gro ba/ 167 sdod pa'i tshe rkang pa skyong ba'o/ /lus sogs ni/ 168lus yang yang sgyur ba/ 169 lag pa skyong ba/ 170 mgo bo sgril ba/ 171 gzhan dang phrag pa sprod —378

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)pa dang /172lag pa sbrel ba'o//'dug pa'i sde tshan ni/173ma bsgos par gzhan gyi stan la 'dug pa/174ma brtags par 'dug pa/ 75khri la lus kyi ljid 'gel ba/176rkang pa gnyis pa snol nas brkyang ba/ 77brla gnyis bsnol ba/178long bu bsnol ba/179rkang pa khri'i 'og tu bkug pa/180rkang pa'i mgo bo gnyis phyir gdengs pa/181'doms snang bar byed pa'o//zas kyi sde tshan ni/182zas legs par ma blangs pa/183lhang bzed las zas mtho bar len pa/184gos chan dang tshod ma mnyam par len pa/185mthar chags su mi len pa/186lhung bzed la ma bltas par len pa/187zas ma byung bar lhung bzed kha gdangs pa/188zas lhag po 'dod nas gcig 11bskos gcig sbas pa/15bza' ba dang bca' ba'i steng du lhung bzed bzhag pa'o//zas za ba'i sdo tshan la/legs par bya ba ni/190legs pa ma zos pa191kham ha cang ches pa/192ha cang chung ba/193ran pa ma yin pa/ 94zas mthun par kha gdangs pa/195zas kha bkang nas gtam smra ba'o//tsug tsug sogs ni/196mngar ba la tsug tsug/197skyur ba la cag cag/198grang ba la hu hu/199tsha ba la phu phu/200lce phyir byung ste za ba'o//tha dad byed pa sogs ni/20 'bru re re nas bza' ba/202zas la smod pa/203mkhur ba phan tshun spo ba/24rkan sgra gtog pa/sa kham 'phro gcod cing za ba'o 206lag pa bsdam pa sogs ni/lag pas zas chags la ldag pa/2079 dang mdzub mos lhung bzed la 'byog pa/208zas gos pa'i lag pa sprug pa/209lhang bzed skyom pa/210zas la mchode rten gyi gzugs 'chos pa'o//lhung bzed kyi sdo tshan la/'phya ba sogs ni/211gzhan gyi lhung bzed la smod pa/212zas 'gos pa'i lag pas chu snod 'dzin pa/212sbags pa'i chu dge slong la 'thor ba/214ma dris par khyim du khyud chu 'bo ba'o//215lhung bzed sogs ni/216lhag ma lhung bzed du blugs nas 'dor ba/217lhung bzeng sa la 'jog pa/218g.yangs sa/29gad kha/220dkan gzar po sogs su 'jog pa/229de 222gsum du 223bkru ba/224

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7'greng ste /lhung bzed bkru ba/ 225 'bab chu drag po'i rgyun las ldog ste bcu pa'o/ /chos bshad pa'i sdo tshan la/ 'grengs sogs ni/ 226 langs pa dang / 227 nyal ba dang / 228 mtho sar bsdad pa dang / 229 sngon du 'gro ba dang / 230 lam gyi 'gram nas chos bshad pa'o/ /mgo bo g.yogasapa sogs(12na ji/ 231 mgo la ras lta bu g.yogs pa dang / 232 gos brdzes pa/ 233 phrag gong du rdzes pa/ 234 lag pa gnya' gong du bsnol ba/ 235 ltag par bsnol ba rnams kyis chos nyan pa'o/ /do ker sogs ni/ 236 skra'i thor cog byas pa/ 237 dar gyi cod pan bcings pa/232 zhu gyon pa/ 239 thod bcangs pa/ 240 me tog gi 'phreng ba byas pa rnams la chos bshad pa'o/ /glang chen sogs ni/ 241 glang po/ 242 rta 243 de ma yin pa'i bzhen pa dang gsum/244 'do les bteg pa/ 245 mchil lham gyon pas chos nyan pa'o/ /'khar ba sogs ni/ 246lag na 'khar ba dang / 247 dgra sta dang de ma yin pa'i 248 mtshon cha dang / 249 go cha thogs pas chos nyan pa'o/ /sgrub pa'i sde tshan ni/ 250 'greng nas bshang gci 'dor ba/ 251 chu la bshang gci dang lud pa 'dor ba/ 25 rto sngon gyi steng du bshang gci 'dor ba/ 253 shing la 'dom gang yan chad la 'dzeg pa'o/ /gnyas pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten pa la/ gos mtha' ga biñdza gsu ma lhung ba/ sman mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba/ gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad ni/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ sham thabs/ sham thabs kyi gzan/ rngul gzan/ rngul gzan gyi gzan/ gdong phyis/ rnag gzan/ g.yan pa dgab pa/ lhung bzed/ gding ba/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen/ mkho ba'i yo byad ni/ gdan dang gtur bu lta bu/ lhag po'i yo byad ni/ snam sbyar lhag po la sogs pa/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs ni/ zhwa lham ska rags sogs/ mkho ba'i yo byad dang (12ba)lhag po'i yo byad phran tshegs ni/ de dag gi rgyur bsngos zhing khrur ma longs pa'o/ /de yang 'tsho ba'i yo byad ni kha sgyur dgos shing / sgyur byed kyi tshon yang sngon po btsag dang ngur smrig tshon gsum po gang rung —380

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (3)gis bsgyur/ che chung gi tshad snam sbyar gyi dbangs su khru gsum dang / srid du khru lnga la che tshad byas pa/mthang gos la dpangs su khru do dang srid du khru lnga la che tshad byas pa/ ral kha dpung chad ni/ de'i tshad la mi gtogs so/ kham thabs dang de'i gzan gnyis ni/ tshad mthang sham dang mtshungs/ rngul gzan dang / de'i gzan gnyis ni bla gos dang mtshungs/ rnag gzan gyi tshad srid du khru drug zhed du gsum/g.yan pa dgab pa ni/ srid du khru drug dang zheng du khru gsum/ skra bzed ni zheng du khru phyed dang gnyisadang srid du khru gsum/ gding ba ni/ srid du khru gsum dang / zheng du khru do dang sor drug /dbyar gyi gos ras chen ni/ srid du khru dgu dang / zheng du khru gsum dang sor bco brgyad yin no/ /mkho ba'i yo byad ni/ kha dog dang dbyibs nges pa med do/ /gnyis pa/ sman mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la/ dus rung gi sman ni/ 'bras chan/ zan/ sha/ phye/ 'khur ba lnga la bza' ba lnga/ rtsa ba/sdong bu/ me tog /gos bu/ yal 'dab lnga la bca' ba lnga ste/ bcu po 'di skya rengs shar nas dgung ma yol gyi bar kho nar za ba'o/ /thun tshod kyi sman ni/ tshags kyis gtsags pa'i rtsam dwangs shin tu sla ba/ bu ram gyi khu ba shin tu sla ba/ skyu ru ra'i khu ba shin tu sla ba/ ja la sogs pa btung bar 'os pa rnams so/ /nyin mtshan gyi bar gyi thun mtshams ma gtogs par longs spyad rung ba'o/ /zhag bdun pa'i sman ni/ zhun mar/ 'bru (13na sgor/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram rnams skol zhing gtsags ba ste/ zhag bdun gyi mtha' ma 'das kyi bar du longs spyad rung ba'o/ /'tsho bcang gi sman ni/ gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i sman te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bcang rung ba'o/ /gsum pa gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba ni/ spyod lam bzhi shong gi khang pa 'am/ shing drung dang brag gi skyibs lta bu/ char chu dang rlung nyi ma sogs kyi 'jigs pa skyob nus pa la brten pa'o/ /de yang skyes bus rtsol ba ma byas pa'i gnas ni grub pa'i gnas dang / thog ma nas grub pa la skyes bus rtsol bas kyang cung zad byas pa ni bgyis pa'i gnas dang / gang zag kho na'i rtsol bas byas pa ni/ legs pa'i gnas yin no/ /rtswadang / khri dang / bal gyi mal stan longs spyad 'os pa rnams la/ srog chags yod med legs par —381 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobartags nas longs spyod pa dang / khri dma' yang nyis brtsegs su byas na nyes byas 'byung bas spang ngo //snod spyad kyi rtags lhung bzed/ byi byad kyi yo byad sbu gri/ gri gu /khab sogs 'du bya ba'o/ /ko lpags ni nad pa lta bu la dmigs bsal ma gtogs longs spyad du mi rung ngo / /de yang ga lha pa ṇi 'bum phrag gcig re ba'i gos dang / zas ro brgya dang ldan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya pa la sogs pa lta bu rang nyid kyis tshegs kyis sgrub mi dgos par 'bad med du rnyed na zhen med kyi sgo nas longs spyad du rung na'ang rang nyid kyis klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gyi gegs su 'gro ba'i sha thang thang gi sgo nas 'bad rtsol gyis sgrub pa dgag pa'i ched du/ mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba bstan to/ /gzhan gyi dad pa'i rdzas de dag kyang (13ba 〉 slob pa dang mi slob pa dang / 'phags pa min yang tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhig gis longs spyad dgos shing / tshul 'chal gyis spyad na/ lcags kyi tho lum za ba khro chu khol ma 'thung ba sogs kyi nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa gsungs shing / rang gi 'tsho ba'i ched las/ rgyags phyir sogs ma yin te/ ji skad du bshes spring las/ rgyags phyir ma lags snyems pa'i phyir ma lags/ /'tshag phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thog mar snga chab blangs/ zas la 'jug pa'i tshe mchil lham phud/ dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo ba 'a/ phud kyis dkon mchog mchod cing chang bu 'phrog ma la byin/ longs spyad pa'i lhag ma rnams kyang 'byung po rnams la ster zhing / chab kyis kha bshal ba sogs bag dang ldan par bya'o/ /de yang rang rang gis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims las 'das na/ nyes dmigs shin tu che ste/ lung rnam 'byed las/ gang zhig ston pa thugs rje'i bstan pa la/ /yang bar sems shing cung zad 'da' byed pa//de ni de las sdug bsngal g.yin dbang 'thob/ /spyig tshal bregs pas a mra'i tshal nyams bzhin/ /'di na la la rgyal po'i tshig chen yang / /'das na lan 'ga' chad pa thob par 'gyur/ /thub pa'i bka' lung tshul min 'da' byed pa/ /dud 'gror skye 'gyur e la'i 'dab klu bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /pham pa —382

wa na dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)bzhi nas bzung yan lag phra mo'i bar rang nyid kyis bsrung mi nus pa'i bag med kyi spyod pas khyim pa sun 'byin pa'i gnas lhur len las bslab pa phul ba phan yon che ste/ lung las/ dge slong lnga brgyas sdom pa phul/ /sangs(14na)rgyas byams pa'i bstan pa la/ /'dus pa dang por ngas lung bstan/zhes so/ /bsrung nus na snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir phan yon lhag par che ste/ /zla ba sgron mes zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gags par gyur ba'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa/ /bsod nams de ni de bas khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhib tu byas na/ ma byin len lta bu la mtshon na/ gzhi'i sel ba ni/ dur khrod kyi ro'i rdzas lta bu brkus na sbom po'i nyes byas 'byung / bsam pa'i sel ba la/ lhas byin gyi nor la mchod sbyin gyi nor du 'du shes nas brkus na sbom po 'gyung / mi ma yin pa'i rdzas brkus na sbom po 'byung / gang zag gzhan gyi ched du rku ba dang / bzhad gad tsam gyi ched du rku ba la sbom po 'byung /sbyor ba'i sel ba ni/ dngul thob na rang gi byed/ gser thob na grogs kyi byed ces khrims su bcasanas rang gis gser brkus na sbom po 'byung / mthar thug gi sel ba ni/ thob blo med pa'am/ gnasanas spags dgos pa rnams la ma spags na sbom por bshad do/ /des mtshon gnyen byed pa'i lhag ma lta bu la/ lhag ma sngar bshad pa de 'byung ba tsam du ma zad/ bud med 'di khyim la 'gro ran no zhes smras pa tsam la yang nyes byas 'byung bar bshad/ dngangs par byed pa'i lhung byed la/ dge slong dngangs par byas pa la lhung byed 'byung bar ma zad/ khyim pa dang dud 'gro dngangs par byas na nyes byas 'byung ba sogs sngar bshad pa'i phra rags kyi bslab bya rnams la zhib cha shin tu mang bas mtha' dag bris na glegs bam chen bor 'gro ba'i phyir re zhig de tsam mo/ /(14bsgog pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa las nye bar brtsams pa'i bslab bya'i gnas la nan tan du bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las byung ba'i bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems sgom pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i zab mo'i gnas la 'khrul pa med par spyod pa sogs la rgyal ba'i bka' tshad mar byas/ brgyud ldan gyi bla —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorama'i gsung rgyun la brten nas rang gzhan gyi mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa thob pa'i thabs yid la brnags pa'i dpyod ldan gyi skyes bu ni ches cher dkon pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis gnyis med gsung ba'i nyin byed nub gyur cing / /bstan 'dzin skye bo'i thun mtshams 'od dang bral/ /nag po'i phyogs gyur sdig spyod 'byung po'i bya/ /ltas ngan sna tshogs bzung ste rang dgar spyod/ /zhes gsungs pa thugs shin tu bden par snang zhing / gsung rab nas 'di ltar bshad kyang /yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun pa'i 'di ltar byed dgos zhes/ rang bzor spyod pa ches mang ba'i dus 'dir gzhung lugs so so'i rang skad dang bstun pa'i 'thad mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa dang zhib cha mang du byas na mchog dman mang po'i mtshang la phog par 'gyur zhing / de dag gi spyod tshul la bden par smra ba'i ngo bsrungs na lag len 'chol bar 'gyur bas/ dus go blo gsal dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan las/kye ma gangs can khrod 'di na/ /mkhan slob khyim pas byed pa dang / /sdom pa gtor mas len pa dang //dus go hor zlas byed pa mang / /mdo dang ku me sha rta du/ /lo zla tshes grangs bshad pa med/ /zla ba bdun pa'am brgyad pa nas/ /lo 'go 'dzin pa'ang mdo dang 'gal/ /mang du smras (15na ji dgra sogs sdang / /ma smras lag len 'tshal bar spyod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /de ltar gzhi gcig gi steng nas 'thad pa dang mi 'thad pa gnyis ka 'thad ldan du sgrub mi nus pas/ bdag gis chos min smra ru chos dang 'gal/ /chos bzhin smras na bod rnams dgra ru sdang / /ci yang ma smras kun gyis blun zhes brnyas/ /kye ma da ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bshad ma thag pa rnams kyi don ltar na/phal che ba dag blo cung zad 'byog la 'phyang mod/ me tog tsam pa ka na rgas gyur kyang / /me tog phal pa rnams kyi do zla min/ /nga yi nyan thos tshul khrims 'chal gyur kyang / /mu stegs phal pa rnams kyi do zla min/ /zhes pa'i lung ltar na/ blo 'tshub dang sbubs 'thums zhi nas thugs blo rang mal du bde bar 'gyur ro/ /—384

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanasmras pa/ so thar gzhung brgya'i lho phyogs nags klung nas/ /nyon mongs gdungs la tshul khrimasamangar ba'i dri/ /'dren byed sngon med legs bshad bser bu ni/ /byed po 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /chos 'dul khrims kyi chu gter chen po dag /bdag 'dra'i blo gros a mra'i tshig gu yis/ /'jal ba'i dka' thub len pa ngal lo zhes/ /yon tan 'od de mgrin par byon nasabartsams/ /srid 'byor khyim gyi 'du 'dzi'i smig rgyu la/ /gtan bde'i skom du zhen pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /theg gsum byang chub rnyog bral dwangs pa'i chu/ /btungs nas phan bde'i sa la gar byed shog khres da ltar gyi cho ga'i sgo nas sdom gsum mnos pa'i gang zag las dang po ba rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i spang blang gi rim pa rags pa tsam ngos bzung ba'i rim pa nyung ngu rnam gsal sgron me zhes bya ba (15ba 'di ni/ mtha' 'khob kyi yul grur skyes kyang dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la mos pa'i bag chags sad pa dge slong ngag dbang blo bzang gis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang nges kyi gnad 'chad pa la smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la cung zad sbyangs pa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes rnam par rgyal ba'i lo dus tshigs la bzhir phye ba'i dbyar zla ra ba'i gral tshes la byang phyogs tal kha'i gzims khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga lag len snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/ /mchog dman bar pa'i 'gro kun mngon mtho dang / /nges legs sar 'god rnam 'dren thamasacad mkhyen/ /zas gtsang sras dang de yi lugs 'dzin pa'i/ /'jam da byangs dkone mchog chos 'phel gtsug na rgyal/ /bya sla tshegs chud gru gzings la brten nas/ /myang 'das gi chen gling du bgrod pa'i —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)thabs/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims kyi cho ga'i rjes/ /phun tsho gos dge ba'i rab dkar dar chen bskyod//zla ba gang gi'ang nya stong brgyad gsum mam gang rung la/ yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims bsrung ba la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi mdun du mchod pa bshams/ rang nyid khrus byas/ mchil lham phud/ nam langs nyi ma ma shar ba'i dus dang sku gzugs kyi mdun du phyag gsum btsal/ pus mo btsugs/ thal (16na〉po sbyar te/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pa dung nge ba'i ngang nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs de sangs rgyas dngos su 'du shes par byas nas/de las sdom pa len pa'i bsam pas cho ga 'di ltar brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ston pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par ston pas bzung du gsol/ 'di lan gsum brjod pas/ gsum pa'i skabs kyi bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par zhes pa'i tshig de rdzogs pa dang mnyam du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa thob bsam pa'i bsam pa 'jog /de nas ston pas bzung du gsol byas rjes sku 'dras thabs yin no gsung bar mos te/ rang gis legs so zhes lan 'debs byed/ mjug chod ni/ phyag gsum btsal nas/ spang bya brgyad po rnams spong snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ ston pa dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes 'gyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /(16ba〉pan lag dang po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyi bslab pa la —386

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (phanarjes su bslab bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji srid 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang /rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang /glu gar dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos nyug pa dang / rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang / khri gdan mthon po dang / khri gdan chen po dang / dus ma yin pa'i kha zas spangs te/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ ma byin par len pa nas dus min pa'i kha zas zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin brjod rjes/ spangs te dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag brgyad pa 'dis bdag 'phags pa/ zhes sogs sngar dang 'dra/ mjug tu thabs legs brjod/ yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga nyams su blang bde ba 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don ltar 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi phyag bzhesasu gnang ba la gzhi byas/ tshig don rnams dkyus su bshad na rtogs dka' bsan/ gsal byed kyi lhan thabs logs su kha 'phangs te/ lag len snying po bsdus pa 'di ni/ khyim pa rnams kyis nyamasasu blang bde ba'i slad du/ za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos byang tal khar sbyar/ /ma sgo lo// //yan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga'i lag len gyi snying po bsdus pa bsal byed nor bu'i 'phreng ba bzhugs/ /na maḥsarba dzñā ya/ gser sbyangs rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba'i mdzes sdug gis/ /mig gi bdud rtsir mtshar du dngar ba yi/ /'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge rgyal//gang de'i rjes 'brang gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin/ /bram ze'i btsun pa yon tan 'od la sogs/ /—387—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorarnam dag tshul khrims tsan dan dri bsung gis/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i tshogs spyi dang / khyad par tshul khrims chu gter dbus gnas shing / /sde snod nor bus gtsug rgyan gdengs can dbang / /lugs 'dzin dkon mchog chos 'phel bka' drin dag /dran tshe snying khar lag pa'i padmo zum/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga'i 'khrid rim gyi/ /lag len gsal byed nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'di/ /rnam dpyod tshig gi srad bu la brgyus nas/ /blo ldan su dag mgrin pa'i rgyan du long / /de yang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni/ zla ba re re bzhin gyi nya stong tshes brgyad gsum ga'am gang rung zhig la srung yang / tshes grangs de'i nam langs kyi dus gang zag gam rten lta bu zhig gi drung du/cho ga tshad ldan gyi sgo nas blangs pa zhig dgos te/ mdzod las/ bsnyen gnas yan lag tshang bar na/nangs par gzhan las nod par bya/ zhes so/ /thog mar rab tu byung ba'am khyim pa gso sbyong la gnas pa zhig la/ ji srid 'tsho bar gyi nya stong brgyad gsum ga'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dus gcig la blangs nas/ de phyin chad nas sdom pa len yul gyi gang zag ma rnyed na/ rang nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i (17ba lhan gyi drung du len pa yin gyi/ sngar gang zag la len ma myong ba zhig gis rten gyi drung du blangs kyang sdom pa mi skye la/ sngar gang zag la len myong yang bsrung rgyu'i tshes grangs kyi nyin rang gis rten gi drung du ma blangs na mi skye'o/ /rnam par dag pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig byed na/gang bsrung rgyu'i tshes grangs re re zhing gang zag la blangs pa/ cho ga'i tshig kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma shar gyi bar du zhes mtshams bcad pa zhig dgos/ 'on kyang jo bo chen po'i phyag len du grags pa'i ding sang sdom pa rnams dus gcig la bog nas slar rang gis len pa 'di nyid bya mi rigs pa ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis klu dang gnod sbyin la bslab pa'i gzhi lnga len du bcug pa dang / 'phags pa ka tyā ya nas/ bshan pa dang byi byed pa gnyis la nyin mtshan gyi bsnyen gnas srung bcug pa lta bu'o/ /lugs snga ma ltar na/ zas ma zos pa'i gong du nges par len dgos la/ lugs phyi ma ltar na/ 388

'dul ba'i la chog rnam rgyal gser mdog / (pha)nyi ma ma shar gong du blangs phyin zas zos kyang nyes pa med de/ mdzod 'grel las/ gang gis tshes brgyad la bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes sngon yang dag par blangs pa byas pa des ni zas zos nas kyang nod par bya'o/ /gzhan las nod par bya yi/ bdag nyid las ni ma yin te/ zhes bshad do/ /de yang len pa'i yul las rang nyid stan mtho ba dang / len yul la ma gus pa dang / rjes slosam byas par mnyam por smras pa dang / nyi ma shar ba dang / rgyan gsar du 'dogs pa rnams kyi sdom pa skye ba'i gegs byed yin la/ sang gi nyi ma shar ba/ nyi (1ni sgo ma shar gong du shi ba/ log lta skyesapa/ phul ba rnams ni sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu yin no/ /sdom pa skye ba'i rgyu ni/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa yin pas/ de ni/ bshes spring las/ rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang / /rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las/ /mi nyid ches 'thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/ /dam chos spyad pas de gos mchis par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed dka' zhing / yun ring du mi gnas pa glog 'od lta bur 'chi ba'i rkyen mang ba rlung nang gi mar me lta bu/ rkyen chung ngus 'jig pa chu'i lha ba lta bu/ 'tsho ba'i rkyen nyung ba dgun dusakyi lteng ka lta bu/ rnyed par dka' zhing don wo po dang ldan pa yid bzhi gyi nor bu lta bu 'di/ dus da res thob pa'i skabs 'dir 'khor ba las thar ba zhig byed dgos te/ 'khor ba ni gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin par gsungs/ ji skad du/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zasanyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtsetsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs ba ltar ro/ /sdug bsngal de las thar pa'i phyir du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa len pa la dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro dgos te/ mdzod las/gzhan la'ang bsnyen gnas yod mod kyi/ /skyabs su ma song ba la med/ ces so/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul yang / mi slob pa'i lam bden sangs rgyas dkon mchog la (18ba)—389

rkyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poskyabs ston pa po/chos mya ༅ las 'das pa 'gog pa'i bden pa la skyabs dngos/slob mi slob kyi lam bden dge bon dkon mar la skyabs ston pa po'i grogs zhus te/ji srid ma shi bar du dkon ma rdzo gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa snying thag pa nas byed dgos te/dkon mchog gsum gyis gtan gyi skyabs su rung la/de ma yin pa'i skyabs kyis gtan gyi skyabs su mi rung ba'i phyir/mdo sde rgyal mtshan dam pa las/'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni//phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang //ljon shing dag laskyabs 'gro ste//skyabs de gtso bo ma yin te//skyabs de dag la brten nas ni//'jigs pa kun lasathar mi 'gyur//gang zhig sangs rgyas chos dang ni//dge 'dun dag la skyabs 'gro ba//sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang //sdug bsngal yang dag 'gags pa dang //bde gzhi mya ngan 'das byas nas//sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/zhes dang /skyabs song bsod nams gzugs yod na//stong gsum 'di yang snod du wo //zhes pa ltar ro//skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas//lhag 'an la phyag mchod mi byed/sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bshig pa sogs sangs rgyas spong ba'i las mi bya/chos la skyabs su song bas sems༅ la gnod 'tshe spong /chos spong gi las mi bya/dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas grogs mu stegs pa dang mi 'grogs/dge 'dun la log sgrub mi bya ba so so'i bslab bya dang /sa mong du skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/dam pa'i chos nyan pa/tshul19na tha'i na yid la bya ba/chos kyi rjes su mas pa'i chos sgrub pa ste bzhi/dbang po mi rgod pa/sdom pa ci nus su len pa/sems can la snying brtse ba/dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa stobazhi la bslab dgos so//bsnyen gnas kyi phan yon ni/byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/brgya bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang //de bzhi zla gcig tshes brgyad dang //cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la//yan lag brgyad legs mnyam gzhag cing //bsnyen gnas gso sbyong byas na ni//nga yi bstan la lhags sgo zhes//don 'di rab tu gsung bar 'gyur//zhes/sangs rgyas byams pa'i bstan pa la 'bras bu 'thob par gsungs shing /gnas 'jog gi mdo las/gaṅgā pa sogs pa'i chu klung rṣa po lnga dang /rgya mtsho ༷ 0po'i chu bum pa'i grangs kyis bzung bar nus kyi/

'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog/ (pha)bsnyen gnas kyi phan yon gyi sgo bzung bar mi nus shing /'dzam bu gling gang ba'i dgra bas pa la si po che la sogs pa'i yo byad thams cad byin pa'i bsod nams kyis/bsnyen gnas kyi bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang mi 'gro/stong gi 4 yang mi 'gro bar gsungs shing /kun du rgyu sen ring gis zhug pa'i mdo las/srog gcod spangs pas rdo rje'i lus dang ldan par 'gyur/ma byin yi spangs pas go mo ring zhing dra bas 'brel/'dod log spangs pas dbang po tshang zhing lus rgyas/rdzun du smra ba spangs pas lcesagadong pa khebs/chang spangs pas seng ge'i stabs kyis gshegs/dus min gyi zas spangs pas tshe masabazhi bstomanyam zhing dkar/phreng so gos spangs pas lus la tshul 9ba khrims kyi spos kyis byugs/gar sogs spangs pas lus mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan par 'gyur/khri stan che mtho spangs pas stan gsum la sbyor bar 'gyur/da rka zhe mchog gsum dang /mkhan slob la yan lag lnga sa la gtugs te phyag byas pas dbu gtsug tor dang ldan par bshad do//de ltar phan yon rṣa po dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi spyo pa 'di ni/rab zla re bzhi slob dpon las 'a pa dang /de ltar mi nus pa rnams kyis thog mar gos su blangs nas slar rang ṣka kyi len pa dang /wo zhag gi bar du srung mi nus pa rnams la/wo mo tsam du yang dag par po na/dus 'di nas tshong nas ji srid nyi ma nub kyi bar du zhes dus lhu yongasasu tsod par bya'o//zhes spyod pa bzhi du mas mo len na'ang /a ma sgos kyi dus su/dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid nam langs kyi bar du zhes bya/cho 'phrul gyi tshes rsāg nas bco lnga wo zla ba rilabu'i bar srung na/cho 'phrul rsā po'i tshes grangs re re snyo gi nangs par yi dgos spang bya ni/mi'i srog mi gcod pa'i shugs la srog chags phra mo grog sbur yan chad la gnod 'tshe spong /gser zho phyed kyi rin longs pa'i dngos po mi rku ba'i shugs la/bas gad dang rtsed tsho phyir i du dngos po wo ngu i yang ma byin par mi'/pho mo3 wo mi tshangs par mi spyad pa'i shugs la/chags sems kyis gcig gisagacig gi lus la reg pa tsam yang mi bya/mi'i chos las 'das pa'i yon to ma thob pa thob bo zhes rdzun mi smra ba'i shugs la/rtsed tsho ne du rdzun phra mo /sto ba i yang spong /'di bzhi rtsab dang /cha mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa rig dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'athung 20na tha'i shugs la/yid myos pa la brten pa'i bag med kyi gnas thams cad spong /lus kyisagar mi byed pa'i shugs la/glu dbyangs len pa/rol mo dgrol ba/lus la rgyan phreng byug pa byed pa sogs sems rgod pa dang /lus kyi mas sgeg pa sogs brtul zhugs nyams pa'i rigs rnams spangs rin po tsho khri dang khri mthon po gnyis dang /nyi ma'i gung phan ho du dus rung gi sman bza' ba bzhi po 'di yan lag yin no//de ltar spangs bya rnams tshul bzhin du ma spangs na/sdom pa blangs kyang phan yon mi 'byung ba ma zad/ston pa'i bcas pa dang 'gal ba la brten nas ༅ song du skye ba'i nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa 'byung ste/lung rnam 'byed las/gang zhig ston pa thugs rje'i bstan pa la//yang bar sems shing cung zad 'da' byed pa//de ni de las sdug bsngal g.yin dbang 'thob//spyig tshal bregs pas a sgra'i tshal zhi nyams ban//'di na la la rgyal po'i tshig chen yang //lan 'gar 'das na chad pa thob mi 'gyur//thub ba'i bka' lung tshul min 'da' byed pa//dud 'gror skye 'gyur e la'i 'dab klu bzhin/zhes so//tshul bzhin bsrungs na phan yon shan tu che ste/'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po las/gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang //mthar thug 'bras bu byang chub gsum//thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir//dpyod ldan rnams kyis so so thar//rtag tu gus pas4da de srungs/zhes dang /so thar gyi mdo las/'di ni thar pa'i grong 'jug pa'i//them skas gzhi dang 'dra bar gnas/zhes gsungs pa ltar/gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun du phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i thabs dam pa'o//de ltar dus khrims rta ljang dbang po ༅/shar tshes pa'i mun tsho gis 'joms pa dang //ma' mtho pes legs4 gsal snang ba'i 'od/ /rgyas par byed 'di blo gros mkha' las 'phags//yan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga'i lag len gyi//snying po bsdus pa'i gsal byed nor bu'i phreng //snying nas dal ba'i rten bzang don ldan du//sgrub 'dod mang por phan pas yid drangs te//'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung rgyun nyams med du//ma brjed yid kyi yol gor rtag 'khyil ba'i//za hor rigs kyi bas pa ldum bu bas//rnam par rgyal ba'i lo la 'di rgya nag gi rgyal khams nyul ba'i dus su sbyar ro// 9

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (phanar༅༅//chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄༅//legs byas rgya mtsho'i snang ba mi zad 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs las//mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar rtsibs stong 'khor lo bzang po'i bskal pa'i gling bzhi la//2na khogs med bgrod bas phan dang bde ba'i rdzogs ldan dga' ston ster mkhas pa//dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor je rgyal zas gtsang sras por gus phyag 'tshal//2ba ji med rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma la ya yi skyed tshal nas//chos mngone dri bsung 'gugs mdzad nyen mongs tsha gdung g.yul ngo las//rnam par rgyal ba'i dgra bcom rdul gyi rgyal mtshan tsho gos rnams kyis//legs bshad bsil ba'i bde bskyed de phyir gus pas 'dud pa'i yul//rgya chen chos mngone yan lag brgyad ldan chab//rnam dpyod hub kyis cig car 'thung mdzad pa'i//mkhas dbang dbyig gnyen drang srong dza ཿ'i//grags snyan sgrog la dpyod ldan phal cher brel//legs sbyar skad kyi 'chi med lam yangs ngos//a 'dus ka 'phreng ldan pa'i dbang po'i gzhu//ma 'dres gsal byed 'jig rten mig gcig bu//skad gnyis smra ba'i rnam thar yid la 'bab//blo rṣa 'jig rten byed por grags ldan tshangs pa rgan po oṃ yig zol gyi rdzur brten zhing //bskal pa bzang po'i 'dren mchog rnams kyang mkhyen brtse'i gzi byin bzod pa'i skabs bral zhin gzhol bas//mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar dag la 'gran zlar 'os pa gzhan med rang nyid dper bstan pa'i//grags pa phyogs bral thosaXdzin rgyan rgyur rgyal ba'i yab gcig tsong kha pa la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gesnying nas 'dud/ /gang zhig gzhung lugs chen po'i legs bshad khur gyis lci ba'i shing rta che/ /nyesapar bshad dang stobs 'byor 'dam du bying ste nub la mngon phyogs tshe/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i thabs mkhas tshil gyis bde bar 'dren pa'i kha lo pa/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel mkhas mang yongs kyi gtsug na mdzes/ /zla med dam pa mchog de'i bka' drin las/ /ches phra'i blo gros ku sha'i rtse mo yis/ /(3na〉byas mngon rgya mtsho'i dbus nas cha shas tsam/ /len la rgol bar rtsom pa'i klan ka su/ /sgra dang tshad ma rig pa'i lcags ris yongs bskor bzo dang gso ba'i ba gam dbus/ /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor rin chen phra yis rab mdzes nang don rig pa'i seng khri la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khur gyis ngal gso'i stegs bca' dgag sgrub rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ /rgol ngan sbyin skyes 'joms pa'i skad gnyis smra ba mig stong can gyi mdun sa na/ /ji ltar nyin byed dbang po shar ba'i tshe//srin bu me khyer nyams pa chos nyid ltar/ /gsung rab phyogs res dregs pa'i mkhas rlom gyi/ /dam bca' snying po med pa'i rang mtshang ston/ /zang zing 'du 'god blun po'i 'khor tshogs dbus/ /za 'og brtsegs pa'i stan tsam lhur len par/ /skyabs su mi bsten rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /brgal brtag dpyod 'di yongs 'dzin bla ma'i drin/ /chos mngone rgya mtsho'i gru rdzings la brten nas/ /gsung rab nor bu'i gling du bgrod byed pa'i/ /ngo mtshar snga na med pa'i legs bshad glu/ /mgrin pa'i lam nasalen no shes ldan kye/ /zhes bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs te/ rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa mchog rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis/ bya dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad de/ mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi ched du chos tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams bsdu na sde stod rin po che gsum du grags pa las chosamangon pa'i sde snod kyi dgongs don gsal bar byed pa mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i chos ma phro pa mdzod kyi (3ba)bstan bcos 'di rang blos gang spobs kyis/ yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i drin las cung zad 'chad pa ni/ kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan la rab tu byung zhing / gang 'di'i gzhung —394

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (phanalugs la thos bsam bgyis pa'i 'bras bu rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed pa'o snyam du dang ba'i yid kyis brjod par bya'o/ /klad kyi don/de la gsum/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don/ dang po la mtshan don/ 'gyur phyag gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rgya gar bas smra ba'i lha'i skad du bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la a bhi sogs su 'dod pa yin te bsgyur gyi a bhi mngon pa/ dharma chos/ ko ṣa mdzod/ kā ri kā tshig le'ur byas pa'i don yin pas lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar skad shan sbyar te bsgyur ba la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bstan bcos 'di 'phags yul mkhas pa'i ngag yin pa'i nges shes rnyed pa dang / legs sbyar gyi skad la bag chags gzhag ched yin pa'i phyir/ de yang 'phags yul na skad rigs bzhi yod kyang rgyal ba rnams kyis skad rigs 'di la brten nas chos 'khor bskor zhing / paṇḍita rnams kyang de dang tshul mthun par mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo stobs/ rgyal ba gsung rab thams cad su khradang ni/ /ting gi mtha' can legs sbyar lha yi snad/ /byingasadang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi rang bzhin du/ /gnas phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams tshulu 'dir rol/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni/ nyon mongs kyi rtsub reg dang bral bas 'jam zhing /bde legs kyi dpal du gyur pa na tshod gzhen nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i nyams ldan gyi lang tsho can du gyur pa'i 'jam dbyangs la (4na)phyag 'tshal ba la dgos pa yod de/ sgyur byed lo paṇa gyi don 'grub cing / 'di mngon pa'i sde snod kyi khongs su gtogs par shes pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa gzhung don la/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag /brtsams pa'i gzhung gi brjod don dngos bshad pa/ rtsom pa mthar phyin dang gsum/ dang po la mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gebaca' ba/chos mdzo pa'i mtshan don bshad pa/chos ma rga pa brtsams pa'i dgos pa bshad pa dang bzhi/dang po la mchod par brjod pa/brtsam par dam bca' ba/chos ma rga pa'i mtshan don bshad pa/chos ma' pa brtsams pa'i dgos pa bshad pa dang bzhi/dang po la/tshig don dang /mtha' dpyad gnyis las/dang po ni/slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/khyod kyis bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i thog mar/phun sum tsho gos pa gsum mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas gang zhig la phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/sangs rgyas de shes bya kun la sgrib pa'i nyen mongs dang /nyen mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa sa bon dang bcas pa gtan nas bcom zhing spangs pa'i spangs pa phun tsho gos dang /shes bya thamasacad rtogs pa'i rtogs pa phun tsho gis gnyis dang ldan zhing /de gdul bya la phan pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams brgal bar dka' ba'i 'dam lta bu'i 'khor ba las drang bar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig/nyon mongs can gyi mun pa dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa gnyis spangs pa'i spangs pa de gzhung 'di'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i spangs pa yin zer na/de chos can/khyod rgyud ldan gyi nyan rang dgra bcom med par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod mi nus te/nyan rang dgra bcom de 4ba gnyis kyis de gnyis spangs pa'i phyir/der thal/rang 'grel las/rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams kyang nyon mongs pa can gyi rmongs pa dang bral ba'i phyir kun la mun pa bcom par ni 'dod mod kyi/gtan nasani ma yin te/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/g.yin yang /nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa spangs na/de slar skye mi rung gi chos can du byas nas spangs dgos par thal/khas blangs 'thad pa'i phyir/'dod na/de 'dra'i gang zag yin na/cig shos de'i gang zag yin dgos par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/nyams pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa chos can/der thal/de'i phyir/der thal/dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir/der thal/dgra bcom drug po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/'dod na/mi 'thad par thal/de slar skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de de'i ༷bras bu las nyams pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)dgra bcom bar pa bzhi po de rang gi rigs las nyams pa dang / nyams pa'i chos can sogs lnga/ rang gi 'bras bu las nyams par 'gyur ba dang / rgyun zhugs rang gi 'bras bu las nyams par 'gyur ba med pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bzhi ni rigs las lnga sa las nyams 'gyur/ dang po las ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa yin na/ thob bya'i yon tan gang las kyang mi nyams pas khyab zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de thob bya'i yon tan ma thob pa las nyams pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de stobs bcu la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma thob pa'i phyir/ kha cig /sangs rgyas yin na yon tan gang (ldan tshe pas kyang mi nyams pas khyab zer na/mi 'thad par thal/ de thob bya'i yon to thob kyang mngon du mi byed pa'i nyer spyod las nyams pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des 'gog snyoms thob kyang ma' du ma byas pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la tshor 'du rags pa mngon gyur du yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la sgo lnga'i dbang shes mngon gyur du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ slob dpon gyis de ltar phyag 'tshal nas dgos pa'i don bya ba khyad par can zhig brtsam par bya ba yin te/ chos mngone pa sdo bdun gyi brjod bya thams cad tshang ba'i rgyal po'i gan mdzod lta bu'i bstan bcos 'di rab tu bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa chos ma lnga zhe pa'i mtshan don bshad pa la/ don dam pa'i chos ma' pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis/ dang po la/ tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i dri ma med pa'i shes rab zag pa med pa'i phung po lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa chos can/ gos bu'i mngon pa yin te/ don dam pa'i chos mdzo pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ zag med kyi chos su dmigs pa de chos mja pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thosasbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dus ma byas gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam bden yin —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logepar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i (5ba)rgyud la lam bden yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/kha cig /chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis bsdus pa'i zag med kyi chos su dmigs pa de/chos mngon pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi zag med kyi sdom pa chos can/mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ der thal/ zag med kyi phung po lnga po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ zag med kyi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems byung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ gzugs phung yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /zag med kyi sdom pa yin na/gzugs yin pas ma khyab par thal/ gzugs med khams na de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs med khams pa'i 'phags pa'i rgyud la de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la de ldan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des de thob pa gang zhig /des de ma btang ba'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ zag med 'phags pa'i sems can rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgom lam la zag bcas zag med gnyis su yod zer na/ zag bcas sgom lam rgyud ldan yin na/ sgom lam rgyud ldan yin dgos par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zag bcas sgom lam rgyud ldan gyi phyi rol pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam rgyud la ldan pa'i phyi rol pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song bar thal/lam zhugs (6na〉rtsems can yin pa'i phyir/brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa la/ lam mngon pa dang / gzhung mngon pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i shes rab gang yin pa de chos can/ lam mngon pa yin te/ 'bras bu de thob par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa'i bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyas las/ dang po ni/ mngon pa'i bstan bcos 'di chos can/ khyod la —398—

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta la gnas dang po/ (pha)mdzod ces bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mngon pa gnyis brjod bya'i don du yang dag par chud pa'i phyir ram/ yang na/ mngon pa sdebadun po de la chos mdzo pa'i gsung rab mtshan nyid pa zhes bya la/ khyod gang nas byung ba'i gnas kyang de yin pas/ de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/kha cig /don dam pa'i chos ma rga pa thob byed kyi thabs yin na/ brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa yin pas khyab zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ don dam pa'i chos mngone pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /tshogs sbyor gang rung yin na brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa yin pas khyab par thal/ nyan thos kyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems kyi tshogs lam yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/nyan thos 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyan thos kyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i de yod (6ba)pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab/ kha cig /'dod khams na brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bsgoms byung gi shes rab med zer na/ de yod par thal/ 'dod khams na sbyor lam yod pa gang zhig /de bsgoms byung gtso bor gyur pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ 'dod rten chos mchogo bud med kyi/ /gnyis ga'i rten can thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pas sbyor lam bzhi po de 'dod pa'i lha mi gnyis kyi rten la thob par bstan nas/ chos mchog bud med kyi/zhes sogs kyis sbyor lam chos mchog gi ye shes de/ dang por bud med kyi rten la thob pa yin na/slar yang pho mo gnyis ga'i rten du thob par 'gyur ba yod cing / dang por skyes pa'i rten la thob pa yin na/ slar yang skyes pa kho na'i rten la thob par 'gyur bar bstan pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags gnyis pa der thal/ bsgoms byung mi lcogs med pa dang / khyad par bsam gtan sa pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa dang pos de bsgoms byung gtso bor gyur pa'i lam du bstan cing / phyi ma'i de khyad par bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la brten nas thob par bstan pa'i phyir/ kha cig /brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa de chos ma rga pa yin zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ de lam bden ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de zag —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pomed ma yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ chos mngon pa me la bsregs pa'i chos spong gi las mi srid par thal/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa ni me la sreg mi nus/ brdar btags pa'i chos ma ro zhe pa chos mngon pa ma yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab/ 'o na/ sangs rgyas la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba'i mtshams med kyi (7na〉pas mi srid par thal/ ye shes la sus kyang khrag 'byin mi nus/ gzugasaphung sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa chos mngon pa gsungs pa'i dgos pa la/ tshig don/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shesarab brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang gi phyir na/shes rab de med par nyon mongs pa rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs med la/ nyon mongs pa dag dang ldan pas kyang / 'jig rten te skye dgu rnams srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang 'dra chos su grub pa 'dir 'khyams te/ thar pa thob par mi 'gyur ba de bas rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs la mngon pa sde bdun po 'di ston pas gsungs pa'i bka' dgra bcom bdun gyis bsdus par grags pa de'i rjes su gongs te bshad pa'i phyir/ lo zhes smos pa la chos can/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ slob dpon gyi/ mngon pa'i don ston pas gsungs shing / sdebadun dgra bcom pa bdun gyisabartsams par bzhed pas/ ma rangs pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /mngon pa mdzod 'di rang gi bstan don rtogs pa'i tshad ma sngon du song ba'i bstan bcos ma yin par thal/ rang gi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i mngon pa sde bdun la ma rangs pa'i tshig yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lo zhes bya ba'i tshig yod pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ lo zhes pa'i tshig de mngon pa sdebadun bka' yin par 'dod pa la ma rangs pa yin zhing / (7ba)de'i brjod don la ma rangs pa'i tshig ma yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/dang po gang zhig /phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang po der thal/ rang 'grel las/ bye brag tu smra ba rnams na re/ de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sil bur bshad la/ btsun pa kā tta'i bu la sogs pas —400

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (phanabasdus nas bzhag ste/ btsun pa chos skyob kyis ched du brjod pa'i sde tshan du byas pa bzhin no zer ro//ces/gsung bas pas/ skabs 'dir bye brag smra ba phyogabs sngar slang ba'i phyir dang / 'grel pa rgyal srabangam las kyang / lo zhes bya ba'i sgra ni/ chos ma rga pa ba rnams kyi gzhung lugs yin gyi/ mdo sdeb kho bo cag gi ni ma yin no/ /zhes pha rol gyi 'dod pa ston par byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/rtsa rtags gnyis pa der thal/ slob dpon gyis bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs khas len pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dus ma byas gsum rdzas grub tu khas len pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gsum rdzas su grub pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gsum don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nam mkhas rlung brten pa'i don byed nus/ so sor brtags 'gog gis rang gi bral thob 'dzin pa'i don byed nus/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pas rang gi dgag bya 'gog pa'i don byed nus pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/slob dpon dbyig gnyen mdo sde pa yin par thal/ 'grel pa rgyal sras mar/ mdo sde pa kho bo cag gi zhes khrung ba'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ de'i don ni/ mngon pa sdebadun sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma yin par 'dod pa mdo sde pa dang / slob dpon gnyis mthun par bstan gyi/ slob dpon mdo sde (8na)par bshad pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ la la dag /lo grag zer gsum bshad pa'i rgyan yin zer ba ni/ rang nyid kyis khas blangs phyin ci log tu bzung ba'i sgrib byed yin 'dug kyang zer rgyus phongs pa'o kha cig /srid nyon spangs pa'i gang zag yin na/ de spangs pa'i zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes thob pa'i gang zag yin bas khyab zer na/ de 'dra'i gang zag yin na/ de spangs pa'i zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shesathob pa'i gang zag yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yin na/ de slar skye mi rung gi chos can du byas nas spangs pa'i gang zag yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa brtsams pa'i gzhung gi brjod don la/ lus kyi tshul gyis mdor bstan pa/ yan lag gi tshul gyis rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gnyis su bsdu ba dang / cung zad bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ bstan —40/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobacos 'dir zag bcas dang zag med kyi chos gnyis brjod bya'i gtso bor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos thams cad bsdu na de gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /zag pa dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas su rung ba de zag bcas kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi mig dbang chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/der thal/ bsgom spang yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs can gyi khams bcu po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de bcu dang rnam shes kyi khams lnga la bsgoms spang gi khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bcu ni bsgoms pas spang bya yin/ /lnga yang / zhes(8ba〉na sungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ mtshungasaldan gyi sgo nas zag pa rgyas su rung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyon mongs rgyud ldan gyi dgra bcom pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cig /dmigs pa dang mtshudas ldan gang rung gi sgo nasazag pa skye ba'i chos yin na/ de gang rung gi sgo nas zag pa rgyas rung gi chos yin pas khyab zer na/'gog lam gnyis chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas zag pa skye ba'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis la dmigs nas zag pa skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/'gog pa mthong spang nyon mongs dang lam mthong spang nyon slongs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ zag bcas yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang 'grel las/ de gnyis la rgyas par ni mi 'gyur bas de gnyis zag pa dang bcas pa nyid du thal ba med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ lam bden du ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams ni/ zag bcas yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ de dag la dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan ci rigs pa'i sgo nas zag pa rnam pa kun tu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lam gyi bden pa dang / 'dus ma byas rnam gsum yang chos can/zag med yin te/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan ci rigs pa'i sgo nas zag pa rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' dang ni so so brtags 'gog /so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa gnyis 402

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)te gsum yod pa de la/ 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' cho so can/ mi sgrib pa zhes bya ste/ rang yod pa'i (9na gi zhir gzugs can gzhan 'byung ba la gegs mi byed pa'i stong cha yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi nyon sgrib spangs pa'i 'gog pa chos can/ so sor brtags pas 'gog pa yin te/zag med bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngo skal gyi nyon sgrib spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal mthong spang sogs bzhi spangs pa'i spangs pa bzhi po rdzas so so yin te/ de dag ldan par byed pa'i rdzas rnams kyang rdzas so so yin pa'i phyir/ chos 'og ma rnams skye ba la gtan du gegs byed pa bral ba las gzhan pa'i 'gog pa gang yin pa de chos can/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa yin te/zag med bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya spangs pa ma yin pa'i phyir na rgyu ma tshang bas re zhig yul gang dang gang dgag pa'i 'gog pa yin pa'i phyir/smras pa/ chos mngon kun gsal nor bu'i bzhin ras la/ /tshig don mtha' dpyod chu 'dzin smin ma'i gar/ /legs bshad gru char g.yo ba'i zur mig gis/ /blo gsal zhing pa'i 'dod ldan dga' ba skyed/ /zang zing nor gyi gzhal bas khugs min pa'i/ /ches dkon phra zhib rig pa'i nor bu dpya/ /mchog dman thar pa'i gling du 'khrid pa la/ /chos tshul 'phel 'di yongs 'dzin zhal lung yin/ /gang zhig 'brug sgra dal gyis rgod pa la/ /rma bya dal gyis brel ba chos nyid ltar/ /na tshod ches phra'i dus nas tshul 'di la/ thang zad sbyangs rnams mi smra'i rang dbang ci/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnas dang po khams bstan pa/gnyis pa yan lag (9ba)rgyas par bshad pa la/ gang la mkhas par bya ba'i gnas ngosagazung ba/ de ltar mkhas par byas pa'i yon tan dang gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhas bya'i gnas/ de nyid nges par byed tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ yul phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag /yul can dbang —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gepo'i rab dbye dang gnyis/ dang po la 'dus byas spyi'i mtshan nyid/ chos gsum gyi rnam gzhag /khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye dang gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba dang / ming gi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po la tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bshad pa'i lam bden du ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos rnams la dbye na mtha' yas kyang / bsdu na phung po lngar 'dus te/ de dag la gzugs can yin pa gzugs kyi phung po dang / la sogs pa gtso sems yin pa rnam par shes pa'i phung po/ sems byung yin pa tshor ba 'du shes/ de las gzhan pa'i sems byung dang /ldan min 'du byed rnams 'du byed kyi phung por 'du ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /gzugs can gyi khams yin na gzugs khams yin pas khyab zer na/ sgra'i khams cho me can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs phung yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/'dod na/ bstan yod yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzugs can gyi khams bcu'i nang nas gzugs khams la bstan yod kyis khyab cing / khams gzhan rnams bstan yod min pa'i phyir/der thal/ bstan yod 'dir ni gzugs gcig pu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /gzugs can gyi khams yin na/ (10na po zugs can gyi khams bcu po gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ so thar gyi sdom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ mig sogs dbang po lnga dang gzugs sogs don lnga po gang rung yin par thal/ (9ba 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dbang don de dag kho na la/ /skye mched dang ni khams bcur 'dod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /khams bco brgyad nang phan tshun 'gal bar thal mig sogs dbang po lnga po gang rung yin na/ de'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzugs khams ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de bco brgyad po re re nas nang phan tshun 'gal bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/'dod mi nus te/ yid khams dang rnam shes kyi khams drug po re re nas mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de drug po gang rung yin na/ yid khams yin dgos pa'i phyir/ kha cig /bar do ba'i rgyud la —404—

chos mngo ni rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)dbang po lnga yod par thal/ gnyid mthug po log bzhin pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi mig dbang de rten mtshungs kyi dbang po gzugs can pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzugs khams kyi bar do ba'i rgyud la mig sogs dbang po lnga yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de na mig sogs dbang po lnga yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de na sna'i dbang po dang lce'i dbang po yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de na de gnyis kyi rnam par shes pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ de na sna lce'i rnam par shes pa gnyis dang / dri ro gnyis kyi khams te bzhi ma gtogs lhag ma bcu bzhi yod/ 'dod khams na bco brgyad yod/ (10ba tshe/grugs med khams na yid dang chos kyi khams dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams ma ga rta gos gzhan rnams med pa'i phyir/ der thal/'dod khams ga rta gos pa thams cad do/ /gzugs kyi khams na bcu bzhi'o/ /dri dang ro dang sna dang ni//lce yi rnam shes khams ma gtogs/ /gzugs med gtogos pa yid dang ni/ /chos dang yid kyi rnam shes khams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra yin na/ zin pa'i khams yin pas khyab zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ sgra yin na ma zin pa'i khams yin dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems kyi khams bdun dang / chos khams kyi byed sems byung dang / sgra dang dgu po de ma zin pa'i khams dang / gzugs can gyi khams dgu la zin ma zin gyi cha gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ma zin dgu /brgyad po de dag rnams dang sgra/ /dgu po gzhan ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ so thar gyi sdom pa chos can/ bstan yod kyi gzugs yin par thal/ gzugs khams yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khams bco brgyad po gang rung yin/ lhag ma bcu bdun po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ phyi ma ma grub ste/ cho me khams yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs gang zhig /de la cho me khams kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ sdom pa de rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la sdom pa/ sdom pa min pa/ bar ma gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam rig min rnam gsum shes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ /—405

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logezhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ phung (11na)po bar pa gsum dang / rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos te lnga la chos khams dang chos kyi skye mched kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ de gsum rnam rig byed min dang / /'dus ma byas rnams bcas pa ni/ /chos kyi skye mched khamasazhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig /'dod pa'i rten can gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dbang po yin na/ 'dod pa'i sa sa bsdus yin pas khyab zer na/ de'i rten can gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi bsam gtan dang po'i mig dbang chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi gang zag gi bsam gtan dang po'i mig la brten nas bsam gtan dang po'i gzugs la lta ba'i tshe/ rten/ dbang po/ yul/ rnam par shes pa rnams mi mtshungs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rten 'dod pa'i sa sa bsdus/ lhag ma rnams bsam gtan dang po'i sa sa bsdus yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/bsam brtan dang po ba des gnyis pa'i mig la brten nas gnyis pa'i gzugs la lta ba'i tshe rten rnam par shes pa gnyis bsam gtan dang po'i sa sa bsdus/ lhag ma gnyis bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sa sa bsdus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gsum pa bas/ de bzhi pa ba'i mig la brten nas gnyis pa'i gzugs la lta ba'i tshe/ dbang po de bzhi pa'i sa sa bsdus/ rten de gsum pa'i sa bsdus/ yul de gnyis pa'i sa sa bsdus/ rnam par shes pa de dang po'i sa sa bsdus pa'i phyir/'dus byas ming gi rnam grangs sogs bshad pa/gnyis pa la 'dus byas spyi'i ming gi rnam grangs dang / zag bcas kyi ming gi rnam grangs(11bgi nyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dus byas de dag nyid chos can/ dus zhes bya ste/ dus gsum 'jog pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ gtam gzhi zhes bya ste/ rjod byed kyi gtam rnams 'byung —406

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/nges par 'byung bcas zhes bya ste/nges pa gdon mi zab dang /'byung ba myang 'das yin pas/ khyod dor nas lhag med myang 'das mngon du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ de chos can/gzhi dang bcas pa zhes bya ste/skyed par byed pa'i rgyu dang bcas pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/zag tsos kyi phung po lnga gang dag chos can/nyer len gyi phung po zhes bya ste/khyod nyer len nyon mongs pa de dag las byung ba dang /de dag la rag lus pa dang /khyod las rang gos nyer len nyon mongs pa rnams byung ba'i phyir/dper na rtolas byung ba'i me la tswame dang /rgyal po la rag lus pa'i mi la rgyal po'i mi dang /me tog skyed pa'i shing la me rtag gi shing zhes brjod pa ltar ro//zag phung de dag chos can/'thab bcas zhes kyang bya ste/khyod la brten nas rang gzhan la dmigs pa'i lus ngag gi 'thab mo 'byung ba'i phyir/de chos can/sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/sdug bsngal gsum po gang rung dang 'brel ba'i phyir/de chos can/kun 'byung zhes bya ste/sdug bsngal phyi ma skyed pa'i phyir/de chos can/'jig rten zhes bya ste/skad cig gis 'jig cing garsā pos kyang 'jig pa'i phyir/de chos༅/lta gnas zhes bya ste/lta ba ga pa rnams 'byung ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/srid pa zhesakyang bya ste/'khor ba thog med nas yang srid phyi ma yang yang du 'grub pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/chos gsum gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa/gnyis pa chos gsum gyi rnam bzhag la/ 12na sgos gsum so so'i rang bzhin/chos gsum gyi khyad chos/chos gsum gzhan gyis bsdus tshul dang gsum/dang po la/gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i cho me gsum/gzugs sems gnyis las ga pas bsdus pa'i cho me gsum/sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum/dang po la gzugs phung gi rang bzhi dang /de las phyung ste khams dang skye mgo du 'jog wo gnyis/dang po la mdor bstan dang /4/sa༅da gnyis/dang po ni/dbang bo lnga don lnga

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo7)dang rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs dang bcu gcig chos can/ gzugs phung yin te/ blo'i yul du du ma spungs pa ltar snang ba'i gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbang po lnga/ don lnga/rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ mig la sogs pa de dag rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i rten te bdag rkyen mig dbang sogs 'jog tshul yod de/ rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa'i thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs dang ba rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ la sogs zhes smos pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dbang po phyi ma bzhi la yang shugs kyis go nus pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gzugs 'dzin pa'i mig shes kyi yul gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi'i skye mched de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi skye mched chos can/khyod la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na rnam pa gnyis su yod de/ khyod la kha dog dang dbyibs kyi gzugs rnam pa gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la yan (12ba〉pag gi sgo nas dbye na rnam pa nyi shu yod de/ khyod la kha dog bcu gnyis dang dbyibs brgyad du yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi dang / yan lag gi kha dog brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ dkar po bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sprin/ du ba/ rdul/ khug rna/ snang ba ste zla skar/me/ sman/ nor bu rnams kyi 'od/ mun pa/ nyi ma/ grib ma rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ ring po/ thung ngu / lham pa ste gru bzhi/ zlum po/ mtho ba dma' ba/ cha le ba cha le ba ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sgra chos can/ khyod la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis yod de/khyod la zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na rnam pa brgyad yod de/ de gnyis re re la bzhi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dang po sems can du ston pa snyan mi snyan dang / mi ston pa snyan mi snyan gnyis yod pa gang zhig /phyi ma la yang de yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ skyes bus glu len pa/ skyes bus tshig rtsub smra ba/ sil ldan dang / khu tshur gyi sgra rnamasang rim pa —408

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)bzhin du yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ sprul pas chos 'chad pa/ desang ro sgrog pa/ dril bu rang sgra 'brol ba/ brag ral ba'i sgra rnams rim pa bzhin du yin pa'i phyir/ ro chos can/ khyod la dbye na rnam pa drug tu yod de/ mngar ba/ skyur ba/ kha ba/ bska ba/ tsha ba/ lan tshwa ba drug tu yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la mang por dbye rung ste/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas mngar ba'i mngar ba sogs drug tu phye ba'i sum cu rtsa drug dang / de re re la lce dbang gis myong ba'i tshe lce shes la phan 'dogs pa'i ro/ /'ju bar ma wa zhe du phyogs tshe lus (13na〉pa mi gnod pa'i ro/ 'ju ba'i tshe lus sems la phan 'dogs pa'i ro ste brgya dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang yod de/ ro drug phan tshun phrad pa'i khyad par las/ ro drug cu rtsa gsum du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ji skad du/ 'grel pa rgyal sras ma las/ rigs drug gi dbang du byas nas de skad ces bshad kyi/ ro drug phan tshun phrad pa'i khyad par las ni/ ro'i rnam pa rab tu mang por 'gyur te/ sman dbyad tsa ra ka las/ gcig dang gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga dang drug phrad pa'i spyor ba las ro drug cu rtsa gsum bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dri chos can/ khyod la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na rnam pa gnyis yod de/ zhim mi zhim gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na bzhi yod de/ dang po la mnyam mi mnyam dang / phyi ma la mnyam mi mnyam gnyis gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rgya spos/ a ka sa shing kun/ sgog skya'i dri rnams rim pa bzhin du yin pa'i phyir/ reg bya chos can/ khyod la bcu gcig gi bdag nyid du dbyer yod de/ 'byung ba bzhi'i reg bya bzhi/ 'byung 'gyur gyi reg bya bdun yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ 'jam rtsub/ lci yang / bkres sgom/ grang ba dang bdun yod pa'i phyir/ /smras pa/ dbang po lnga yi rin chen rtsig ngos la/ /skye mched lang ga'i bdag po'i gzugs brnyan stong / shar tshe ma 'dres byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /ha nu mas gnyis pa 'di na snang / /gya gyu'i sems kyis tshe 'di'i che thabs dag /sgrub pa'i dam pa'i gral du ma tshud kyang / /rigs pa'i mig gis shes bya'i gzigs mo kun/ /mthong ba 'di yang skyesathob shes rab drin/ /rjod byed nyung ngu sbyar (13ba tha'i gnam ru la/ /gzugs phung nyag phran mtha' —409—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gedag rab sbyar nas//blo gros rgyud kyis bkug tshe mgrin sngon can//'gog pa'i ting 'dzin rgyal brten nam snyam//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa/gsum pa rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa la/ngo bo/zhan byung gnyis/dang po ni/rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs de la ni 'jog tshul yod de/khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs la ngos 'dzin pa'i phyir/khyad chos bzhi dang ldan par brjod de/gnas skabs/ngo bo/rgyun/rgyu dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/dang po grub ste/ma yengs semasasakyi gnas skabs su 'byung bar ma zad/sems g.yeng ba dang sems med pa'i gnas skabs su yang 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa grub ste/dge mi dge gang rung gis bsdus pa'i phyir/gsum pa grub ste/snga ma snga ma las ma phyi ma rjes su 'brel ba'i rgyun dang bcas pa'i phyir/bzhi pa grub ste/'byung ba chen po bzhi rnams rgyur byas pa'i sa gzugs yin pa'i phyir//gnyis pa zhan thong ni/'byung ba'i dbye ba/byed las/ngo bo/los pa'i dogs dpyod bzhi/dang po ni/shes bya chos༅/'byung ba de dag la dbye na bzhi yod de/sa khams dang /chu dang /me dang /rlung gi khams rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/'byung bzhi'i byed las yod de/sa sa 'dzin par byed/la sogs pa chus sdud par byed/mes smin par byed/rlung gis rgyasapar byed pa las su grub pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/shes bya chos can/'byung bzhi'i ngo bo yod de/sra zhing 'thas14na tha sa/rlan zhing gsher ba chu/dro ba nyid me/yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ḍū dhwan 'dzin pa'i byings la/ḍū rjes su 'grel pa las/de'i tshar pa la lha ma dzi'o zhes pas/sdu dang /in dang /nya dang /ya dza /gaXlas gnyis ka kho zhes pas nya phyis/ṅgā lasagi

chosamangon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (phanata ni ga mi ma si sa tsi a bi ṅgā nya kru shi rnams las tu na'o zhes pas tu pa'o na rkyen byin/ rjes 'brel phyis pas rdzo tu cheXg pa khams dang / tho lha nya 'dzin pa la pa tsa sogs rnams las a tsa'o zhes pas a tsa'i rkyen sbyar bas dha ra zhes pa 'dzin pa yin pas gnyis ka rtags su grub zin par de ma go ba'i/drung chen dngos grub/ khams kyi skad dod/ dha tu la ṅgā ra'i rkyen dang sbyar zhes smra ba ni/ 'phags yul gyi sgra mdo chen po brgyad gang du yang ma grags pa'i ba 'ad gad kyi gtam du snang bas/ gzhan gyis dbang med du nan gyis bkol ba yin na ma gtogs/ tha snyad rig gnas pa'i thugs khur de bzhag nas mtshan nyid pa rkyang pa mdzad na legs pa 'dug go /bzhi pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa sogs dang sa'i kha dog sogs kyi dbye ba yod de/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du 'byung bzhi'i kha dog dang dbyibs la 'byung bzhir brjod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sa ser bo gru bzhi/ chu dkar po zlum po/ me dmar po gru gsum/ g.yin yang rlung gi tshogs ji snyed pa ni rlung gi khams nyid yin pas/ snga ma de dang 'dra bar rlung sngon po dang / zlum po zhes brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa de las phyung ste khams dang skye mched 'jog pa la/ tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ dbang don bcu po de dag kho na la skye mched du 'jog tshul yod de/ gzugs can gyi skye (14bsgo ched bcur 'jog pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ khams su 'jog pa'i tshul yod de/ gzugs can gyi khams bcur 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag phor mtshon par byed pa de pho dbang gi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag mor mtshon par byed pa de mo dbang gi mtshan nyid zer na/ mtshan gnyis pa ba'i rgyud kyi pho dbang chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gang zag de'i rgyud kyi mo dbang chos can/ mas nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gang zag de pho mo gnyis ka yin par thal lo/ kha cig /tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang po yin na/ tshor ba la lngar phye ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang po yin pas khyab zer na/ tshor ba yid mi bde ba'i dbang po chosacan/ der thal/ de'i phyir/—411 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logeder thal/ tshor ba la bde sdug btang snyoms gsum du phye ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang po yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lus tshor yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ phyi tshor yin par thal lo/ kha cig /tshor ba bde ba'i dbang po yin na/ tshor ba la lngar phye ba'i tshor ba bde ba'i dbang po yin pas khyab zer na/ tshor ba bde ba'i dbang po chos can/der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ tshor ba la gsum du phye ba'i tshor ba bde ba'i dbang po yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /dad pa'i dbang bo yin na/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i dad pa'i dbang po yin pas khyab zer na/ de yin na lam yin pas khyab par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa gang zhig /byang (15na/phyogs so bdun gyi dad par lam gyis khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dad pa'i dbang po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus/ldan min 'du byed bshad pa/gnyis pa gzugs sems gnyis las g.yin pas bsdus pa'i chos gsum la/ ngo bo/ de lasakhams dang skye mched 'jog tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/rang stobs kyis nyams su myong ba'i sems byung de yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba de chos can/ khyod la dbye tshul yod de/ bde ba sogs lngar dbye rigs pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang stobs kyis yul spu ris mtshan ma mi 'dra bar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid kyi sems byung de yin pa'i phyir/ 'du shes chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ khyod la rtog bcas rtog med gnyisasu yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i mtshan nyid yod de/ phung po gzhan bzhi las don gzhan zhig tu gyur pa'i 'dus byas de yin pa'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi phung po chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ khyod la mtshungs ldan 'du byed dang ldan min 'du byed gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/—412

chos ma' rin rsā 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs sems gnyis las g.yin pa'i chos gtan la phab pas chos kyi skye mched dang chos kyi khams zhes bya ba rnams kyang gtan la phab par 'gyur te/ de gsum rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs 'dus ma byas rnams dang bcas pa rnams skye mched khams su 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum la/ chos gsum gyi rang bzhin/ chosagasum (15ba)gyi gtso bo ngos gzung ba/ zhar la khams kyi grangs nges la rtsod pa spang ba dang gsum/dang po ni/ rnam shes tsho gos drug chos can/ rnam shes kyi phung po yin te/ blo'i yul du du ma spungs pa ltar snang zhing / ngo bo rang gi stobs kyis so sor rnam par rig pa'i gtso sems yin pa'i phyir/ shesabya chos can/ yid kyi skye mched kyang yod de/ drug po de nyid de yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/khams bco brgyad du 'jog pa'i tshe rnam shes kyi khams bdun dag tu'ang 'dod de/ rnam par shes pa drug dang / bdun pa yid khams rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ yid kyi khams de rnam shes tshogos drug lasadon gzhan ma yin te/ rang gi bdag 'bras kyi dus na 'das ma thag pa'i rnam shes tshogs drug 'das ma thag pa ste de nas rnam shes gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i rnam shes gang yin pa de yid kyi khamasayin pa'i phyir/ yid khams chos can/ rnam shes tshogos drug las logs su smos pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes kyi thun mong min pa'i rten ni rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir du smos pa'i phyir/khams chos can/ khyod la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na bco brgyad dag tu 'dod de/ khyod la bdag rkyen byed pa'i khams drug /dmigs pa yul gyi khams drug /'bras bu rnam shes kyi khams drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bco brgyad po de/ rdzas kyi sgo nas bcu gnyis su 'du ste/ rnam shes tshogis drug yid khams su 'du ba'i phyir/ cung zad bsdu na bcu bdun du yod de/ yid khams rnam shes tshogos drug las gzhan du med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos gsum gyi gtso bo ngos gzung ba ni/ gzugs kyi phung po dang ni yid kyi skye mched dang / chos khams gcig pu de gsum po chos can/ chos gsum gyi gtso bo yin (16na)te/ khyod kyis chos thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pochos gzugs phung dang / sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos yid kyi skye mched dang / gzugs sems las gzhan pa'i chos/ chos khams kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ bsdu tshul de ni/ rang gi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i tshul gyis bsdus pa yin te 'dir bsdu bya'i chos ni sdu byed gzhan gyi bsdu bya'i dngos por mi ldan pa'i phyir/gsum pa khams kyi grangs nges la rtsod pa spong ba ni/ kho na re/ khams bco brgyad du grangs ma nges par thal/ mig g.yas g.yon sogs yod pa'i phyir/ zer na/ shes bya chos can/ mig rna ba sogs gsum po gnyis gnyis yod pas grangs mangs bar thal ba'i skyon med de/ mig g.yas g.yon gnyis mig tu rigs gcig pa dang spyod yul gzugs la dmigs pa dang / 'bras bu rnam shes skyed pa 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis khams gcig tu bzhag pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ gang zag gcig la mig sogs gsum re res don byed nus pa la gnyis gnyis yod pas ci bya zer na/ shes bya chos can/ skyes bu la mig gnyis byung ba'i rgyu mas yod de/ rten mdzes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa chos gsum gyi khyad chos la/ chos gsum gyi sgra don/ chos gsum gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ chos gsum gyi go rim dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phung po lnga chos can/ phung po zhes bya ste/ du ma spungs pa'i 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ skye mched bcu gnyis chos can/ skye mched ces bya ste/ rnam shes skyed pa'i sgo nas de skye zhing mched par byed pa'i phyir/ khams bco brgyad chos can/ khams zhes bya ste/ 'bras (16ba)bu 'byung ba'i rgyu'am rigs yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ dgos pa dngos dang / dogs dpyod gnyis/ dang po ni/ phung po la sogs pa'i chos gsum bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ sems byung la ril po/ gzugs can la ril po/ gzugasasems gnyis ka la ril po gcig tu rmongs pa'i rmongs pa gsum po de bzlog pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ phung po lnga bshad pas rmongs pa dang po bzlog nus te/ phung po lnga'i skabs su sems byung gi phung po la gsum du phye ba'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ skye mched bcu gnyis bshad pas rmongs pa gnyis pa bzlog nus te/ de'i skabs su/ gzugs can gyi skye mched la bcur phye ba'i phyir/—414

chos ma' rin 0 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas dang po/ (pha)shes bya chos can/ khams bco brgyad bshad pas rmo mes pa gsum pa bzlog nus te/ de'i skabs su/gzugs can gyi khams la bcu dang / rnam shes kyi khams la bdun du bshad pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ chos gsum gsungs pa'i dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ dbang rnon la tshig bsdus pa/ dbang 'bring la 'bring / dbang rtul la rgyas pa 'dod pa gsum dang 'tsham par bstan nas rjes su gzung ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sems byung gi nang nas tshore ba dang 'du shes gnyis phung po logs su bzhag pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pas 'gro ba rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhan rnams las rags shing nyen mongs kyi go rim gyi rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas phung po sgo du ma bshad pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ du ma spungasapa'i don du mi rung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa go rim la/ phung (17na)po'i go rim/ khams dang skye mched kyi go rim/ zhar byung dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phung po lnga'i go rim 'di rags pa dang por bstan nasaphra ba mjug tu bstan pa yin te/ snga ma snga ma las ma phyi ma phra ba'i phyir/ de 'dra'i go rim de ltar byas pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzugs mthong bas nye zhe mongs skye/ de nas tshor ba/ tshor bas bde ba thob 'dod/ de nas 'du shes phyin ci log /de nas 'du byed chags sdang sogs/ de nas rnam par shes pa nyon mongs can gyi ngo bor skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs skye ba'i go rim dang mthun pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas pa la dgos pa yod de/ gzugs snod/ tshor ba zas/ 'du shes byan/ 'du byed byan po/ rnam shes de (14ba 'a longs spyod pa po dang mtshungs par shes pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/snod la sogs pas don khams ji lta ba bzhin du nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snod kyis zas rten pa bzhin du gzugs kyis tshor ba rten/ zas longs spyad bya yin pa bzhin du/ tshor ba rnam shes kyis spyad bya yin/ byan des zas zhim par byed pa bzhin du/ 'du shes kyis bde sdug gi tha snyad 'dogs/ byan pos zas 'dren par byed pa bzhin du/ 'du byed kyis rnam shes kyi yul la bde sdug skyed par byed/skyes bu zas za ba bzhin du rnam shes kyis bde sdug la spyod pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas pa la dgos pa —4/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logeyod de/ 'dod khams gzugs kyis phye/ bsam gtan bzhi tshor bas phye/ gzugs med dang po gsum 'du shes kyis phye/ srid rtse 'du byed kyis phye/ rnam shes kun la khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis(17ba)pa ni/ gzugs can gyi dbang po lnga dang por bstan nas yid dbang rjes su bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ dang po lnga yul da ltar ba kho na la 'jug /phyi ma gcig pu dus gsum ga la 'jug pa'i don can yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can gyi dbang po lnga'i nang nas lus dbang rjes su bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ don de bzhi 'byung gyur kho na'i yul can dang / gcig pu byung ba dang 'byung gyur gnyis ka la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gzhan mig sna'i dbang po gnyis kyi nang nas snga ma dang por bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ mig dbang gis ches ring ba'i yul la 'jug la/ cig shos kyis de tsam gyi sgra mi thos pa'i phyir/ sna lce gnyis kyi nang nas/ sna dang por bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ de yul la myur bar lces ro ma myong pa'i sngon du 'jug pa'i phyir/ yang na zhes smos pa la dgos pa yod de/gong gi go rim de dbang rten lus la ji ltar gnas pa bzhin gyi rim pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/mig gi yul kho na la gcig ni gzugs kyi skye mched du bzhag pa la dgos pa yod de/ spyir gzugs can bcu gzugs yin yang 'dir spyi ming bye brag la btags pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar btags pa la dgos pa yod de/ de gzugs kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ yid shes kho na'i yul la gcig ni chos khams zhes bya bar bzhag pa la dgos pa yod de/ spyir 'dus byas 'dus ma byasathams cad chos yin yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa des/ de gnyis ka'i chos mang po dang chos kyi mchog myang 'das yul du bsdus pa'i phyir/ /smras pa/ phung khams skye mched ri dwags mig can la/ /ma 'dres (18na〉khyed pa'i rin chen phra tsho mes kyis/ /rnam par brgyan 'di blo gsal
