rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ge'ajig rten pa'i lam chos can/mnyam pas mnyam pa dang /khyad par can gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed pa de gnyis kho na yin te/dper na thos pa dang bsams pa las byung ba dang /bsgoms pa las byung ba rnams mnyam pa dang /khyad par can cho ga'i rgyu yin gyi/dman pa'i rgyu ma yin pa lta bus shes nus pa'i phyir/bzhi pa mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu ni/mtshudas ldan gyi rgyu chos can/khyod kyi 'jog tshul yod de/thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen cig la brten par mtshungs pa can gyi sems dag dang /sems byung gnyis la byed 44na ) pa'i phyir/lnga pa kun 'gro'i rgyu ni/kun 'gro'i rgyu chos can/khyod 'jog tshul yod de/gos bu rang dang 'dra ba skyed pa'i nyon mongs can gyi rgyu cig la byed pa'i phyir/drug pa rnam smin gyi rgyu ni/rnam smin gyi rgyu chos can/khyod la gnyis su grangs nges te/mi dge ba dang /dge ba zag bcas gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/kun 'gro dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu gnyis ni dus gnyis pa ba yin te/'das pas da ltar ba dang /da ltar bsam 'ongs pa'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ lhan cig 'byung ba/ mtshungs ldan/ rnam smin gsum po dag ni dus gsum pa ba yin te/ma 'ongs pas ma 'ongs pa skyed pa yod pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/byed rgyu gsal bar mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/dus thams cad pa dang /dus dang bral ba yang rig par bya'o//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa 'bras bu la/mtshan gzhi/'bras bu gang rgyu du las 'byung tshul/'bras bu so so'i ngo bo dang gsum/dang po ni/'bras bu chos can/khyod bzhag tu yod de/'dus byas/bral ba 'gog pa dang bcas pa de yin pa'i phyir/'dus ma byas chos can/khyod la rgyu drug po de dag med de/dang po yang med/gnyis pa dang bzhi pa yang med/gsum pa dang lnga pa yang med/drug pa yang med pa'i phyir/dang po grub ste/'bras bu skye rung du med pa'i phyi///nyis pa grub ste/phan tshun rgyu gos su med pa'i

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren tha shing rta las gnas gnyis pa gad pa/ (phanaphyir/gsum pa grub ste/rigs mthun gyi rgyu med pa'i phyir/bzhi pa grub ste/de'i rgyur gyur pa'i mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas gang rung med pa'i 44ba phyir/gnyis pa ni/rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/drug gi nang nas tha ma las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/bdag po'i 'bras bu chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/dang po byed rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/rgyu mthun gyi gos bu chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/skal mnyam dang /kun 'gro gnyis las byung ba'i phyir/skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/lhan cig 'byung ba dang /mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gnyis las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/rnam smin gyi gos bu chos༅/khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ma sgrib pa lung du ma bstan pa'i chos yin la/sems can gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa cig la brjod pa'i phyir/de chos can/rgyu lung du bstan pa las phyis 'byung ste/mi dge ba dang /dge ba zag bcas gang rung las nyis 'byung ba'i yis bu yin pa'i phyir/rgyu mas gyi gos bu chos༅/khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/rgyu de dang rigasa'adra bar skyes pa'i 'bras bu cig la 'jog pa'i phyir/bral 'bras chos can/khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/blo bar chad med lam gyis rang gi spang bya zad par spangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i 'gog pa la byed pa'i phyir/skyes bu'i byed 'bras chos can/khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/rgyu gang skyes pa'i stobs kyis 'brasabu gang rang gi ngang gis skyes pa'i 'bras bu la byed pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/bdag po'i gos bu yod de/sngon du byung ba ma yin par dus mnyam pa'i phyir 'byung ba'i 'dus byas de yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa rgyu 'bras gnyis ka'i thun mong gi chos la 'bras bu 'dzin par byed pa'i khyad par dang /'bras bu gang rgyu gang las khrung tshul 45na ) gnyis/dang po ni/byed rgyu ma gtagos pa'i rgyu lnga po ni chos can/da ltar ba'i 'bras bu 'dzin par byed de/dus mnyam pa'i gos bu skyed pa'i nus pa yod pa'i phyir/lhan mtshudas kyi rgyu gnyis ni chos can/da ltar ba'i 'bras bu 'byin par byed de/'brasabu rang dang lhan cig tu skyes pa'i phyir/skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis ni chos can/da ltar gyi gos bu dang /'das pa'i gos bu dag kho / 'a byin te/skad cig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogeganyis pa la 'bras bu skyed na da ltar ba dang /bar chod pa'i 'bras bu skyed na 'das pa 'byin zhing /ma 'ongs ba'i 'bras bu 'byin pa med pa'i phyir/rnam smin gyi rgyu chos can/khyod 'das pa kho nasagos bu 'byin ba yin te/lhan cig gam de ma thag tu 'bras bu 'byin pa med pa'i phyir//gnyis pa la/sems sems byung gis bsdus pa dang /ma bsdus pa gnyis/dang po la/nyon mongs can/rnam smin skyes/de gnyis kyi lhag ma ma bsgribs lung ma bstan dang skad cig gnyis pa man chad kyi dge ba/zag med skad cig dang po'i dge ba dang bzhi/dang po ni/nyon mongs can gyi 'bras bu rgyu gzhan lnga las byung yang rnam smin gyi rgyu las ma byung ste/rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ma bsgribasalung ma bstan la bshad pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/rnam smin gyi gos bu rgyu gzhan lnga las byung yang kun 'gro'i rgyu las ma byung ste/de nyen slongs can yin pa gang zhig/cig shos bsgribs lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/lhag ma rnams dang /zag med skad cig gnyis pa 45ba ) ma na chad kyi gos bu ni chos can/gzhan bzhi las byung yang /rnam smin dang kun 'gro'i rgyu de gnyis las ma byung ste/rim bzhin mi dge ba dang /dge ba zag bcas kyi 'bras bu ma yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/zag med skad cig dang po'i 'phags lam ni chos can/gzhan gsum las skyes kyang /rnam smin/kun 'gro/skal mnyam gyi rgyu gsum las ma byung ste/dang po gnyis las ma byung ba gang zhig/phyi ma las ma byung ba'i phyir/phyi ma der thal/de zag med kyi rigs 'dra sngon song ma yin pa'i phyir/de ltar bshad pa la chos can/dgos pa yod de/sems dang sems las byung ba'i dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya cho ge can/sems sems byung gis ma bsdus pa'i 'bras bu rnams kyi rgyu yod de/mtshudas ldan gyi rgyu ma gtogs pa gzhan sngar bshad pa bzhin du bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis las skye ba yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/longs ldan gyi rgyu las ma byung ste/khyod dang mtshudas ldan gyi semasasems byung gang yang med pa'i phyir//smras pa/dge dang mi dge bar ma'i sa bo/ /sa//bde sdug btang snyoms lo 'bras smin byed

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gnyis pa bzhad pa/ (phanapa'i//ma 'dres tshul bzhin ston pa'i bstan bcos dag/ma thos blun po bag med byed bden yang //cung zad shes bzhin nyes spyod zlos gar gyis//ga 'gro'i g.yang la mchang ba'i skye bo dag/gzhung lugs thos 'di tshig phyir ma 'brang bar//de don rigs pas dpyad nas legs soms dang //srid pa'i sdug bsngal chu yi rlabs ltar g.yo//ngan song me 'obs lta bur brnag dka' na/shes bzhin las 46na〉'bras khyad du gsod byed pa//snying 'di lcags las byas sam gzhan ci zhig/ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa la/rkyen gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang /de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/dbye ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/so so'i rang bzhin rgyasapar bshad pa/de dag gi khyad chos gas bshad pa dang gsum/dang po ni/rkyen chos ro/khyod la dbye na bzhi yod de/rgyu rkyen/de ma thag rkyen/dmigs rkyen/bdag rkyen dang bzhi dag tu gsungasapa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/sngar bshad pa'i rgyu phyi ma lnga po chos can/rgyu'i rkyen yin te/rang tsos ngo bo la phan 'dogs byed yin pa'i phyir/skyes pa da ltar ba dang /'das pas 'i bsdus pa' sems semasabyung phal che ba rnams chos can/mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen yin te/rang phros rig pa phyi ma'i nyer len byed nus kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/lhag med pa'i dgra bcom pa'i tha ma'i sems sems byung rnams chos can/de ma thag rkyen ma yin te/rang 'bras rig pa phyi ma'i nyer len ma yin pa'i phyir/gzugs sogs kyi chos thams cad dmigs rkyen yin te/gzugs de mig gi rnam shes kyi dmigs rkyen yin pa gang zhig/chos thams cad yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i dmigs rkyen yin pas mtshon nusapa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/byed rgyu zhes bya ba 'jog tu yod de/bdag po'i rkyen du bshad pa'i phyir/rkyen 'di gnyis po chos can/khyad par yod de/rnam shes dang lhan cig tu byung ba'i chos46brnams de'i dmigs rkyen ma yin yang bdag rkyen yin pa'i phyir//gsum pa la/rkyen gang gis lāsabu gang la bya ba byed tshul/'bras bu gang rkyen ༷༷ las byung tshul/'byung ba 'byung gyur gnyis rkyen

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogedang rkyen can du 'gyur ba'i tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gnyis po dag ni chos can/'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i gos bu da ltar ba la bya ba byed de/rgyu 'bras dus mnyam pa'i phyir/rgyu lhag ma gsum po ni chos can/gos bu skye rung ma 'ongs pa la bya ba byed de/rang 'bras phyi ma skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/de las gzhan pa'i rkyen de ma thag rkyen/dmigasarkyen/bdag rkyen gsum po dag ni chos can/snga ma las go rim bzlog nas byed de/rim pa bzhin 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa/da ltar pa/dus kun la byed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/sems sems byung rnamasachos can/rkyen bzhis skyed de/'dus byas yin pas rgyu rkyen dang bdag rkyen las byung ba gang zhig/shes pa yin pas dmigs rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen las byung ba'i phyir/'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang /'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis chos can/dmigs rkyen ma gtogs pa gsum gyis skyed de/rgyu'i rkyen dang bdag rkyen gnyis kyis skyed pa gang zhig/snyoms par 'jug kha ma'i sems las byung ba'i de ma thag rkyen gyis kyang skyed pa'i phyir/de las gzhan ldan pa ma yin pa lhag ma dang /gzugasacan gyi dngos po rnams chos can/rgyu'i rkyen dang bdag rkyen gnyis po dag las skye ste/'dus byasayin pa'i phyir/rkyen ni bzhin grangs nges te/dbang phyug gam rtag pa sogs phyi rol pas 'dod pa rnams rkyen ma yin pa'i phyir/der thal/de'i 'bras bu rim bzhin skyed byed ma yin pa gang zhig/cig shos yin na skyed byed sogs yin dgos pa'i phyir/gsum pa la/'byung ba rgyur byas pa dang /'byung gyur rgyur byas pa gnyis/dang po la/'byung ba skyed pa dang /'byung gyur skyed pa gnyis/dang po ni/de'i rgyu 'byung ba ni chos can/rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/rang dang dus mnyam pa'i 'byung ba skyed pas lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu dang /rigs 'dra phyi ma skyed pas skal mnyam gyi rgyur gyur pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/'byung gyur chos can/khyod skyed pa'i tshe/byed rgyu kho nar 'gyur ba de la yang lnga yod de/'byung gyur phyi ma skyed par byed pa/de phyi ma la brten pa/gnas pa/rgyun mi 'chad pa/gong 'phel du byed ༵ khri yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa 'byung gyur rgyur byas

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gnyi pa bzhad pa/ (phanapa la/ de las yang gyur skyed pa dang / 'byung ba skyed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'byung gyur gyi gzugasaphan tshun skyed pa na gsum du 'gyur ba yod de/ nyon mongs can skyed pa'i tshe lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang skal mnyam gnyis su 'gyur ba gang zhig /ma sgribs lung ma bstan gyi tshe/ rnam smin gyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ 'byung ba rnams kyi rgyu byed pa'i tshe/ rnam smin gyi rgyu gcig pu de 'gyur te/ lus ngag gi las de dbang po dang tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa/gnyis pa de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa la/ bcu gnyis su dbye ba/ nyi shur dbye ba/sems kyi thob pa rnyed tshul bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ so so'i rang bzhin bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems yid gnyis chos can/ 'dod pa'i khamasan bzhin yod de/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / sgrib pa dang / ma sgrib pa bzhin yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa dag na gsum gsum yod de/ mi dge ba las ga' na pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ sngar bshad pa bcu po'i steng du gnyis bsnan pas bcu gnyis su 'gyur te/ slob pa zag med dang / mi slob pa zag med gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa/ gzugs kyi dbang du byas pa/ gzugs med kyi dbang du byas pa gsum/dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod sems dge ba'i mjug tu sems byung dgu 'byung ste/ rgyun dang samatshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i bzhi/ khams gong ma gnyis su nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe de'i sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis/ snyoms 'asdug gi tshe gzugs kyi dge sems/ zag med gnyis te dgu rnams sting ba'i phyir/ 'dod sems dge ba de ni chos can/ brgyad kho na'i mjug tu 'gyung ste/ rang sa'i bzhi dang /snyoms 'jug las langs pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems dang / zag med gnyis dang / gzugs kyi —461 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posnyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe/gzugs kyi sgrib pa dang brgyad las yang ba'i phyir/'dod pa'i mi dge ba ni chos can/bcu dag las khrung ste/rgyun dang sa mtshungs pa'i tsherang sa'i bzhi dang /nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs kyi sems gsum/gzugs med kyi gsum ste bcu las yang ba'i phyir/de chos can/khyod las bzhi 'byung 4gci/rang sa'i bzhi 'byung ba'i phyir/'dod pa'i sgrib lung ma bstan la yang rigs 'gre/'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa ni cho me can/sems lnga las 'byung ste/sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i bzhi/sprul pa la 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems dang lnga las khrung ba'i phyir/de chos can/khyod las 'jug thogs su sems bdun 'byung ste/sa wodasapa'i tshe rang sa'i bzhi/khams gong ma gnyis su nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe de gnyis kyi nyon mongs can gnyis/sprul pa las langs pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems te bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa gzugs kyi dbang du byas pa ni/gzugs kyi dge ba chos can/khyod las bcu gcig 'byung ste/sa ma tsos pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang bsgribs pa gnyis/gzugs gzugs med kyi sgrib pa gnyis/snyoms 'as ga gi tshe gzugs med kyi dge ba zag med gnyis/sprul pa 'jug pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i ma bsgribs pa/sgoms 'jug lasalangs pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge sems te bcu gcig 'byung ba'i phyir/gzugs kyi dge ba de ni chos can/dgu'i 'jug thogs su 'byung ste/sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/snyoms 'dug gi tshe 'dod pa'i dge ba/de las langs pa'i tshe gzugs med kyi dge ba zag med gnyis/sprul pa las langs pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa/nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe gzugs med kyi sgrib pa'i 'jug thogs su 'byung ba'i phyir/gzugs kyi sgrib pa chos can/sems brgyad las yang ste/sa44mtshudas pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs med kyi gsum/'dod pa'i dge ba dang /ma sgrib lung ma bstan te brgyad las 'byung ba'i phyir/de chos can/khyod las drug 'byung ste/sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying maX sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib pa

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gnyis pa gad pa/ (phanaganyis/nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge ba ste drug 'byung ba'i phyir/gzugs kyi ma sgrib pa ni chos can/sems gsum las khrung ste/rang sa'i gsum las khrung ba'i phyir/de chos can/khyod las drug 'byung ste/sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib pa gnyis/gzugs med kyi sgrib pa ste drug 'byung ba'i phyir//gsum pa/gzugs med kyi dbang du byas pa ni/gzugs med kyi dge ba chos can/khyod las sems dgu 'byung ste/sa mtshudas pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs kyi bsgribs pa/'dod pa'i bsgribs pa dang mi dge ba gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe zag med gnyis/de las langs pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge ba ste dgu 'byung ba'i phyir/gzugs med kyi dge ba de ni chos can/drug gi 'jug thogs su 'byung ste/rang sa'i gsum/snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge ba/ldang ba'i tshe zag med gnyis las khrung ba'i phyir/gzugs med kyi sgrib pa chos can/khyod las bdun 'byung ste/sa wongs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs kyi sgrib pa/'dod pa'i 49nabasgribs pa/mi dge ba/gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe gzugs kyi dge ba ste bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ bdun las 'byung ste/ rang sa'i gsum/ nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod gzugs kyi dge ba dang /sgrib pa bzhi las sting ba'i phyir/gzugs med kyi bsgribs pa chos can/gsum las 'byung ste/rang sa'i gsum las 'byung ba'i phyir/de chosacan/khyod las drug 'byung ste/sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugasakyi sgrib pa/'dod pa'i bsgribs pa dang /mi dge ba ste drug 'byung ba'i phyir/slob pa'i sems zag med ni chos can/bzhi las 'byung ste/snyoms 'jug gi cha khams gsum gyi dge ba gsum/rgyun gyi tshe rang gi rigs 'dra sngon ma dang bzhi las 'byung ba'i phyir/de chos can/khyod las lnga 'byung ste/snga ma gsum gyi steng du rgyun gyi tshe rigs 'dra phyi ma/rtogs pa 'phel ba'i tshe mi slob pa'i sems zag med ste lnga 'byung ba'i phyir/mi slob pa'i sems zag // ni chos can/lnga las 'byung ste/sgoms 'jug gi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)tshe khams gsum gyi dge ba/ rtogs pa 'phel ba'i dbang du byas na slob pa'i zag med/ rgyun gyi tshe rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma ste lnga las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod las sems bzhi dag 'byung ste/snyoms 'jug las langs pa'i tshe khams gsum gyi dge ba gsum/ rgyun gyi tshe rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma nyid 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa nyi shur dbye ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i bcu gnyis po de (49brkog chos can/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na nyi shu yod de/ khams gsum gyi dge ba la skyes nas thob pa dang / sbyor byung gnyis gnyis phye bas drug dang / khams gsum gyi sgrib pa gsum/ 'dod pa'i mi dge ba ste bcu dang /'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa ste lung du bstan pa ma yin pa la rnam smin skyes dang / spyod lam pa dang / bzo yi gnas dang / sprul pa'i sems te bzhi dang / gzugs na bzo gnas ma gtogs pa'i gsum dang /gzugs med kyi bsgribs pa dang / slob mi slob kyi sems zag med gnyis te nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa sems kyi thob pa bye brag tu rnyed tshul bshad pa ni/ khams gsum las 'dod pa'i rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod rang gi 'bras bu las nyams nas nyon mongs pa mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ sems drug gi thob pa cig car du rnyed de/ 'dod pa'i dge mi dge /khams gsum gyi bsgribs pa gsum dang / slob pa zag med de drug gi thob pa cig car du rnyed pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i dgra bcom pa de chos can/ rang 'bras las nyams nas 'dod pa'i 'dod chags las ma nyams/ gzugs kyi nyon mongs mngon du gyur pa'i tshe sems drug gi thob pa cig car du rnyed de/ gzugs kyi dge ba/'dod gzugs gnyis kyi sprul sems gnyis/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi bsgrubs pa gnyis/ slob pa zag med dang drug gi thob pa cig car du rnyed pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i dgra bcom chos can/ rang 'bras las nyams nas gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can mngon du gyur pa'i tshe gnyis rnyed de/ de nyid dang /slob pa'i thob pa (50na)gnyis rnyed pa'i phyir/ gzugs su skyes pa'i tshe gsum cig car du rnyed de/de'i dge ba/ de'i stobs kyis 'dod gzugs kyi sprul sems te gsum rnyed pa'i phyir/ slob pa zag —464

chos mgi rin wo 'dren pa'i shing rta la gnas gnyis pa bshad pa/ (phanamed/ gzugs kyi dge ba/ de'i stobs kyis sprul sems gnyis te bzhi'i thob pa chos can/ khyod sbyor lam pas 'dod pa'i rten la bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs la brten nas sdug bsngal chos bzod thob pa'i tshe rnyed de/ de'i tshe cig car du rnyed pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa drug po'i lhag ma sems drug po rnams la ni/ sngar mi ldan gsar rnyed kyi tshe sems zla bo rnyed pa'i nges pa med de/ de'i tshe sems rang rang gcig pu de nyid rnyed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ chos mngone pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ gnas gnyis pa zhes bya ba gtan la phab pa yin te/ dbang po mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i phyir/smras pa/ mtshams sprin gsar pa'i mngal du lci ba'i khur/ /'jam mgon mi yi rgyu 'phrul rol gar can/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs pad nyer bsten pas/ /gzhung lugs 'di 'dra smra ba'i spobasapa thob/ /gzhung don so sor ma 'dres phye ba yis/ /dbang po'i gzhu de skyengs nas mkha' la bros/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i thog mda' 'phangs pa na/ /dbang phyug 'gog pa'i rdzul nye bar brten/ /cho ge tshul chu gter ma lus 'bab pa'i gnas/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho'i phra zhib 'byed pa la/ /chos kyi spyan ldan dbyig gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po gang de'i zhal lung ltar/ /ma 'dres tshig don phye ba yang / /ma smad stobs bcu'i go 'phang de/ /ma lus 'gro bas thob pa'i tshe/ /ma gyur sems can don du bsto/ /chos mdzo pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa/ chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya (50ba)ba las/ gnas gnyis pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod ji snyed pa bshad zin to/ /—465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ganas gsum pa 'jig rten bstan pa/rnam dpyod me long gsar pa'i ngos yangs por/ snod bcud gzugs brnyan brgya phrag 'char byed pa'i/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi zlos gar can/ /dkon mchog chos 'phel smra ba'i zla ba rgyal/ /g.yin phan 'dren par rlom pa'i rnam g.yeng gis/ /phyogs bral rgyal khams nyul bar ma phyin kyang / /shes rab mig gis khams gsum ma lus pa'i/ /snang tshul rjen par mthong 'di gad mo bro/ /zang zing 'byor pa'i zong gis khugs min zhing / /kha drag dpung gis 'phrog par nus min pa'i/ /bslabs shing sbyangs pas shes pa'i yon tan 'di/ /bsams shing zhe blo bde ba'i ngo mtshar yin/ /gnyis skyes mun pa'i mdog can rnam thar gyis/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad 'ba' zhig don gnyer la/ /dbyar skyes gzhen nu gcan gzan mdun ngogs su/ /'byur bur spungs dang khyad par ma mchis kyang / /pad dkar 'dab brgya rgod pa'i dga' tshal du/ /bgrod par chas pa'i ra yig gnyis pa ltar/ /thos pa'i tshul la chog mi shes pa yi/ /blo ldan tshogs rnams long la ci dgar spyod/ /gnyis pa de nyid nges par byed tshul la/ ta shes bya sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gtan la phab/ spang bya kun 'byung gi bden pa gtan la phab/ thob bya 'gog lam gyi bden pa gtan la phab pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ nang bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / skye tshul rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin bshad pa/ (51na)skye ba gnas pa'i thabs/ gnas pa 'chi ba'i sems bshad/ sems can gyi tshogs gsum du bsdu ba dang lnga/ dang po la/ khams gsum du dbye ba dang / 'gro ba lngar dbye ba/ skye gnas bzhin dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'dod pa/ gzugs/ gzugs med pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ tshig don dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi rnams—466

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanadang / 'dod lha rigs drug po rnams brten par byed pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten lhar bcas pa chos can/'dod pa'i khams yin te/ 'dod par spyi mthun gyi las kyis 'phangs shing / de la chags bral ma byas pa'i sa sa bsdus yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod khams chos can/ khyod la dbye na nyi shur yod de/ dmyal ba la yang sos sogs brgyad dang mi la gling bzhir dbye ba las nyi shur yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /grang dmyal dang nyi tshe ba dang gling phran rnams 'dod khams su mi ga rta gos par thal/ de la grangs nyi shur nges pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ snga ma tsha dmyal dang / phyi ma gling bzhi'i 'khor yin la/ nyi tshe ba la gnas dang tshe nges pa med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gang spel las/ ngos bzhi la 'khor gyi tshul du gnas pas gtso bo ma yin la/ nye tshe ba ni grangs dang tshad nges pa med pa'i phyir ma drangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /gling phran brgyad po gang rung gi rten can yin na/ mi yin pas khyab zer na/ rnga yab gling gi rten can gyi srin po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gang spel las (51ba)gcig na ni srin po dag yod do/ /zhes bya ba ni rnga yab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /dmyal ba'i sgra don/ na rag zhes/ na dgag pa la bshad nas/ ra ga zhes pa mi rnyed pa'i don yin pas/ skyabs mi rnyed pa zhes bshad pa ni mi 'thad de/ de ltar na/ mi rnyed pa de dgag pa'i gnas bkag pas rnyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/gnyis pa la tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khams gong ma'i gnasatshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar dang bcu bdun ni brten pa sa dang bcas pa chos can/ gzugasakhams yin te/ gzugs khams su spyi mthun gyi las kyis 'phangs shing / 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral/ gzugs la chags bral ma byas pa'i sa bsdus pa'i phyir/ de cho sgo can/ khyod la so so'i sgo nas dbye na bcu bdun yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi las/ dang po gsum la gsum gsum yod bsadagu /bzhi pa la sgo skye'i gnas gsum/ 'phags pa'i gnas lnga ste brgyad du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun po gang rung gi rten can yin —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)na/ lha yin pas khyab zer na/ gzugs khams kyi rten can yin na/ lha yin pas khyab par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzugs khams kyi bar srid pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i bar srid kyi rten can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzugs khams kyi rten can gyi gang zag yin na/ de'i skye srid kyi rten can yin mi dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba de chos can/ der thal/ (52na)de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ der skye ba blangs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der skye ba blangs pa ni gang zhig /gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ lha yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ bar do ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzugs kyi bar do ba de 'gro ba rigs lnga po gang rung du ma gtogs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can zhes bya bar srid min/ /zhes dang / rang 'grel du/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos drangs pa las/ skye gnas bcis ni 'gro ba lnga bsdus kyi/ 'gro ba lngabs ni skye gnabs bzhi ma bsdus te/gang zhig ma bsdus zhe na/ srid pa bar ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ gzugs med khams chos can/ khyod na gzugs can gyi gnas med de/ rten snod dang / brten pa sems can la kha dog dang dbyibs sogs med pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la snyoms 'jug gi dbang gis skye ba las ni rnam pa bzhi yod de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la rten gzugs med pas brten pa sems med pa'i skyon med de/ der ni rigs 'dra skal mnyam dang / srog la yang sems kyi rgyud ni brten pa'i phyir/gnyis pa 'gro ba lngar dbye ba la/ dngos dang dogs dpyod gnyis/ dang po la/ tshig don dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khams gsum po der ni chos(52ba)can/ skye ba'i 'gro ba lnga yod de/ dmyal ba pa la sogs pa rang rang gi ming gis bstan pa de dag gi phyir/ 'gro ba lnga che ldasabashad pa la chos can/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa'i lha ma yin lha dang /'phen byed mi dge bas 'phangs pa'i lha ma yin dud 'gror 'du ba'i phyir/ 'gro ba lnga po chos can/ ma —468

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanabasgribs lung ma bstan yin te/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa gang zhig /lung du bstan pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la sems can zhes bya ste/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i sems rgyud la brten pa'i phyir/ bar srid pa de 'gro ba lngar tog gas pa ma yin te/ gdags pa las 'gro ba lngas skye gnasabazhi ma bsdus te/ gang zhe na srid pa bar ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /gzhud 'di'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i 'gro ba lnga po gang rung yin na/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i khams gsum gang rung gi rten can yin pas khyab zer na/ chu bur can gyi rten can chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i 'dod pa'i rten can yin par thal/'dod pa gang zhig g.yin gnyis po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i dmyal ba pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig /gzhan rnams ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/tsha dmyal ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzhung 'di'i skabs su tsha dmyal brgyad dngosasu bstan nas/ grang dmyal dang nyi tshe ba rnams shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dmyal ba dang gling dbye ba las de nyi shu/ zhes pa'i nyi shu'i grangs nges de mi 'thad par thal/ de las mang ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /sems kyi gnas pa bdun sogs bshad pa/gnyis ba la/ (53na〉sems kyi gnas pa bdun bshad/ sems can gyi gnas dgu bshad/sems kyi gnas pa bzhi bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang bo ni/rnam par shes pa'i gnas pa chos can/ khyod la bdun yod de/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad pa dang / lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa dang / de las bzlog pa lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad —469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logepa dang / gnyis ka gcig pa dang / gzugs can ma yin pa'i gnas dang po gsum ste bdun yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i lha mi gnyis dang / bsam gtan dang po ba dang por byung ba ma gtogos pa rnams chos can/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad te/ lus kyi che chung kha dog dang / 'du shes bde sdug btang snyoms gsum ci rigs par tha dad pa'i phyir bsam gtan dang po na dang por skyes ma thag pa rnams chos can/ lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa yin te/ lus snga ma dang 'dra ba gang zhig /'du shes tshangs chen gyis byas so snyam pa gcig pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa ba rnams cho me can/ snga ma las bzlog pa lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa yin te/ lus 'od lus su gcig pa gang zhig /'du shes bde ba dang btang snyoms gnyis re mos su don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa chos can/ gnyis ka gcig ste/ lus snga ma gang zhig /'du shes tshor ba bde ba gcig pu don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ lhag ma ngan song gsum po ni chos can/ sems kyi gnas pa ma yin te/ sdug bsngal gyisamanar ba'i sgo nas sems 'joms par byed pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / srid rtse ba gnyis (53ba)de ma yin te/ snga ma 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / phyi ma 'gog snyomasakyis 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /mi'i 'gro ba dang / 'dod lha dang / bsam gtan dang por phyis skyes pa'i lha gsum po gang rung yin na/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa dang po yin pas khyab zer na/'dod lha'i rten can gyi 'gog snyoms rgyud la ldan pa'i phyir mi 'ong lus ma' byed chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod lha yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa bdun po gang rung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa 'jomasabyed dang ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'gog snyoms rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de 'joms byed ldan/ zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i rnam shes kyi gnas pa 'joms byed dang ldan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig zhom shes—470

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanakyi gnas pa bdun sa bsdus na gang zag yin pas khyab zer na/ 'dod pa'i lha mi'i rgyud kyi zag bcas kyi phung po dang po bzhi po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa bzhi bdun gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ gsum pa ni bdun no/ /de dag tu phung po bzhi rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems can gyi ni gnas dgu yod par bshad de/ gong gi bdun/ srid rtse dang / 'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams (54na ti dgur bshad pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan ngan song gsum na sems can gyi gnas su bshad pa min pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de semasacan rnams der mi 'dod bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yang rnam shes kyi gnas pa dag ni chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ khyod la zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de dag na rang gi sa pa nyid dgos te/ 'dod pa'i phung po bzhi po 'dod pa'i rnam shes kho na'i gnas yin gyi/khams gong ma'i ma yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rnam par shes pa 'ba' zhig 'dir gnas par ma bshad de/ 'di'i gnas pa ni rten byed pa'i dbang du byas la/ rnam shes rang nyid kyi rten rang la byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ sems kyi gnas pa chos can/ khyod la mu bzhi yod de/ mdor bsdu na de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod bdun gyis bsdus la bzhis ma bsdus pa yod de/ bdun pa'i gnas skabs kyi rnam shes kyi phung po de yin pa'i phyir/ de las go bzlog pa yod de/ ngan song dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / srid pa'i rtse mo'i rnam shes ma gtogs pa'i phung po bzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/gnyis gas bsdus pa yod de/ bdun gyi gnas skabs kyi zag bcas kyi phung po dang po bzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis kas ma bsdus pa yod de/ ngan song dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / srid rtse'i rnam shes lta bu yin ba'i phyir/—471 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poskye gnas bzhi bshad pa/gsum pa skye gnas bzhir dbye ba la/ gang du 'jug pa skye gnas kyi dbye ba/ gang 'jug pa bar srid kyi rang bzhin/ de skye gnas su bgrod (54ba)pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems can rnams chos can/ khyod khams gsum po der ni skye ba'i gnas bzhi dag tu yod de/ sgo nga las skyes pa dang / sogs pas mngal/ drod gsher/ rdzus skyes rnams yod pa'i phyir/ mi dang dud 'gro rnams ni chos can/ khyod la sngar bshad pa'i skye gnas bzhi ga yod de/ rim pa bzhin du yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ gru zhig pa'i tshong pa/ bya khrung khrung mo dang rtses pa'i sgo nga las dge slong brag dang nye ba'i brag gnyis byung ba lta bu dang / rgyal po lnga len gyi btsun mo la sgo nga lnga brgya skyes pa sgrom du bcug ste chu bo ga bla la bskur ba/ li tsa byis rnyed pa las khye'u lnga brgya byung ba dang / btsun mo ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu sum cu rtsa gnyis lta bu rnams yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ da ltar gyi mi phal che ba rnams yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo lasang las nu/ de'i brla g.yasalas mdzes pa/ g.yon las nye mdzas skyes pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ bskal pa dang po'i mi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma bzhi ga grub ste/ khyung skye gnas bzhi ldan gyis klu skye gnasabazhi ldan za ba'i phyir/ dmyal ba rnams dang / lha rnams dang / srid pa bar ma ba rnams rdzus te skye ba yin te/ las kyi nus pa stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ yi dwags chos can/ phal cher rdzus te skye yang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ mngal nas skye ba yang yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'phags pa mo'u gal gyi bu la/ yi dwags mo zhig na re/ bdag gis mtshan mo bu lnga dang / de bzhin nyin mo gzhan lnga dag bskyed nas de dag za (55na)mod kyi/ /'on kyang bdag ni tshim pa med/ /ces smras pa'i phyir/ skye gnas bzhi po de la bzang ngan gyi khyad par yod de/ rdzus skyes rang gzhan gnyis ka la mi gnod par —472

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (pha)skye/ drod gsher skyes gzhan la mi gnod par skye/ mngal skyes sdug bsngal lan gcig dang / sgong skyesasdug bsngal lan gnyis myong ba'i sgo nas skye ba'i phyir/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ khyod skye gnasabazang ba gnyis bzhag nas mngal du skye ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gdul bya spro ba bskyed cing / nye du chos la dgod pa dang / mu stegs byed sogs kyi log rtog dgog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ bar srid kyi ngo bo/ sgrub byed/ khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po la/ tshig don dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bar srid chos can/ khyod gzhag tu yod de/ 'jig rten semasacan 'dir gang gi /'chi srid dang skye ba'i srid pa'i bar du 'byung ba'i srid pa zhig la byed pa'i phyir/de chos can/ khyod la byung ba zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang du bgrod pa'i yul mngon dus kyi srid pa der ma phyin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig na re/ bar do ba yin na/ bar srid rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab zer na/ skye srid kyi rten can yin na/ skye srid rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzugs kyi skye srid kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/de'i rgyud kyi skye srid chos can/ nyon mongs can yin par thal/ skye srid yin pa'i phyir (55ba)khyab ste/srid pa bzhi po de dag las/ /skye ba'i srid pa nyon mongs can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /bar do ba'i rgyud kyi skye srid du nying 'tshams sbyor byed kyi blo yin na/ chags sdang gi blo phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i sgo nas skye srid du nying 'tshams sbyor byed kyi blo yin pas khyab zer na/ rdzus skyes kyi bar do ba'i rgyud kyi skye srid du nying 'tshams sbyor byed kyi blo cho ge can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ de gnas don du gnyer ba'i sgo nas skye srid du nying sgoms sbyor ba'i phyir/ kha cig /mngal skyes dang sgong skyes la gong gi khyab pa de nges zer na/ rgyal bu don grub kyi bar do ba'i rgyud kyi mngal du nying 'tshams sbyor byed kyi blo cho se can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags gsal sla/ kha cig /yum sgyu ma lha mdzes kyi mngal du nying loms sbyor kha ma'i bar do ba de mtshan dpes spras par thal/ ston pa shākya —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gethub pa mtshan dpes spras pa gang zhig /de ni 'phen pa gcig pa'i phyir/ /sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis sprasapar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de sangs rgyas yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/gzhon nu don grub sangs rgyas yin par thal lo/ kha cig /mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ khyi'i bar srid grub nas/ der mi skye ba yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ der thal/ de grub nas lce spyang du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis rigs mthun pa'i phyir/ kha cig /mngal du skyes pa'i mi'i bar do ba yod par thal/ der skye ba'i mi'i bar (56na)srid yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/de chos can/ rdzus skyes yin par thal/ bar do ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal mngal skyes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mngal du skyes pa'i srid pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der skyes pa'i mi'i srid pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der skyes pa'i mi'i bar srid pa yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/mi'i bar srid yin na mi'i srid pa yin mi dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mdo las/ srid pa ni bdun te/dmyal ba'i srid pa/ yi dwags kyi srid pa dang / dud 'gro'i srid pa/ mi'i srid pa dang / lha'i srid pa dang / las kyi srid pa dang / srid pa bar ma'o/ /zhes so sor bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig /mi'i bar do ba yin na/ rdzus skyes yin pa'i mi'i bar do ba yin pas khyab zer na/ mi'i bar do'i rten can gyi gang zag yin na/ rdzus skyes yin pa'i mi'i bar do'i rten can gyi gang zag yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngal skyes yin pa'i mi'i skye srid du nying sgoms sbyor kha ma'i bar do ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de la rdzus skyes yin pa'i mi'i bar do grub par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rdzus skyes yin pa'i mi'i skye srid du nying 'tshams sbyor bar thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig /mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ rigs pa dang / lung gi sgrub byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya cho se can/ phal chen pa khyed rnams kyis 'chi ba'i srid pa rgyun chad pa kho na las skye srid byung bar 'dod pa ni rigs pa —474

chos mdzo rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanam yin te/ sems ni 'bru yi rgyun dang rgyun mi 'chad par chos mthun pas srid pa snga ma'i rgyun las (56ba)phyi ma'i rgyun rim pas 'byung ba'i phyir/ dper na 'bru shar nas nub tu drangs pa'i tshe/ rgyun mi 'chad par sleb pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ 'chi srid rgyun chad pa las skye srid 'byung ba'i dpe yod de/ byad bzhin gyi gzugs dang 'gyangs chad pa las me long nang du de'i gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'i phyir/ zer na de dpe rnam dag ma yin te/ de 'dra'i gzugs brnyan thogs bcas pa ma grub pa gang zhig /yin du chug kyang de dang 'chi srid rgyun chad pa'i skye srid mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ gos gcig na lhan cig thogs bcas kyi rdul rigs mi mthun pa gnyis gnas pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan byad gzugs kyi rgyun ma yin pa'i phyir dang /gzugs brnyan de byad bzhin dang me long gnyis las byung ba ni gang zhig /skye srid rgyu gnyis po de las 'byung ba med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bar srid pa chos can/ khyod yod de/ ston pa'i mgur nas srid pa bdun gsungs pas khyod yod par 'grub pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang / mdo las/ bar 'da' ba gcig /skyes 'da' ba gsum/ gong 'pho ba dang lnga gsungs pa'i phyir dang / skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba bdun zhes bya ba'i mdo las kyang / myur bar 'da' ba/ myur ba ma yin par 'da' ba/ dus yun ring mo zhig nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar 'da' ba gsum gsungs pa'i phyir/ phal chen pasasangs rgyas 'od srung kyi nyan thos zhig gi dbu la bdud sun 'byin byed kyis rdo bsnun te bkrongs pas/ lus de nyid la mes bskor te/ dmyal bar skyes par bshad pa'i rigs pa byed pa mi 'thad de/de ni mthong (57na khyos myong 'gyur la dgongs pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ mi'i bar srid pa chos can/ rang gang du skye 'gyur gyi mi'i sngon 'dus kya srid pa'i kha dog dang dbyibs sogs sha tshugs can du 'byung ste/ de na mi'i sngon dus kyi srid pa dang 'phen byed kyi las gcig gis 'phangs par rigs gcig pa'i phyir/ sngon dus kyi srid pa de ni chos can/ khyod yod de/ skye srid grub pa'i skad cig gnyis pa phan chad nas 'chi ba'i srid pa'i sngon rol tshun chad la —475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)'jog pa'i phyir/ mi'i bar srid chos can/ khyod kyis lha'i bar srid mi mthong ste/ khyod kyi nang phan tshun rigs mthun rnams mthong la rigs mi mthun pa rnams mi mthong ba gang zhig /mi'i bar srid yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod gzugs kyi bar srid thams cad chos can/ khyod mthong ba'i mig yod de/ skyon bcu gcig dang bral ba'i lha'i mig rnam par dag pas mthong ba'i phyir/ bar srid pa chos can/ rdzu'aphrul dang ldan te/ las kyi rdo 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i phyir/ de cho ge can/ shugs dang ldan te/ gang du bsams pa'i gnas der skad cig gis 'gro nus pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dbang po kun tshang thogs pa med pa dang ldan te/ ri rwa ba sogs la yang mi thogs pa'i phyir/ mi'i bar srid chos can/ khyod grub nas mi'i sngon dus su 'gro bar nges te/ gzhan du mi ldog pa'i phyir/ de chos can/dri za zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'dod pa'i bar srid pa gang zhig des zas su dri za ba'i phyir/de chos can/ khyod kyi tshe tshad yod de/ zhag bdun du gnas shing / skye ba'i tshogs pa ma rnyed nang gi gnas de nyid (57ba)du skye ba'i phyir/gsum pa de skye gnas su bgrod pa'i tshul la/ dngos dang / skye gnas su 'jug pa'i dbye sgo gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngal dang sgo nga las skyes pa gnyis ni chos can/ khyod skye gnas su bgrod tshul yod de/ blo ni phyin ci log tu gyur pas rtse shing dga' ba'i rnam pas 'gro ba'i yul skye gnas der 'gro ba'i phyir/ drod bsher skyes dang rdzus skyes gnyis 'jug tshul yod de/ snga ma dri dang / phyi ma gnas la mngon par 'dod par 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnas la mngon par 'dod pas 'jug tshul yod de/ tsha dmyal gyi bar srid grub tshe/ reg bya shin tu grang bas nyen nas tsha ba'i gnas 'tshol 'dod pas de la mngon par dga' ba sogs kyi 'jug pa'i phyir/ bar srid kyi 'gro tshul yod de/ dmyal ba yi ni bar srid spyi bo tshugs su 'gro la/ mi dang / dud 'gro/ yi dwags gsum gyi thad ka /lha'i de gyen la 'gro ba'i phyir/ de dag gi kha dog yod de/ dmyal ba'i bar srid sdong rdum mes tshig pa lta bu/ yi dwags chu/dud 'gro du ba/ mi dang 'dod lha gser/ gzugs khams pa snam bu dkar po lta bur yod pa'i phyir/—476

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanaganyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ blo phyin ci ma log par mngal du 'jug tshul gsum dag yod de/ go rim bzhin/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ gcig 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni shes bzhin du 'jug pa'i phyir/de chos can/ gnas pa dang 'byung ba mi shes te/ bsod nams kyi las rgya chen po tsam dang ldan pa'i phyir/ g.yin rang sangs rgyas ni chos can/ snga ma las lhag ste/ gnas pa yang shes bzhin (5srin〉du 'i gnas pa phyir/ de chos can/ 'byung ba mi shes te/ ye shes kyi tsho gos rgya che ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos can/ 'byung ba'ang gsum ga la shes bzhin du 'byung ste/ tshogs gnyis ka rgya che bas de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ de las ga' na pa'i mngal skyes ni cho so can/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum ga mi shes te/ de thams cad la rmongs pa'i phyir/ sgo nga las skyes pa chos can/ dus rtag tu rmongs te/ skye gnas gnyis pa can yin pa'i phyir/smras pa/ las kyi gzhan dbang can gyur bar srid dag /mkha' la rlung gis shing bal bskyod pa ltar/ /thogs med rgyu ba'i tshul 'di bsams pa na/ /dal 'byor don ldan byed pa'i lcag gcig byung //mi rtag snang tshul bsams nas long med skye/ /mkhas pa'i bstan bcos mthong na blo sna ring / /thosabasam res 'jog byed pa'i bande khyod/ /da dung 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang du long / /dbyar gyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i bzhin ras nas/ /smin ma'i lo 'dab g.yo ba'i dpag bsam ljon/ /mngar ba'i kha yi dri ldan lus phra ma'i/ /med byung bde bas 'dod ldan dga' skyed na/ /mi shes mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab sil ba'i/ /blang dor snang ba'i gzugs phung ma lus pa/ /mthong byed chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcos kyis/ /shes ldan kun gyi brtan pa cis mi 'phrog /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /—477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lorarten 'brel gyi rang bzhin bshad pa/gnyis pa skye tshul rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin la/ dngos dang / zhan la srid pa bzhi'i khyad par la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'khor bar 'jug (58bskos gyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ grub pa'i 'khor ba rgyas par bshad/ nyen mongs pa gsum dpes mtshone tshul gyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la/ 'khor bar 'jug tshul dngos dang / srid pa'i rgyun thog med du bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rgol ba khyed kyis skye ba snga phyir nying mtshams sbyor ba la the tshom pa mi 'thad par thal/spyir bdag med ni phung po tsam la der 'dogs pa nyid yin yang / skye ba snga mar nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ste zag bcas kyi las kyi mngon par 'du byas pa las srid pa bar ma'i sems kyi rgyun 'byung / de las skye srid kyi sems rgyun 'byung ba nyid kyis na/ mar me gcig las gnyis mched pa bzhin du mngal skyes sogs skye gnas bzhin 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ srid pa'i 'khor lo chos can/ thog ma med de/ sngon ma rig pas kun nas bslang ste/ zag bcas kyi las bsags pas/ yang srid phyi mar yang dang yang du ji ltar 'phangs pa bzhin/ skye ba snga mar ma rig pa dang / zag bcas kyi las sngon du song ba las/ 'dir rim gyis phung po'i rgyun 'byung zhing / 'dir skyes nas las nyon gyi stobs kyis yang srid phyi mar 'gro la/ de las nyon mongs kyis las bsags pas yang 'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro ba'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sdo pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ rdzogs tshul dang /bsdu ba/ 'khor tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po la/ tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ phung po'i rgyun skye ba'i gnas skabs gsum po de ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis dang —478—

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanaldan te/ ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ cha gsum du 'dus te/ 'dasam 'ongs da ltar gyi cha gsum du 'dus pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ tshe gsum la rdzogs te/ skye ba snga ma ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis sngon du song ba las/ bar du rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar lnga dang / tshe mthug la sred len srid pa gsum ste brgyad 'byung / de gsum sngon du song ba las skye ba phyi mar skye rga gnyas khrung ba'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa ni ma yin te/ skye gnas gzhan gsum/ dus min du 'chi ba dang / rdzus skyes la ma nges pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyod pa la/ kha cig /rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis po de tshes gsum la nges par rdzogs dgos zer na/ nges par rdzogs mi dgos par thal/ de tshe gnyis la rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mi zhig 'dod lhar skye ba'i 'du byed kyi las ma rig pa'i dbang gis rang gi rnam shes kyi steng du bsags/ las de la sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab pa las/ de'i nus pa mthu can du byas pa la brten nas/ skye ba phyi ma 'dod lhar skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod lhar skye ba'i skye gnas myong 'gyur gyi las yod pa'i phyir/ g.yin yang / de mi 'thad par thal/ de tshe gcig la rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tshar mi gcig (59ba)pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis tshe gcig la rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig /ma rig pa'i rten 'brel yin na/ ma rig pa yin pasakhyab zer na/ ma rig pa'i rten 'brel du gyur pa'i gzugs phung chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes pa yin par thal lo/ kha cig /reg pa brjod par bya ste/ reg drug 'dus te byung ba yin/zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i reg pa yin na/ reg pa bde sdug la sogs kyi/ /rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad do/ /zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i reg pa yin pas khyab zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ gzhung phyi ma'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i reg pa yin na/ yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i reg pa yin pas khyab/ reg pa brjod bya ste/ zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i reg pa yin na/ yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i reg pa yin pas —479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'am khyab pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ ma rig nyon mongs sngon gnas skabs/ /zhes pa'i skabs nasadangos su bstan pa'i mo rig pa yin na/ yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i ma rig pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ zag med yid kyi 'dus te reg pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/der thal/ gzhung 'di'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i zag med yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yin pa'i phyir/ de der thal/ gzhung 'di'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i zag med kyi yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rig dang ma rig dang gzhan reg dang ces pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i reg par gyur pa'i zag (60na thad kyi chos gcig yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dri med nyon mongs can lhag ma/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'dis/ rig dang ma rig dang gzhan rig ces pa'i skabs nasadangos su bstan pa'i reg pa gsum po 'di ngos bzung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ ma rig pa yod de/ sngon 'phen par byed pa'i las kun nas slong bzhin pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya cho sgo can/ 'du byed dag yod de/ sngon las sog pa'i gnas skabs kyi de la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya cho me can/ rnam shes yod de/ skye ba snga ma nas 'dir nying mtshams sbyor bzhin pa'i skabs kyi phung po lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ ming gzugs yod de/ de phan chad nying mtshams sbyar ba nas skye mched drug dod pa tshun chad kyi de la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ skye mched de yod de/ rang ngos nas yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa tshun chad de ma 'dusapa'i skabs kyi de la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ reg pa yod de/ 'dus pa de nas tshore ba bde sdug la sogs pa rnams kyi rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad kyi de lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ tshor ba yod de/ rgyu shes pa nas nang gi longs spyod 'khrig pa spyod par nus pa tshun chad kyi de lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ sred pa yod de/ nang gi longs spyod 'khrig pa chags can gyi yul yongs su 'tshol ba la zhugs pa'i de lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ nye bar len pa yod de/ de nasalongs spyod rnams thob par bya ba'i phyir du yongs su rgyug pa'i skabs kyi de lnga la byed pa'i phyir/—480

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bzhad pa/ (phan(60ba)srid pa yod de/ rgyug pa de srid du 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las byed kyi skabs lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ skye ba yod de/ 'di na yang srid phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor bzhin pa'i de lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rga shi yod de/ de yan chad las tshore ba'i bar gyi skabs kyi de lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ 'di ni rten 'brel la skad cig pa dang / rgyun chags pa dang /'brel ba can dang / gnas skabs pa'i rten 'brel bzhi las/ gnas skabs par 'dod de/ yan lag de dang de'i skabs kyi phung po lnga la/ de dang de'i rten 'brel du bzhag pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/skabs 'dir ma rig pa zhes smos pa la skyon med de/ de gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na yan lag phung po gzhan rnams la'ang de skad bsgrags pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po 'khor bcas byon pa la rgyal po byon zhes brjod pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ cha gsum du bsdus nas bstan pa la chos can/dgos pa yod de/ sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / bar ma da ltar ba dag la rmongs pa rnam par bzlog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis/gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas skye rga gnyis/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas lhag ma brgyad bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs pa gsum du bsdub/ rgyu 'bras gnyis su bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/bcu gnyis po 'di chos can/ khyod nyon mongs pa dang / las dang / gzhi gsum du 'du ste/ nyon mongs pa la ma rig pa dang srid len gsum/ las la 'du (61na)byed dang srid pa gnyis/ gzhi la rnam shesasogs lhag ma bdun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ bdun po bzhi yin pa de bzhin du gos bu'i yang yin te/ lhag ma lnga ni rgyu'i rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu gsum dang / 'bras bu lnga bshad nas/ sngon mthar rgyu bsdus shing / phyi mthar gos bu bsdus pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ snga phyi'i mtha' gnyis gyi rim pa bzhin rgyu dang 'bras bu mdor bsdus pa ni/ bar ma'i rgyu 'bras rgya bskyed pa'i rjes su dpag pa las snga phyi'i rgyu 'bras kyang rgyas par go nus pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa 'khor tshul ni/ ma rig pa la rgyu dang / rga shi la 'bras bu yod pas yan lag bcu gnyis kyi —481—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67)grangs nges nyams pa'i skyon med de/ nyon mongs pa las nyon mongs pa skyes pa sred pa dang len pa/nyon mongs pa las bya ba'i las nyid kyi len pa las srid pa dang / ma rig pa las 2 byed/ las de las gzhi 'du byed las rnam shes dang / srid pa las skye ba/ gzhi de las gzhi rnam shes las ming gzugs sogs dang / skye ba las rga shi/ gzhi las nyon mongs pa skyes pa tshor ba las sred pa/ de ltar bshad pa 'di ni srid pa'i yan lag lugs 'byung du bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'byung ba dang byung ba zhes pa la khyad par yod de/ 'dir 'byung ba zhes pa ni rgyu'i rten 'brel gyi dbang du byas pa dang / byung ba ni 'bras bu'i rten 'brel gyi dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i lugs la/ skabs su (61ba〉bab pa rten 'brel bzhi'i rang bzhin dang /lhag ma bshad 'chad la stos par bstan pa'o/ /dang bo la/ ma rig pa dang / ming dang / reg pa dang /tshor ba'i rten 'brel bzhi/ dang po ni/ ma rig pa chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rig pa ye shes dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i sems byung rmongs pa de yin pa'i phyir/ rig pa bkag tsam gyi med dgag khyod ma rig par 'jog pa mi 'thad de/ de'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i chos rdzas gzhan zhig la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dper na/ mdza' ba'i mi mthun phyogs rdzasagazhan la mi mdza' ba dang / bden pa'i mi mthun phyogs rdzas gzhan la rdzun par 'jog pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / de mi 'thad de/ mdo las/ ma rig pa ni/ kun sbyor dang sogs pas 'ching ba dang / phra rgyas dang / chu bo dang / sbyor ba'i tshig gis bstan la/ rig pa bkag tsam de dag tu 'os pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gal te shes rab ngan pa ma rig par 'dod do zhe na/ mi 'thad de/ de lta ba yin pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ lta ba ma rig pa de dang mtshungs ldan du bshad pa'i phyir/ shes rab de dang ma rig pa gnyis nyon mongs bya mongs byed du bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma grub ste/ mdo las/ 'dod chags kyis nye bar nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i sems ni rnam par mi grol lo/ /ma rig pas nye bar nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i shes rab ni rnam par mi 'dag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ming gi rten —482

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa shad pa/ (phana'abrel chos can/khyod yod de/gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po bzhis 'i bsdus pa 62na〉khyus byas de khyod yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/reg pa'i rten 'brel chos can/khyod yod de/yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la yul gyi 'gyur ba rang stobs kyis spyod pa'i sems byung de khyod yin pa'i phyir/de cho me can/khyod la rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na drug yod de/mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs drug yod pa'i phyir/dang po lnga ni chos can/thogs pa'i reg pa zhes bya ste/bdag rkyen dbang po gzugasacan la brten pa'i reg pa yin pa'i phyir/drug pa cho tre gcan/bla dgas kyi tshig gi reg pa zhes bya ste/bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten pa'i reg pa yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod la mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas dbye na gsum yod de/rig pa'i dang /ma rig pa'i dang /de gnyis las gzhan pa'i reg pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/dang bo yod de dri med kyi reg pa de yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa yod de/nyon mongs can gyi reg pa de yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa yod de/dge ba zag bcas dang /ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyis bsdus pa'i reg pa de yin pa'i phyir/nyon mongs can gyi reg pa chos can/khyod la mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas gsum yod de/khyod la ma rig pa dang /gnod sems dang /rjes su chags pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i reg pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/'bras bu'i sgo nas dbye na gsum yod de/bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba dang /la sogs pas sdug bsngal dang /btang snyems myong 'gyur gyi reg pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir//bzhi pa la/spyir bstan pa dang /yid tshor bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/tshor ba chos can/khyod yod de/rang stobs kyis nyams su myong ba'i 6brdzims byung de yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod la dbye na drug yod de/mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba sogs drug yod pa'i phyir/dang po lnga ni chos can/lus kyi tshor ba zhes bya ste/thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen de dbang po gzugs can pa la brten pa'i tshor ba yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/yul la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas rgyas par ༷༷da/ngo pho sgo nas don bsdub dang gsum/dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogepo ni/yid tshor de chos can/yid yul la nye bar rgyu ba las rnam pa dag ni bco brgyad yod de/yul gzugs tshor drug la dmigs pa'i yid bde drug/cig shos drug/btang snyoms drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la 'dod pa/gzugs/gzugs med kyi dbang du byas pa gsum las/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/'dod pa na bco brgyad po thams cad yod de/de thams cad rang sa'i yul drug la dmigs pa can yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/'dod pa'i yid tshor spyod yul gzugasakhams can ni bcu gnyis yin te/dri ro la nye bar rgyu ba drug po ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/des gong ma gzugs med pa la dmigs tshe gsum gyi spyod yul can yin te/chos la nye bar rgyu ba gsum po de yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa dang /bsam gtan phyi ma gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/dang po ni/bsam gtan dang po gnyis chos can/'dod pa'i yuladrug la 'gro zhing dmigs pa'i tshe bcu gnyis yod de/yid mi bde drug ma gtogs pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/63na'ang sa gzugs khams la dmigs pa'i tshe brgyad yod de/de las dri ro la rgyu ba bzhi ma gtags pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/gzugs med pa'i yul la dmigasapa'i tsha gnyis yod de/chos la rgyu ba'i yid bde ba dang /btang snyoms gnyis yod pa'i phyir/gnyisapa ni/bsam gtan phyi ma gnyis chos can/khyod la drug yod de/khyod la btang snyoms kyi nyer rgyu dag kho na ste de drug gi dmigs pa ni 'dod pa'i yul drug la dmigs pa'i phyir/de chos can/rang sa'i yul la dmigs pa'i tshe bzhi yod de/de'i tshe dri ro ma gtogos pa'i bzhi yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/gong ma gzugs med la dmigs pa'i tshe gcig yod de/de'i tshe chos la rgyu ba kho na yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa la/nyer bsdogs dang /dngos gzhi'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/dang po ni/gzugasamed nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched chos can/khyod kyi nyer bsdogs la bzhi yod de/gzugs med nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i yul bzhi la 'gro zhiX ཿ/migs pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/gong

chos mngon rin rṣa tshon pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanam gzugs med par 'gro zhing dmigs pa gcig yin te/chos la rgyu ba kho na yin pa'i phyir/gnyisapa ni/gzugs med chos can/khyod kyi dngos gzhi na chos rgyu tshor ba gcig pu yin te/der rang sa'i yul can gyi chos la nyer rgyu gcig kho nar nges pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/'dir bstan pa'i yid tshor bco brgyad po thams cad chos can/zag pa dang bcas pa yin te/kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/skabs 'dir rten 'brel bzhi kho na ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/63bsgom shes dang skye mched dang /gzugs ni bshad zin la/gzhan 'du byed dang srid pa ni las bstan dang /srid len gnyis phra rgyas bstan pas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/smras pa/mi lus yid bzhi nor bu mchog/mi gtsang nyon mongs 'dam rdzab gyis//mi shesamathu yis gos gyur pa//mi 'am ci ltar rmo mes min nam//dbyig gnyen zhal lung kun gsal 'gram pa las//nyon mongs phra zhib 'ja' tshon gsar pa 'di//blo gsal mig gis ltos la spong ba'i thabs//brtson pas sgrubs dang thar pa cis mi 'thob//rang cag kun gyi rgyud la 'dzad med du//rgyal po'i gan mdzod lta bur ches gang ba'i//dug gsum nyon mongs mang po'i spyad dngos la/da dung lo 'ga'i bar du spyad kyis dogs//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//nyon mongs pa gsum dpes mtshon tshul sgo nas don bsdu ba/gsum pa nyen mongs pa gsum dpes mtshon tshul gyi sgo nas don bsdu ba la/nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyone mongs pa dpe lngas mtshone tshul/las kyi kun nas na mongs pa dpe gsum gyis mtsho ni tshul/gzhi'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dpe gcig gis mtsho ni tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/nyon mongasapa'i kun nas rsā mongs pa chos ho/khyod dpe lngas ma zhi tshul yod de/sa bon dang /klu dang /shing gi rtsab dang /ljon shing dang /shun lhagasaXsmi du 'dod pa'i phyir/dang po grub ste/sa bon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6polas myu gu 'byung ba ltar/ khyod las las dang gzhi rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ klu yod sar mtsho mi bskams pa ltar/ khyod yod na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mi bskams pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/shing rtsa ba ma bcad na yal ga (64na〉khyung ba ltar/ khyod ma spangs na 'khor bar skye ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ shing las 'bras bu 'byung ba bzhin/ khyod las las dang gzhi 'byung ba'i phyir/ lnga pa grub ste/ shun lpags med pa'i gos kyis myu gu skyed mi nus pa ltar/ nyen mongs dang bral ba'i las kyisarnam smin skyed mi nus pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ las chos can/ dpe gsum gyis mtsho ni te/ shun pa dang bcas pa'i gos dang /de bzhin du sman dang / me tog bzhin du yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ shun pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras kyis myu gu skyed nus pa bzhin/ nyon mongs dang bcas pa'i las kyis rnam smin skyed nus pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ nus pa phyung zin pa'i sman gyis slar nus pa mi 'byin pa ltar/ rnam smin phyung zin pa'i las kyis slar rnam smin mi 'byin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ me tog gos bu'i nyer rgyu yin pa bzhin du/ las kyang rnam smin gyi nyer rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gzhi bdun po chos can/dpe gcig gis mtshon te/ bza' btung g.yos grub pa de longs spyad bya kho na yin pa bzhin du bdun po de yang las nyon gyi 'bras bu grub zin pas slar rnam smin mi 'byin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa srid pa bzhi'i khyad par la dpyad pa ni/ srid pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ khyod la bar srid/ skye srid/ sngon dus/ 'chi ba'i srid pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de dag las skye ba'i srid pa ni/ nyon mongs pa can kho na yin te/ de la dge ba dang ma bsgribs lung ma bstan med pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ byed tshul yod de/ rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs pa kun gyis nyon mongs par byed (64ba)pa'i phyir/ srid pa gzhan gsum po ni chos can/ khyod la mi dge ba kho nar ma nges te/ khyod la de gsum ga yod pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod gzugs gnyis na srid pa bzhi ga yod la/ gzugs med na gsum lasamed de/ der bar srid med pa'i phyir/—486

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanagasum pa skye ba gnas pa'i thabs la/zas kyi byed las mdor bstan/so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/grangs nges kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o//dang po ni/sngar bshad pa'i 'gro ba lnga po chos can/khyod zas kyis gnas pa yin te/de ltar yin par mdo las bshad pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/gzugs can gyi zas/gzugs can ma yin pa'i zlas/bar srid kyi ming gi rnam grangs dang gsum/dang po ni/de 'dra'i zas de chos can/khyod gzhag tu yod de/kham du bcad cing mid pa zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod 'dod pa na dri ro reg bya'i skye mched gsum gyi bdag nyid yin la/gzugs kyi skye mched ni kham zas ma yin te/des rang gi dbang po dang phrad pa'i sgo nas dbang po la mi phan pa'i phyir/dper na kham zas dang bral ba'i grol bar phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom pa la zas shin tu yid du 'ong ba mthong bas mi phan pa bzhin no//gnyis pa ni/de 'dra'i zas chos can/khyod yod de/zag pa dang bcas pa'i reg pa dang /sems pa dang /rnam par shes pa gsum po de khyod yin pa'i phyir/de gsum po chos can/khyod ni khams gcig tu ma nges te/de gsum dag na yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/bar srid pa ni yid lasabyung ba zhes bya ste/de khu khrag las ma byung bar yid tsam las byung ba'i phyir/de cho ge can/srid 'tshol zhes bya ste/skye srid 'tshol ba'i phyir/de chos can/dri za zhes bya ste/zas su dri za ba'i phyir/de chosacan/srid pa bar ma zhes bya 65na ) ste/'chi srid dang skye srid gnyis kyi bar du grub pa'i phyir/de chos can 'grub pa zhes bya ste/skye srid 'grub pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i phyir/gsum pa grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdub ni/shes bya chos can/de ltar bzhin grangs ma ngesapa'i skyon med de/go rim bzhin tshe 'di la gnas pa'i dbang bcas kyi lus dang ni/brten pa semasasems byung 'i rgyas pa don du kham zas dang reg pa'i zas gnyis dang /srid pa gzhan 'phen ba dang 'grub pa'i don du sems pa dang rnam shes kyi zas gnyis te bzhir bzhag pa'i phyir//bzhi pa gnas pa'i 'chi 'pho ba'i sems la/sems gang gisaX/ 7ba/tshor ba gang gis 'chi ba yin byung dang bcas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gepa/lus phyogs gang nas 'chi ba/gnad gcod pa'i rgyu dang bzhi/dang po ni/sems gang gi 'chi ba yod de/dge rtsa chad pa/'tshams sbyor ba/'dod chags dang bral ba/de las nyams pa/'chi 'pho ba/skye ba rnams ni yid kyi rnam shes kyi byed pa kho na las 'byung bar bshad pa de'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/tshor ba gang gi 'chi ba yod de/'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba tshor ba btang snyoms la yod kyi/tshor ba gzhan la med pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/rtse gcig mnyam gzhag/sems med 'gog pa/'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug la gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas skye 'chi byed pa med de/de la gnas na sngar bshad pa rnams mi tshang ba'i phyir/shes bya chos can/lhag med du mya ngan las 'da' ba ni lung bstan ma yin pa'i bye brag spyod lam pa'am/rnam smin skyes btang snyoms pa gnyis la gnas nas 'da' ste/de gnyis mi gsal zhing nyam chung bas sems 'chad 65ba pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/rim gyis 'chi ba ni ngan song ba rnams chos can/phyogs gang nas 'chi tshul yod de/rkang pa nas cha ba'i phyir/mi chos can/phyogs gang nas 'chi tshul yod de/lte ba nas 'chi ba'i phyir/lha dang dgra bcom pa chos can/de yod de/snying gar yid 'chi 'pho ba'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/gnad gcod bar byed pa yod de/de rlung mkhris bad gan gsum la brten nas rlung me chus gcod pa'i phyir/lnga pa sems can gyi tshogs gsum du bsdu ba ni/shes bya chos can/tshogs dang po yang dag par nges pa yod de/'phags pa rnams bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/tshogs gnyis pa log pa nges par yod de/'tshams med kyi las byed pa rnams de nyid du nges pa'i phyir/shes bya chos ro/tshogs gsum pa ma nges pa yod de/de las gzhan pa'i gang zag rnams yin pa'i phyir/smras pa/ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i yol go'i nang //legs bshad rin chen phyur bur spungs pa 'di//kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha pa/48/༷ba sras brgyud par bcas la legs phul te//

chos ma' rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa shad pa/ (pha)snod kyi 'jig rten sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//sngon med gtam gyi gos rgyan dang cas te//grangs med skye bo'i mig gi dga' ston du//spel gyi dang du long dang shes ldan rnams//'di na khams gsum snod bcud khyad par kun//ji tsam dpyad kyang 'dzad med yid kyi bcud//'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal la 'gran byed na/shes rab snyim pas bcus dang don kun 'grub/zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi thunatshigs su bcad pa'o//phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa/gnyis pa phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa la/rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsum ngos gzung ba/brten pa ri mtsho gling gsum bshad pa/tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas bshad pa/nyi zla'i 'char tshul dang 3 bshad pa/lha rnams kyi gnas bshad pa/stong gsum ngos gzung ba/'gro ba rnams kyi lus tshe'i oṃ bshad pa/sgo de gzhal ba'i thabs/snod bcud kyi khyad chos bshad pa dang dgu/dang po la/rma chu sa gsum las/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/snod gan kyi 'jig rten gnyis yod pa de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams chags pa'am gnas par 'dod pa'i 'og dag gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags tshul yod de/sems can spyi mthun gyi las las rlung 'jam bu 'khrigs te chags pa'i phyir/rma gi dkyil 'khor chos can/khyod kyi 3 yod de/rngams te dpangs su dpag 3 sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum yin la/rgyar dpag tshad grangs med gcig yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/chu dkyil chags tshul yod de/sems can spyi mthun gyi las las sprin gser gyi snying po can bos te/byu gyi rgyun babs pa las gos pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi ra yod de/rngamasasu dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang /stong phrag dag ni nyi shur yod pa'i phyir//gsum pa ni/shes bya chos༅/sa dkyil chags tshul yod de/4/ra bshad pa'i chu dkyil de dus phyis ni rngams su

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6podapag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad du gyur nas/ lhag ma sum 'bum nyi khri dag ni chu de'i (slob)steng du 'o ma la spris ma chags pa ltar gser gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur ba'i phyir/ chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis po ni chos can/ khyod kyi rgya tshad yod de/ thad gar che chung med par mnyam zhing dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang / stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag ni phyed dang lnga rnams kho nar yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis cho me can/ khyod kyi khor yug gi tshad yod de/ zhed gi sum 'gyur sa ya gsum dang drug 'bum khri sum brgya lnga bcu yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ ri dgu rgya dang tshad dbyibs kyi sgo nas bshad pa/ mtsho brgyad kyi tshad dbyibs bshad pa/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyi tshad dbyibs bshad pa/ 'dzam bu gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ gser gyi dkyil 'khor de la lhun po dbus na yod de/ de la gnya' shing 'dzin/ ga sgo thamad 'a 'dzin/ seng ldeng can/ de bzhin du lta na sdug ri dang / rta rna dang ni/ rnam 'dud dang / mu khyud 'dzin ri rnams gru bzhir bskor nas yod pa'i phyi rol de na gling rnams kyang yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ de dag gi phyi rol na 'khor lo lta bu'i khor yug gi ri yod cing de dag gi rgyu de gnya' shing 'dzin sogs bdun gser dang / khor yug gi rgyu lcags las byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ lhun po ni chos can/ rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin las grub ste/ shar dngul/lho beeḍūrya/ nub shel/ byang gser las grub pa'i phyir/ ri dgu po chos can/ khyod kyi dpangs tshad yod de/ chu'i nang du gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ dpag tshad brgyad khri mnyam par nub cing / de bzhin du lhun po ni/ ri gzhan brgyad dang mi 'dra bar chu yi steng du yang dpag tshad dag ni brgyad khri (67na 'phags pa'i phyir/ ri gzhan brgyad po ni chos can/ chu'i steng du rngams su snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma phyed phyed dbri ste/ dang po la bzhi khri/ gnyis pa nyi khri/ gsum pa la chig khri/ bzhi pa la lnga stong / lnga pa la nyis stong lnga brgya/ drug pa la chig stong phyed sum brgya/ bdun pa la drug brgya nyi shu rtsalnga yod pa'i phyir/ ri dgu po de dag chos can/ khyod kyi rngams tshad yod de/ rang rang gi 'phangs dang —490

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (pha)mnyam pa'i phyir/ri bdun po chos can/khyod kyi dkyus tshad yod de de snga ma snga ma las phya ma phyi ma che ba'i phyir/dang po chos can/de yod de/dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri mtha' skor du sa ya gcig nyisa'abum brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa chos can/de yod de/bzhi 'bum bzhi khri mtha' skor du saya gcig dang bdun 'bum drug khri yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa chos can de yod de/lnga 'bum dang /mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis yod pa'i phyir/bzhi pa chos can/de yod de/lnga 'bum lnga khri dang /mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum yod pa'i phyir/lnga pa chos can/de yod de/lnga 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong dang /mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/drug pa chos can/de yod de/lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong dang lnga brgya/mtha' skor du sal gnyis nyis 'bum chig khri yod pa'i phyir/bdun pa chos can de yod de/lnga 'bum lnga khri drug stong nyis brgya dang /mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis dang /nyis 'bum nyi khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya yod pa'i phyir/gnya' shing 'dzin chos can/sgra bshad du yod de/nyi zla gnya' shing gi tshul du 'dzin pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa chosacan/sgra 67ba ) bshad du yod de/rtse mo gshol mda' ltar yod pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/gsum pa chos can/sgra bshad du yod de/seng ldeng gi nags stug po dang ldan pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/bzhi pa chos can/sgra bshad du yod de/shin tu mdzes pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/lnga pa chosacan/sgra bshad du yod de/rtse mo rta'i rna ba ltar yod pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/drug pa chos can/sgra bshad du yod de/gtso bo la 'dud pa lta bur yod pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/bdun pa chos can/sgra bshad du yod de/mu khyud kyi 'khor lo ltar yod pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/mtsho bdun po yod de/mu khyud 'dzin la thug pa de dag kyi bar gyi mtsho bdun po de yin pa'i phyir/rol mtsho dang po ni chos can/khyod kyi zheng ra yod de/stong phrag brgyad cu yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/nang gi rgya mtsho yin te/mtsho brgyad kyi nang ma yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi ngos tshad yod de/rang gi thad ga'i sum ༷/ra yin pa'i phyir/rol mtsho gzhan drug pa'i zheng

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (getshad yod de/snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma phyed phyed kyis chung ba'i phyir/chung tshul yod de/gnyis pa la bzhi khri/ gsum pa la nyi khri/bzhi pa la tshig khri/lnga pa la lnga stong /drug pa la phyed dang sum stong /bdun pa la stong nyis brgya lnga bcu yod pa'i phyir/mtsho de rnams choge can/khyod kyi dkyus ra yod de/snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma che ba'i phyir/rol mtsho dang po chos can/khyod kyi ngos tshad yod de/khyod kyi ngos re la dpag tshad nyis 'bum bzhi khri/khor yug tu dgu 'bum drug khri yod pa'i phyir/6niganyis pa chos can/de yod de/bzhi 'bum dang /khor yug tu sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa chos can/de yod de/bzhi 'bum brgyad khri dang /khor yug tu sa ya gcig dang dgu 'bum nyi khri yod pa'i phyir/gzhi pa chos can/de yod de/lnga 'bum nyi khri dang /khor yug tu sa ya gnyis dang brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/lnga pa cho ge can/de yod de/lnga 'bum bzhi khri dang /khor yug tu sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum drug khri yod pa'i phyir/drug pa chos can/de yod de/lnga 'bum lnga khri dang /khor yug tu sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum yod pa'i phyir/bdun pa chos can/de yod de/lnga 'bum lnga khri lnga stong dang /khor yug tu sa ya gnyis nyis 'bum nyi khri yod pa'i phyir/bdun pa chosacan/sgra bshad du yod de/klu chen brgyad po rol zhing rtse ba li gnas yin pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/mtsho bdun gyi lhag ma mu khyud 'dzin dang khor yug gi mtsho chos can/phyi'i rgya mtsho yin te/mtsho brgyad kyi phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi zheng tshad yod de de la dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang /stong phrag dag ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i phyir//gsum pa gling bzhi gling phran brgyad po rnams dbyibs tshad kyi sgo nas bshad pa ni/shes bya chos can/gling bzhi gling phran brgyad gang la chags yod de/phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po de la ni chags pa'i phyir/ri rab kyi lho phyogs na yod pa'i 'dzam bu'i gling ni chos can/khyod kyi dbyibs yod de/shing rta'i dbyibs su yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi tshad yod de/64ngos gsum la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis dang /lcags ri'i phyogs ༷ /me gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod pa'i

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (pha)phyir/ de chos can/ sgra bshad du yod de/ 'dzam bu tri sha'i ljon pas mtshan pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ ri rab kyi shar phyogs kyi lus 'phags gling chen chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs yod de/ zla gam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ ngos gsum 'dzam bu gling 'di dang 'dra ba la/lcags ri'i phyogs kyi ngos cig la dpag tshad sum brgya dang lnga bcu yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sgra bshad du yod de/ lus khyad par du 'phags shing mdzes pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs kyi ba glang spyod kyi gling chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs yod de/ zlum po yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/khyod kyi tshad yod de/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang brgyad dang / de'i dbus thad dar zheng la dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sgra bshad du yod de/sems can ba lang la gtso bor longs spyod pas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs kyi gling sgra mi snyan chos can/ khyod kyi tshad dbyibs yod de/ dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad kyi tshad dang /dbyibs gru bzhin mnyam ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ sgra bshad du yod de/ 'chi khar sgra mi snyan pas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa'i gling bzhi po ni chos can/ khyod la gling zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mtha' chus bskor te gzhan dang ma 'brel bas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/bya ba byed tshul gyi khyad par yod de/ gling gzhan gsum na ched du byas pa'i kha zas za zhing / (69na)gnas khang 'bubs pa dang / nor la nyo tshong / bag ma gtong len yod/ sgra mi snyan na de ltar med pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ bde sdug gi khyad par yod de/ gzhan gsum na/ 'thab rtsod/ tsha grang / yid mibade ba sogs yod la/ sgra mi snyan na de ltar med pa'i phyir/ gling bzhi bo de'i bar gyi gling brgyad ni yod de/ shar du lus dang lus 'phags/ byang du sgra mi snyan dang de'i zla dang ni/ lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro rnams yod pa'i phyir/ de rnams chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs yod de/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i gling dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gling bcu gnyis po ni chos can/khyod kyi rtsa ba'i rngams tshad yod de/ dpag tshad brgyad khri re yod pa'i phyir/—493—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6posmras pa/ mang du thos shing sbyangs pa'i gru rdzings dag /rnam dpyod mthun pa'i rlung dang rab 'grogs nas/ /legs bshad nor bu'i gling der bgrod pa na/ /ci bsams 'grub pa'i dbang gi rgyal po rnyed/ khengs pa'i chang gis myos pa'i rang g.yin gyi/ /mkhas zlodze glang po'i bstan bcos nga ro'i tshogs/ /dka' ba'i gnas bzhag don med tshig tshogs rnams/ /mthong bas nye ring 'phul ba'i gzu bor mngon/ /ri mtsho gling gi tshad dbyibs srad bu'i tshogs/ /'khrul med grangs kyi thags su legs btags te/ /tshig nyung don rgyas ri mo rnam bkra bas/ /stong khun lus phra'i dar gyi khengs pa phyogs/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa/bzhi pa 'dzam gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'chad tshul yod (69ba)de/ 'phags pa'i yul 'di nas rtsis pa'i byang du ri nag po dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba'i gangs ri yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang yod de/ de nas kyang pha rol na ni spos ngad ldang ba'i ri yod cing / de'i dpag tshad bcu'i tshur rol lho phyogs na mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba chu zheng dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho yod pa'i phyir/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang ba'i mtsho de chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs tshad yod de/ dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ chu zhed gnyis dar dpag tshad lnga bcu re yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi sgra don yod de klu ma dros pa gnas pas/ de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi dbus na phun sum tshogs pa'i shing yod de/ de na 'dzam bu prikṣa zhes bya ba 'bras bu mngar po dang ldan pa lha rnams kyis longs spyod pa'i shing yod pa'i phyir/ chu bo ga ṅga chos can/yod de/ mtsho de'i shar na dngul gyi brag glang po che'i kha 'dra ba nas/ dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing babs nas skor ba lan bdun byas te 'gro ba'i phyir/ sis chos can/ yod de/ lho phyogs na gser gyi brag —494

chos ma' rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (pha)khyu mchog gi kha 'dra ba nas gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing sngar bzhin 'gro ba'i phyir/pakṣu chos can/yod de/nub phyogs na beeḍūrya'i brag rta'i kha 'dra ba nas beeḍūrya'i bye ma 'dren cing sngar bzhin 'gro ba'i phyir/si ta chos can/yod de/byang phyogs na brag seng ge'i kha 'dra ba nas babs te sngar bzhin 'gro ba'i phyir/spos ngad ldang chos can/khyod kyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na brag ri gser gyi bya skyibs bya ba yod de de rang dang mtshungs pa'i gser gyi 70na ) bya skyibs brgyad stong gis bskor ba yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi tshad dbyibs yod de/zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu/'phangs su dpag tshad phyed bzhi/dbyibs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa zhig yod pa'i phyir bya skyibs de chos can/khyod kyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na shing sa la'i rgyal bo rab tu brtan pa zhes bya ba yod de/de na de sa la'i phreng ba rim ba bdun gyis bskor ba yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na rdzing bu dal gyis bab pa zhes bya ba yod de/sbrang rtsi lta bu'i chus gang ba de'i ro dang ldan pa yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi tshad yod de/zheng du dpag ra lnga bstodang /mtha' skor du dpag sgo nyis brgya yod pa'i phyir/khyod kyi yon tan yod de/utpal la sogs pa'i me tog sdong bu gshol mda' tsam dang /me tog shing rta'i phang lo tsam/lo ma ba glang gi ko ba tsam/rtsab skyes bu chen po'i brla sha tsam/khor yug tu rdzing bu brgyad stong gis bskor ba yod pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/sngar bshad pa de dag gi nye skor du lha rnams kyi glang po che g.yul ngor spyod pa rab brtan yod de/'khor glang po che brgyad stong dang bcas nas dgun zla bzhin brag gser gyi bya skyibs dang /dbyar zla bzhin shing sa la'i rgyal po rab brtan gyi nye skor du gnas pa'i phyir/lho 'dzam bu gling chos can/khyod la yon tan khyad par can gzhan yang yod de/dbus su rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba bskal bzang gi sangasargyas stong mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas bskal pa 'jig pa'i tshe yang mi 'jig par gnas pa dang /shar phyogs na 70ba 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gnas ri bo rtse lnga/lho phyogs na phyag na padma'i gnas ri bo gru 'dzin/nub phyogaX/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod u rgyan gyi yul/byang
