rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogephyogs na chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas sham bha la yod pa'i phyir//dmyal ba'i gnas bshad pa/gsum pa dmyal ba'i gnas bshad pa ni/'dzam bu gling 'di chos can/khyod kyi 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na mnar med pa'i dmyal ba yod de/de na rngams dang rgyar de tsam gyi dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu re yod pa'i phyir/de cho ge can/khyod kyi steng na dmyal ba gzhan yod de/de yang sosal sogs pa bdun po yod pa'i phyir/tsha dmyal brgyad po de dag kun chos can/khyod las thar kyang sdug bsngal myong ba'i gnas lhag ma nye 'khor bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug yod de de rnams kyi ngos bzhi na me ma mur/ro myags kyi 'dam/spu gri'i lam/chu bo rab med rnams yod pa'i phyir/sngar bshad pa'i tsha dmyal brgyad po chos can/khyod rnams kyi thad gar gzhan grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad yod de/der chu bur can la sogs pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/ngan song gzhan yi dwags kyi gnas kyang yod de/phal cher ni rgyal po'i khab kyi 'og na yod cing /kha 'thor ba rnams ni sa gzhi ri klungs phal cher na yod pa'i phyir/dud 'gro chos can/khyod kyi gnas yod de/phal che ba ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas shing /kha 'thor ba ni lha mi'i gnas gang du'ang yod pas ma nges pa'i phyir/bzhi pa nyi zla'i 'char tshul bshad pa la/dngos dang /dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag gnyis/dang po ni/nyi zla gnyis chos can/khyod kyi 'char sa yod de/lhun po'i chu sgoms yan chad kyi phyed/gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse 71na ) dang mnyam pa nas 'char ba'i phyir/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chos can/khyod kyi tshad yod de/zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu/mtha' skor du dpag tshad phyed dang nyis brgya/rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang /gcig gi bco brgyad cha gcig yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/chu shel las grub cing /gser gyi rwa baXskor ba/rin po che'i them skas dang pha gu sogs

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanakyis spras shing / skyed mos tshal gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ lha'i bu bu mo rnams rol mo dang gar sgyur ba sogs byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ nyi ma chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig /mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang bcas shing rngams su dpag tshad phyed du drug dang / gcig gi bco brgyad cha gcig yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rgyu yod de/ me shel las grub cing / gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ skar ma chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ che ba la rgyang gragasabaco brgyad dang / chung ba la rgyang grags gcig yod pa'i phyir/ nyi zla gnyis chos can/ gling la bya ba byed tshul yod de/ sgra mi snyan du nam phyed pa dang / lus 'phags gling du nyi ma nub pa dang / 'dzam bu gling du nyi ma phyed pa dang / ba glang spyod du nyi ma 'char ba rnams dus gcig tu yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag la/ tshig don/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyad pa dang gsum las/dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ dus tshigs la gsum du phye ba'i dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan mo ring bar 'gyur te/ de ltar mtshan mo yud tsam bco brgyad kyi bar du 'phel ba lasarim gyis 'gribs pa na dgun rnams kyi zla ba bzhi (71ba)pa la nyin mtshan yud tsam bco lngar mnyam pa las rim gyis nyin mtshan go bzlog ste mtshan thung ngur gyur nas nyin mo ring bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/nyin mtshan chos can/ khyod ring thung du 'gyur ba las thengs gcig las mi 'byung ste/ chu tshod kyi dbang gis zhag re la de ltar 'phel 'grib byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyi ma 'dzam bu'i gling du lho phyogs su rgyu ba'i tshe mtshan mo ring / byang phyogs su rgyu ba'i tshe nyin mo ring bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ tshes gsum gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de yongs su ma rdzogs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i tshe zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang nye ba las nyi ma'i 'od zla ba'i gzhal med khang la babs pa na pha rol gyi ngos su zla ba rang gi grib ma babs pas 'grib par snang ba'i phyir/ dper na/ ka ba la mar me'i 'od nye ba ri na ka ba rang gi grib mas bsgribs pas cung zad 'gyur/ zhan tu nye ba na rang gi grib mas mi snang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/—497—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poganyis pa spyi'i don la/ dus tshigs gang las byung / byed po yod med la dpyad/ dus posagazung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bskal pa mar 'grib kyi dus shed bu dang / shed las skyes gnyis kyis sa'i zhag zos pas lus kyi 'od nyams te mun pa byung bas de'i tshe nyi zla skar ma rnams/ 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las byung ste/ gdags pa las/ sems can de dag gis khams kyi zas zos pa des na/de dag gi lus la mkhrang ba dang / lci ba zhu bar gyur te/ 'od dang kha dog gi mdog gang yin pa de ni med par gyur to/ /zhes dang chos ca kyis na 'ag rten du mun pa byung ba na/ nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ṣka 'jig(72na)rten du byung bar gyur to/ khyu skar rnams dang / mas mo dang / wo mo rnams dang / dusatshigs rnams dang / skad cig dang / thang cig dang / yud tsam rnams 'jig rten du byung bar gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ lo zla tshes grangs gza' skar gyi go rim gi byed po yod de/ rang re'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal po de nyid sku tshe snga ma zhig la/ drang srong rnga bong du gyur dus lo drug khrir dka' thub bsgrubs pas/ srid pa gsum na mthu che bar gyur te/ tshangs pa sogs lha rnams kyis zhug pa'i ngor rgyu skar sogs kyi go rim mdzad pa'i phyir/ ji skad du mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ lo ni drug khri tham par yang / /rkang pa gcig gis dka' thub gnas/ /zhes dang / re zhig dang por smin drug ces/ khyu skar dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /nangs kyi dang por gzhag par bya/ /zhes yang ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/skyes bu gcig gi mig 'dzum bco brgyad la mthar gnas gcig /de sum cu la skad cig gcig /de bcu gnyis la yud tsam gcig /de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de bco lnga la phyogs gcig /de gnyis la zla ba gcig /de gnyis la tshigs pa gcig /de gsum la bgrod pa gcig /de gnyis la lo gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ ji skad du 'chi med mdzod las/ mig 'dzum bco brgyad mthar gnas la//de sum cu la skad cig bgrang / /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam yin/ /de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de dag bco lnga phyogs su grags/ /snga phyi'i phyogs ni dkar nag gnyis/ /de gnyis bsdoms(72ba)pa 'jal byed de/ /chu zla la sogs gnyis gnyis la/ /de tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /sto byang —498

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa ༅da pa/ (phanabagrod pa gnyis la lo//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/de yang lo'i skad dod wa rṣa zhes pa nges tshig gisabashad na bzhing 'gyur te/yongs bgrang /grang bzhi/rang skyob/'dor byed ces bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ji skad du 'chi med mdzod las/yongs bgrang bgrang bzhi rang skyob dang //'dor byed ces bya lo yi ming //zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/spyir rgya gar na rgyal po rang rang gi rgyal srid kyi lo la mnga' ris kyi bu lon sbyangs nas/lo de nas mgo 'dzin pa shas che ste/lub/sa kyi bsta na bcos rnams su/g.yul brtan 'og du nyis stong lon//zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/'on kyang gsung rab las ni/lo drug cur byed de/bde mchog bstod 'grel las/rab byung rnam byung dkar po dang /zhes sogasa'abyung ba'i phyir/lo de la dus tshigs ji tsam du 'byed tshul yod de/gsum/bzhi/lnga/drug rnams su 'byed pa'i phyir/gsum du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/sems ni tsha bar mtshungs pas dpyid du bsdus/ston ni char 'bab pas dbyar du bsdus te/dgun/dpyid/dbyar gyi dus gsum du 'a zad rigs pa'i phyir/de yang yod de/mgo/rgyal/mchu/dbo'i zla ba bzhi dang po/nag pa/sa ga/ston/chu stod kyi zla ba bzhi gnyis pa/gro zhun/khrums/tha skar/smin drug gi zla ba bzhi gsum par 'jog pa'i phyir/bzhin 'jog rigs te/dbyar dgun ston dpyid du ma phye nas bzhin 'jog pa'i phyir/ji skad du/rgya las 'gyur ba'i myang 'das las/zla ba 73na ) gsum ni dpyid kyi dus//zla ba gsum ni dbyar gyi dus//zla ba gsum ni ston gyi phyogs//zla ba gsum ni dgun zhes bya//zhes pa dang /sothar gyi mdo las/byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang /zhes yang ba'i phyir/dus tshigs la lngar 'byed rigs 'dul ba lung las/dus tshod ni lnga ste/dgun gyi dus dang /dpyid kyi dus dang /dbyar gyi dus dang /dbyar thung ngu'i dus dang /dbyar ring po'i dus so//zhes bshad pa'i phyir/dus tshigs la drug tu 'byed rigs te/myang 'das las gnyis gnyis dus tshigs gcig byas nas//lo gcig dusatshigs drug tu bsgyur//zhes dang /yan lag brgyad pa las/dgun zla ra ba so gos gnyis gnyis//rim bzhin dus ni drug tu 'dod//ces bshad ༷༷ phyir/dus tshigs la gsum du phye ba la chos can/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'dagos pa yod de/ phyag dar khrod pa'i gos shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bzhin phye ba la chos can/dgos pa yod de/ bod kyi tha snyad du rab 'bring tha gsum dang / rgya gar bas dgun dpyid dbyar ston bzhin phye ba'i lugs dang mthun pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ chos rje bsod grags pas/ 'jig rten dang mthun par dgun dpyid dbyar ston te bzhi gsungs/ dgos pa ni gsung rab las/ rab 'bring / tha chung gsum gsungs zhes pa ni mi 'thad de/ rgya dpe na/ de 'dra'i skad dod med pa'i phyir/ rgya dpe la/pā la gu ni zhes pa bod skad du lo tsā ba rnams kyis dbo can zhes pa thon yong rgyu la/ bod dang bstun nas dpyid rar bsgyur ba'i phyir/ dus tshigs la lngar phye ba la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dbyar thung ngu shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dus tshigs la drug tu phye (73ba)ba la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ zhag mi thub shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ lo mgo ngos 'dzin tshul la/ shes bya chos can/ lo mgo 'dzin tshul yod de/ hor zla bcu pa'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu drug nas 'dzin pa'i phyir/ der thal/dgun nas 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dge slong gi lo dri ba las/ dus du yod ce na lnga'o/ /lnga po dag gang zhe na/ dgun dang / so ka dang / dbyar dang / dbyar thung ngu dang / dbyar ring po zhes bya'o//zhes dang / rgya cher 'grel las/ dus tshigs drug po dgun dang / dgun smad dang / dpyid dang / so ga dang / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'di'i shugs la nyin mtshan ring ba mthar thug pa'i dus su dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ldog pa bstan kyang / rang gzhan gyi mkhas pa mang po nyin mo bzlog ces pa mtshan mo las bzlog ste nyin mo ring du song ba ma dgongs par/ nyi ldog la bsnyegasapa'i bshad pa mdzad pas/ dpyid dang ston gyi dus su nyi ma log dgos pa lta bu'i mu cor gyi gtam gyis shes ldan rnams lta ci smos/ bod kyi gnag rdzi rgan po rnams kyang khrel ba'i gnas so/ /gar lugs pa kha cig /zla ba brgyad par lo mgo 'dzin pa sogs ni dpyad pa bya ba'i yul yin no/ /sa skya pa'i mkhas pa kha cig /dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa khrums kyi zla ba yi tha ma mar ngo sngon du song ba'i yar —500

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa 3da pa/ (pha)ngo'i tshes brgyad la dbyar nyi ldog ste/zhes smra ba ni mi yid de/de ltar na khrums zla zla ba brgyad pa yin pa gang zhig/zla ba brgyad pa la dbyar nyi ldog 4na ) pa mi srid pa'i phyir/der thal/zla ba brgyad pa la ston sto mas mkho pa gang zhig/dbyar nyi ldog pa'i tshe/nyi ma ring ba'i mthar thug pa'i dus yin pa'i phyir/zla shol khrung ba'i rgyu mas yod de/tshes sa gis nyin tsā gi dod ma thub pa la brten nas/lo lnga lnga la zla shol re re 'don pa dang /tshes zhag gis khyim zhag gi dod thub pa la brten nas/lo gnyis dang zla ba phyed par dgu nas 'don pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/dang po grub ste/lo re la tshes zhag drug drug lhag pa gang zhig/de bsags pas lo lnga na zhag sum cur longs pa'i phyir/dang po grub ste/nyin zhag gi zla ba gnyis dang /tshes zhag gi zla ba gnyis do bsdosapa na tshes zlas nyi zla'i dod ma thub pas nyin zhag gcig lhag pa'i dod mnyam la tshes zhag gcig bsnan pas rags rtsis la yun mnyam yang /zhag grangs gcig gis tshes zla de mang bas de 'dra'i zhag re bsags pas lo gcig la zhag drug lhag pa'i phyir/zhag mi thub ces pa 'di'i don du 'chad dgos la/de lta bu'i gnad ma shes par rang gas gyi mas wo pa rgan po rnams/zhag mi tso kyi bshad pa sna tshogs byed pa ni rtsis kyi gtsug lag la byang ba zhig gis bltas na shin tu nongs pa'i gnas so//de yang lo lnga nas zla shol 'byung ste/gzhung dam pa'i gleng gzhi'i skabs las/ston pa gto yod kyi rgyal byed tshal na bzhugs pa' tshe na dge slong rnams la lo lnga lnga na shol dor cig/ces gsungs nas lo lnga lnga na shol dor ro//zhes gsungs4ba lnga'i phyir/gong gi rtsa rtagasaganyis pa grub ste/lo gcig la zhag bcu gcig 'brang bcas re lhag pa gang zhig/de bsags pasalo gnyis dang zla ba phyed dang dgun zla tsog tu longs pa'i phyir/dang po grub ste/khyim zla re dang tshes zla re dang bsdos pas zhag re bag med re ma thub pas/de gnyis dod mnyam pa la zhag re bag med re bsnan pas/don la yun mnyam yang /bag med re lhag pa de bsags pas/lo gcig la zhag brgyagacig 'brang bcas lhag pa'i phyir/gnyis pa 0 5 0 ste/lo gnyis la zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis lhag pa gang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logezhig /de'i rigs bas zla ba phyed dang dgu na zhag brgyad lhag pa rnams bsdoms pas zla ba gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nyin mtshan gyi khyad par gzhag tu yod de/ skya rengs shar nas 'od dmar gyi bar nyin mo dang / de nas mtshan mo'i mtha'i skad cig ma'i bar mtshan mor 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni 'dul mngon gyi lugs gtso bor bkod pa yin la/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pas gzhan gyi bzhed pa dang /dus kyi 'khor lo/ dbyangs 'char/ nag rtsis sogs sgo bstun pa'i legs pa'i cha phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ phyogs bral gyi gsung rab la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams spro ba skyed par nus mod/gsung rab phyogs re la chen pa'i deng sang gi rigs lam pa rnams la byis pa la lha khang bstan pa ltar dgos nus mi 'byung bas de tsam las ma spros so/ /smras pa/ legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs can/ khungs ldan mkhas pa'i gtam gyi rgyud mang dang / /lhan cig (75na)brdungs tshe dri za'i pi wang mkhan/ /skyengs te lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru bros/ /tshul 'di'i phra zhib dka' ba'i gnad rnams la/ /'grel bshad byed po phal cher mi smra ba'i/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin zhing 'ga' zhig mu cor tshig /bong bu'i skad gsang lta bur sgrog pa mthong / /de 'dra'i dgongs don log par bkral ba dag /gcig tu sangs rgyas bstan la rma 'byin mod/ /'on kyang 'bri stag phyag rgya'i khyu mthong tshe/ /mang du thos pas cung zad rjes yi rang / zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ chos rje bsod nams grags pa rjes gong dang bcas pa rnams na re/ dus bzhi cig car ba yin te/ 'dzam bu gling du dgun yod pa'i dus su gling gzhan gsum du'ang dgun grub pa'i phyir/ zer na/ 'dzam bu gling du dgun grub pa'i dus yin na/ sgra mi snyan du dgun grub pa'i dus yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dzam bu gling du dgun grub pa'i dus med par thal/ der de grub ma thag pa'i dus med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs dang po shar ma thag pa'i dus de 'dzam bu gling du dgun grub ma thag 502

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta la gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (pha)pa'i dus ma yin pa gang zhig/'dzam bu gling du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs dang po shar ba dang /'dzam bu gling du dgun grub pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/dang po ma grub na/sgra mi snyan du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs dang po shar ma thag pa'i dus de/sgra mi snyan du dgun grub ma thag pa'i dus yin par thal/sgra mi snyan du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug nas75ba ) hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar de dgun zla dang por 'jog pa'i phyir/'dod na/gling bzhir nyi ma cig car du 'char bar thal/'dzam bu gling du nyi ma shar ba'i tshe sgra mi snyan du nyi ma 'char ba'i phyir/der thal/'dzam bu gling du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyi ma shar ma thag pa'i dus su/sgra mi snyan du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyi ma shar ma thag pa yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/der thal/'dzam bu gling du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs dang po shar ma thag pa'i dus de/sgra mi snyan du hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs dang po shar ma thag pa yin pa'i phyir/der thal/de der dgun grub ma thag pa'i dus yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/'dzam bu gling du hor zla bcu pa'i tshesabacu drug gi skya rengs dang po shar ma thag pa'i dus chos can/sgra mi snyan du dgun grub pa'i dus yin par thal/'dzam bu gling du dgun grub ma thag pa'i dus yin ba'i phyir/'khor gsum/g.yin yang /'dzam bu gling du dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i dus su sgra mi snyan du dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i dus yin par thal/dam bca' yid pa'i phyir/'dod na/'dzam bu gling du i mo ring ba mthar thug pa'i dus su 'dzam bu gling du mtshan mo'ang ring ba mthar thug pa'i dus yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/dgun zla tha chung gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la 'dzam bu gling du mtshan mo yud tsam bco brgyad yod pa ltar/nyin mo'ang yud tsam bco brgyad yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod mi nus te/gdags pa las/dgun zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la mtshan mo yud tsam bco brgyad/nyin mo yud tsam bcu gnyis yod/tshes dgu 7na ) phan chad nas mtshan mo ni bri/nyin mo ni bskyed de/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/byas pa la kho na re/0 3 phyed nyi ma nub pa dang /zhes sogs kyi don/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logeston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa zhag gcig kho na la 'byung ba'i don yin pas skyon med do/ /zer na/'o na/ ston nyin mtshan mnyam nas zhag gnyis song ba'i skabs su/ nyin mtshan ring thung dod mi mnyam pa skyes bu mtha' dag gis mngon sum du shes pa zhig 'byung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ yud tsam gyi 'phel 'grib rim gyis byed dgos pa'i phyir dang / zhag gcig gnyis kyi bar la nyin mtshan gyi ring thung mngon pa mngon sum du mi 'byung ba ding sang gi btsun chung bsdus grwa pa yan chad kyis kyang shes pa'i phyir/ dus bzhi cig car ba la chen pa kha cig na re/ 'dzam bu gling du nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe sgra mi snyan du lho bgrod mthar thug pa 'byung bar thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyi mas nyin zhag phrugs gcig la ri rab la bskor ba'i tshe 'byog por bskor bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ rang lugs la 'dod lan 'debs la/ khos/ de mi 'thad de/ dus 'khor ba ltar mtho dman dang / sgang ga gongs sogs mi byed par thad skar chom rgyus ga pa'i phyir/ zer ba ni/ dus 'khor dang / go la'i rnam gzhag ma thos pa'i gtam yin zhing / chos mdzo pa 'chad pa'i skabs su dus 'khor sogs lugs mi gcig pa'i khungs 'dren pa ni/ mu to ba'i phye dang 'dra bas kho bo ni mi smra'o/ /bsdus grwa ma chags pa kha cig na re/ gling bzhin dus bzhi cig car du 'byung zer na/ 'dzam bu gling (7ba)du dus bzhi cig car du 'byung bar thal/ gling bzhin dus bzhi cig car du 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dzam bu gling du dbyar dgun cig car du 'byung bar thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mis tsha grang gi reg bya cig car du myong par thal lo/ /'dod na/ tsha grang gnyis po gcig gis gcig gi go sa 'gog nus pa ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ / 504

lnga pa lha rnams kyi gnas bshad pa la/sa dang 'brel ba'i gnas bshad/ma 'brel ba'i gnasabashad/dang po/zhar byung sems can gyi khyad chos/bar gyi thag tshad bshad pa dang bzhi/rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa dang /sum sto rtsa gsum pa'i gnas gnyis/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/ri rab 'di la chu mtshams yan la bang rim bzhi yod de/de bzhi'i bar gyi thag dpag tshad stong phrag bcu bcu yod pa'i phyir/bang rim bzhi po de dag chos can/ri rab las cung zad 'phags te/dang po la stong phrag bcu drug dang /gnyis pa la brgyad dang /gsum pa la bzhi dang /bzhi pa la gnyis phyir 'phags pa'i phyir/bang rim de rnams chos can/khyod la gnas pa'i lha yod de/rim pa bzhin gnod sbyin lag na gzhed thogs dang /phreng thogs dang /rtag myos dang /bzhi pa la rgyal chen bzhi dang de'i 'khor gyi lha rnams gnas pa'i phyir/gser gyi ri bdun po dag la yang cho ge can/khyod la gnas pa yod de/rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyi grong dang grong rdal dpag tu med pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/lhun po chos can/khyod kyi rtse na gnasayod de/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gnas77na yod pa'i phyir/lhun po'i rtse chos can/khyod kyi tshad yod de/ngos la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/de'i phyogs mtshams na dpag tshad lnga brgya'i tshad tsam gyi brtsegs pa bzhi la gnas pa'i lha yod de/gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnas pa'i phyir/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/grong dang tshal dang sa dang shing dang mdun sa'i mngon par dga' ba bshad pa lnga/dang po ni/sngar bshad pa'i rtse de chos can/khyod kyi dbus na gnas yod de/brgya byin gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi tshad yod de/ngos re la dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya/rngams su 6 5 0 tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/de chos can/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gerang bzhin khyad par can dang ldan pa yin te/ gzhi gser las grub pa/ sa gzhi 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba/ rkang pa bzhag na rnam rnam pa dang / bteg na spar bar byed pa'i gnyen pa yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ grong khyer gyi dbus de na brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed yod de/ ngos re la dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu re yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ grong khyer de chos can/ khyod kyi phyi rol ngos bzhi na/ lha'i skyed tshal bzhi yod de/ shing rta sna tsho gos tshal dang / slebs pa tsam gyis shes pa rtsub par 'gyur ba'i tshal dang / lha'i bu bu mo rnams 'dres shing 'dod yon la spyod pa'i tshal dang /yid dga' ba skyed pa'i tshal dang bzhis brgyan pa'i phyir/ shing rta sna tsho gos kyi tshal de chos can/ khyod na glang po de khyad par du 'phags pa yod de/ khyod na sa srung gi bu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa/dkar ba/ yan lag bdun legs par gnas pa/ mgo dmar ba/ mche (77ba)ba drug pa/ srid du dpag tshad gcig dang / khor yug tu bdun yod pa/ 'khor glang po che brgyad stong dang ldan pa/ mgo sum cu rtsa gsum du sprul zhing mgo re la mche ba drug drug dang / mche ba re la rdzing bu bdun bdun dang / rdzing bu re la padma'i sdong po bdun bdun dang / padma re la lha mo bdun bdun dang / de re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang / de re la sil snyan 'brol ba bdun bdun dang ldan par sprul te/ mgo dbus ma la dbang po dang / gzhan rnams la nye dbang so gnyis dang / glang po che gzhan rnams la 'khor rnams zhen nas 'gro ba'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ skyed tshal de rnams kyi phyogs bzhi na tshal bzhi yod de/ dpag tshad nyi shus bcad pa na/ sa gzhi bzang po tshal de dag la 'gran pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ grong khyer de'i byang shar gyi mtshams na shing yongs 'dus brtol yod de/ de dpag tshad lnga thur du zug pa/ brgya gyen du 'phags pa/ yal ga dang 'dab mas lnga bcur khyab pa/ me tog rgyas pa'i dri bzang po dpag tshad brgyar ldang ba sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ lho nub kyi mtshams na/ lha rnams kyi bka' bgro ba'i gnas yod de/ chos bzang lha'i mdun sa yod pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa sa dang ma 'brel ba'i gnas ni/ shes bya chos can/ de yod de/ sum cu rtsa gsum —506

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phanade'i steng na 'thab bral sogs 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams ni nam mkha' la gzhal med khang dang bcas par yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa zhan byung sems can gyi khyad chos la/ 'dod pa la spyod pa dang /lha'i bu skye ba dang / 'dod bde bsten tshul(74)dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ shes bya cho rtse can/ lha rnams 'dod pa la spyod tshul drug yod de/ rim pa bzhin 'og ma gnyis ni/ mi ltar dbang po gnyisasprad nas 'khrig pa bsten bar byed/ gsum pa 'khyud pa dang / bzhi pa lag pa bcangs pa dang / lnga pa rgod pa dang / drug pa bltas pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba myong bar byed pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/ 'dod pa'i lha mo rnams la bu mngal nas btsa' ba ma yin te/ de dag gi bang du byis pa lo lnga lon pa tsam nas lo bcu lon pa'i bar dag tu rim bzhin de rnams su skye ba'i phyir/thams cad yin nam zer na/ ma yin te/ brgya byin ni rdzogs par skye bas snga phyi brjes pa gzhan gyisami shes pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs can gyi lha rnams ni thog ma nyid nas lus kun rdzogasashing / gos dang bcas pa nyid du skye ste/ de rnams 'dod khams pa dang mi 'dra bar ngo tsha khrel yod shas che ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ de yod de/ 'dod pa ji ltar gnas ba dang / rang gisasprul pa dang / gzhan gyis sprul pa la dbang byed pa'i skye ba gsum po ni/ rim pa bzhin/ 'dod lha dang po bzhi mir bcas pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ba rnams yin la/dben pa las skyes pa dang / ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa dang / dga' ba med pa'i bde ba can gyi skye ba gsum ni/ rim pa bzhin bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi skye ba ste/ de re re la sa gsum gsum ste dgu yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bar gyi thag tshad ni/ shes bya chos can/ de yod de/ rgyal chen rigs (78na)bzhi pa'i gnas nas/ de'i 'og ma 'dod khams 'dzam bu gling la dpag tshad bzhi khri yod pa de bzhin du/ de'i gong ma sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bar la yang de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnas 'og ma'i gang zag rnams rang stobs kyis gnas gong ma rnams su bgrod mi nus te/ rdo phrul dang gzhan la bsten pa ma gtogs pa rnams kyis sa gong mar 'gro ba dang de dag mthong ba med pa'i phyir/—307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma gsung ma/ (ge wa wadrug pa stong gsum ngos gzung ba ni/shes bya chos can/stong spyi phud kyis 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang //ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang //tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gto dang po man ho stong la ni yin par 'dod pa'i phyir/stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams cho me can/yod de/sngar bshad pa'i stong spyi phud de stong la shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/stong gsum gyi 'jig rten chos can/yod de/stong gnyis pa de stong la byed pa'i phyir/stong gsum po de chos can/'chags 'jig rim can du mi 'byung ste/me sogs kyis 'jig pa dang /de'i rjes su 'byung ba ste mnyam du 'chags pa'i phyir/'gro ba rnams kyi lus che'i tshad bshad pa/bdun pa 'gro ba rnams kyi lus tshe'i 3 bshad pa la/lus tshad bshad pa dang /tshe tshad bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/mi'i lus tshad dang /lha'i lus tshad gnyis/dang po ni/gling bzhi'i mi rnams kyi lus tshad yod de/'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshad ni/kha cig khru bzhi dang /phal cher khru phyed dang bzhi yin la/shar khru brgyad/ba glang spyod pa bcu drug/sgra mi snyan pa soganyis zhes bya ba/ 79nasnga ma las phyi ma nyis 'gyur du bskyed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la 'dod lha'i lus tshad dang /gzugs kyi lus tshad gnyis/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/'dod dang ldan pa'i lha'i lus tshad yod de/rgyal wo rigs bzhi pa rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha nas/dga' ldan pa gcig dang /g.yin 'phrul dbang byed pa rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis kyi bar rgyang grags bzhi cha re bskyed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos༅/de yod de/gzugs ro dang po tshangs rigs pa la dpag tshad phyed dang /de'i gong ma phyed phyed bskyed cing /'od chung ba rnams kyi lus tshad dpag tshad gnyis/de'i ltag tshad med // yan chad kyi lus ni/'og ma bas gong ma nyis

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phana'agyur nyis 'gyur gyi che ba la/sprin med bas dpag tshad gsum dor bas brgya nyer lnga/'og min pa khri drug stong gi bar yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa tshe tshad la/bde 'gro'i tshe tshad/ga 'gro'i tshe tshad/ma nges pa'i 'chi ba yod med la dpyad pa dang gsum/dang po la/mi'i tshe tshad dang /lha'i tshe tshad gnyisadang po ni/shes bya chos can/de yod de/sgra mi snyan na tshe lo stong /nub dang shar gnyis na de'i phyed phyed spangs pa ste lnga brgya dang /phyed sum brgya/'dzam bu gling 'dir ma nges pa ste/tha mar lo bcu dang /bskal pa dang po'i tshe dpag tu med pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la 'dod lha'i tshe tshad dang /gzugs kyi tshe tshad/gzugs med khams pa'i tshe tshad dang gsum/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/'dod lha'i tshe tshad yod de/mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/'dod pa'i lha 'og ma 79brgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig/de sum cu la zla ba/de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya yin zhing /gong ma sum cu rtsa gsum pa nas gas 'phrul dbang byed pa'i bar la/mi lo brgya/nyis brgya sogs dang /rang lo gnyis ka nyis 'gyur du byasapas/mthar rang lo khri drub/ stong 'byung ba'i phyir/rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa chos can/khyod kyi tshe tshad mi lo'i grangs yod de/de la mi lo sa ya dgu yod pa'i phyir/sum cu rtsa gsum pa chos can/yod de/bye ba gsum dang sa ya drug yod pa'i phyir/'thab bral ba chos can/yod de/dung phyur gcig/bye ba bzhi/sa ya bzhi yod pa'i phyir/dga' ldan pa chos can/yod de/dung phyur lnga/bye ba bdun/sa ya drug yod pa'i phyir/'phrul dga' ba chos can/yod de/ther 'bum gnyis/dung phyur gsum/sa ya bzhi yod pa'i phyir/gzhan 'khrul dbang byed pa chos can/yod de/ther 'bum dgu/dung phyur gnyis/bye ba gcig/sa ya drug yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/gzugs kyi lha chos can/khyod rnams la nyin mtshan gyi tha snyad med kyang /tshe tshad ni gzhag tu yod de/rang gi lus gzhal ba'i dpag tshad kyi grangs kyi bskal pas 'jal ba'i phyir/dper na/tshangs rigs pa lus dpag tshad phyed yin pa bzhin du/tshe bskal pa phyed yin pas mtshon nus pa' phyir/༷sum pa ni/gzugs med kyi lha rnams khyod kyi tshe

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (potshad yod de/dang po'i tshe tshad bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu dang /lhag ma gsum po nyi shu res lhag pasalhag pa yin pa'i phyir/sngar bshad pa'i bskal pa de rnams chos can/ngos gzung du yod de/'od chung nas bzung ste bskal chen dang /de'i 80na ) 'og ma tshangs chen sogs ni phyed bskal te bskal chen phyed la bskal par byed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ༅ 'gro'i tshe tshwa la/tsha dmyal ba/yi dwags/dud 'gro/grang dmyal gyi tshe 3 dang bzhi/dang po ni/yang sos la sogs pa'i dmyal ba drug chos can/khyod kyi tshe tshad yod de/rim pa bzhin 'dod lha rigs drug gi tshe tshad dang /rang gi nyin zhag mnyam la/zhag de grangs pa'i de rnams kyi tshe ni 'dod lha rigs drug dang lo grangs 'dren tshul 'dra ba yin pa'i phyir/rab tu tsha ba dang mnar med gnyis tshe tshad yod de/snga ma bar bskal phyed dang /phyi ma bar bskal gcig yin pa'i phyir/yang sos chos can/khyod kyi tshe tshwa yod de/de mi lo khrag khrig chen po gcig dang /khrag khrig drug dang /ther 'bum wo po gnyis yod pa'i phyir/thig nag chos ro/de yod de/de 4 bkram gcig dang /khrag khrig chen po gnyis/khrag khrig dgu/ther 'bum chen po drug yod pa'i phyir/bsdus 'joms chos can/de yod de/de rab bkram chen po gcig dang /khrag khrig chen po gsum/khrag khrig drug/ther 'bum rṣa po brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ngu 'bod chos tso/de yod de/de rab bkram chen po brgyad/rab bkram gnyis/khrag khrig chen po dgu/khrag khrig bzhi/ther 'bum chen po bzhi rnams yod pa'i phyir/ngu 'bod rṣa po chos can/de yod de/de gtos drug/rab bkram wo po drug/rab bkram gsum/khrag khrig chen po lnga dang /khrag khrig lnga/ther 'bum chen po gnyis yod pa'i phyir/tsha ba chos can/de yod de/de gtams chen lnga/gtams gsum/rab bkram brgyad/khrag khrig chen po bzhi/khrag khrig gcig/ther 'bum 80ba ) chen po drug yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/dud 'gro rnams chos can/de yod de/khyod tshe mchog tu ring ba la bar bskal gcig yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/yi dwags rnams chos can /de /da de/de mi'i zla ba la zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo

chos ma ga rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa gad pa/ (phanalnga brgya yin pa'i phyir/mi lo dang sbyor tshul yod de/khri lnga stong yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/grang dmyal gyi tshe ro yod de/ma ga dha'i til khal brgyad cu shong ba'i til gyi sbyangs nang phyur bur bkang ba'i nang nas mi lo brgya re na til nyag gcig re phyung bas zad par gyur pa ni chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin la/gzhan lhag ma bdun la nyi shu nyi shus 'phar ba'i phyir/chu bur can chog can/de yod de/mi lo khrag khrig brgyad dang /ther tsom snyag yod pa'i phyir/chu bur rdol ba chos tso/de yod de/de 4 bkram gcig/khrag rpā drug dang /ther wo gnyis yod pa'i phyir/sgo tham pa chos can/de yod de/de rab bkram gsum dang /khrag chen gnyis/ther chen bzhi yod pa'i phyir/a chu pa chos can/de yod de/de 4 bkras bzhi/khrag ོ brgyad/zer wo drug yod pa'i phyir/kye glo ba chos ro/de yod de/de rab bkram drug/khrag chen bzhi/ther chen brgyad yod pa'i phyir/utpal ltar gas pa chosacan/de yod de/de rab bkram brgyad/khrag khrig gcig yod pa'i phyir/padma ltar gas pa chos can/de yod de/de rab bkram dgu/khrag chen drug/khrag khrig gcig dang /ther chen gnyis yod pa'i phyir/bad wo ltar gas pa chos can/de yod de/de 4 wo gcig/rab bkram gcig/khrag 'a gnyis/khrag khrig gcig/ther 'bum chen po bzhi yod pa'i phyir//gsum pa 81nasgo nges pa'i 'chi ba yod med la dpyad pa ni/sgra mi snyan pa chos can/khyod ma gtogs zhes dmigs kyis bsal ba la dgos pa yod de/khyod kyis nges par lo stong thub la/gas rnams dus min du tsha ba yod pa'i phyir/smras pa/rigs drug las kyis 'phangs pa'i tshe yi tshad/man tu phra bas gtan la phab pa 'di//tha snyad rig pa'i tshul la ma sbyangs pa'i//mkhas sgro me gzhan gyi rna ba'i spyod yul min//'di ltar brjod pa rang nyid grags 'dod tsam//don du gnyer min gas dag blo gsal tshogs//spro ba bskyed dang yongs 'dzin bla ma la//chos phyir legs bshad rol mo 'brol ba yin//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogetshad bshad pa/brgyad pa tshad de gzhal thabs la/'jog gzhi ngos gzung ba dang /bskal pa ngos gzung ba gnyis/dang po la/dpag tshad rgyang grags ngos gzung ba dang /lo ngos gzung ba gnyis/dang bo ni/shes bya cho se can/gzugs dang /ming dang /dus kyi chung tha yod de/rdul phra rab de gzugs kyi chung tha/yi ge lta bu ming gi thung tha/dus mtha'i skad cig ma de dus kyi thung tha yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/lus tshad gzhal bya'i rgyang grags dang /dpag tshad ngos gzung du yod de/phra rab kyi rdul dang /rdul phran dang /de bzhin du lcags rdul dang /chu rdul dang /ri bong gi rdul dang /lug rdul dang /glang rdul dang /nyi zer gyi rdul dang /sro ma dang /de las byung ba shig dang /de bzhin du nas dang /sor tshigs rnams ni gong nas gong du bdun du 'gyur bar 81ba ) shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/khru tshad sogs yod de/sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang /khru bzhi la gzhu gang ste 'dom gang /gzhu 'dom zhe dag lnga brgya rnams la rgyang grags te/de tsam grong nas 'phags pa la dgon par 'dod pa'i phyir/dpag tshad chos can/yod de/sngar bshad pa'i rgyang grags brgyad la byed pa'i phyir/gnyis pa lo ngos gzung ba ni/shes bya chos can/thang cig gi rtsom gzhi yod de/dusamatha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma gcig/de'i skad cig ma de dag kyang drug cu la ni thang gcig go/zhes 'jog pa'i phyir/yud tsam chos can/yod de/thang gcig sum cu la byed pa'i phyir/nyin zhag chos can/yod de/yud tsam sum cu la byed pa'i phyir/zla ba chos can/yod de/nyin zhag sum cu la byas pas sngar bshad pa gsum po de gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur ba'i phyir/shes bya chos can/lo yod de/lo re la zhag mi thub drug drug dor ba dang bcas pa yi zla ba bcu gnyis la lor 'jog pa'i phyir/

chos ma' rin rṣa tshon pa'i shing rta las gan gsum pa gad pa/ (phanaganyis pa la/mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/bskal pa chosacan/rnam pa mang du yod de/khyod la 'jig bskal/stong bskal/'chags bskal/gnas bskal/bskal pa chen po sogs bshad pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/'jig bskal/'chags bskal/gnasabaskal/zhig nas khrug pa'i bskal pa/bskal pa chen po dang lnga/dang po ni/shes bya cho me can/de yod de/'jig pa'i bskal pa ni dmyal ba'i srid pa med pa ste der sems can gsar skye med pa nas/snod zad pa'i bar la 'jog pa'i phyir//82na gnyis pa ni/shes bya cho rtse can/de yod de/'chagasapa'i bskal pa ni dang po rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags pa nas ni/dmyal ba'i srid pa grub pa'i bar la 'jog pa'i phyir/gsum pa la/bar bskal gyi tshad ya thog gzhag pa/bar gyi khug pa/mtha'i ma thog/yar 'phel bcu dgu'i 'tshams/de rnams gnas pa'i bskal par bstan pa'o//dang po ni/shesabya chos can/bar gyi bskal pa'i 3 yod de/mi rnams kyi tshe lo dpag med nas 'gribs te/tshe lo bcu pa'i bar la bar bskal gcig du 'jug pa ya thog ring mo zhes grags pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/bar bskal de la bco brgyad du 'gyur te/tshe lo bcu pa nas yar skye ste brgyad khri'i bar du 'gyur ba dang /brgyad khri nas mar bri ste bcu par gyur pa'i bar gyi bskal pa gzhan ni bco brgyad 'byung ba la bar gyi khug pa zhes bya ba'i phyir/gsum pa ni/shes bya chos can/bar gyi bskalapa nyi shu las gcig ni yar la skye ba kho nar 'gyur te/mar la mi 'bri ba'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/shes bya chos can/yar 'phel de dag kyang yod de/tshe lo brgyad khri'i bar du yar 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/lnga pa ni/shes bya chos can/de ltar 'jig rten 'am gas pa dang ni gnas pa dang /'jig ba dang /zhig nas 'dug pa dang dus mnyam ste/bar bskal nyi shur 'chags/nyi shur gnas/nyi shur 'jig/nyi shur stongs nas bog pa'i phyir/lnga pa la gnyis/dngos dang /zhan la gang zag gsum gyi 'byung tshul lo//dang bo ni/shes bya chos can/bskal rpā gyi 3 yod de/bar bskal de dag brgyad cu la der 'jog pa'i phyir/gnyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogepa la sangs rgyas/rang sangs rgyas/'khor los sgyur rgyal 'byung tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/sangs rgyasang tshul yod de/bskal chen grangs med gsum du tsho gis bsags pa lasade 'byung ba'i phyir/grangs med de ni grangs gtan med ma yin te/lung sil bu las/gcig bstobargya stong khri 'bum dang /sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams//rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya//chen po'i zla dang bcas pa ni//ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang //gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang //pad steng der 'dren mtha' snang dang /khyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang //legs phyin rtogasa'agro 'bying rdul dang //rgya rtags stobs 'khor brda shes dang //rnam 'byung sto bos mig nyi shu gcig/bar du brgyad ni ma rnyed pas//rang gi ming gang rung ba gzhug/grangs med bar du bcu 'gyur bsgres//zhes pa ltar ro//sangs rgyasang ba'i dus yod de/mi rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri pa las mar ni 'grib pa yi brgya yi bar la de dag 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa la 'byung ba'i dus dang /tsho gis bsag ba'i 3 gnyis/dang po ni/shes bya chos ro/rang sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba'i dus yod de/de yar 'phel mar 'grib gnyis ka la 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/bskal pa brgyar byang chub kyi tshogs bsags pa las 'byung ba'i phyir/gsum pa 'khor rte ba'i rgyal po 'byung tshul la/tshig don dang /spyi don gnyis/dang po la/'byung ba'i dus/ji ltar 'khor ༷ tshul/sangs83na ) rgyas kyi mas gyi khyad par dang gsum/dang bo ni/shes bya chos can/'dor los rgyal srid la dbang sgyur ba'i 4 tshul can 'byung dus ni yod de/de tshe lo dpag med nas stong phrag brgyad cu yan la 'byung gi de man chad la mi 'byung ba'i phyir//gnyis pa ni/shes bya chos can/'khor los sa la dbang sgyur tshul yod de/gser gyi 'khor re ba'i rgyal pos gling bzhi/dngul gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos gling gsum/zangs kyi 'khor rte ba'i rgyal pos gling gnyis/lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos gling gcig la rim bzhi du dbang sgyur ba'i phyir/shes bya cho/can/gling gcig tu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po

chos ma' rin chen tshon pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ 9)gnyis su cig car du mi 'byung ste/ des 'gran zla med pa'i las bsags pa'i phyir/ dper na bstan pa gcig la de'i bdag po sangs rgyas gnyis mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /shes bya chos can/ 'khor rte ba'i rgyal po de kun las rnam par rgyal tshul yod de/gser gyi 'khor pe ba'i rgyal po la ni rgyal phran rnams kyis phar bsus nas 'dud/ dngul ni/rang nyid der 'gro bas 'dud/ zangs la ni/ g.yul bshams pa tsam gyis 'dud/ lcags la ni mtshon gdengs pa tsam gyis 'dud cing / rang nyid rgyal yang gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba med pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ 'khor sgyur dang / thub pa'i mtshan gyi khyad par yod de/ phyi mni/ rang gi yul rnams ma 'dres par gnas pa dang / 'od gsal la cha shas rdzogs pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/gnyis pa spyi'i don la/ 'khor ༷ rgyal 'byung ba'i (83ba)rgyu/ dus la dpyad pa/ ji ltar 'byung tshul/ yon to gyi khyad par gang dang ldan tshul/ dgos pa ci'i don du 'jig rten du 'byung ba dang lnga/ dang po ni/ tsho gos gnyis kyi mthu dbag tu med pa las rgyal ba'i sras po rnams semasacan gyi don du 'bor je ba'i rgyal po'i srid 'dzin pa yin te/ lugs gzhan la mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni/ khyim pa 'khor rte rnams su/ gyur nas skye ba thamasacad du/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /zhes dang / mdo sdes bcu pa las/ sa dang po laganasapa phal cher 'dzam bu gling gi dbang phyug ser sna'i dri ma dang bral ba/ sems can rnams kyi ser sna'i dri ma sel ba'i bdag bor gyur to/ /zhes yang ba dang cha 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor wa ba'i rgyal po ni rdzogs ldan gyi dus ma gtogos de las phyi bar mi 'byung ste/ dus der de'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa de mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ rang 'grel las/ mi rnams kyi tshe dpag tu med pa nas brgyad khri'i bar du 'khor bye ba rnams 'byung ngo / /'og tu ni ma yin te/ de bas thung ba'i tshe ni phun sum tsho gos pa de'i snod ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / 'dul ba lung las/ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bltams pa'i dus su/ ri bo kun 'dzin nas drang srong nyen —515

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gemongs med ces bya ba 'ongs te/rgyal po la smras pa las kyang /sa bdag rtogs pa po rnams blo grosag gil//rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung //bsod nams mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni//rnyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas84na ) 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/de lta na yang /dus 'og ma rnams la stobs kyi 'khor ༷ ba mi 'byung ba ni ma yin te/'phags pa'i yul du chos rgyal mya ga med/rgya nag po'i yul du jing gir/gas gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir cho ge rgyal mes dpon gsum dang /dpal phag mo gru pa'i sde srid lta bu bsod nams kyi 'khor lo yongs su 'bar ba'i bdag nyid can dag yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/sa thams cad la dbang sgyur bar byed pa'i 'khor lo de ni/mgar ba sogs bzo bos ched du ma byas par/brgya byin gyis sbyin zhing /rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/tshes bco lnga'i dus na rgyal po gso sbyong la gnas pa'i tshe rang bzhin gyis yang ba zhig dgos te/rgya cher rol pa las/'khor je ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur zhe na/'di la rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nasadabang bskur ba/gso sbyong gi nyi ma tshes bco lnga la mgo khrus byas te/dbu gzungs su gnas shing /steng gi khyams na bud med kyis kun nas bskor zhing 'dug pa'i tshe/shar gyi phyogs nas lha'i 'khor lo rin po che/rtsibs stong yod pa mu khyud dang ldan pa lte ba dang bcas pa gser las grub pa/mgar bsam byas pa/'phang du shing rta la bdun tsam nas khrung ste/zhes 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang 'dod rigs pa'i phyir/bzhi pa yon to gyi khyad par ni/'khor ༷ ba thams cad la rin po che sna bdun 'byung ba yin te/rgya cher rol pa las/gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa btsas pa'i dus na/bram ze mtshan mkhan rnams la bstan pa'i tshe/de rnams kyis smras pa/gzhen nu 84ba ) khyim na gnas pa'i tshe/'khor ༷ ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba/chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/de'i rin po che sna bdun 'di lta ste/'khor lo si po che dang /glang po rin po che dang /rta rin po ṭaṃ dang /bud med rin po che dang /nor bu rin po

chos ma' rin wo tshon pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (pha)che dang /khyim bdag rin po che dang /blon po rin po che dang bdun no//zhes khrung ba 'dir yang mtshungs pa'i phyir/rin po che bdun po de la yon to khyad par can mang du yod de/'khor lo la yon tan lnga/nor bu la yon tan brgyad/bud med la yon tan lnga/khyim bdag la yon tan bzhi/glang po la yon to brgyad/rta mchog la yon to brgyad/blon po la yon to brgyad yod pa'i phyir/dang po yod de/rtsibs stong la dpag tshad lnga brgya pa/nam mkha' la dpag tshad 'bum du nyi ma gcig la thogs med du 'gro ba/gling gzhan dang rgya chen bzhi'i gnas la phyin pas dpung tshogs gzhan rnamasarjes su 'brang dgos pa/gzhan mtha' dag ngang gis 'du dgos pa ste lnga yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa yod de/mun pa la dpag tshad brgya'i bar du 'od 'byung ba/chu med pa'i sar yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu 'byung ba/don rnams bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub pa/kha dog sna lnga dang ldan pa/dpag tshad brgya tso du nad mi 'byung ba/yul dgon pa skyed mos tshal rnams phun sum tsho gos pa/char bzang po dusasu 'bab pa/'gro ba rnams dus min du mi 'chi ba rnams yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa yod de/bsam pa mthun pa/bu mang po btsa' ba/rigs mthun ba/srid mtho ba//bud med gzhan la phrag dog mi byed pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/bzhi pa yod de/dpag tshad 85na ) brgya tshun chad mthong ba/yid gzhudas pa/lha'i mig dang ldan pa/'byor ba zad pa med pa rnams yod ba'i phyir/lnga pa yod de/cang shes pa/mchog tu bka' nyan pa/pha rol gyi sde las rgyal ba/nam mkha' la 'gro ba/rdzu phrul dang ldan pa/thams cad thal skar du gyur pa/yan lag shin tu gnas ba/gser gyi rgyan dang ldan pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/drug pa yod de/kha dog mdzes pa/dbyibs phun sum tsho gos pa/nyin gcig la 'dzam bu gling la lan gsum bskor nus pa/lus la nad med pa/rdzu'aphrul dang ldan pa/nam mkha' la 'gro ba/zhon na gus par byed pa/rnam par 'phrul ba'i chos can rnams yod pa'i phyir/bdun pa yod de/shin tu rdzogs pa dang /de bsags pa dang /ma chags pa dang /chos ma yin pa rnam par spangs pa dang /shin / rigs par brtsom pa dang /yul dang dus ldan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogepa dang /nyon mongs med pa dang /skye bo la rnam par mi 'tshe ba rnams yod pa'i phyir/de yang mdo rnams su blon po las/ dmag dpon zhes ming ma bshad kyang / don la khyad par med de/ dpag bsam hphu shing las/de nas de yi rin rṣa bdun//de tshe khrung 'gyur 'khor lo rta//nor bu glang po bud med dang /khyim bdag dmag dpon sngon 'gro ba'o//zhes khrung ba'i phyir/lnga pa dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'byung ba ni/mdo las/srog chags kun la phan pa yi//byang chub tu ni sgos bskyed nas//'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la//su zhig skor ba byed pa ni//tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du//zhes pa nas/ris bskor rgya mtsho tshun chad kyi//gling bzhi dag gi dbang phyug bla//85brgyal po chos dang ldan par 'gyur//'khor los sgyur ba rdzu phrul che//rin wo bdun dang ldan par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir//smras pa/mi dge'i rnyog ma mtha' dag rgyang bsrings shing //dge bcu'i chu klung dwangs pa 'khyil ba'i nang //rdzogs ldan cha shas gang ba'i zla ba'i ngos//'khor los sgyur rgyal ri dwags gzugs kyisamadzes//su zhig gsar pa'i gtam dang mi ldan par//snga rabs rnying ma'i sgros la bdag gir byed//la la gang byung bris pa'i 'gal sdum la//bstan bcos yin zhes blun po'i dbus su rngam//sngon chad mkhas la cung zad ma grags pa'i//legs bshad bdag 'dras smra ba ches dka' yang //gzhung don log par smra ba'i bab col tshig/brjod pas mkhas mang dbus su gnong ma dgos//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//snod bcud khyad chos bshad pa/dgu pa snod bcud kyi khyad chos la/dngos dang /'jig bskal bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/bskal pa dang po'i khyad par/de las/ ltar 'grib tshul/'gribs pa'i mthar ji ltar

chos ma' rin rsā 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas gsum pa bshad pa/ (phana'abyung tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/sngar bskal pa dang por byung ba'i sems༅ rnams la rje 'bangs kyi tha snyad med de/gzugs can gyi lha bzhin du rdzu phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang /rang 'od kyis mun pa sel zhing dga' ba zas su za ba'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/shes bya chosacan/de yod de/bskal pa de rim gyis 'grib pa na skyes bu skam chags can zhig gis sbrang rtsi lta bu'i ro la chags shing /de nas gzhan zhig gis ma rmos86na ) pa'i lo tog la le los gsog 'jog byas/de rjes bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis zhing btab pas/gcig gi de la gzhan gyisalongs spyad pas rtsod pa byung ste/thams cad kha 'cham par/dpon du mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po bskos pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/de ltar 'byung ba'i nyes spyod rnams kyang las ga la brten nasa'abyung ste/der ma zad las ga pa'i lam rnams lhag par spyad pas tshe thung zhing lo ni bcu par 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyir ro//gsum pa ni/shes bya chos can/mthar ji ltar 'byung tshul yod de/bas kyi bskal ba ni/mtshon gyi bskal pa bar ma dang /nad kyi bskal pa bar ma dang /mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma dag gi tshar phyin pa'i phyir/go rim bzhin de rnams kyi yun tshad yod de/mtshon bskal zhag bdun/nad bskal zla ba bdun/mu ge'i bskal pa lo bdun dang zla ba bdun dang zhag bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa 'jig bskal bye brag tu bshad pa la/gang gis 'jig pa'i rkyen/gang 'jig pa'i ngo bo/'jig pa'i rgyu mtshan/'jig tshul dang bzhi/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/de yod de/de nyi ma bdun gyi me dang /char pa'i chu dang /rlung gis rab tu 'jig pa dag ni yin pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa ni/shes bya cho ge can de yod de/bsam gtan gnyis pa dang sogs pas gsum pa dang /bzhi pa ste/gsum po de dag gi rtse mo re bzhag ste lhag ma rnams ni go rim bzhin du bzhag pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/shes bya chos can/rgyu mtshan yod de/de dang de'i sems can gyi nang gi skyon dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu dang /gnyis pa na/dga' ba'i chu lta bu dang /gsum pa na dbugs 'byung 86brngub rlung yod pa dang chos mtshungs pa'i /ra/shes bya chos can/bsam gto bzhi pa na

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ge'ajig pa de gsum med de/nang gi skyon dang bral bas mi g.yo ba yin pa'i phyir/'o na de rtag pa yin nam zer na/mi rtag pa yin te/bzhi pa de'i gzhal med khang rnams skar ma ltar chad nas ma 'dresapas na sems can dang bcas te cig car 'byung zhing 'jig pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/'jig tshul yod de/me yis bar med par 'jig pa bdun/de nas chu yis gcig/rim pa de lta bu 'byung ba'i chu bdun thal nas ni/slar yang me yis bdun/de nas ni mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa gcig yin pa'i phyir/de ltar na bskal chen drug cu rtsa bzhi re na rlung gi 'jig pa re 'byung ngo /shes bya chos can/chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/gnas gsum pa zhes bya ba gtan la phab pa yin te/snod bas kyi 'jig rten mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i phyir/smras pa/snod bcud 'jig rten snang tshul mtha' klas pa//rnam dpyod pir gyis yid kyi rtsig ngos la//ma 'dres gsal bar bris pa'i rang rtags su//dkar 'jam shog bu'i ngos kyang dog por bgyis//lha mi'i lang tsho dar ba'i bde ba dang /ga song bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal dag/bsams tshe blang dor bya ba'i blo skye yang //tshul bzhin de rgyu sgrub pa'i skye bo dkon//dge dang mi dge mtha' dag 'byed pa la//dbyig gnyen gzhung lugs dag la nan tan du//dang por thos dang bar du de don soms//tha mar nyams su long dang shes ldan kye//chos mngone pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes 87na ) pa las/gnas gsum pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod ji snyed pa nyad zin to// 20

chos mdzo rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bzhi pa bshad pa/ (phanaganas bzhi pa las bstan pa/rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum ma lus pa/ /rgyal sras gzhone nu'i gar gyis rnam rol ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel phyir ngur sgrig gar/ /rnam mang mkhyen dang brtse bas rol mdzad pa'i/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha par/ /rnam dkar las kyi sa bon bskrun pa nas/ /rnam 'dren ma thob bar du phyag btsal te/ /bzhi pa las dang 'bras bu'i tshul/ /tshul bzhin ma nor ston byed na/ /na tshod lta bur blo phra yang / /yang yang bsams te bshad par bya/ /gnyis pa spang bya kun 'byung bden pa gtan la dbab pa la/ las kyi kun 'byung dang / nyen mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ las kyi rnam grangasagazhan bstan pa'i sgo nas don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/dang po ni/ 'jig rten sna tshogs chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu yod de/ sems can gyi las bzang ga lasaskyes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig na re/ las yin na/ bde ba myong 'gyur/ sdug bsngal myong 'gyur/ bar ma myong 'gyur gyi las gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ zag med kyi las chosacan/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zag bcas yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/kha cig /rnam gsum dri med gzugs gsungs dang / /'phel dang ma byas la ma sogs phyir/ /zhesapa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i (87ba)gzugs yin na/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yin pas khyab zer na/ lus kyi rnam par rig byed kyi las chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/der thal/ rnam gsum zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/bstan yod thogs bcas kyi gzugs/ bstan med thogs bcas kyi gzugs/ bstan med thogs med —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pokyi gzugs gsum po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bstan med thogs bcas kyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mig shes kyi yul du bstan du med ba gang zhig /rang gi go sar gzugs can gyi dngos po g.yin 'byung ba la thogs pa'i gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de bye brag tu smra bas mig shes kyi yul du ma gyur ba dang / mdo sdo pas/ de las bzlog ste khas len ba'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gnyis gzung 'gyur te zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi 'gyur te zhes pas lus kyi rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs de dbang po gnyis kyi gzung byar med pa'i 'dod pa bstan pa'i phyir/kha cig lusang ga gi las yin na/ zag bcas kyi las yin bas khyab zer na/ dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi lus kyi las su gyur pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ lus kyi las yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud kyi lus kyi las su gyur pa'i sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ bstan bcos nas bshad pa'i las kyi rnam gzhag dang / mdo nas gsungs pa'i las kyi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang / rig byed min pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang bo la/ sems pa'i las ngos(85)gzung ba/ rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa ngos gzung ba/de dag la dge sogs gsum du 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ las de cho rtse can/ gnyis su yod de/sems pa'i las dang / des byas pa'i las gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ sems pa'i las chos can/ yid kyi las yin te/ des gtso bor bsgrubs pa'i las yin pa'i phyir/ des bskyed pa'i las chos can/lusang ga gi las yin te/ de gnyis kyis gtso bor grub pa'i las yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus ngag gi lasade dag chos can/ gnyis yod de/ rnam par rig byed dang / rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rnam par rig byed dang / rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la/lus kyi rig byed/ ngag gi rig byed gnyis/ dang po/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs gzhag /rang sdoganasam bu'i lugs dgag /mdo ga pa'i lugs brjod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus kyi rnam par rig —322

chos ma ga rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta la gnas bzhi pa bshad pa/ (pha)byed chos can/ lus kyi dbyibs su 'dod de/ lus kyi bkod pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya cho so can/ gnas ma bu pas lus gang du skyes pa'i gnas der mi 'chi bar yul gzhan du 'gro ba lusakyi rig byed du 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ lus gang du skyes pa'i gnas der mi 'chi bar 'gro ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus byas ni skad cig mar gsungasapas na ltos med du 'jig pa'i phyir ro/ /byas pa la kho (88ba)na re/ 'dus byas skad cig mar gsungs ba ni glog dang / mar me dang / sems byung sogs la dgongs te/ bum pa sogs skad cig gis mi 'jig pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'jig pa la lus kyi sa 'byung gi rgyu tho ba lta bu la ltosadagos pa'i phyir na/ sa 'byung ba'i 'jig rgyu la ltos pa med pa las dngos po 'ga' yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar thal/ bum pa 'jig pa nyis 'byung gi rgyu la ltos pa'i phyir/ byas pa la/ kho na re/ tho ba chos can/ bum pa'i 'jig rgyu yin par thal/ bum pa'i dbyibs dang kha dog gzhan du sgyur ba'i phyir na/ bum pa 'tshos par byed pa'i rgyu de yang bum pa 'jig pa por 'gyur bar thal/ des bum pa kha dog dang dbyibs gzhan du sgyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ lus kyi dbyibs chos can/ rdzas su ma grub ste/khyod kha dog gi rdul btags yad yin pa'i phyir/ byas ba la/ lus kyi dbyibs cho me can/ rdzas su grub par thal/ mig shes kyi gzung bya yin pa'i phyir/ de der thal/ mig gis lus la bltas pa na/zlum po 'di/ gru bzhi 'di snyam pa'i blo skye ba'i phyir zer na/ lus kyi dbyibs de lus shes kyi gzung bya yin par thal/ dbyibs la lus kyis reg pa na/ zlum po 'di'o gru bzhi 'di'o snyam pa'i blo skye ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dbyibs de dbang shes rigs mi mthun gnyis kyi gzung byar 'gyur te/ mig shesadang lus shes gnyis kyi gzung bya yin pa'i phyir/ dbyibs ni rdzas su med de/ kha dog sngon po dbyibs gru bzhi yin pa bcom nas rdul phran du gyur pa'i tshe/ rdul phran la kha dog sngon po yod kyang byid bas gru bzhi med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa (89na)ngag gi rig byed ni/ ngag gi rnam par rig byed ni chos can/khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ ngag gi sgra la 'jog pa'i phyir /—523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogeganyis pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa la/dbye ba/sgrub byed/khyad cho ge dang gsum/dang po ni/rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs chos can/dbye na gsum du yod de/bstan du yod la thogs pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs dang /bstan du med pa la thogs pa dang bcas pa dang /bstan du yang med la thogs pa yang med pa'i gzugs gsum du mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir dang /dri med zag med kyi gzugs gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa sgrub byed ni/rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs chos can/yod de/kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang //mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang //slo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang //yul ga dus su byin pa ni//rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun//zhes pa ltar bdun po de rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs na pa'i phyir/ji skad du rdzas las byung ba'i dngos po bdun dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni/nyal yang rung /'dug kyang rung /bsod nams rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro//zhes dang /rang gis ma byas par srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i las lam 'grub pa yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa khyad chos la/rgyu'i khyad chos/sa'i khyad chos/ngo bo'i khyad chos/rgyu'i khyad chos gzhan bshad pa dang bzhi/dang po ni/'dod par ga rta ges pa'i rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i skad cig dang po phyin chad chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/'das pa'i 'byung ba las skye ba'i phyir/gnyis pa yo ba ni/shes bya chos can/zag pa dang bcas pa'i lusang ga gi las rang gi sa'i 'byung ba dag rgyur byas nas skye ste/'byung ba des de la phan btags pa'i phyir/zag med kyi lusang ga gi las chosacan/rgyu yod de/rang sa gang du skyes pa ste gtogs pa'i 'byung ba las skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/rnam par rig byed ma yin pa chos can/khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ma zin pa dang /rgyu mthun las byung ba dang /sems can du ston pa yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/de chos can rgyu gnyis las 'byung ste/rgyu mthun dang /zin pa'i 'byung ba las skyes pa'i phyir/ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i bsam gto dang zag med kyi sdom pa chos /na/rgyu gnyis las skye ste/ma zin pa'i 'byung ba

chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bzhi pa bshad pa/ 'didang / rgyas pa las byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ skye tshul khyad par can dang ldan te/ 'byung ba rigs tha dad ma yin pa las skyes pa'i phyir/gsum pa de dag la dge sogs gsum du 'jog tshul la/ dngos/ dge sogs gsum gyi dbye ba/ kun slong bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la tshig don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/shes bya chos can/ rnam par rig byed min pa ni lung du bstan pa ma yin pa med de/ de dag dge mi dge gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan rnam par rig byed ni chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa'i phyir/ mi dge ba'i rnam par rig byed ni chos can/ khams gas na med de/ 'dod pa kho na'i sa sa bsdus pa phyir/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs khams na las gnyisayod de/ rnam par rig byed dang / (90na skom par rig byed ma yin pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rnam par rig byed kyi las la/ rtog dpyod dang bcas pa dag ni dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis yod de/ de'i kun slong rtog dpyod gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod pa na yang bsgribs pa'i rnam par rig byed med de/ gang gi phyir na de'i kun slong med pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /dkar nag la sogs bye brag gis/ /las ni rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i las yin na/ las yin pas khyab zer na/ log lta chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ las nag la rnam smin nag pa'i las lam yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ gzugs kyi sa sa bsdus kyi dge ba de las dkar la rnam smin dkar ba'i las lam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod pa'i kyis sa bsdus dge ba de dkar nag 'dres ma'i las yin pa'i phyir/rtsa bar 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ las ma yin la las lam yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/der thal/ brnab sems la sogs las min yang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /'dod pa'i dge ba de dkar nag gnyis ka'i las yin zer na/ dkar nag gnyis ga'i las yin pa srid pa'i chosayin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus/ kha cig /bsam gtan bzhi la chags pa dang bral —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6poba'i sgom lam bar chad med lam dgu po de dkar po zad byed kyi las yin zer na/ dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi dkar po dge ba'i las de/ dkar po zad pa'i las yin par thal/ cig shos de (90ba)yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /gzugs med khams na gzugs yod par thal/ de na de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na/ de yod par thal/ de na zag med kyi sdom pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod dang gzugs skyes lha rnams la/ /bsam gtan skyes yod zag med ni/ /bsam gtan khyad par 'du shes med/ /sems can ma gtogs gzugs med na'ang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /sgra mi snyan pa'i rgyud la dge ba'i las lam bdun mngon gyur du yod par thal/ de la mi dge ba'i las lam bdun mngon gyur du yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de na yid kyi gsum po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yod/ lusang ga gi bdun po mngon gyur du yang yod par bshad pa'i phyir/der thal/ sgra mi snyan na gsum yod de/ /de na bdun pa dngos su yang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na 'gal khyab yin te des de na de bdun pa ngag bkyal yod par bshad kyi de bdun po yod par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig /mi dge ba'i las yin na/ bdag gos su na nges yin pas khyab ste/thams cad bdag po rgyu mthun dang / /rnam smin 'bras bu 'byin par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ de ni bsags la ma sbyangs pa'i srog gcod kyi las lta bu la dgongs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /dgra bcom pa bsad pa'i srog gcod kyi las yin na/ mtshams med kyi las yin pas khyab zer na/ phyir mi 'ong gi rten la 'chi nges pa'i mtshon bsnun pa la brten nas/ dgra bcom pa thob nasasrog chad pa'i srog gcod kyi las chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa'i mtshams med kyi las yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i (91na)phyir/ 'dod na/ gang zag de la dgra bcom pa bsad pa'i mtshams med kyi las thing bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi 'byung bar thal/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa'i mtshams med kyi las yang ba la gsod pa'i sbyor ba de yang dgra bcom pa'i rten la nges par byas pa cig dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bsnun 'og dgra bcom pa —326

chos ma' rin rsā 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas pa shad pa/ (phanal min//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/byas pa la kho na re/de la de 'byung bar thal/de 'dra'i sgog gcod ba po'i dge slong la de 'byung ba'i phyir/der thal/de la dgra bcom pa bsad pa'i srog gcod kyi pham pa 'byung ba'i phyir na ma khyab/der thal/mdo rtsa bar/gnas skabs gzhan thob pa ni gzhan nyid ma yin no//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gzhan yang /khyod kyi dam bca' de mi 'thad par thal/ma ning gi rten la dgra bcom pa bsad na srog gcod kyi las 'byung yang mtshams med kyi las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/der thal/mtshams med gling gsum dag na yod//za ma sogs la mi 'dod do//zhes pa'i sogs khongs na sgra mi snyan pa 'dren rigs pa'i phyir/gzhan yang /ma bsad pa'i srog gcod kyi las yin na/mtshams med kyi las yin dgosapar thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/de yin na/bud med bsad pa'i srog gcod kyi las yin dgos par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/rang gi ma phyis skyes par mtshan 'gyur ba'i skyes ba bsad pa'i las de chos can/der thal/de'i phyir/der thal/de la de 'byung ba'i phyir/der thal/mtshan ni gzhan du gyur kyang 9ba〉gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba'i las yin na/mtshams med kyi las yin dgos par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/de bzhin gshegs pa la brdeg sems tsam gyis khrag phyung ba'i las de chos can/der thal/de'i phyir/'dod na/de bzhin gshegs pa bkrong sems kyis kun nas bslang ste khrag phyung ba'i las yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir//gnyis pa ni/thar pa chos can/don dam pa'i dge ba yin te/sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i 'gog pa yin pa'i phyir/dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum dang /ngo tsha shes ba dang /khrel yod pa chos can/bdag nyid kyi dge ba yin te/dkar po'i ngo bor lung du bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/dge ba de dag dang mtshudas ldan gyi sems byung chos can/mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba yin te/lhungs ldan gyi dbang gisadakar por skyes pa'i phyir/dge bas kun nas bslang ba'i lus kyi bya ba la sogs pa chos can/dge

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pob yin te/ kun slong gi dbang gis dkar po'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir/ thar pa las bzlog pa 'khor ba chos can/ don dam par mi dge ba yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas yin pa'i phyir/ sngar bstan pa'i sosor brtags min gyi 'gog pa dang / 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' dag chos can/ don dam par lung du ma bstan ba yin te/ kun slong dkar nag gang du yang ma bstan pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa la kun slong gi dbye ba dang / mu bzhi'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/las kyi kun slong chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ (92na)rgyu'i kun slong dang ni dus kyi kun slong zhes bya ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis las dang po chos can/ rab tu 'jug byed ces bya ste/ lasargyud nas 'phen pa'i kun slong yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de'i dus kyi kun slong chos can/ rjes su 'jug byed yin te/ las la dngos su 'jug pa'i kun slong yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chosacan/ mu bzhin yod de/ rab tu 'jug byed yin la rjes su 'jug byed ma yin pa'i mu/ gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ rjes 'jug yin la rab tu 'jug byed ma yin pa'i mu/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i rnam shes 'khor dang bcas pa ni rab tu 'jug byed kho na yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ kha nang bltas su nges pa'i lusang ga gi rig byed de'i snga rol du 'byung ba de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba la gnyis ka'i cha yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lusang ga gi rig byed kyi snga rol du byung ba dang / lhan cig tu byung ba sna tshogasayod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ sgo lnga'i dbang shes de rjes su 'jug byed kho na yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de lusang ga gi rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'byung gi snga rol du ma yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sla/shes bya chos can/ rab tu 'jug byed dge mi dge sogs las rjes su 'jug byed kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur te/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ thams cad la der ma nges te/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi kun slong dge ba las dge bar 'dra ba'am/ (92ba)lung ma bstan de las dge ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rnam smin las skyes pa'i sems pa ni rab tu 'jug —528

chos ma' rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gan bzhi pa bshad pa/ (phanabyed dang /rjes su 'jug byedaganyis ka ma yin te/de stobs chung bas de ltar mi nus pa'i phyir/rig byed ma yin pa bye brag tu bshad pa/gnyis pa rig byed ma yin pa bye brag tu bshad pa la/mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/rnam rig ma yin pa'i las chos can/rnam pa gsum du shes par bya ste/sdom pa dang /sdom pa ma yin ba dang /gzhan bar ma gsum du yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/sdom pa khyad par du bshad pa dang /thams cad thun mong du bshad ba gnyis/dang po la/mdor bstan pa/rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/sdom pa chos can/gsum yod de/so sor thar ces bya ba'i sdom pa dang /de bzhin du zag med kyi sdom pa dang /bsam gtan skyesate bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/so thar gyi sdom pa/bsam gtan zag med kyi sdom pa/sdom pa'i rnam grangs ga' na bshad pa dang gsum/dang po la/dbye bsdu/ldan tshul/ngo bo/rnam grangs/sgra bshad/rten gyi gang zag bshad pa dang bdun/dang po la/tshig don dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/dang po ni/so sor thar ces bya ba'i sdom pa chos can/rnam pa brgyad yod de/dge slong pha ma/dge tshul pha ma/dge bsnyen pha ma/dge slob ma/bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/kha cig/so thar gyi sdom pa skye ba'i rten can yin na/gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/93na ) de 'dra'i 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi chos can/der thal/de'i phyir/'dod na/ma yin par thal/dang po ma yin ba gang zhig/phyi mam yin pa'i phyir/dang po ma grub na/gling gsum gyi skyes pa yin pa yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod mi nus so/kha cig/chos ma' pa nas baXd pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gang zag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6geyin na/ spyir tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab zer na/ skyon 'phen pa kha cig na re/ mdo rtsa ba la yang des khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtsa ba'i sdo pa bzhi pa gang rung gcig gi lugs kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag na spyir tshul khrims rnam par dag pas khyab par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ phal chen sde pa'i lugs kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag na/ thams cad yod smra'i lugs kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/phal chen sde pa'i lugs kyi nub lhag par nyal ba'i lhung byed ma byung na/ thams cad yod smra'i lugs kyi nub lhag por nyal ba'i lhung byed ma byung bas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thamasacad yod smra'i lugs la yol bas nub lhag chod par thal/ cig shos la chod pa gang zhig /dam ba po ri 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus/ byas pa la kho na re/ mi tshangs par spyad pa'i dge slong de la phal chen sde pa'i lugs kyi rtsa lhung mi 'byung bar thal/ yol bas mtshams bcad pa la phal chen sdopa'i lugs la nub lhag nyal gyi lhung ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir na ma khyab/ byas pa la kho na re/ khyab par thal/ phal chen sde pa'i lugs la/ dge slong pha la rtsa lhung bzhin grangs(93ba)nges pa gang zhig /mi tshangs spyod rtsa lhung du bgrangs na rtsa ltung lngar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der thal/ chang rtsa lhung du 'dren pa'i phyir zer ba ni/ snga rabs pa mang po zhig la grags kyang / 'gos lo gzhen nu dpal bas/ phal chen sde pa'i rgya dper mi tshangs spyod rtsa ba dang / chang yan lag tu bshad gsungs 'dug pas/ da dung rgya dpe la lta ba'i spobs pa yod na dpyad dgos 'dug go /gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ de dag kyang rdzas su rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa yin te/ dge slong / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen/ bsnyen gnas rnams su 'dus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dge slong pha mtshan gyur pa las dge slong mar ming 'pho ba yin gyi/ de'i tshe sdom pa mi gtong ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/shes bya chos can/ tha dad de dag kyang gang zag gcig gi rgyud la cig car du ldan pa la 'gal ba med de/ de gsum thob byed kyi rgyus thob/ gtong byed kyi rgyus ma btang ba'i gzugs can ngo bo tha dad yin —530

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bzhi pa bshad pa/ 'dipa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ dge bsnyen du 'gyur ba'i dus yod de/ dge bsnyen gyi ched du spang bya srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod log /rdzun smra/ 'bru'i chang lnga spong ba mnos shing khas blangs pa las gang zag de dge bsnyen du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ bsnyen gnas dang / dge tshul dang / dge slong nyid kyi ched du spang bya brgyad dang / bcu dang ni/ lusang ga gi bdun po thamasacad spong ba mnos pa las/ bsnyen gnas dang / dge tshul dang / dge slong nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir/lnga pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa chos can/ tshul khrims dang ni/ legs spyad dang / las dang / sdom pa zhes(94na)sgra bshad par bya ste/ bsil ba'i dngos po yin pa dang / mkhas pas bsngags par bya ba dang / bya ba'i rang bzhin yin pa dang / lus dang ngag gi nyes spyod las sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa skad cig dang po chos can/ rnam pa gnyis su yod de/ rnam par rig byed dang / rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can so sor thar pa dang bya ba'i lam zhes bya ste/ dang po sdom min las thar ma thag pa las lam gyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag de chos can/ khyod la dbye na brgyad yod de/ dge slong nas bsnyen gnas kyi bar brgyad du yod pa'i phyir/smras pa/ yongs 'dzin ded dpon mchog gi bka' drin dang / /so thar sdom pa'i gru rdzings thosabasam gyi/ /mthun pa'i lung gis bskul las myang 'das kyi/ /gtan bde'i rin chen gling du bgrod par rigs/ /nges 'byung chu yis rang rgyud tha ba'i tshogs/ /brlan par ma byas tshul 'chos sgrub ga gis/ shākya'i rnam bzhi'i 'khor gyi gral rings der/ /bsnyegs kyang bong bus gzig lngags gyon pa bzhin/ /khyim pa mgo reg mthong na gad mo bro/ /'dul mngon gzhung lugs mthong na skyid pa skyur/ /khrims ldan dge sbyong mthong na spro ba 'phel/ /chos ldan grogs po mthong na dge la sbyor/ /gro nasabatab pa'i zhing sar so so'i 'bras/ /ma 'dres smin pa ji bzhin dge sdig las/ /bde sdug so sor 'phyung ba'i tshul bsams na/ /mkhas rlom phal cher dred po chos sgyus mkhan/ /'on kyang mi shes rmongs—531 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang gyo mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogedang blo ldan gyi//sdig la lci yang 'byung bar gsung rab las//bshad na thos yi sgom rpā rgan po las//mang thos94ba ) mtshan nyid 'dus sde gu re yangs//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//bsam gtan zag med kyi sdom pa bshad pa/gnyis pa bsam gtan zag med kyi sdom pa bshad pa ni/shes bya chos can/bsam gtan gyi sdom pa yod de/bsam gto gyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gang rung mdzo du gyur pa'i stobasakyis skyes pa'i gzugs can gyi sdom pa de yin pa'i phyir/bsam gtan gyi sdom pa chos can/khyod rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yod de/sngar bshad pa gang rung rgyud la skyes pa la byed pa'i phyir/shes bya chosacan/'phags pa'i sems can de zag med kyi sdom pa dang ldan te/de bden pa mngon rtogs rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag yin ba'i phyir/tha ma bsam gto dang /zag med kyi sdom pa gnyis ni chos can/sems kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin te/sems dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir//gsum pa sdom pa'i rnam grangs gzhan bshad pa ni/shes bya chos can/sdom pa de gnyis bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor skyes shing /mi lcogs med la brten pa'i tshe spong ba'i sdom pa zhes bya ste/de'i tshe de 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang /de'i kun slong 'gog pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/shes bzhin dang ni dran pa dag gnyis chos can/yid dang dbang po'i sdom pa zhes bya ste/lusang ga nyes spyod las sdom pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir//gnyis pa thams cad thun mong du bshad pa la/ldan pa'i tshul/'thob pa'i tshul/gtong ba'i rgyu/ldan pa'i gang zag dang bzhi/dang po la/rig byed ma yin pa'i ldan tshul/rig byed 95na ) kyi ldan tshul/sdom min gyi ming gi rnam grangs/mu bzhi'i sgo nas dogs pa dpyad pa'o//dang po la/sdom pa dang sdom min gyi ldan tshul dang /bar ma'i ldan tshul lo//dang po ni/so thar gyi sdom ba chos ga/ldan tshul khyad par mā dang lda/ pa yin te/so sor thar pa la gnas pa ni thob

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bzhi pa bshad pa/ (phan nas ji srid ma gtang gi bar du rtag tu de ltar gyi rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan sa/skad cig dang po phyin chad 'das pa'i rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/sdom min la gnas pa'i ldan tshul yang yod de/snga ma de dang 'dra ba'i phyir/bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa ni chos can/ldan tshul khyad par can yod de/thob nas ma gtang gi bar du rtag tu 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/'phags pa zag med kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa ni chos can/ldan tshul khyad par can yod de/skad cig ma dang po 'das pa'i rnam par rig byed dang ldan pa ma yin la/g.yin rnams sngar dang mtshudas pa'i phyir/mnyam gzhag 'phags lam gyi sa sa bsdus pa'i bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa de gnyis chos can/ldan tshul khyad par can yod de/da ltar gyi rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/bar ma dge ba yang chos can/ldan tshul yod de/bar ma la gnas pa yod na dang po bar gyi de da ltar gyi rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa'i phyir dang /skad cig ma dang po phyin chad 'das pa dang da ltar gyi dusaganyis ni rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/shes bya cho se can/95bsdom pa min pa la gnas pa dge ba'i rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa dang /sdom pa la gnas pa mi dge ba'i rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa yod de/ji srid de gnyis la gnas bzhin du rab tu dang ba drag pos phyag 'tshal ba dang /nyon mongs shugs drag po'i sgo nas gsod pa dang 'ching ba sogs byed pa'i tshe rim pa bzhin du ldan pa'i phyir//gnyis pa rig byed kyi ldan tshul ni/rnam par rig byed chos can/ldan tshul khyad par can yod de/sdom pa dang sdom pa min pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rig byed ni thams cad byed ba la ma btang bar du da ltar dang ldan zhing /skad cig ma dang po phyin chad 'das ba dang ldan gyi/ma 'ongs pa dang ldan pa ni med pa'i phyir/shes bya cho ge can/bsgribs pa dang ni ma bsgribs pa'i rnam par rig byed ma 'ongs par ma zad/'das pa dag dang yang ldan ༷ med de/de gnyis shin tu stobs chud ba'i phyir/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gegasum pa sdom min gyi rnam grangs ni/shes bya chos can/sdom pa min pa'i rnam grangs gzhag tu yod de/nyes spyad dang /'chal pa'i tshul khrims dang /las dang /de'i lam zhes pa rnams yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa mu bzhi'i sgo nas dogs pa dpyad pa ni/shes bya chos can/rnam par rig byed dang ldan wo /rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang ldan pa yod de/sems zhen pas bar ma dor gnas shing dge mi dge byed pa na/rnam par rig byed nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir/shes bya chos ro/rnam par rig byed ma 96nayin pa dang ldan zhing /rnam par rig byed dang mi ldan pa'ang yod de/rnam par rig byed btang ba dang /de ma skyes pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag rnam par rig byed ma yin pa nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa 'thob pa'i tshul la/rgyu gang la brten pa dang /gzhi gang la brten pa'o//dang po la/bsam gtan zag med kyi sdom pa dang /so thar gyi sdom pa rgyu gang la brten nas 'thob pa gnyis/dang po ni/bsam gtan las skyes pa bsam gtan gyi sdom pa chosacan/'thob tshul yod de/bsam gtan sa drug tu skyes pa nyid kyis 'thob pa'i phyir/zag med kyi sdom pa ni chos can/'thob tshul yod de/'phags pa zag med sa drug tu skyes pa des 'thob pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/spyir bstan pa dang /bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/so sor thar cesabya ba'i sdom pa chos can/gang zag gzhan gyi rnam par rig byed sogs kyis 'thob ste/da ltar gyi chos dang sngon chog sogs la brten nas 'thob pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/dus bsnyen gnas/dge bsnyen/che chung gi/skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten/bslab bya'i khyad par la dpyad pa dang drug/dang po ni/so thar rigs bdun po chos can/len tshul yod de/snga ma rnams tshe ji srid 'tsho dang /bsnyen gnasakyi sdom pa nyin zhag gcig tu yang dag par blang bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/nyin zhag gcig pa'i sdom min ni med de/de de ltar nod pa med ces grags pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/len tshul/bslab bya/len pa'i gang zag la dpyad pa dang gsum/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa de len tshul gyi khyad par bzhi yo/ de/kun spyod kyi khyad par slob dpon las stan

chos ma' rin 'a tshon pa'i shing rta las gnas pa bshad pa/ (pha)dma' bar 'dug cing /rgyan gsar du mi 'dogs pa/len tshul gyi khyad par 96ba ) gzhan gyis smras pa'i rjes zlos byed pa/dus kyi khyad par nam langs nas nyi ma shar gyi bar du/yan lag gi khyad par bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad tshang bar ni nangs par len pa'i yul sdom ldan gzhan las nod par byed dgos pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/rtsa ba bzhi spong ba chos can/tshul khrims kyi yan lag yin te/tshul 'chal gyi dngos gas yin pa'i phyir/myos 'gyur spong ba gcig ni chos can/bag yod pa'i yan lag yin te/bag med kyi dngos gnyen yin pa'i phyir/gar sogs gsum spong ba ni chos can/brtul zhugs kyi yan lag yin te/rim ba bzhin du brtul zhugasang na pa'i dngos gnyen yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/yan lag rnams ma spangs pa skyon du 'gyur te/myos 'gyur 'thung ba de yisabya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i dran pa nyams par 'gyur/dus min gyi zas la longs spyad pas bsnyen gnas kyi dran pa dang /skyo ba'i dran pa nyams par 'gyur/khri stan mthon po dang chen po dang /glu gar/phreng ba rnams la spyad na rgyud dregs pa 'gyur ba'i phyir/gsum pa ni/shes bya chos can/bsnyen gnas 'di dge bsnyen kho na la yod pa ni ma yin te/khyim pa g.yin la'ang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skye ba yod pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/'on kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su ma song ba la ni med de/skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas pa'i sgo nas khas len dgos pa'i phyir/gsum pa dge bsnyen gyi khyad par ni/shes bya chos can/skyabs su song ba tsam gyis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'thob pa ma yin te/dge bsnyen nyid du khas blangs pa las dge bsnyen gyi sdom 97na ) pa 'thob pa'i phyir/'on kyang bslab pa bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/blang dor shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/dper na dge slong gi sdom pa brjod pa bzhin no/shes bya chos can/gal te dge bsnyen thamasacad sdom pas bsdams pa yin na/sna gcig spyod pa dang /phal cher spyod pa sogs kyi dge bsnyen bshad pa ji lta bu snyam pa'i skyon yod pa ni ma yin te/dang por len pa'i tshe dge bsnyen tsam du khasablangs nas phyis spang bya de dag bsrung ba la/sna kaṇi ga spyod ba sogs su gsungs zhes grags pa'i phyir/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebazhi pa ni/shes bya chos can/sdom pa de la chung 'bring chen po gsum yod de/len 'dod kyi kun slong de la chung ngu dang la sogs pa 'bring dang /chen po'i yid gsum yod pa ji lta ba bzhin du sdom pa skye ba'i phyir/lnga pa ni/gang zag gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba de chosacan/khyod kyi skyabs yul yod de/sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos mi slob pa dang /dge 'dun du byed pa'i chos slob mi slob gnyis ka dang /chos su byed pa'i chos mya ngan las 'das pa la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyir/gzugs phung ni zag bcas yin pas sangs rgyas dkon mchog ma yin yang sangs rgyas su 'dod de/'grel pa las/sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos zhes 'byung ste/de'i phyir rten sangs rgyas nyid du ma bkag pas de ni klan skar mi rung ba nyid
