de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/'jig rten pa'i lam gyis thob pa'i phyir 'ong dang /phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu/dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bur mi rung ba'i skyon med de/'jig rten pa yi lam gyis thob pa'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu ni mthong lam gyis thob pa'i spangs pa dang /sgom lam gyis thob pa'i spangs par bsres pa dang /zag med kyi thob pa yang 'dzin pa'i phyir/gong du bshad pa'i dge sbyong tshul de nyid chos can/tshangs pa'i tshul zhes bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/nyon mongs spong pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/tshangs pa yi 'khor lo chos can/skor ba po yod de/tshangs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bskor ba'i phyir/mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad cho me can/chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/der thal/rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che la rten par byed pa'i lte ba/150ba da cing myur bar 'gro ba'i mu khyud/gcod par byed pa'i rtsibs gsum dang ldan pa ltar/'phags lam yan lag brgyad po de bsdu na bslab pa gsum du 'du zhing /de rnams snga ma gsum dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/bzhi pa 'thob tshul ni/// bya chos can/'dod par dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gebu gsum 'thob ste/der rgyun zhugs/phyir 'ong /phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu gsum 'thob pa'i phyir/tha ma dgra bcom pa'i gos bu ni khams gsum du 'gro ba ste/'dod gzugs/gzugs med rnams su 'thob pa'i phyir/sngar bshad pa gsum po de rnams khams gong mar mi 'thob ste/de na de'i rten la mthong lam gsar skye med pa'i phyir/der thal/gzugs med khams na 'chad nyan med/gzugs khams na skyo shas mi skye ba'i phyir dang /mdo las kyang bar ma dor yongs su mya ga las 'da' ba nas gong du 'pho ba'i bar gang zlag lnga ni 'dir rtsom zhing de mthar phyin par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/smras pa/lam gyi bgrod tshul 'khrul med ston mkhas pa'i//yongs 'dzin ded dpon drin lasamyang 'das kyi//rin chen gling du bgrod pa'i go rim 'gros//ma nor ston pa dbyig gnyen mkhas pa'i lugs//mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub bo zhes//rang sde'i grub mtha' smra ba 'ga' 'dod kyang //thob bya mthar thug dgra bcom rnam gsum gyi//go 'phang yin phyir lugs 'dir gsal bar 'chad//ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi dbye ba sogs bshad pa/gsum pa dgra bcom 151na gos gnas kyi dbye ba la/mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas drug tu dbye/'bras bu nyams pa yod med la dpyad/dbang po 'pho tshul/dgra bcom pa dgur yod tshul dang bzhi/dang po ni/dgra bcom pa la drug tu 'dod de/yongs su nyams pa'i chos can/bdag gsod pa'i chos can/gnas pa las mi bskyod pa'i chos can/rtogs pa'i skal ba can gyi cho ge can/rjes su srung ba'i chos can/mi g.yo ba'i chos can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/drug po de dag las/dang po lnga ni chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/dad pas mos pa las skyes pa'i phyir/lnga po de dag chos can/rnam grol dus dang sbyor ba zer ba'i rgyu mas yod de/myang 'das maX8 du byed pa la yo byad dang /nad med pa dang /yul

chos ma' rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gan drug pa bzhad pa/ (pha)khyad par can la ltos dgos pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom mi g.yo ba'i chos can chos can/ mi g.yo ba zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbang po mi g.yo ba ste mi nyams pa'i dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chosacan/ dus mi sbyor bar rnam par grol ba zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbang po mi g.yo ba'i dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rgyu yod de/ mthong bas thob pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ dgra bcoyopa de dag la'ang rigs gnyis su yod de/ kha cig dang po nas de'i rigs dang / kha cig sbyangs pa'i yon tan las mi g.yo bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dgra bcom pa dang po lnga la nyams par 'gyur ba yod de/ nyams pa'i chos can ma gtogs pa bzhi ni rigs las nyams par 'gyur/ lnga ga gos bu las nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rang (151bsko dang por 'bras bu gang thob pa lasanyams par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ de ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis kyisabartan par byas pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom par ma zad/ nyan thos slob pa dang 'phags pa ma yin pa sososkye bo'ang rigs drug dang ldan pa yod de/ nyams pa'i chos can nas mi g.yo ba'i bar gyi de ldan yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam la gnas pa la ni de la gnas bzhin du dbang po 'pho ba med de/ de ni shin tu yun thung ba'i phyir/ yon tan las yongs su nyams pa la rnam pa gsum du shes par bya ste/ yon tan thob pa las nyams pa dang / ma thob pa las nyams pa dang thob bya mngon du mi byed pas nyer spyad lasanyams pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ ston pa sangs rgyas la nyams pa gcig yod de/ tha ma nyer spyad las nyams pa yod pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom mi g.yo ba'i chos can la nyams pa gnyis yod de/ nyer spyad las nyams pa dang / bar ma ma thob pa las kyang nyams pa yod pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom g.yin la nyams tshul yod de/ de de yi rnam pa gsum ga yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar nyams pas dgra bcom 'khor bar skye ba'i skyon med de/ de ni 'bras bu las nyams pa sor ma chud kyi bar du 'chi ba med cing /'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i bya ba ma yin pa de mi byed pa'i phyir/ dper na rtsal po che 'dred kyang 'gyel bub mi 'ong ba bzhin no/ /—619

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 67) gsum pa dbang po 'pho tshul ni/ rtogs pa'i skal pa can mi g.yo bar dbang po 'pho ba la/rnam grol lam dang bar chad med lam dgu la brten dgos te/ de sngar dbang po rtul po'i rigs shin tu bsten pa'i phyir ro/ /dad pa dang mos pa mthong bas thob par dbang po 'pho ba la/ bar (152na)chad med lam dang / rnam grol lam du ma brten mi dgos te/ de gnyis re re nas 'pho nus pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa'i gang zag dbang po 'pho ba'i lam yod de/ zag med kyi lam la brten nas 'pho ba'i phyir/ dbang po 'pho ba'i rten yod de/ mi'i nang du dbang po 'phel zhing 'pho ba'i phyir/ mi slob pa dbang bo 'pho ba la zag med sa dgu la brten te/ bsam gtan sa drug dang gzugs med dang po gsum la brten dgos pa'i phyir/ slob pa dbang po 'pho ba na sa drug la brten dgos te/ bsam gtan sa drug la brten dgos pa'i phyir/ dbang po 'pho ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang gi phyir na dbang rtul gyi dbang po 'phel bas 'bras bu khyad par can btang ste/ dbang rnon gyi 'bras bu phyi ma thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ dgra bcom pa la dbang po'i sgo nas dgur yod de/ rang sangs rgyas dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis dang / nyan thos bdun dang dgur yod pa'i phyir/ dgu po de chos can/ dbang po rnam pa dgu dbye ba can yin te/ dbang bo rnon po'i rnon po nas rtul po'i rtul po'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi gang zag bdun po de dag sbyor ba dang / dbang po dang / snyomasa'ajug dang / rnam par grol ba bzhi gas rdzogs par byas pa yin te/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / chosakyi rjes 'brang gnyis ni sbyor bas rdzogs/ dad mos pa dang mthong thob gnyis ni dbang po dang / lusamangon byed stoms 'jug gis rdzogs/ shes rab kyis rnam grol ni nyon mongs las rnam par grol bas dang / gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba snyoms 'jug dang / shes rab gnyis kas rdzogasapar byas pa' phyir/ gsum pa gang zag gi (152ba)rigs bsdu ba ni/ nyan thos bdun po de dag kyang chos can/ bsdu na drug tu 'du ste/ 'di ltar/ mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum la gang zag gnyis gnyisa'ajog pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'dug thob pa'i dgra bcom pa chos can/ nyon mongs pa dang snyoms—620—

chos ma rga rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas drug pa bshad pa/ (pha)'jug gi sgrib pa gnyis ka las rnam par grol te/ de gnyis spangs pa'i phyir/ shes rab rkyang pas rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom pa chos can/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las ma grol te/ khyod kyis ni cig shos nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam bcom pa'i phyir/zhan la yan lag gi rdzogs tshul ni/ shes bya chos can/ slob pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i chos gsum yod de/ snyoms 'dug dang / dbang po dang / gos bu rnams kyis yongs su rdzogs par shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ rdzogs tshul yod de/ phyir mi 'ong dad mos pa lus mdzo byed ma yin pa ni gos bu kho nas rdzogs/ yin pa ni 'bras bu dang snyoms 'dun gnyis kyis rdzogs/ mthong thob pa lus ma' byed ni/ de gsum gas rdzogs pa'i phyir/ chos gnyis kyis mi slob pa yongs su rdzogs te/dbang po dang snyoms 'dug gnyis kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/lam gyi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa/gsum pa lam gyi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa la/ lam gyi dbye ba spyir bstan/ byang chub phyogasamathun bye brag tu bshad pa/ lam gyi thob pa'i rnam grol lam ngos gzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/shes bya chos can/ mdor na 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i lam ni rnam pa bzhi yod de/ khyad par gyi lam dang / rnam grol gyi lam dang / bar chad med pa'i lam dang / sbyor ba'i (153na)lam zhes bya ba rnams yod pa'i phyir/ yang na lam de la dka' ba dang / sla ba'i lam gnyis yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dag la brten pa'i lam rnams sla zhing sa g.yin nyer bsdogs dang gzugs med dag la brten pa'i lam rnams dka' ba yin pa'i phyir/ yang lam de la mngon par shes pa bul pa dang myur ba gnyis su yod de/ blo ste dbang po rtul po'i lam rnams mngon shes bul ba/ gcig shos dbang rnon gyi lam rnams ma rga shes myur ba yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mu bzhi yod de/ sla ba la myur bul gnyis—621 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'dang / dka' ba la myur bul gnyis yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ sgra bshad dbye ba dang bcas pa/ lam gang du 'thob pa/ sa gang la brten nasa'athob pa/ shes nas dad pa 'thob pa'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes chos can/ byang chub ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang lam gyi bslab bya rdzogs pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ sdo tshan bdun gyi sum cu rtsa bdun chos can/ byang chub de'i phyogs mas yin te/ de dang mthun pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ de yang ming gi sgo nas sum cu rtsa bdun yod cing / rjes su na bas 'dus te/ dad pa dang / brtson tsos dang / dran pa dang / shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /btang snyoms dang / dga' ba dang / rtog pa dang / tshul khrims dang / shin tu sbyangs pa rnams su 'dus pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'dus te/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi ni shes rab kyis bsdus/ yang dag spong ba sgo gsum/ yang dag 'jog ces bya ba ni brtson 'grus kyis bsdus/ rdzu phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni ting nge 'dzin (153ba)gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ sde tshan gsum shes rab dang brtson 'grus dang ting nge 'dzin yin zhes bshad pa ni gtso bo smos pa la dgos pa yod de/ sbyor byung gi yon tan kun kyang bsdus par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yon tan sde tshan bdun gyi go rim nges te/ rim pa bzhin du las dang po la tsho gos la ma gyi skabs su dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi dag dang / nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi la rim bzhin yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu snyul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga rnamasadang ni/ sgom lam la byang chub yan lag bdun/ mthong lam la 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rab tu phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang 'phags lam gyi yan lag chos can/ zag pa med pa yin te/ lam gyi bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag sogs chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ zag bcas dang zag med gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po na byang phyogs so bdun po thams cad kyi rigs yod de/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas byang chub yan lag gi bar yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med na sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ de na dga' ba —622

chos mngon rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas drug pa bshad pa/ (pha)yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ma gtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa ma gtags pa yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa dang bzhi pa na sum cu rtsa lnga yod de/ dga' ba dang rtog pa de gnyis ma to rtag gsab gzhan rnams de gnyis na yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs gzhan rnams dang bsam gtan bar khyad par can la'ang sum cu rtsa lnga yod de/ sngar gyi de gnyis ma gags pa yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med dang po gsum na'ang sum cu (154na cu gnyis yod de/ sngar gyi gnyis po de dang tshul khrims kyi yan lag dag dang las kyi mtha' dang / 'tshe ba ma gtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa khams dang srid rtse na nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ de gnyis na byang chub yan lag dang ni 'phags lam yan lag ma gtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa shes nas dad pa 'thob pa'i tshul ni/ bden pa dang po gsum mngon sum du mthong na tshul khrims dang chos la shes nas dad pa 'thob pa yin te/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam gyi bden pa mngon par rtogs pa na sangs rgyas dang de'i dge 'dun dag la yang shes nasadad pa 'thob ste/ de la mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ dmigs yul gyi chos chos can/ du ma yod de/ bden pa dang po gsum dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnams su yod pa yin pa'i phyir/ shes nas dad pa thob pa chos can/ rjes su bsdu na gnyis su 'du ste/dad pa dang tshul khrims dri med kyi zag pa med pa gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir/gsum pa lam gyi thob pa'i rnam grol la/ rnam grol lam gyi dbye ba spyir bstan/ rnam grol lam 'thob tshul/ 'dus ma byas rnam grol bye brag tu bshad pa/ yid 'byung dang khyad par gyi chagasabral dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ slob pa'i yan lag tu rnam grol ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ slob pa ni nyon mongs pas bcings pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ nyen mongs bcom pa 'dus ma byas kyi rnam grol dang / mos pa 'dus byas kyi rnam grol lam dang gnyisayod pa'i phyir/ (154baṣṭha khyus byas rnam grol lam de chos can/ mi slob pa'i yan lag yin te/ de'i —623

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pomadzo rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid chos can/ rnam grol lam gnyis yod de/ sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems gang rnam par grol ba dang / lam gang gi stobs kyis rnam par grol ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang chub tu ji skad bshad pa'i shes pa mi slob pa'i sems ni chos can/ rnam par grol bar 'gyur te/ sgrib pa skye 'gyur ma 'ongs pa las grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gag par 'gyur ba dang / da ltar ba'i lam ni chosacan/ sgrib pa rab tu spong ste/ ngo skal gyi sgrib pa 'joms pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'dus ma byas rnam grol bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ khams de la gsum yod de/ 'dus ma byas nyid 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya ba dang / 'dod chags kun zad pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams dang / de de las gzhan nyon mongs spangs pa'i khams dag yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i khams zhes bya ba chos can/ bzhi yod de/ sdug bsngal mthong spang spangs pa nas/ lam mthong spang spangs pa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ sdug bsngal la chos bzod dang shes pa dang / rgyu kun 'byung la chos bzod dang shes pa rnams kyis 'khor ba las yid 'byung bar 'gyur te/ des zag bcas kyi dngos po la skyon du lta ba'i phyir/ shes bzod gang gis ngo skal gyi sgrib pa spong bar 'gyur ba kun gyis 'dod chags dang 'bral bar 'gyur te/ bral ba'i thob pa 'dren pa'i phyir/ de lta na ni/ mngon rtogs de la yid 'byung la sgrib pa mi spong / de'i cig shos/ gnyis (155na)ga yin min te mu bzhi srid de/ sdug kun gyi shes pa bzhi ni yid 'byung ba'i lam yin la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam ma yin pa'i mu/ sdug kun gyi bzod pa bzhi ni gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ 'gog lam gyi bzod pa bzhi ni/ chags bral gyi lam yin la/ yid 'byung ba'i lam ma yin pa'i mu/ 'gog lam gyi shes pa bzhi ni/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ cho so mngone pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ gnas drug pa zhes bya ba gtan la phab pa yin te/ lam dang gang zag mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i phyir/ smras pa/ gang zhig spang bya'i rnyog pa kun bsal bas/ /thob bya'i lam gyi rdzing bu rnam par —624

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas drug pa bshad pa/ (phanadwangs//ye shes gzugs brnyan stong phrag 'char ba yi//yang dag bgrod pa'i go rim ma nor mdzes//dkar 'jam chu 'dzin bu mo'i phang ba nas//chal chil g.yo ba'i char rgyun babs pa na//zhing pa'i snying la dga' ba cher skyed na//thar pa 'dod rnams tshul 'dir cis mi dga'//cung zad sems kyi gnasacha rnyed pa la//sal ma mthon por bgrod pa'i khur 'byer na//srid rtse'i bar du phyin nas phyir log pa'i//mu stegs byed la sangs rgyas zer ram ci//gzhung lugs 'di 'drar bshad pa'i lam gyi 'gros//cung zad bshad pa'i dge tsho gos ji snyed kyis//grangs med 'gro rnams log pa'i lam spangs te//theg gsum mi slob go 'phang thob gyur cig/chos mdzo pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa/chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/155ba ngonas drug pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod ji snyed pa bshad zin to// 62

gnas bdun pa ye shes bstan pa/grangs med shes bya'i phung po ma lus pa//blo gros shing rta gcig gis 'dren pa la//ma smad snying stobs bzang po'i gyad kyi rigs//grags pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje//rje btsun mchog de'i bstan pa dri ma med//bsre bslad ming bsgyur spangs te 'chad rtsod kyi//dga' ldan pa zhesa'akhrul med grub pa'i mtha'//'dzin mkhas 'jam mgon da rka zhe mchog chos 'phel zhes//dka' gnad rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'chad pa'i tshe//smra mkhasang ga gi dbang por 'gran bzod de'i/khrin las snyom las bdag 'dra'i spobs pas kyang //gzhung lugs 'di 'dra 'chad pa'i khur chen blangs//mkhas par bya ba'i yon tan ma lus pa//gcig tu gtan la 'bebs pa'i ye shes kyi//tshul rnamasa'aphags yul mkhas pa'i gsung sgros ltar//gsal bar 'chad do sgra 'dzin dbang po nyon/gnyis pa de ltar mkhas par byas pa'i yon tan gtan la dbab pa la/shes pa'i yon to gtan la dbab pa dang /snyoms 'asdug gi yon tan gtan la dbab pa gnyis/dang po la/ye shes kyi rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa/ldan tshul/'thob pa'i tshul/khyad par gyi chos dang bzhi/dang po la/bzod shes lta ba'i khyad par/shes pa bcu ngos gzung /de dag gi khyad chos dang gsum/dang po ni/dri med zag med kyi bzod pa rnams chos can/shes bzod gnyis kyi nang nas shes pa min te/ngo la gyi spang bya the tshom ma spangs pa'i phyir/lta ba yin te/yang dag par rtog pa'i bdag nyid ༅ yin pa'i 156na thar/zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blo chos can/lta ba ma yin te/yang dag par rtog pa med pa'i phyir/de las gzhan pa'i 'phags pa'i blo chos can/de gnyis/yin te/yul la des rtog pa'i ye shes pa yin pa'i phyir/zag med las ga' na pa'i 'jig rten pa'i shes rab rnams shes pa yin te/kun rdzob shes pa'i 'jig tsho gis la lta ༷ /gas lnga dang 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i ltab

chos ma' rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa gad pa/ (phanaste drug ni chos can/lta ba'ang yin te/yang dag par rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/mdor bstan pa/rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/shes pa de laganyisayod de/zag bcas dang /zag pa med pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/spyi bstan pa dang /bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/de chos can/kun rdzob shes pa zhes bya ste/bum snam sogs kun rdzob la dmigs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/shes pa zag med chos can/rnam pa gnyis yod de/chos shesapa dang ni rjes su shes pa kho nar yod pa dang 'gog lam yin pa'i phyir/kun rdzob shes pa chos can/yul la dmigs pa yin te/'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos de thams cad la dmigs pa'i phyir/chos shes pa zhes bya ba'i blo chos can/spyod yul ni yod de/'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la sogasapa kun 'byung dang 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/pha rol sems shes dang zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis/dang po ni/rjes su shes pa chos can/khyod kyi spyod yul yod de/khamasagong ma'i sdug bsngal dang sogs pas kun 'byung dang 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i phyir/chos shesadang rjes shes de dag nyid ni bden pa la dmigs pa'i bye brag 156bgis bzhi bzhi yod de/sdug bsngal shes pa nas lam shes pa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/bden pa shes pa rnam pa bzhi po de dag ni chos can/mi skye ba dang zad pa shes pa zhes bya ste/rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya mi skye ba dang /nyon mongasa'agags pa shes pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/dang por skyes pa'i zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes de ni chos can/sdug bsngal dang rgyu kun 'byung la rjes su shes pa zhes bshad de/srid rtse/sdug kun gang rung la rjesasu zhugs pa'i rnam pas dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/pha rol po'i sems rig pa'i shes pa da ltar ba ni chos can/bzhi las nga ste/chos shes dang /rjes shes/lam shes pa dang /kun rdzob shes pa las byung ba'i phyir/des ni chos༅/chos kun rig pa ma yin te/sa dang /dbang po dang /gang zag dang /zhig pa 'das pa dang /ma ra ma 'ongs pa rnams mi rig pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/chosashes rjes shes kyi blo yi phyogs dang mthun pa ni ༷/7 tshun gcig gis gcig spyod yul du byed pa min

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pote/ snga ma ni 'dod pa dang / phyi ma ni khams gong kho na la dmigs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi pha rol gyi sems shes kyis mthong lam skad cig ma gnyis rig ste/ sdug bsngal la chos shes dang chos bzod gnyis rig pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal bse ru lta bus pha rol sems shes kyis mthong lam skad cig ma gsum rig ste/ snga ma gnyis dang kun 'byung la rjes shes rig pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyis da rtsol gyi sbyor ba med par mthong lam skad cig ma kun rig ste/ des chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa'i blo gnyis la khyad (157na ngor yod de/snga mas ni sdug bsngal ba yongs su shes/ la sogs pa kun 'byung spangs shing 'gog pa mngon du byas lam bsgoms so zhes nges pa'i cha nas bzhag /sdug bsngal yongs su shes te shes par byar med/kun 'byung sogs la yang des mtshon pa'i cha nas mi skye ba shes pa'i blor 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa khyad chos la/ shes pa bcur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyen po'i khyad par/ rnam pa'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ shes pa de la bcur yod de/ rang bzhin las ni kun rdzob shesapa dang / gnyen po las chos shes rjes shes dang / rnam pa las sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung shes pa dang / rnam pa dang spyod yul gnyis ka las 'gog pa dang / lam shes dang / sbyor ba las pha rol gyi sems shes dang / bya ba byas pa nyid las zad pa shes pa dang / rgyu rgyas pa las mi skye ba shes pa rnamasayod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam la 'gog pa 'am lam la chos shes pa gang yin pa chosacan/ khams gong kho na la ma dmigs te/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs gzugs med kyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ rjes shes chos can/ khyod kyis 'dod khams kyi gnyen po byed pa yod pa ma yin te/ de la chags pa dang bral ba'i rjes su skyes pa'i phyir/gsum pa la/ shes pa so so'i rnam pa'i ngo bo/ rnam pa'i grangs nges/ de dag gi khyad par/chos gas bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ chos shes pa dang rjes su shes pa chos can/ rnam pa khyad par can dang ldan pa yin te/ mi rtag sogs rnam pa bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob —628—

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa bshad pa/ (phanashes pa ni chos can/ rnam pa (157ba gnyis dang ldan te/ sngon ma de bzhin du dmigs la/ de lasagazhan du yang chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ bden pa bzhi shes pa chos can/rnam pa khyad par can dang ldan te/ rang rang gi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi bzhi yod de/ sdug bden la mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med bzhi sogasayod pa'i phyir/ pha rol yid shes dri med kyang chos can/ ldan te/ snga ma de bzhin du lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ pha rol sems shes dri ma dang bcas pa ni chos can/ rnam pa khyad par can dang ldan te/ sems sems byung la sogs pa'i shes bya rang rang gi mtshan nyid la dmigs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems sems byung gi rdzas re re zhig kho na spyod yul du byed pa'i phyir/ shes pa de dag gi lhag ma zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes cho se can/ rnam pa bcu bzhi la dmigs pa can yin te/stong ba dang bdag med pa ma gtogs pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kha che bye brag smra ba rnams ni bden pa'i rnam pa dri ma med pa de la bcu drug tu grangs nges te/ gzhan zag med kyi rnam pa med pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan nyi 'og pa na re/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa yod ces smra ste/ bstan bcos las rigs pas skye ba'i sgo nas mi rtag pa la sogs pa shes pa 'di ni gnas yod do/ 'di ni gzhi yod do/ zhes khrung bas/ snga ma mtshan nyid dang / phyi ma rgyu ste/ de lta bu'i rnam pa yod pa'i phyir zer ro/ /bden pa'i rnam pa de la rdzas su ni rnam pa bcu drug yod de/ de dag shes rab kyis so sor mngon du byed dgos pa'i (158na8ra/ gsum pa ni/ rnam pa 'dzin par byed pa yod de/ shes rab dang bcas pa'i blo dmigs pa dang bcas pas 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir/ gzung bya yod de/ shes bya gzhi lnga thams cad shes rab kyis gzung bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa la/ ngo bo/ rten gyi khyad par/ dran pa nyer gzhag gi khyad par/ dmigs pa'i khyad par dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob shes pa chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan dgu po rnams chos can/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis—629

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gemed de/dge ba kho na yod pa'i phyir//gnyis pa la/sems kyi rten dang /lus kyi rten gnyis/dang po ni/dang po kun rdzob shes pa chos can/sa khyad par dang ldan te/sa rnams thams na yod pa'i phyir/sa drug na yod de/bsam gto sa drug na yod pa'i phyir/rjes shes bya ba chos can/sal brten tshul yod de/zag med sa dgu na yod pa'i phyir/de bzhin du bden bzhi shes pa dang /zad mi skye shes pa ste drug po yang chos can/yod de/dgu na yod pa'i phyir/gzhan yid shes pa chos can/yod de/bsam gto bzhi kho na na yod pa'i phyir//gnyis pa ni/sems shes pa de ni chos can/rten yod de/'dod pa dang gzugs kyi rten ༅ yin pa'i phyir/chos shes pa zhes bya ba chos ro/yod de/'dod pa'i rten can yin pa'i phyir/de gnyis las/shes pa gas brgyad chos can/yod de/khamasagasum pa'i rten can yin pa'i phyir//gsum pa ni/'gog pa 154thas pa'i blo chos can/dran pa nyer gzhag dang bcas te/chos dran pa nyer gzhag gcig pu yod pa'i phyir/pha rol sems shes pa'i blo ni chos can/de ltar bcas te/lus ma gtogos pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag gsum yod pa'i phyir/lhag ma brgyad chos can/dran pa nyer gzhag dang bcas te/de bzhi ga yod pa'i phyir//bzhi pa la/shes ba nang phan oṃ yul du gyur pa'i tshul/chos bstodang yul yul can du sbyar ba/chos gang rig pa'i tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/chos blo chos mā/khyod kyi spyod yul du shes pa dgu yod de/rjes shes ma ga rta gos yod pa'i phyir/lam shes pa dang rjes shes blo'i spyod yul du shesab dgu yod de/snga ma la kun rdzob shes pa ma gtagos pa dang /phyi ma la chos shes ma ga rta gesayod pa'i phyir/sdug bsngal dang rgyu kun 'byung shes pa'i blo'i yul chos can/gnyis yod de/kun rdzob dang sems shes pa zag 4sa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/kun rdzob dang /sems dang /zad mi skye shes pa bzhi'i dmigs pa bcu yin zhing /'gog shes gcig pu dmigs pa ni shes pa min te/des 'gog pa kho na yul du byed pa'i phyir//gnyis pa ni/shes pa bcu dang chos bcu dag ni chos can/sbyor tshul yod de/yul yul can du sbyar bar bya ༷ /na pa'i phyir/

chos ma' rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gan bdun pa ༅da pa/ (phanagasum pa ni/chos bcu yod de/khams gsum pa'i chos dang /dri ma med pa'i chos bzhi la mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis su phye bas brgyad/'dus ma byas rnams la dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis su phye bas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu rang gi ngo bo dang tshogs rnams mi 'dzin te/rang nyid la byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir dang shin tu nye ba'i phyir/de lasagazhan pa'i chos rnams ni des rig cing rig tshul yod de/bdag med 159na ) pa nyid do zhes rig par 'gyur ba'i phyir/gnyis pa ldan tshul ni/zag med skad cig dang po la gnas pa'i 'phags pa chags can sdug bsngal chos bzod pa ni shes pa gcig dang ldan te kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu kho na dang ldan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa sdug bsngal chos shes kyi bzod pa la ni chos can/shes pa gsum dang ldan te/kun rdzob/chos/sdug bsngal shes pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/de yan chad kyi shes pa ni chos can/ldan tshul yod de/skad cig ma bzhi ga la re re 'phos pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/'thob tshul bshad pa/ gsum pa 'thob tshul la/mthong lam 'thob tshul/lam gzhan 'thob tshul/shes pa gzhan 'thob tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/shes bya chos༅/'thob tshul yod de/mthong lam la bzod pa brgyad/shes pa bdun ji ltar ra rnams dang /rnam pa wa ba'i ma 'ongs pa kho na thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/der ma zad mthong lam de nyid la lam ma gtogos pa'i rjes shes gsum ni kun rdzob shesapa nyid kyang thob pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod la mngon rtogs mtha' las byung ba'i shes ba zhes bya ste/bden pa re re mngon par rtogs pa'i rjes la thob pa'i shes pa yin pa de'i phyir/mtha' las byung ba'i shes pa de ni chos can/mi skye ba'i chos can zhes bya ste/snyed pa las thob pa tsam skyes pa'i phyir/mthong lam gyi sa du ma'i kun rdzob shes pa 'thoX ste/rang sa dang 'og sa'i kun rdzob shes pa 'thob

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logepa'i phyir/ de dag dran pa nyer gzhag dang gcig yin zhe na/ 'gog pa shes pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa ni chos dran pa nyer bzhag dang / g.yin gnyis dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi gang yin la de gsum ga'i rnam pa dang dmigs pa yod de/ de gsum rang sa'i bden pa gang mngon par rtogs pas thob pa'i bden pa de'i rnam pa dang dmigs pa can yin pa'i phyir/ (159ba8 chos can/ skyesathob ma yin te/ 'bad pa'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i chags pa dang bcasapa'i bcu drug pa lam rjes shes chos can/ shes pa drug ma 'ongs pa 'thob ste/ chos shes dang / rjesashes/ bden bzhi shes pa ma 'ongs pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba dag chosacan/ shes pa bdun 'thob ste/ snga ma drug gi steng du sems shes pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po de'i gong ma 'dod pa'i chags bcas bar chad med lam dgu pa yan chad kyi sgom pa'i lam la chos can/shes pa bdun 'thob ste/ sems shes pa dang / zad mi skye shes pa gsum ma gtogs pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med dang po gsum gyi sa ste bdun las 'dod chags dang bral zhing rgyal ba'i slob lam mngon shes lnga dang / rtogs pa'i skal pa can mi g.yo ba 'thob pa'i bar chad med lam dang / bsam gtan spel te sgom pa'i bar chad med lam dag la shes pa bdun 'thob pa dang / sa bdun gyi gong ma srid rtse las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i grol ba'i lam dang po brgyad la'ang bdun 'thob ste/ chos shes rjes shes bden bzhi shes pa sems shes rnams 'thob pa'i phyir/slob pa chags bcas dbang po sbyong ba'i grol ba'i lam la shes pa drug dang / chags bral la pha rol sems shes bsnan te bdun 'thob ste/ dang pos chos shes rjes shes bden bzhi shes pa rnams 'thob/phyi mas sems shes kyang 'thob pa'i phyir 'am zhes smos pa la dgos pa yod de/ kha cig de gnyis kasakun rdzob shes pa'ang 'thob bo zhes zer ba'i lugs tha dad pa bsdu ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ /slob pa dbang po spong ba'i bar chad med lam 'thob tshul yod de/ snga ma ltar drug 'thob pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gzhan yang yod de/ srid rtse'i 'dod chags las rnam (160na)par rgyal ba'i bar chad med lam —632

chos mdzo rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa bshad pa/ (pha)la'ang sngar ltar 'thob pa'i phyir/ srid rtse las 'dod chags dang bral ba rnam grol lam dgu pa zad pa shes pa la chos can/ shes pa dgu 'thob ste/ mi skye ba shes pa ma gtogs 'thob pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba shes pas ni chos can/ shes pa thams cad 'thob ste/ shes pa bcu ga 'thob pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba der 'pho ba'i grol ba'i lam tha ma'ang chos can/ rtags gsal sngar ltar/ bshad pa'i lhag ma rnamasal zad mi skye shes pa ma gtogs brgyad ma 'ongs pa 'thob ste/ 'dod pa la chags bral gyi lam dgu dang / sa bdun las 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / mngon shes dang po gsum dang / spel sgom gyi rnam grol lam dang / mi g.yo ba rtogs byed rnam grol lam dang po brgyad/ 'dod chags bral ba'i sbyor ba dang / khyad par gyi lam thams cad la de ltar 'thob pa'i phyir/gsum pa shes pa gzhan 'thob tshul ni/ sa gang las 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir du lam la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis gang zag gang gis thob pa der yang sa kho na 'thob par ma zad de/ 'og ma'i zag med kyi shes pa'ang 'thob pa'i phyir/ zad pa shes pa chos can/zag med tsam 'thob pa ma yin te/ zag bcas mi sdug pa sogs dang dran pa nyer gzhag sogs kyang 'thob pa'i phyir/ 'thob tshul yod de/ sa kun gyi sngon med kyi rnyed pa 'thob kyi/ rnyed zin pa ma 'thob pa'i phyir/ 'thob pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ rnyed pa/ bsten pa/ gnyen po/ thag bsring ba'i 'thob pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ sngar med gsar du rnyed pa de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ (160brda skad cig gnyis pa phan chad dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ spang bya spong bzhin pa'i gnas skabs kyi thob pa de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ spang bya las grol ba'i gnasaskabs kyi thob pa de yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ bzhi po'i khyad par yod de/ sngon ma gnyis ni dge ba 'dus byas thob pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos kyi thob pa yin pa'i phyir/smras pa/ 'dir na thabs mkhas rtsi yi byed po yis/ /lcags kun gser du sgyur ba ji bzhin du/ /blang dang dor bya'i tshul la ma rmongs na/ /so so skye bo dgra bcom pa la dbang / /gang zhig thob na —633

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtoge'akhor ba'i duḥkha las//'jigs bral theg pa gsum gyi mi slob pa//yod kyang skyon zad yon tan kun ldan pa//sangs rgyas lhag gcig yin phyir de ṣka mchog/ma 'dres chos dang stobs bsto mi 'jigasasogs//rgyal ba'i yon to ma lus 'dir bshad tshe//snya 'gyur dri za'i rgyud kyi pi wang yang //brjod bya'i don gyis stong phyir gus pa lhod/zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//khyad par gyi chos bshad pa/bzhi pa khyad par gyi chos la/thun mong ma yin pa'i yon to dang /thun mong gi yon to gnyis/dang po la/mdor bstan pa/rgyas par bshad pa/don bsdub gsum/dang po ni/sa pas rgyasakyi chos ma tshos chos can/bco brgyad du yod de/stobs bcu dang /la sogs mi 'jigs pa bzhi/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum/thugs rje chen po rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/mkhyen pa'i stobs dang /sku'i stobs gnyis/dang po la/so po'i ngo bo dang /gang la brten nas 'thob 161natshul/sgra bshad pa dang gsum/dang po ni/gnas dang gnas min pa nga pa'i stobs ni chos ga/shes pa dang bcas te/khyod la shes pa bcu char yod pa'i phyir/las dang las kyi gos bu rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs de dgu chos can/khyod la shes pa brgyad yod de/khyod la 'gog lam shes pa gnyis ma ga rta gos de rnams bod pa'i phyir/bsam gto rnam thar sogs mkhyen pa dang /dbang po dang /mos pa dang /khams ma zhi pa'i stobs rnams la ni chos can/dgu yod de/'gog shes ma gtogos de dgu yod pa'i phyir/kun 'gro'i lam nye tshe mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang mkhyen pa chos can/de yod de/shes pa dgu 'am bcu ga'i ngo bo las skyes pa yin ba'i phyir/sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang /'chi 'pho ba dang /skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs chos can/mtha' gcig tu nges te/kun rdzob shes pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/zag pa za/ ༷/ngo bo nga pa ni chos can/shes pa drug gi ngo

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa bshad pa/ (pha)bor skye ste/ cho so shes/ rjes shes/ zad mi skye shes pa gnyis/ 'gog pa shes pa/ kun rdzob shes pa rnams kyi ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ zad shes zag zad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i dbang du byas na bcu yod de/shes pa bcu ga'i ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon gnas dang 'chi 'pho ba skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs chos can/ sa la brten te/ bsam gtan bzhi po'i dngos gzhi'i sa dag la brten cing yod pa'i phyir/ lhag ma brgyad ni chos can/ sal brten te/ nyer bsdogos phyi ma bdun ma gtogos 'dod pa la sogs pa bcu gcig po rnams kun na yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ ci'i phyir 'di dag la stobs zhes bya zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang gi phyir chos thams cad la thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa sku'i stobs ni/ shes bya chos can/ bye smra (161bsgo'i 'dod tshul yod de/ sku la sred med kyi bu'i stobs yod pa'i phyir/ mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul yod de/ tshad gzung bar mi nus par 'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan dag gi 'dod pa yod de/ sku la sred med kyi bu'i stobs yod pa'i phyir/ sred med kyi bu'i stobs yod de/ glang po che phal pa dang /spos glang dang / phywa po che dang / rab gnon dang / yan lag mchog dang / stobs mchog dang / sred med bu dang bdun po rim bzhin bcus blags pas stobs che ba'i phyir/ stobs de ni reg bya'i skye mched yin te/ de 'byung ba'i khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ mi 'jigs pa ni chos can/ rnam pa bzhi yod de/ rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs/ rang don spangs pa phun tshogs/ gas don bar pha kyi chosasu dam bcas pa/ g.yin don nges 'byung gi lam du dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ ji ltar stobs dang po gnas dang gnas min pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 'dra bar shes pa bcu ga'i ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ stobs bcu pa zag pa zad pa'i stobs bzhin te de dang tshul 'dra bar zag pa zad par rang gi ngo bo rig pa'i dbang du byas na shes pa drug gi ngo bor skye/ 'khor bcas rig pa'i dbang du byas na bcu ga'i ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ stobasaganyis pa las kyi rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 'dra bar 'gog lam shes pa ma gtogs pa shes pa —635

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pobargyad kyi ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ bdun pa/ lam mkhyen pa'i stobs ltar shes pa bcu ga'i ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ ga smo po dran pa dang blang dor shes pa'i shes bzhi gyi bdag nyid can gyi dran pa nyer gzhag chos can/ gsum yod de/ cho so gus pas nyan pa la 'dod chags kyis dben/chos ma gus pas nyan pa la zhe sdang gis dben/ gus ma gus gnyis(162na tshe/sa nyan pa la chags sdang gis dben pa'i phyir/ thugs rje wo po ni chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ kun rdzob blo ye shesapa'i blo'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ de skad ces bya ste/ tshogs che ba/ rnam pa che ba/ spyod yul che ba/ mnyam pa che ba/ ches che ba dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ snying rje dang thugs rje chen po la tha dad du bya ba rnam pa brgyad yod de/ thugs rje chen po ni gti mug med pa khams gsum gyi sems can la dmigs pa sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten pa/ sangs rgyasakho na'i rgyud la yod pa/ srid rtse las chags bral gyi tshul gyis 'thob pa/ khams gsum gyi skyob pa 'phrin las kun la 'jug pa yin la/ snying rje chen po ni/ zhe sdang med pa/ 'dod pa'i sems can tsam la dmigs pa/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can/ bsam gtan bzhi la brten pa nyan thos kyi rgyud la yod pa/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bas 'thob pa/ 'dod khams kyi semasacan tsam skyob pa/ 'phrin las kyang de la 'jug pa rnams yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa don bsdub ni/sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa nyid gsum dang ldan te/ rgyu tsho gis gnyis bsags pa/ mtshan nyid chos sku thob pa/ phrin las 'gro ba'i don spyod pa la mnyam nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sku tshe dang rigs dang gdung dang sku'i bongs tshodi kyi sgo nas mnyam pa ni min te/ sku tshe la ring thung / rigs la bram ze dang rgyal rigs/ gdung la 'od srungs dang shākya sogs sku bongs la che chung yod pa'i phyir/—636

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa bshad pa/ (phanathun mong gi yon tan bshad pa/gnyis pa thun mong gi yon tan bshad pa la/ mdor bstan pa rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gzhan thun mong ba'i yon tan la gnyis yod de/ nyen mongs med pa dang (162ba)smon nas shes pa sogs slob pa nyan thos dang thun mong ba yod la/ yon tan kha cig so so skye bo dang thun mong ba yod pa'i phyir/ de yod de/ nyon mongs med pa dang / smon nas shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / sogs pas bsam gtan gzugs med/ rnam thar zil gnon sogs yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ slob pa 'phags pa dang thun slong ba'i yon tan bshad/ so so skye bo dang thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ nyan mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon nasamakhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ so sor yang dag rig pa zhan byung bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' ngos gzung ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ shes pa yin te/ kun rdzob shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sa la brten te/ bsam gtan gyi ya mtha' bzhi pa kho na la brten pa'i phyir/sgom pa'i rten yod de/ mi g.yo ba kho nas sgom pa'i phyir/ gsar du skyed pa'i rten yod de/ gling gsum gyi mis gsar du skyed pa'i phyir/ spyod yul yod de/ 'dod pa'i sar gtogs pa'i nyon mongs pa ma skyes ste ma 'ongs pa gzhir bcas la dmigs pa'i khyad chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir shes par bya'o snyam du smon nas shes pa'ang nyon mongs pa med pa de bzhin no/ /de'i dmigs pa yod de/ chosathams cad la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de chos can khyod kyi rten yod de/ mi g.yo ba dang mi'i rten la yod pa'i phyir/ dbye na bzhi yod de/ chos/ don/ nges tshig /spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ ngo bo yod de/ dang po gsum/ go rim bzhin du/ ming dang / don dang /(163nang ga so sor rig pa dang / bzhi pa ni/ rig pa dang thags thogs med par mngon par brjod pa —637

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogenyid lam ting nge 'dzin la dbang ba rim pa bzhin gsal bar bya ba thogs pa med par shes pa yin pa'i phyir/de'i dmigs pa yod de/ngag dang lam la dmigs pa'i phyir/spobs pa so sor ba cho ge can/shes pa dgu yod de/'gog shes ma gtogos dgu yod pa'i phyir/yang dag pa'i don sgo sor rig pa ni chos can/don chos kun yin na shes pa bcu 'am don myang 'das yin na drug yod de chos shes rjes shes 'gog shes zad shes mi skye shes pa kun rdzob shes pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/don rig pa de ni cho ge can/sa kun na yod de/'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar na yod pa'i phyir/de las gas chos dang nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag rig pa chos can/kun rdzob shes pa yod de/rim pa bzhi ming gi tshig dang gang ldodamigs pa'i phyir/chos so sor yang dag rig pa gnyis chos can/yod de/de 'dod khams dang bsam gtan bzhi na yod pa'i phyir/ngag so sor yang dag rig pa chos can/yod de/'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po na yod pa'i phyir/bzhi po chos can/lhan cig tu 'thob ste/ma tshang na gzhan thob pa med pa'i phyir/bzhi pa dang /nyon mongs med pa dang /smon nas shes pa po de dag ni chos can/thob byed yod de/rab mtha'i bsam gto la brten nas 'thob pa'i phyir/de ni chos can/rnam pa drug yod de/nyon mongs med pa dang /smon nas shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /ngag ma gtagos so sor yang dag rig pa dang /rab mtha' de de rnams yod pa'i phyir/de ni chos can/rab mtha' zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/sa kun gyis mthun par byas shing 'phel ba'i rab tu phyin par bya ba yin pa'i phyir//yon tan de dag 163ba long sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i gang zag la ni sbyor ba'i stobs las skyes pa yin te/'bad med du 'grub pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ 68

chos ma' rin 'a 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa bshad pa/ (pha)so so'i skye bo dang thun mong gi yon to ༅da pa/gnyis pa so so skye bo dang thun mong gi yon to bshad pa la/mngon shes drug gi ngo bo dang /khyad par gyi chos gnyis/dang po ni/mdzo shes chos༅/rnam pa drug yod de/rdzu 'phrul gyi/lha'i rna ba'i/gzhan gyi yid shes pa'i/sngon gyi tshe rabs sam gnas rjes su dran ba'i/'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba shes pa'i zag pa zad pa'i ma' shes dang drug yod pa'i phyir/de dag chos can/ngo bo yod de/rnam grol gyi blo yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa dang drug pa ma gtogos pa'i bzhi ni chos can/ngo bo khyad par tso dang ldan te/kun rdzob shes pa yin pa'i phyir/gas sems shes pa'i mngon shes chos༅/lngas bsdus te/chos shes/rjes shes/lam shes/kun rdzob shes pa/sems shes lngas bsdus pa'i phyir/zag pa zad pa shes pa'i mngon shes chos can/drug gam bcus bsdus te/zag pa zad pa'i stobs zhes pa de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/spyir bstan pa/bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/sa'i khyad par/dran pa nyer gzhag gi khyad par/ngo bo'i khyad par/rig pa'i khyad par/cho 'phrul gsum gyi khyad par dang lnga/dang po ni/zag zad ma gtogos pa'i mngon shes lnga chos can/sa khyad par can la brten te/bsam gtan bzhi po dag la brten te gnas pa'i phyir/de chos can/spyod yul can yin te/rang sa dang 'og sa'i spyod yul can yin pa'i phyir/mngon par shes pa ni chos can/'thob tshul yod de/ma 'dris pa ni sbyor bas thob 64na ) par bya la 'dris pa ni 'dod chags dang bral bas 'thob pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/mngon shes gsum pa gzhan sems shes pa ni chos can/dran pa nyer gzhag gsum gyis bsdus te/sems tshore chos gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/rdo 'phrul dang lha'i rna ba dang mig gi mngon shes rnams chos can/gcig giXsdus te dang pos bsdus pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gemig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni/ lung du ma bstan pa yin te/ de cig shos gnyis gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang lhag ma rnams ni dge ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ sngon gnas rjes dran so gos phyi ma gsum nyid ni chos can/ mi slob pa'i rig pa zhes bya ste/ sngon/ mtha' dang sogs pas phyi dang bar gyi mtha' gsum la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa bzlog pa'i phyir yin pa'i phyir/ tha ma zad shes kho na mi slob pa'i rig pa yin la de'i dang po gnyis la mi slob pa'i rig pa gang rung pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis mi slob pa'i rgyud las skyes pa'i phyir/ de gnyis ni slob mi slob gang gi yang min no/ /slob pa'i rig pa zhesam bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ slob pa la de gsum yod par 'dod kyang ma rig pa dang 'bacas pa 'a phyir/ lnga pa ni/ cho 'phrul de la rnam pa gsum yod de/ rdzu phrul gyi/ gsung kun brjod pa'i/ thugasarjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de yang yod de/ mdzo shes dang po dang /gsum pa dang drug pa rnams rim pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum las thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul chos can/ mchog yin te/ mi 'khrul pa'i phyir dang phan pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i gos bu la sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir/ gzhan gnyis ni rig sngags kyis kyang byed do/ /mngon shes lnga po so sor bshad pa/gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ rdo 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i mig dang rna ba/ skyes thob sogs kyi khyad par bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ rdzu tshil gyi ngo bo 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ sprul (164bsams yul dang bcas pa/ sprul pa byed tshul zhan byung dang bcas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ pahrūl chos can/ 'grub ba'i thabs yod de/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin de las ni chos gnyisang ste/ sprul pa dang / 'gro ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ston pa sangs rgyas la yid 'gyogs kyi 'gro ba yod de/ de yid la bsams pa tsam gyi 'gro nus pa'i —640

chos mngon rin rpā 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas bdun pa bshad pa/ (pha)phyir/ tī rang dang gzhan la 'gro ba gnyis yod de/ lus phyin byed kyis 'gro ba dang / thag ring la nye bar mos nas 'gro ba mos pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i sprul pa ni chos can/ phyi'i skye mched bzhis bsdus te/ gzugs dri ro reg byasabasdus pa'i phyir/ de la yang gnyis yod de/ rang dang gzhan gyi lus la 'brel ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs su gtogos pa'i sprul pa ni chos can/ phyi'i skye mched gnyis kyis bsdus te/ gzugasadang reg bya'i skye mched kyas bsdus pa'i phyir/ sprul pa chos can/ rgyu yod de/ sprul sems dag gis sprul pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang chos can/ bcu bzhi yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'bras bu'i sprul sems la rang sa dang 'dod pa'i sa sa bsdus pa gnyis nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i 'bras bu sprul sems la 'og sa bzhi dang rang sa sa bsdus pa'i sems gcig ste lnga'i bar rim pa bzhin yod pa'i phyir/ sa 'og ma'i sprul sems chos can/ sa gong ma las skyes pa yod pa min te/ rang sa dang 'og sakho na yin pa'i phyir/ sprul sems de chos can/ rnyed tshul yod de/ bsam gtan rnams ji lta ba bzhin du rnyed pa'i phyir/ de ni chos can/ rgyu yod de/ bsam gto dag pa ba dang / rang gi rigs 'dra'i 'jug thogs las 'byung zhing / de las kyang de gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum (165na)pa ni/ gzhan gyi sprul sems kyis sprul pa byed mi nus te/ rang gi sa pa kho na'i sprul sems kyis sprul par byed pa'i phyir/ smrar 'jug pa'i sprul pa ni sa 'og ma la brten nas kyang byed de/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ ston pa sangs rgyas min pa ni sprul pa po rang nyid dang bcas nas smra bar byed/ ston pa'i sprul pa ni ston pa ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin smra ba'i phyir/ sprul sems dang smra sems tha dad kyang sprul pa smra ba yod de/byin gyis brlabs nas gzhan smra sems kyis smra ba la 'jug pa'i phyir/ byin gyis brlabs nas ga' na sprul 'jug pa'i phyir/ gson po kho nar ma nges te/ shi ba la yang de ltar 'jug pa'i phyir/ de yang mi brtan pa sha dang khrag sogs la byin gyis mi rlob ste/ brtan pa rus pa lta bu la rlom pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyan thos 'od srung chen po'i rus pa sprul sems kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ da lta yang ri bo —641

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'bya rkang na yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ rnam pa gsum/ zhes bye brag smra ba zer ro/ sde pa gzhan dag ni/'thad pa min te/ de gnas gtsang gi lha'i byin rlabs yin pa'i phyir/ dang por sprul sems du masasprul pa gcig sprul par byed pa yin la/ byang nas de las bzlog ste du ma gcig gis sprul bar byed de/ sgom pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rdzu snyul gyi dbye ba ni/ bsgoms stobs las skyesapa'i sprul sems ni lung ma bstan yin te/ de gzhan gnyis por ma gtogos pa'i phyir/ skye ba'i stobasalas skyes pa'i sprul sems chos can/ yod de/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rdzu'aphrul chos can/ rnam pa lnga yod de/ gsang sngags dang sman dag dang / las las skyes pa dang / sgom pa dang / skye bas thob pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha'i mig dang / rna ba'i mngon shesachos can/ (165bajo bo yod de/ mig rnams bsdus pa'i phyir/ khyad par dang ldan te/ bsam gtan gyis bsdus pa'i nang gi gzugs dang ba dang / rtag tu brten pa dang bcas pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba med pa'i phyir/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes chos can/ yul khyad par can la 'jug ste/ thag ring po'i sgra phra ba dang sogs pas rags pa thams cad spyod yul du byed nus pa'i phyir/ mig gi ma ho shesakyis yul mthong tshul yod de/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyis stong gnyis/ brtse ru rang rgyal gyis stong gsum/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi de rnams kyis grangs med pa'i zhing gi gzugs phra rags mtha' dag mthong ba'i phyir/gsum pa skyes thob kyi khyad par bshad pa ni gzhan yang skye bas thob pa'i mig gi mngon shes ni chos can/ chos thams cad mi mthong ste/ srid pa bar ma mi mthong ba'i phyir/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes de ni chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ skye bas thob pa gang de dang / rtog zhes byas pa dang /rig sngags kyis byas pa'ang yod pa'i phyir/ dmyal ba pas ni/ dang por gzhan gyi sems shes pa yin gyi phyis sdug bsngal gyis mnar bas mi shes pa'i phyir/ mi la skye bas thob pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran med de/yod na thams cad la yod dgos pa la med pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ chos ma' pa mdzod kyi tshig yo2

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gan bdun pa gad pa/ (phanale'ur byas pa las/ gnas bdun pa zhes bya ba gtan la phab pa yin te/ ye shes mdor bstan rgyasabashad kyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i phyir/smras pa/ dpag tshad mang po'i gzugs sgra mthong thos pa'i/ /mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes dga' ston gyis/ /legs byas rgya mtsho'i gos bu mngar ba 'dis/ /gzur gnas skye bo'i (17na)yid kyi spro ba 'phel/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan pha mtha' yongs bral ba/ /kun gsal zhags pas gzhal las phyir 'gong na/ /tshur mthong byis pa'i blo yi yul 'das kyang / /gzhung lugs 'di 'drar brten nas cung zad bshad/ /'bras bu med pa'i ljon shing sdong po la/ /phang phung lo 'dab tsam gyi rab mdzes pa/ /'bras ldan shing gi gral du bsgrags pa yis/ /rkang 'thung yongs kyi ngang tshul lhag bar skad/ /gzhung lugs mang po mthong zhing thos pa yi/ /gral du mig phab smra ba'i kha yang btsum/ /rigs mthun rmongs pa'i grogs po mthong ba'i tshe/ /bzhin ras zla ltar 'phyar ba 'ga' gzigs sam/ /'bras bu thob bya'i yon to rnams/ /cung zad bshad pa'i dge bas kyang / /chos ma' mdzod kyi ring lugasa'adi/ khrid rtse'i bar du 'phel gyur cig /chos mngon pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa chos ma ga rin wo 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/ gnas bdun pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod ji snyed pa bshad zin to/ /—43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geganas brgyad pa snyoms 'jug bstan pa/ji lta ji snyed chos kyi snang bas kun//rjen par lang ba'i blo gros ā glo//skal bzang mdzes ma'i rgyan du spud byed pa'i//grags pa'i u dha /de mchog tu ldir//u dum wa ra lta bur chesadakon pa'i//legs bshad mchog dman yongs kyi dga' ston du//sbyin mkhas chos kyi 'khor losasgyur ba can//thub bstan 'phel mdzad yongs 'dzin bla ma rje//gang gi gsung bzhin snyoms 'asdug rnam gzhag kun/thang ngu'i tshig gis gsal bar rab phye yi//snying nas nges 'byung skyes te bstan pa la//zhugs pa'i slobaskyes bu ma lus 'dir 'dus shig/sto phyir lus bsgyur go sa tsam gyi phyir//sa zad thos dang lag yi sha tsos dag/'dzin kyang 'dod lha'i mda' yis myos rnams la//'di 'dra'i gtam las rnyed pa nyung zad dga'//'on kyang 'brug gi sgra dbyangs kyis//rma bya zlos gar sgyur ba ltar//blo gros chu 'dzin stug po las//legs bshad char rgyun 'di na'o//snyoms 'jug yon tan gtan la dbab pa/gnyis pa snyoms 'asdug gi yon tan gtan la dbab pa la/snyoms 'jug gi rang bzhin gtan la dbab/de'i khyad par gyi chos/ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi dbye ba/de la brten pa'i yon to bshad pa dang bzhi/dang po la/snyoms 'jug gnyis/dang po la/tshig don dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/dang po ni/bsam gto de dag ni chos can/rnam pa gnyis yod de/rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dang /'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan gnyis yod pa'i phyir/de re re la bzhi bzhi yod de/dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/der skye ba ༷༷sa bu skyes thob kyi bsam gtan ni 'dir rgyas

chos ma' rin rṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta las gan brgyad pa bshad pa/ (phanapar mi 'chad de/ gong ma'i gnas dang bcu bdun ni/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su rab tu bshad zin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /bsam gtan dang po na tshor ba bde ba yid bde btang snyoms gsum ga yod cing / gnyis pa man chad la med pa'i khyad par 'thad zer na/ bsam gtan gnyis pa na/ (167nas ga rna ba lus kyi rnam shes gsum dang / lusang ga gi las kun nas slong bar byed pa'i rtog dpyod gnyis med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bsam gtan gnyis pa ba'i rgyud la de med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus/ kha cig /srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug khyad par cha mthun dang / nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis med zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ srid rtse'i snyoms 'dun de la nges 'byed cha mthun yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ srid pa'i rtse mo rnam pa gsum ste/ khyad par gyi cha dang mthun pa ni ma gtogos so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /skabs 'dir stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag khas mi len zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ skabs 'dir rnam thar sgo gsum gyi stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag khas len pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i ting nge 'dzin khas len pa'i phyir/ gnyisapa ni/ bsam gto gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'dug chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa yin pa'i phyir/ phung po du ma yod de/rjes gong dang bcas par phung po lnga ga yod pa'i phyir/ dang po'i ngo bo yod de/ rtog dpyod dang / dga' ba dang / bde ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa nas bzhi pa'i bar gyi ngo bo yod de/bsam gtan lhag ma gsum ni yan lag snga ma snga ma spangs pa yi/ dge ba rtse gcig pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang yod de/ spyod pa sogs spangs nas dga' ba sogs gnyen po'i yan lag dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbye ba/ 'thob tshul/ dmigs pa'i khyad par/ so so'i ngo bo dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzugs (167bsad chos can/ gnyis yod de/ bsam gtan de bzhin du rgyu snyoms 'jug gi gzugs med dang 'bras bu skye ba'i gzugs med dag yod pa'i phyir/ rjes 'brang —645

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podang bcas par phung po bzhi yod de/de dang brgya bar gzugs phung ma gtogs pa'i phung po rnams yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/de chos can/'thob tshul yod de/'og ma'i sa las dben pa ste chagasabral gyi tshul gyis skye ba'i phyir/gsum pa ni/gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs phyi ma gsum dngos gzhi dang bcas pa cho rtse can/gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig ces bya ste/de dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir/gzugs med khams na gzugs med de/de ni ming gzhi'i phung po tsam gyis phye ba yin pa'i phyir/de nas 'dod khams su skye ba'i gzugs ni chos can/khyod kyi rgyu yod de/gzugs kyi bag chagasayongs su goms pa'i sems kyi 'jug pa las skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir//bzhi pa ni/rnam shes mtha' yas kyi skye mched chos can/ngo bo yod de/sbyor ba'i dus su rnam shes mtha' yas so snyam du sgom zhing /dngos gzhi'i dus su de mngon 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi skye mched chos can/ngo bo yod de/nam mkha' ma ga rta gos snga ma dang 'dra/ci yang med pa'i skye mched chos can/yod de/ci yang med ces kha spo/'du shes med pa'i skye mgo chos༅/yod de/'du shes dman pa'i phyir 'du shes med pa dang /'du shes gto med pa'ang med pa ni zhi ba'o/snyam du sgom zhing lhag ma sngar dang 'dra//gnyis pa a mong du bshad pa ni/snyoms 'dug dngos gzhi'i rdzas chos ro/rnam pa bas yod de/bsam gto bzhi'i snyoms 'dun/gzugs med bzhi'i snyoms 'asdug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/srid rtse 6ni sgo gtogos pa'i snyoms 'jug bdun chos༅/rnam pa gsum yod de/ro myang dang tsos ldan dang /dag pa ba dang /zag med snyoms 'jug rnams yod pa'i phyir/brgyad pa srid rtse'i snyoms la sdug chos can/rnam pa gnyisayod de/ro myang dang mtshungs ldan dang /dag pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/dag pa chos can/ngo bo yod de/'jig rten pa'i dge bas bsdus pa'i snyoms 'dug de yin pa'i phyir/dag pa de dag ni chos can/ro myang dang mtshungs ldan yin te/snyoms 'dug gi rdzas la brten nas myang bya yin pa'i phyir/zag med kyi snyoms 'dun chos can/ngo bo yod de/'jiX /na las 'das pas bsdus pa'i snyoms 'asdug de

yin pa'i phyir/ /bsam gtan gyi yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa/gsum pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag bye brag sgyu bshad pa la/ dbye ba/ bsdub/ nyen mongs can yan lag ldan tshul/ zhan byung dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po la yan lag lnga yod de/rtog dpyod gnyen po'i yan lag dang / dga' ba dang bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi mo yan lag rnams yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la ni yan lag bzhi yod de/nang rab tu dang ba gnyen po'i yan lag dang / dga' ba dang la sogs pa bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag /sems rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag rnams yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa la yan lag lnga yod de/ dran pa shes bzhin gnyen po'i yan lag /btang snyoms dang bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag rnams yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi mtha' na ste/ bzhi pa la yan lag bzhi yod de/ dran pa dang btang snyoms(168ba)gnyen po'i yan lag /bde ba'ang min sdug bsngal yang min pa'i btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag rnams yod pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag de dag rdzas su bcu gcig tu 'du ste/bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag lnga/ gnyis pa'i nang rab tu dang ba/ gsum pa'i btang snyoms/ dran pa shes bzhin/ bde ba/ bzhi pa'i btang snyoms rnams su 'du ba'i phyir/ de ltar nges te/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis na shin tu sbyangs pa la bde ba yin zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'i nang rab tu dang ba ni gsum pa'i dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum du 'dus pa ma yin te/ de ni bsam gtan las nges par byung ba'i yid ches kyis dad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa'i bde ba de ni chos can/ yid bde ma yin te/ de ltar ma yin par rnam sbyar gyi mdo'i lung tshan rnam pa gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/—647

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'gasum pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po gsum nyen mongs can la rim pa bzhin dga' ba dang bde ba dang rab tu dang ba dang shes bzhin dang dran pa med do/ /nyen mongs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa nyen mongs can la btang snyoms dang dran pa yang dag med de/ nyon mongs dri bcas yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /dang po gnyis na shin tu sbyangs pa med la/ phyi ma gnyis na btang snyoms yongs su dag pa med de/ de dge ba'i sa pa yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa zhan byung la/ bsam gtan bzhi pa mi g.yo ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'bras bu skye bsathob pa'i bsam gtan la tshor ba'i ldan tshul/ bsam gtan gnyis par 'og ma'i sems ma ga du byed tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa (169na hā mer can/ g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ste/skyon brgyad las grol ba'i phyir/ brgyad po yod de/ rtog pa dang / dpyod pa dang / dbu gsang ba dang / rngub pa dang / bde ba dang la sogs pas sdug bsngal dang / yid bde dang / yid mi bde dang bzhi po rnams yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ snyoms 'jug gi rten la yod pa'i tshor ba bde ba skyed pa'i bsam gtan yod de/ skye ba'i bsam gtan dang po dag na tshor ba gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/yid bde dang / tshor bde dang / btang snyoms rnams yod pa'i phyir/ skye ba'i bsam gtan gnyis pa na gnyis yod de/ yid bde dang btang snyoms gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa na gnyis yod de/ sems tshor bde ba dang btang snyoms gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa na tshor ba gcig yod de/ btang snyoms kyi tshor ba kho na yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gnyis pa sogs gong ma na/ lus/ mig /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / rnam par rig byed kun nas slong bar byed pa yod de/ de spyir yod cing rang sa sa bsdus pa med pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'dra'i kun slong gang yin pa de dang por gtogs pa'i phyir/ de rnams ni ma bsgribs lung ma bstan yin gyi nyon mongs can dang dge ba min te/'dod chags bral ba'i phyir dang dman pa'i phyir/ —648—

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas brgyad pa bshad pa/ (phanabasam gtan dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug sogs kyi khyad chos bshad pa/gnyis pa de dag gi khyad chos la/'thob pa'i tshul/thob zin mngon du byed tshul/dmigs pa'i khyad par/spang bya spong tshul nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa bzhi/dang po la/dngos dang /snyoms 'jug gang gi mjug tu snyoms 'asdug du 'byung la dpyad pa/dag pa'i dbye ba/yin byung thod rgyal gyi rnam gzhag dang bzhi/dang po ni/169bsnyoms 'jug dag pa 'thob tshul yod de/'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral ba dang /srid rtse ma gtogs 'og sar skye ba las ni/de dang mi ldan pa 'thob pa'i phyir/zag med kyi bsam gtan chos can/de yod de/'dod chags dang bral ba yis 'thob pa'i phyir/nyon mongs can gyi bsam gto chos can/de yod de/yongs su nyams pa dang gong sanasa'og sar skye ba yis 'thob pa'i phyir//gnyis pa ni/zag pa med pa'i mjug thogs su bsam gtan skye tshul yod de/dper na bsam gtan gsum pa la rang sa nas rang gi ltag gong sa dang 'og sagasum pa bsam gtan dang po'i bar gyi dge ba dag pa der zag med rnams skye ba'i phyir/bsam gtan dag pa ba chos can/khyod kyi mjug tu chos du ma 'thob ste/snga ma de bzhin du/rang sa 'og sasogs kyi bsam gtan dag pa ba dang /rang gi sa'i nyen mongs can yang 'thob pa'i phyir/nyon mongasacan gyi bsam gto chos can/mjug tu gsum 'byung ste/rang sa'i dag pa ba dang /nyon mongs can dang /'og ma'i dag pa gcig kyang 'thob pa'i phyir/'chi 'pho ba'i dus kyi skyes thob kyi bsam gtan dag pa mjug thogs su chos gsum 'byung ste/rang sa 'og sa gong sa'i nyon mongs can kun 'byung ba'i phyir/'chi 'pho ba'i tshe nyon mongs can chos can/mjug tu gong ma'i dag pa skye ba med de/'og sa kho na 'byung ba'i phyir//gsum pa ni/bsam gta/ sdug pa chos can/bzhi yod de/nyams pa cha mthun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posogs kyis gnas pa/khyad par/nges khed cha mthun rnams yod pa'i phyir/ngo bo yod de/go rim bzhi du/wo mongs skye ba dang /rang sa dang /gong sa dang /zag med skye ba dang rjes su mas pa'i phyir/nyams pa cha 70na7thun gyi mjug thogs su gnyis khrung ste/de dang gnas pa cha mthun gnyas 'byung ba'i phyir/sogs pas rjes ma'i mjug tu gsum 'byung ste/nges 'byed cha mthun ma gags khrung ba'i phyir/khyad par gyi mjug tu gsum 'byung ste/nyams pa ma gags yang ba'i phyir/nges 'byed kyi rjes su gcig 'byung ste/de kho na 'byung ba'i phyir/smras pa/dgra bcom bdun gyi zhal sgo'i gangs ri las//legs 'ongs chos mngone gzhung brgya'i nyal 'gro dag/blo gros skyed tshal gsar par babs pa na//legs bshad pad dkar 'dab ma ci yang 'dzum//tshig gi spros pa tsam gyi glu dbyangs kyis//blun rmonges byis pa'i snang ba ma 'brid par//snyoms 'jug ze 'bru'i bcud rnams rab tsongs dang //bde ba'i sbrang rtsi'i skal ba ngang gisa'athob//dag dang ma dag dpyod pa'i rnam dpyod dang //'khor ba'i snang tshul la skyo nges khrung dang //'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i snying rje yis//dal 'byor don ldan byed pa'i lcag cig byung //rig pa'i gnas ni mkha' ltar zad pa med//snyigs dus tshe 'di glog ltar myur du 'jig/ngan song sdug bsngal me ltar bzod par dka'//dal 'byor wo mo'i skar ltar thob pa dkon//rnyed dka'i rten thob mjal dka'i chos dang phrad//mi dge'i grogs spangs dge ba'i bshes kyis bzung //rgyal ba'i gsung la thos bsam byar yod pa'i//dus 'dir dal ba don dang ldan par byos//zhes bya ba ni bar skabasakyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// 60

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas brgyad pa bshad pa/ (phanazhar byung thod rgal gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa/bzhi pa zhan byung thod rgal gyi rnam gzhag la/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/(170ba'ang sbyor dang / nye sbyor gnyis/ dang po la/ zag bcas ring sbyor dang / zag med ring sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med gnyis kyi bzhi ste sa brgyad kyi zag bcas brgyad dang srid rtse ma gtogs zag med bdun ste rnam pa gnyis kyi zag bcas la 'brel ba ste go rim bzhin mthar chags su rgal nas lugs mthun du yar song zhing / lugs mi mthun du mar 'ongs nas ni/ snyoms par 'jug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de yod de/ de gnyis kyi snyoms 'jug zag med bdun la lugs mthun lugs mi mthun gyis snyoms par 'jug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug 'di ni gling gsum du dgra bcom dus mi sbyor ba kho nas skyed de/ de la nyon mongs med pa'i phyir dang / des ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ zag bcas nye sbyor dang / zag med nye sbyor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de yod de/ bsam gto dang po nasagacig ste re re rgal nas yar song zhing mar 'ongs nas bsam gtan dang po gsum pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ ci yang med bzhi'i snyoms 'jug zag bcas bzhi la lugs mthun lugs mi mthun du mjug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de yod de/ de bzhi'i zag med bzhi la sngar ltar 'jug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ thod rgal gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'a lcag yod de/ ris mi mthun zag bcas zag med spel te rang gnas nas gsum par 'gro bas/ sngar gyi bzhi las/ dang po dang / gsum pa zag bcas/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa zag med kyi snyoms 'asdug rnams la lugasamathun lugs mi mthun gyi sgo nas 'jug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa thob zin mngon du byed tshul ni/ spyir btang la bsam gtan dang / gzugs med kyi snyoms 'asdug rnams chos can/ rten yod de/—651—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogerang sa dang 'og sa'i rten can yin pa'i phyir/gong sa'i rten la 'og sa'i snyoms 'jug mngon du mi byed de/de ltar byas pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/172na dmigs bsal ni/thams cad la der ma nges te/srid rtser skyes pa'i 'phags pa 'og sa ci yang med pa'i skye mched mngon du byas nas zag pa zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/gsum pa dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/sred pa dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan chos can/dmigs pa yod de/rang sa'i srid pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/bsam gtan dge ba dag pa dang zag med chos can/de yod de/chos yod dgu la dmigs pa'i phyir/gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i dge ba rnams chos can/spyod yul du 'og sa'i zag bcas med de/rang sa dang gong sa'i de kho na la dmigs pa'i phyir/bzhi pa spang bya spong tshul nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa la/spang bya spong tshul/nyer bsdogs kyi dbye ba/bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug khyad par can ngos gzung ba dang gsum/dang po ni/zag pa med pa'i bsam gtan dang gzugs med rnams chos can/nyon mongasarnams spong bar byed de/de rnams 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs dag pa ba chos can/rtags gsal sngar bzhin/gnyis pa ni/de dag la nyer bsdogs brgyad yod de/bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs bzhi/gzugs med kyi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/de dag chos can/ngo bo khyad par can yin te/dag pa ba yin pa'i phyir/tshor ba dang bcas te/bde min sdug min gyi btang snyoms dang mtshudas ldan yin pa'i phyir/dang po'i nyer bsdogos chos can/gnyis yod de/dag pa ba dang /'phags pa zag pa med pa gnyisayod pa'i phyir/kha cig/mang bar lar de/ro myang mtshungs ldan dang gsum yod pa'i phyir//gsum pa ni/bsam gto khyad par can chos can/ngo bo yod de/bsam gto dang po'i rtog pa med 171bkyi pa las chags bral gyi spyod pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'i phyir/sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas rnam pa gsum yod de/de dag zag med gsum yod pa'i phyir/tshor ba dang bcas te/bde min sdug min gyi bto snyoms dang mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir6/ḍi chos po/'bras bu dang bcas te/tshangs chen

chos mngone rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas brgyad pa bshad pa/ (phanadu skye ba'i 'bras bu can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba la/ gsum du dbye ba/bzhin dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yod de/ bsam gtan khyad par can man chad kyi ting nge 'dzin ni rtog dpyod dang bcas pa yin la/ bsam gtan khyad par can ni rtog pa med pa la dpyod pa dang bcas pa dang / de yan chad kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ gnyis ka med pa yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ dmigs pa yod de/ myang 'das la zhi ba'i rnam pa can du dmigs pa'i phyir/stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ dmigs pa yod de/ bdag med pa dang stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa la 'jug pa'i phyir/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ dmigs pa yod de/ snga ma'i de lasagazhan pa'i mi rtag pa sogs bden pa'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin phra mo de gsum po de chos can/ gnyis yod de/ dag pa dang dri ma med pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir des na rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yod de/ dri ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum po de rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzhan ting nge 'dzin gsum du yod de/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba la sogs pa'i gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po gnyis kyi dmigs pa yod de/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ting 'dzin gyis ni mi slob pa'i ting nge 'dzin la stong par dmigs/ phyi mas ni mi slob pa'i smon med la mi rtag par dmigasapa'i phyir/ gsum pa'i dmigs pa yod de/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin des mi slob (172na)pa'i zhi bar ma brtags pa'i zad pa so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin gzhan rnams chos can/ zag pa dang bcas te des spangs pa'i phyir/ rten yod de/mi'i nang du dgra bcom mi g.yo ba'i cho ge can la skye ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ sa bcu gcig la brten de/nyer bsdogs phyi ma bdun ni ma gtogs pa/ 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar la brten pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan ting nge 'dzin gsum yod de/ dge ba ste dag pa ba dang / zag med kyi bsam gtan dang po ni bde bar 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa dang / mig gi mngon shes mthong 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin du 'dod pa dang / khams gsum gyi sbyor ba las byung ba'i yon tan rnams blo gros rnam par dbye ba'i ting nge —653

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'a'adzin yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi ya mtha' bzhi la brten pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa de cho ge can/ zag pa zad par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa yin te/ khams gsum gyi sgrib pa'i dngos gnyen yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa de la brten pa'i yon tan la/ tshad med/ rnam thar/ zil gnon/ zad par/ 'thob tshul dang lnga/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon to la chos can/ tshad med pa bzhi yod de/ byams pa/snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i byed las yod de/ rim pa bzhin gnod sems/ la sogs pas rnam 'tshe/ mi dga' ba/ 'dod chags dang gnod sems mang ba'i garsā po byed pa'i phyir/ dang po chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ zhe sa med pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rnam pa yod de/ kye ma sems can rnams bde bar gyur na snyam pa de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyisapa snying rje yang chos can/ yod de/ zhe sdang med pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ yod de/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar (172bgyur na snyam pa de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dga' ba chos can/ yod de/ yid bde ba yin pa'i phyir/ yod de/ sems can rnams dga' bar gyur na snyam pa de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa chos can/ yod de/ ma chags pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ yod de/ sems can thams cad la semasamanyam pa de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi po chos can/ spyod yul yod de/ 'dod khams kyi sems can rnamasal dmigs pa'i phyir/ dga' ba tshad med chos can/ sa gnyis na yod de/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis na yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan gsum ni chos can/ sa drug na yod de/ bsam gtan sa drug na yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig lngar yang 'dod de/ nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med ma gtogos pa'i lnga yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhas 'a mongs pa'i rtsa ba mi spong ste/ mgo gnon pa tsam du zad pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rten yod de/ mi de'i yon tan nang du skyed pa'i phyir/ dga' ba ma gtogs pa'i gzhan gsum ni chos can/ phan tshun nges par ldan te/ phan tshun med na mi 'byung gi tshul gyis ldan pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ de'i yon tan rnam par thar pa brgyad yod de/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i —654

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las gnas brgyad pa bshad pa/ (phanarnam thar/ gzugs can ma yin pa gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po gnyis chos can/ rnam pa khyad par can yin te/ rnam par bsngos pa sogs mi sdug pa'i rnam par yod pa'i phyir/ sa khyad par can dang ldan te/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis na yod pa'i phyir/ rnam thar gsum pa de chos can/ sal brten te/ bsam gtan gyi ya mtha' bzhi pa na yod pa'i phyir/ ngo bo dang ldan te/ ma chags pa'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi chos can/ yod de/ gzugs med kyi mnyam par bzhag pa'i sa sa bsdus pa'i dge ba (173na bog pa dang / zag med kyi snyoms 'jug dang nyer bsdogs zag med rnams la 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar la snyoms par 'jug tshul yod de/srid rtse'i sems ni shin tu phra ba yin la/ di yang / ches phra bar byas pa'i mjug thogs su sems tshesaphra ba de'i gnyen por 'jug pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ ldang tshul yod de/ rang gi sa pa'i dag pa ba dang /sa 'og ma yi 'phags pa zag med kyi sems kyis snyoms 'jug de las ldang ba'i phyir/ rnam thar dang po gsum cho ge can/ spyod yul yod de/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i gzugs sogs snang yul du byed pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gang dag gzugs can min pa'i rnam thar ni chos can/ spyod yul yod de/ gong sa dang rang gi sa pa'i sdug bsngal dang / sogs pas kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / rjes shes kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam thams cad la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched chos can/ brgyad yod de/ dbyibs zil gnon bzhi dang / kha dog zil gnon bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ zil gnon dang po gnyis ni chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rnam thar dang po gnyis bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de 'og gnyis ni chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rnam thar gnyis pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ lhag ma rnams chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ sdug pa'i rnam thar bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ bcu yod de/ sa chu me rlung / sngo/ ser/ dmar/ dkar/ nam mkha'/ rnam shes kyi ting nge 'dzin dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ brgyad po chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ ma chags pa'i rnam pa can —655

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('ayin pa'i phyir/sal brten te/bsam gtan gyi mtha' bzhi pa na ste de la brten pa'i phyir/spyod yul yod de/'dod pa na spyod pa'i gzugs la dmigs pa'i phyir/phyi ma gnyis pa ni cho ge can/sa la brten te rim pa bzhin gzugs med dang po gnyis kyi dag pa ba yin pa'i phyir/173bstod yul yod de/rang sa'i phung po bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/lnga pa ni/'gog pa'i rnam thar chos can/mi spro ste/sngar bshad zin pa'i phyir/rnam thar lhag ma rnams ni chos can/yod de/'dris pa 'dod chagasadang bral ba dang /ma 'dris pa sbyor bas 'thob pa'i phyir/gzugs med ces bya ba'i rnam thar dang zad par thams cad chos can/rten yod de/khams gsum pa'i rten can yin pa'i phyir/lhag ma rnamasachos can/yod de/mi kho na las skyed pa'i phyir/bsam gto dang gzugs med kyi skyed tshul yod de/khams gong ma gnyis dag tu gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams rgyu'i stobs dang las kyi stobs kyis skye ba'i phyir/gzugs kyi khams su bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'asdug rnams choge can/rgyu gsum las skye ste/snga ma gnyis po de dag dang /chos nyid kyi stobs las kyang skye ba'i phyir/shes bya chosacan/chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/gnas brgyad pa zhes bya ba gtan la phab pa yin te/snyoms 'jug mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i phyir/smras pa/shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul kun//ma 'dres gsal bar mkhyen pa'i zhal lung las//snyoms 'jug brgyad kyi sngon med dga' ston 'di//gzur gnas blo ldan spro ba bskyed phyir bkod//ting 'dzin 3 med rnam thar zil gnon sogs//yang dag gtam gyi bdud rtsis rab gang ba'i//gnas brgyad 'chi ba med pa'i bum bzang 'di/shes ldan lha bu'i tshogs rnams da long zhig/tshul 'di'i dgongs don ma nyams 'dab gzhog dang /thos bsam mthun pa'i lung gisagrogs byas te//gtan bde'i rdzing bur zhugs nas rtse dga' la//spyod 174nang dod ngang pa'i tsho gis rnams dga' bar byos//chos mngone pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa/chos ma' rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba las/gnas brgyad pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod ji snyed pa bshad zin to//66

rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba bstan pa/gsum pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la/bstan pa'i gnas tshad/nongs pa la bzod par gsol ba/thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis bag yod rten rigs pa dang gsum/dang po la/tshig don dang /spyi'i don ga snya/dang po ni/ston pa'i dam chos cho me ho/rnam pa gnyis yod de/lung gi dam chosadang /rtogs pa'i dam chos gnyis kyi bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/shes bya chos can/de 'dzin par byed pa yod pa de srid du bstan pa gnas te/lung gi chos ni thos bsam gyi sgo nas smra bar byed pa dang /rtogs pa'i chos ni sgrub par byed pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa de srid du yod pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/rtogs pa'i dam chos bshad/lung gi dam chos bshad/de gnyis kyi gnas tshad bshad pa dang gsum/dang po ni/rtogs pa'i dam chos chos can/gzhag tu yod de/bslab pa gsum gang rung gis bsdus pa'i dam chos de yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/mtshan gzhi yod de/byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun lta bu yin pa'i phyir/der thal/rang 'grel las/rtogs pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa rnams te/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/lung gi dam chos chos can/khyod gzhag tu yod de/sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel rnam dag gang rung gis bsdus pa'i dam chos de yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/khyod kyi mas gzhi yod de/sdosnod gsum lta bu yod pa'i phyir/der thal/rang 'grel las/de la/lung ni mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang chos 74bamangon pa rnams so//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/rang 'grel las/de'i phyir/de nyid ji srid du gnas pa de srid du dam pa'i chos gnas par rig par bya'o//de dag kyang lo stong du gnasasozhes bshad do//zhes gsungs pa dang /lung phran tshegs su yang de dang 'dra bar gsungs la/snying rje pad dkar du stong dang lnga brgya/zla ba snying po'i ༷dor nyis stong /rdo rje gcod pa'i lnga brgya tha ma zhes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6popa'i 'grel par lo phyed dang sum stong / 'bum ṭīka tu lo lnga stong gnas par bshad pa sogs mang na'ang / 'dir dang po gnyis ltar bya dgos shing / bod 'dir spyi skad la/ dang po gsum ni drang don du 'grel rigs te/ 'grel tshul/ dgongs gzhi/ dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas 'grel ba'i phyir/ der thal/ dgongs gzhi rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgyud la skye ba rim gyis nyung du song ba dang / dgos pa gdul bya rnams skyo ba bskyed pa dang / dngos la gnod byed/ lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa nyid kyis 'grub pa'i phyir/ zhes smra'o/ /des na bstan pa lnga stong du gnas pa las/ lnga brgya phrag bcu'i dang po dgra bcom pa/ gnyisapa phyir 'ong / gsum pa rgyun zhugs/ bzhi pa shes rab/ lnga pa ting nge 'dzin/ drug pa tshul khrims/ bdun pa mngon pa/ brgyad pa mdo sde/ dgu pa 'dul ba/ bcu pa ni rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ de lnga brgya phrag gang gi dus yin pa gzhag tu yod de/ 'das lo mang nyung gi phyogs sogs nas/ mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul mang yang / mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug thamasacad mkhyen pa nor bzang rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa ltar/ 'o skol gyi ston pa drag po lcags sbrel la sku bltams pa 'di nyid mya ngan (175na sgos 'das pa nas 'go bzung ste/ da lta'i rab byung bcu gcig pa me khyi yan la lnga brgya phrag lnga rdzogs te/ tshul khrims kyi le'u'i lo nyer bdun gyi steng du sleb pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ bstan bcos 'dir bshad pa'i lugs rnams grub mtha' smra ba gang gi lugs yin pa gzhag tu yod de/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen bdag gis brtsams pa'i ma wa zhe pa'i chos phal cher ni kha che bye brag smra ba'i grub mtha'i tshul du bshad pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos 'dir nyes par bshad pa gang yin pa de chos can/ mngon pa'i mdo la skyon yod pa la brten nas byung ba ma yin te/ rtsom pa po bdag gi nyes par bshad bas dam pa'i chos kyi tshul la tshad mar gyur pa'i sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das la bzod par gsol ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de kho na nyid ma mthong —658
