chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las rtsom pa mthar phyin tshul bshad pa/ (phanazhing / rang dgar spyod par gyur pa'i skye bo ni chos can/ khyod rnams kyi ngan rtog gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni dkrugs shing dri ma can du byas te/ de ltar byas pa la dgag sgrub dang / sel bar byed pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa ni zum zhing mya ngan las 'das par gyur/ dpang por 'os par gyur pa'i shing rta chen po sogs phal cher zad pa de'i phyir/ des na thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis bag yod bsten par rigs te/ thub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/lkog mar srog phyin pa dang 'dra bar yun ring du mi gnas pa ni/ snyigs ma rnams stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang byung yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / de'i sras bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa rnams mchog tu zhi bar gshegs pas/ 'gro ba rnams mgon med par gyur te/'doms pa med pa'i yon tan rnams 'joms par byed pa ni dug gsum gyi dri mas/ deng sang 'jig (175brten gyi khams 'di na/ dga' dgur spyod pa mthong ba'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa ni so thar gyi mdo las gsungs pa ltar thar 'dod dang / bag yod la bskul ba yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni/ dus nam yang mi nub ste/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus kun du rgyas pa'i phyir/ chosamangon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa 'di ni chos can/ khyod rtsom pa po'i rten gyi gang zag yod de/shākya'i bstan la zhugs pa'i dge slong / slob dpon chen po dbyig gi gnyen gyis mdzad pa las yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos 'di chos can/ khyod rgya dpe las bod skad du sgyur ba po yod de/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra ste/ rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegasakyis skad gsar bcad kyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ chos mngon pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa/chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bshad zin to/ /—659

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'amadzad byang /smras pa/ legs byas mes po'i thod las rab 'ongs dal 'byor rten gyi yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /nyon mongs dug gsum mi gtsang 'dam gyi rnyog pa mtha' dag rab tu gsal te yang dag pa'i//dngas shing bsil ba'i dri med chu rgyun dgra bcom go 'phang pad dkar mig gi zhabs bsil dag /mngon du byas pas blo ldan skye bo skal ldan shing rta dga' byed phyir na ngang tshul des/ /'byul med gsal bar ston pa'i chos mngon sde bdun 'chi med dga' tshal nas/ /snying por gyur pa'i mdzod kyi bstan bcos tshig nyung don rgyas yongs 'du'i ljon/ /legs bshad 'bras bu ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin rang gir spyod cing gzhan dag la/ /tshim pa med par ster ba'i byed po mkhas mchoge dbyig gnyen skabs gsum gtso/ /gang gi dgongs don 'grel ba'i bstan bcos dag /kha ba'i ljongs (176na)'dir byed po mang mchis kyang / /la la don nyung tshig rgyas 'ga' zhig tu/ /log par 'grel zhing sla sar rgyas bshad byed/ /chos rgyal mes dbon ska cog lo paṇa dang / rin bzang sa lo shong dpang bu ston rje/ /rgyal dbang tsong kha pa sogs mkhas grub kyi/ /rnam thar nyin byed nub kyi rir nye zhing / /mi chen gdol ba'i phru gu dar zab kyis/ /phang phung mdzes par byas te mthon po'i khrir/ /blun po'i 'khor tsho gis dbus na 'gying ba yi/ /ba mos thub bstan pad tshal bcom gyi dogs/ /chos spyod bcu yi grub pa rgyab bor nas/ kha grag dpung dang rgyu nor g.yo khram gyis/ /'gro ba'i phan bde sgrub par rlom byed na/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i gtso de 'khrul bar nges/ /rigs mthun mtshan mo'i bya dang lhan cig tu/ /grub rtags rdzun zog brag la gnas bcas shing / /blang dor lta ba'i mig gnyis zum gyur pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin 'byung po'i 'dab ldan ches cher mang / /rtogs pa'i yon tan brjod byar ston byed pa'i/ /lung gi bstan bcos 'ga' yang mi shes par/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras su khas len na/ khyu dang —660

chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las rtsom pa mthar phyin tshul bshad pa/ (phan gos bu'i rnam gzhag nges par rdzun//dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis bstan bcos 'di mdzad tshe//dpang gyur skye bo zad ces thugs 'byung na//deng dus ba lang rdzi 'dra mang po yis//'gro ba'i 'dren pa byed 'dir ci zhig gsung //ding sang bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa dag/ches cher nyams shing phyogasa'adir gzhol ba'i blo//'dzin pa nyung phyir gzhan la phan dka' yang //rang gi yid la bsgom phyir cung zad bkod//za zi'i tshig gi phreng ba'i glegs bam dang //gnad 'gag 'gol sar bzhag pa'i dka' 'grel dang //gzhan gyis brtsams par rang gi sbyar byang dag/brgyab pa'i bstan bcos rnams dang 'di mi 'dra/176bajon rabs rgan po'i ngag sgros lhur len dang //mtha' dpyod tshig 'grel spangs pa'i bshad yams dang //'brel med rang bzo'i gtam tsam ma byas par//'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung rgyun yi ger bkod//dge 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rta bdun can//lung dang rtogs pa'i mkha' la rab 'phags te//phan bde'i 'dab stong ches cher rgyas pa yis//ye shes mchogo gi sbrang rtsir spyod gyur cig/blo bzang 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i rgyud//grags snyan nga ro srid pa'i rtse mo mā/ches cher bsgrags pas rgol ngan ri dwags tshogs//'joms shing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa rgyas par shog/chos mngon gzhung lugs chu shel dbang po dag/dka' 'grel cha shas yongs su 'phel ba yis//thos bsam sgom pa'i utpal dkar po'i tshal//'dzum zhing snang ba'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig khesachos mngon pa mdzod gsal bar byed pa chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di yang /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud dor te/bur smig gi bla gos kyis mdzes par klubs pa'i slob dpon rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis/rang phyogs kyi bstan pa 'di la mngon pa'i skor mtha' chod pa'i yig cha cung zad dkon par 'dug pas 'di lta bu zhig gyis shig ces bka' bstsal pa dang /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos kyi khrir mab par mdzes pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po chos rgyal bkra shis kyi gsung gis bskul zhing /ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa dang /riXlam smra ba'i 'dus sde'i khyu mchog mkhas mang blo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pogasal gling gi slob dpon don mthun gyi 'chad nyan pa dam chos rnam rgyal/legs bshad chos 'khor gling gi slob dpon bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dang /rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang chos grags grwa mang rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas/dang por yongs 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi drung du/chos 'di lan kha yar thos pa dang /rang 'grel gnyis dgongs pa bstun zhing /rang gzhan gyi mkhas pa du ma'i yig cha la zhib tu dpyad de/gzhung don rnams ma lus par bkral zhing /spyi don dang mtha' dpyod kyis brgyan dgos pa rnams kyis spud de/mtho ris kyi dge mtshan mtha' dag gcig tu 'du ba'i yul lho phyogs sman ljongs yar klungs su/za hor gyi rigs las skyes pa'i chos mngon smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/'phags yul pa a kṣa ya zhes pa mi zad par 'bod cing /rgya nag pa bin zu zhes me khyir brjod pa'i yongs grags kyi hor zla lnga pa/'dul mngon pa'i dus tshigs la bzhin phye ba'i dbyar zla gnyis pa rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la/gsung rab rgya mtsho'i sti gnas dpal ldan 'bras skrungs chos kyi sde chen por grub par bgyis pa'i dge tsho gos rgya mtsho'i mthu las/rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa rin po che rgyas par gyur cig/su sti pra dza saḥtshogs gnyas ma na shel gsar pa'i rtsig ngos la//mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan bye ba 'char byed pa'i//nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras//gang gi chos ma ho sdosnod ga tho'i rgyun//med byung blo gros hub gcig gis 'thung ba'i//gnas lnga rig pa dbyig gnyen dzaḥre//gzhung lugs 'dzin mkhas 'jam dbyangs mi'i srid pa//yongs bzung dkon mchog chos 'phel gsung rgyun rnams//tshangs dbang sras mo dgyes pa'i 'dzum bag gis//nam yang ba 'ad pa'i rtse dga' mi gtong ba//blun rmongs kun 'joms 'jigs med rdo rje'i sdes//legs bshad dri za'i rgyud mang 'brol ba 'di//mtho btsun 'od gsal lha yi gdung las byon//lugs gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i mkhyen spyan yangs//sdebazhi'i sgo 'phar ma ༷༷yongs phye ba//ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan

dpal bzang pos/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan lus phra'i rna lam du/ /mi bzad chos sbyin par gyi nor bu'i dpya/ /rnam par brgyan pa'i mtshungs med snying stobs kyis/ /yangs pa'i sa chen 'di yang 'degasasam snyam/ /sgyu ma'i rol gar gzigs mor mtshar ba la/ /yid kyi mdud pa 'grol byed sor mo'i 'phrul/ /bsgyur ba'i byed po rtsa ri dar rgyas dang / /skar ma dar po'i rnam dpyod dag las so/ /gang zhig tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i skye bo kun/ /tshogs gnyis nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ches/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i char chen po/ /'dzad med kun tu bsnyil ba'i bkra shis shog /maṅga lo// //
